Dưới đây là patch additive cho gateway/control_tower_gateway.mjs để tích hợp lớp vận hành V3.1 qua HTTP.
Giả định:
gateway hiện tại đang dùng Express,
trong file đã có const app = express();,
bạn muốn không phá route cũ, chỉ mount thêm nhóm route /ops.
Các route mới:
GET /ops — index mô tả endpoint
GET /ops/status — trạng thái vận hành tổng hợp
GET /ops/dashboard — serve drift_dashboard.html
GET /ops/allocation — đọc allocation_plan.json
GET /ops/leaderboard — đọc leaderboard từ snapshot governance mới nhất
POST /ops/run-once — chạy analytics/v3_1_scheduler.py --once
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1) Bổ sung import ở đầu file
Nếu chưa có, thêm các import này vào phần đầu gateway/control_tower_gateway.mjs:
import fs from 'node:fs';
import fsp from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2) Nếu file chưa có JSON body parser thì thêm
Ngay sau chỗ tạo app:

Nếu file đã có app.use(express.json(...)) rồi thì không cần thêm lần nữa.

3) Dán block patch này trước app.listen(...)
// =========================
// APEX V3.1 OPS PATCH START
// =========================

function mountApexV31OpsRoutes({ app, express, logger = console } = {}) {
  if (!app) {
    throw new Error('mountApexV31OpsRoutes requires { app }');
  }
  if (!express) {
    throw new Error('mountApexV31OpsRoutes requires { express }');
  }

  const info = (...args) =>
    typeof logger?.info === 'function' ? logger.info(...args) : logger.log(...args);
  const warn = (...args) =>
    typeof logger?.warn === 'function' ? logger.warn(...args) : logger.log(...args);
  const error = (...args) =>
    typeof logger?.error === 'function' ? logger.error(...args) : logger.log(...args);

  const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
  const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
  const PROJECT_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

  const TRUE_SET = new Set(['1', 'true', 'yes', 'on']);

  function asBool(value, fallback = false) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return fallback;
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
    return TRUE_SET.has(String(value).trim().toLowerCase());
  }

  function asInt(value, fallback) {
    const n = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.trunc(n) : fallback;
  }

  function normalizeRoutePrefix(value) {
    const raw = String(value || '/ops').trim();
    const trimmed = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
    return `/${trimmed || 'ops'}`;
  }

  function resolveProjectPath(value) {
    if (!value) return null;
    return path.isAbsolute(value) ? value : path.resolve(PROJECT_ROOT, value);
  }

  function envPath(name, fallback) {
    return resolveProjectPath(process.env[name] || fallback);
  }

  async function fileExists(filePath) {
    if (!filePath) return false;
    try {
      await fsp.access(filePath, fs.constants.F_OK);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  async function readJsonSafe(filePath) {
    if (!filePath) return null;
    try {
      const raw = await fsp.readFile(filePath, 'utf8');
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err?.code === 'ENOENT') return null;
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async function statSafe(filePath) {
    if (!filePath) return null;
    try {
      return await fsp.stat(filePath);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function sanitizeError(err) {
    if (!err) return null;
    return {
      name: err.name || 'Error',
      message: err.message || String(err),
      code: err.code || null,
      stack: err.stack || null,
    };
  }

  function appendTail(current, chunk, maxLen = 64_000) {
    const next = `${current || ''}${chunk || ''}`;
    return next.length <= maxLen ? next : next.slice(next.length - maxLen);
  }

  function buildCounts(rows, key) {
    const out = {};
    for (const row of rows || []) {
      const k = String(row?.[key] ?? 'UNKNOWN');
      out[k] = (out[k] || 0) + 1;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function extractToken(req) {
    const headerToken = req.get('x-ops-token');
    if (headerToken) return String(headerToken).trim();

    const auth = req.get('authorization');
    if (auth && auth.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      return auth.slice('Bearer '.length).trim();
    }
    return '';
  }

  function requireOpsAuth({ write = false, read = false } = {}) {
    return (req, res, next) => {
      const mustProtectRead = read && cfg.protectReadRoutes && !!cfg.opsApiToken;
      const mustProtectWrite = write && !!cfg.opsApiToken;
      if (!mustProtectRead && !mustProtectWrite) {
        next();
        return;
      }

      const token = extractToken(req);
      if (token && token === cfg.opsApiToken) {
        next();
        return;
      }

      res.status(401).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
        message: 'Missing or invalid ops token',
      });
    };
  }

  const cfg = {
    routePrefix: normalizeRoutePrefix(process.env.OPS_ROUTE_PREFIX || '/ops'),
    opsApiToken: process.env.OPS_API_TOKEN || '',
    protectReadRoutes: asBool(process.env.OPS_PROTECT_READ_ROUTES, false),
    allowRunOnce: asBool(process.env.OPS_ALLOW_RUN_ONCE, true),
    pythonBin: process.env.PYTHON_BIN || process.env.PYTHON || 'python3',
    runOnceTimeoutMs: asInt(process.env.OPS_RUN_ONCE_TIMEOUT_MS, 15 * 60 * 1000),

    runtimeDir: envPath('APEX_RUNTIME_DIR', path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime')),
    outRoot: envPath('APEX_OUT_ROOT', path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'backtests', 'v3')),

    dashboardHtmlPath: envPath(
      'APEX_DASHBOARD_HTML',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'dashboard', 'drift_dashboard.html'),
    ),

    allocationPlanPath: envPath(
      'APEX_ALLOCATION_PLAN',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'allocation_plan.json'),
    ),

    allocationStatePath: envPath(
      'APEX_ALLOCATION_STATE',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'allocation_state.json'),
    ),

    notificationStatePath: envPath(
      'APEX_NOTIFICATION_STATE',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'notification_state.json'),
    ),

    schedulerStatePath: envPath(
      'APEX_SCHEDULER_STATE',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'scheduler_state.json'),
    ),

    governanceStatePath: envPath(
      'APEX_GOVERNANCE_STATE',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'governance_state.json'),
    ),

    liveRegistryPath: envPath(
      'APEX_LIVE_REGISTRY',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'active_registry.json'),
    ),

    governanceSnapshotPath: process.env.APEX_GOVERNANCE_SNAPSHOT_PATH
      ? resolveProjectPath(process.env.APEX_GOVERNANCE_SNAPSHOT_PATH)
      : null,

    schedulerEntry: envPath(
      'APEX_SCHEDULER_ENTRY',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'analytics', 'v3_1_scheduler.py'),
    ),

    logsDir: envPath(
      'APEX_GATEWAY_LOG_DIR',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'logs'),
    ),
  };

  const schedulerDefaults = {
    draws: envPath('APEX_DRAWS_PATH', path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'xsmb_full_draws.json')),
    methodsDir: envPath('APEX_METHODS_DIR', path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'methods')),
    registry: envPath(
      'APEX_REGISTRY_PATH',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'methods', 'registry.json'),
    ),
    governanceConfig: envPath(
      'APEX_GOVERNANCE_CONFIG',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'governance', 'governance_config.json'),
    ),
    outRoot: cfg.outRoot,
    governanceState: cfg.governanceStatePath,
    liveRegistryOut: cfg.liveRegistryPath,
    dateFrom: process.env.APEX_DATE_FROM || null,
    dateTo: process.env.APEX_DATE_TO || null,
    topKEval: asInt(process.env.APEX_TOP_K_EVAL, 3),
    runTag: null,
    allocationOut: cfg.allocationPlanPath,
    allocationState: cfg.allocationStatePath,
    allocationConfig: process.env.APEX_ALLOCATION_CONFIG
      ? resolveProjectPath(process.env.APEX_ALLOCATION_CONFIG)
      : null,
    allocationCsvOut: envPath(
      'APEX_ALLOCATION_CSV',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'allocation_candidates.csv'),
    ),
    dashboardOutHtml: cfg.dashboardHtmlPath,
    dashboardTitle: process.env.APEX_DASHBOARD_TITLE || 'APEX V3.1 Drift Dashboard',
    dashboardLastNDays: asInt(process.env.APEX_DASHBOARD_LAST_N_DAYS, 90),
    notificationState: cfg.notificationStatePath,
    schedulerState: cfg.schedulerStatePath,
    lockFile: envPath(
      'APEX_SCHEDULER_LOCK',
      path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'data', 'runtime', 'v3_1_scheduler.lock'),
    ),
    alwaysSendSummary: false,
    noStdout: false,
  };

  const runState = {
    activeJob: null,
    history: [],
  };

  function serializeJob(job) {
    if (!job) return null;
    const { child, completionPromise, ...rest } = job;
    return { ...rest };
  }

  function pushJobHistory(job) {
    runState.history.unshift(serializeJob(job));
    runState.history = runState.history.slice(0, 20);
  }

  function buildSchedulerArgs(overrides = {}) {
    const merged = {
      ...schedulerDefaults,
      ...overrides,
    };

    const args = [
      cfg.schedulerEntry,
      '--once',
      '--draws',
      merged.draws,
      '--methods-dir',
      merged.methodsDir,
      '--out-root',
      merged.outRoot,
      '--governance-state',
      merged.governanceState,
      '--live-registry-out',
      merged.liveRegistryOut,
      '--top-k-eval',
      String(merged.topKEval),
      '--allocation-out',
      merged.allocationOut,
      '--allocation-state',
      merged.allocationState,
      '--dashboard-out-html',
      merged.dashboardOutHtml,
      '--dashboard-title',
      merged.dashboardTitle,
      '--dashboard-last-n-days',
      String(merged.dashboardLastNDays),
      '--notification-state',
      merged.notificationState,
      '--scheduler-state',
      merged.schedulerState,
      '--lock-file',
      merged.lockFile,
    ];

    if (merged.registry) args.push('--registry', merged.registry);
    if (merged.governanceConfig) args.push('--governance-config', merged.governanceConfig);
    if (merged.dateFrom) args.push('--date-from', merged.dateFrom);
    if (merged.dateTo) args.push('--date-to', merged.dateTo);
    if (merged.runTag) args.push('--run-tag', merged.runTag);
    if (merged.allocationConfig) args.push('--allocation-config', merged.allocationConfig);
    if (merged.allocationCsvOut) args.push('--allocation-csv-out', merged.allocationCsvOut);
    if (merged.alwaysSendSummary) args.push('--always-send-summary');
    if (merged.noStdout) args.push('--no-stdout');

    return args;
  }

  async function launchRunOnceJob(overrides = {}) {
    if (!cfg.allowRunOnce) {
      const err = new Error('RUN_ONCE_DISABLED');
      err.httpStatus = 403;
      throw err;
    }

    if (runState.activeJob?.status === 'RUNNING') {
      const err = new Error('RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE');
      err.httpStatus = 409;
      err.payload = serializeJob(runState.activeJob);
      throw err;
    }

    await fsp.mkdir(cfg.logsDir, { recursive: true });

    const jobId = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const logPath = path.join(cfg.logsDir, `ops_run_once_${jobId}.log`);
    const args = buildSchedulerArgs(overrides);

    const child = spawn(cfg.pythonBin, args, {
      cwd: PROJECT_ROOT,
      env: process.env,
      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
    });

    const job = {
      jobId,
      status: 'RUNNING',
      startedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
      finishedAtUtc: null,
      pid: child.pid || null,
      logPath,
      exitCode: null,
      signal: null,
      request: overrides,
      command: [cfg.pythonBin, ...args],
      stdoutTail: '',
      stderrTail: '',
      error: null,
      child,
      completionPromise: null,
    };

    runState.activeJob = job;

    const logStream = fs.createWriteStream(logPath, { flags: 'a' });
    let finalized = false;
    let completionResolve;
    let completionReject;

    job.completionPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      completionResolve = resolve;
      completionReject = reject;
    });

    function writeChunk(streamName, chunk) {
      const text = Buffer.isBuffer(chunk) ? chunk.toString('utf8') : String(chunk);
      const stamped = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] [${streamName}] ${text}`;
      logStream.write(stamped);
      if (streamName === 'stdout') {
        job.stdoutTail = appendTail(job.stdoutTail, text);
      } else {
        job.stderrTail = appendTail(job.stderrTail, text);
      }
    }

    function finalize(nextStatus, { exitCode = null, signal = null, err = null } = {}) {
      if (finalized) return;
      finalized = true;

      job.status = nextStatus;
      job.exitCode = exitCode;
      job.signal = signal;
      job.finishedAtUtc = new Date().toISOString();
      job.error = err ? sanitizeError(err) : null;

      try {
        logStream.end();
      } catch (_) {
        // ignore
      }

      runState.activeJob = null;
      pushJobHistory(job);
    }

    child.stdout?.on('data', (chunk) => writeChunk('stdout', chunk));
    child.stderr?.on('data', (chunk) => writeChunk('stderr', chunk));

    child.on('error', (err) => {
      finalize('ERROR', { exitCode: -1, err });
      completionReject(err);
      error('[ops/run-once] spawn error:', err);
    });

    child.on('close', (code, signal) => {
      const exitCode = Number.isInteger(code) ? code : -1;
      const nextStatus = exitCode === 0 ? 'SUCCESS' : 'ERROR';
      finalize(nextStatus, { exitCode, signal });
      completionResolve(serializeJob(job));
      info('[ops/run-once] completed:', { jobId: job.jobId, exitCode, signal });
    });

    info('[ops/run-once] started:', {
      jobId: job.jobId,
      pid: job.pid,
      logPath: job.logPath,
    });

    return job;
  }

  async function waitForJobCompletion(job) {
    let timeoutId = null;
    try {
      return await Promise.race([
        job.completionPromise,
        new Promise((_, reject) => {
          timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            const err = new Error(`RUN_ONCE_TIMEOUT_AFTER_${cfg.runOnceTimeoutMs}MS`);
            err.httpStatus = 504;
            reject(err);
          }, cfg.runOnceTimeoutMs);
        }),
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      if (job?.child && job.status === 'RUNNING') {
        try {
          job.child.kill('SIGTERM');
        } catch (_) {
          // ignore
        }
        const killer = setTimeout(() => {
          try {
            if (job.status === 'RUNNING') {
              job.child.kill('SIGKILL');
            }
          } catch (_) {
            // ignore
          }
        }, 5000);
        killer.unref?.();
      }
      throw err;
    } finally {
      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
  }

  async function discoverLatestManifestPath(rootDir) {
    const candidates = [];

    async function walk(dir, depth) {
      if (!dir || depth < 0) return;

      let entries = [];
      try {
        entries = await fsp.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
      } catch {
        return;
      }

      for (const entry of entries) {
        const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);

        if (entry.isFile() && entry.name === 'manifest.json') {
          const st = await statSafe(fullPath);
          candidates.push({
            path: fullPath,
            mtimeMs: st?.mtimeMs || 0,
          });
          continue;
        }

        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
          await walk(fullPath, depth - 1);
        }
      }
    }

    await walk(path.join(rootDir, 'runs'), 3);
    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      await walk(rootDir, 3);
    }

    candidates.sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs);
    return candidates[0]?.path || null;
  }

  async function loadLatestManifestBundle() {
    const manifestPath = await discoverLatestManifestPath(cfg.outRoot);
    if (!manifestPath) {
      return { manifestPath: null, manifest: null };
    }
    const manifest = await readJsonSafe(manifestPath);
    return { manifestPath, manifest };
  }

  async function resolveGovernanceSnapshotPath() {
    if (cfg.governanceSnapshotPath && (await fileExists(cfg.governanceSnapshotPath))) {
      return cfg.governanceSnapshotPath;
    }

    const allocation = await readJsonSafe(cfg.allocationPlanPath);
    const fromAllocation = allocation?.source_governance_snapshot
      ? resolveProjectPath(allocation.source_governance_snapshot)
      : null;
    if (fromAllocation && (await fileExists(fromAllocation))) {
      return fromAllocation;
    }

    const { manifest } = await loadLatestManifestBundle();
    const candidates = [
      manifest?.artifacts?.governance_snapshot_path,
      manifest?.artifacts?.governanceSnapshotPath,
      manifest?.artifacts?.governance_dir
        ? path.join(resolveProjectPath(manifest.artifacts.governance_dir), 'governance_snapshot.json')
        : null,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map(resolveProjectPath);

    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      if (candidate && (await fileExists(candidate))) {
        return candidate;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  function summarizeAllocation(plan) {
    if (!plan) return null;
    return {
      generated_at_utc: plan.generated_at_utc || null,
      source_governance_snapshot: plan.source_governance_snapshot || null,
      production_method_id: plan?.runtime?.production_method_id || null,
      shadow_method_ids: Array.isArray(plan?.runtime?.shadow_method_ids)
        ? plan.runtime.shadow_method_ids
        : [],
      reserve_method_ids: Array.isArray(plan?.runtime?.reserve_method_ids)
        ? plan.runtime.reserve_method_ids
        : [],
      switch_action: plan?.selection?.switch_action || null,
      switch_reason: plan?.selection?.switch_reason || null,
      champion_method_id: plan?.selection?.champion?.method_id || null,
      challenger_method_ids: Array.isArray(plan?.selection?.challengers)
        ? plan.selection.challengers.map((x) => x.method_id)
        : [],
    };
  }

  function summarizeManifest(manifest, manifestPath) {
    if (!manifest) return null;
    return {
      manifest_path: manifestPath,
      run_tag: manifest.run_tag || null,
      generated_at_utc: manifest.generated_at_utc || null,
      artifacts: manifest.artifacts || null,
    };
  }

  const router = express.Router();

  router.get('/', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    res.json({
      ok: true,
      route_prefix: cfg.routePrefix,
      endpoints: {
        index: `GET ${cfg.routePrefix}`,
        status: `GET ${cfg.routePrefix}/status`,
        dashboard: `GET ${cfg.routePrefix}/dashboard`,
        allocation: `GET ${cfg.routePrefix}/allocation`,
        leaderboard: `GET ${cfg.routePrefix}/leaderboard`,
        run_once: `POST ${cfg.routePrefix}/run-once`,
      },
      security: {
        read_protected: cfg.protectReadRoutes && !!cfg.opsApiToken,
        write_protected: !!cfg.opsApiToken,
        allow_run_once: cfg.allowRunOnce,
      },
    });
  });

  router.get('/dashboard', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const exists = await fileExists(cfg.dashboardHtmlPath);
      if (!exists) {
        res.status(404).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'DASHBOARD_NOT_FOUND',
          path: cfg.dashboardHtmlPath,
        });
        return;
      }

      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
      res.sendFile(cfg.dashboardHtmlPath);
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/dashboard] error:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'DASHBOARD_READ_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  router.get('/allocation', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const plan = await readJsonSafe(cfg.allocationPlanPath);
      if (!plan) {
        res.status(404).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'ALLOCATION_NOT_FOUND',
          path: cfg.allocationPlanPath,
        });
        return;
      }

      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
      res.json({
        ok: true,
        path: cfg.allocationPlanPath,
        summary: summarizeAllocation(plan),
        allocation: plan,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/allocation] error:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'ALLOCATION_READ_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  router.get('/leaderboard', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const snapshotPath = await resolveGovernanceSnapshotPath();
      const snapshot = snapshotPath ? await readJsonSafe(snapshotPath) : null;
      const allocation = await readJsonSafe(cfg.allocationPlanPath);

      let rows = [];
      let source = null;

      if (Array.isArray(snapshot?.leaderboard)) {
        rows = [...snapshot.leaderboard];
        source = 'governance_snapshot.leaderboard';
      } else if (Array.isArray(allocation?.diagnostics?.candidate_table)) {
        rows = [...allocation.diagnostics.candidate_table];
        source = 'allocation_plan.diagnostics.candidate_table';
      }

      const q = String(req.query.q || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const role = String(req.query.role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const band = String(req.query.band || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const lifecycle = String(req.query.lifecycle || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const limit = Math.max(0, asInt(req.query.limit, 0));
      const offset = Math.max(0, asInt(req.query.offset, 0));

      if (q) {
        rows = rows.filter((row) => {
          const haystack = [
            row.method_id,
            row.label,
            row.band,
            row.portfolio_role,
            row.lifecycle_status,
          ]
            .map((x) => String(x ?? ''))
            .join(' | ')
            .toLowerCase();
          return haystack.includes(q);
        });
      }

      if (role) {
        rows = rows.filter((row) => String(row.portfolio_role || '').toUpperCase() === role);
      }

      if (band) {
        rows = rows.filter((row) => String(row.band || '').toUpperCase() === band);
      }

      if (lifecycle) {
        rows = rows.filter((row) => String(row.lifecycle_status || '').toUpperCase() === lifecycle);
      }

      const total = rows.length;
      const pagedRows = limit > 0 ? rows.slice(offset, offset + limit) : rows.slice(offset);

      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
      res.json({
        ok: true,
        source,
        snapshot_path: snapshotPath,
        generated_at_utc: snapshot?.generated_at_utc || null,
        portfolio: snapshot?.portfolio || null,
        count: total,
        offset,
        limit,
        counts: {
          by_band: buildCounts(rows, 'band'),
          by_role: buildCounts(rows, 'portfolio_role'),
          by_lifecycle: buildCounts(rows, 'lifecycle_status'),
        },
        rows: pagedRows,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/leaderboard] error:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'LEADERBOARD_READ_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  router.get('/status', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const [
        dashboardExists,
        schedulerState,
        governanceState,
        notificationState,
        allocationPlan,
        liveRegistry,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        fileExists(cfg.dashboardHtmlPath),
        readJsonSafe(cfg.schedulerStatePath),
        readJsonSafe(cfg.governanceStatePath),
        readJsonSafe(cfg.notificationStatePath),
        readJsonSafe(cfg.allocationPlanPath),
        readJsonSafe(cfg.liveRegistryPath),
      ]);

      const { manifestPath, manifest } = await loadLatestManifestBundle();
      const snapshotPath = await resolveGovernanceSnapshotPath();
      const snapshot = snapshotPath ? await readJsonSafe(snapshotPath) : null;

      const leaderboard = Array.isArray(snapshot?.leaderboard) ? snapshot.leaderboard : [];
      const top3 = leaderboard.slice(0, 3);

      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
      res.json({
        ok: true,
        gateway_time_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        route_prefix: cfg.routePrefix,
        paths: {
          runtime_dir: cfg.runtimeDir,
          out_root: cfg.outRoot,
          dashboard_html: cfg.dashboardHtmlPath,
          allocation_plan: cfg.allocationPlanPath,
          scheduler_state: cfg.schedulerStatePath,
          governance_state: cfg.governanceStatePath,
          notification_state: cfg.notificationStatePath,
          live_registry: cfg.liveRegistryPath,
          governance_snapshot: snapshotPath,
          latest_manifest: manifestPath,
        },
        dashboard: {
          exists: dashboardExists,
          url: `${cfg.routePrefix}/dashboard`,
        },
        scheduler: {
          state: schedulerState,
          active_job: serializeJob(runState.activeJob),
          recent_jobs: runState.history,
          allow_run_once: cfg.allowRunOnce,
        },
        allocation: summarizeAllocation(allocationPlan),
        governance: {
          generated_at_utc: snapshot?.generated_at_utc || null,
          leaderboard_size: leaderboard.length,
          portfolio: snapshot?.portfolio || null,
          counts: {
            by_band: buildCounts(leaderboard, 'band'),
            by_role: buildCounts(leaderboard, 'portfolio_role'),
            by_lifecycle: buildCounts(leaderboard, 'lifecycle_status'),
          },
          top3,
        },
        governance_state: governanceState,
        notification_state: notificationState,
        live_registry: liveRegistry,
        latest_manifest: summarizeManifest(manifest, manifestPath),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/status] error:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'OPS_STATUS_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  router.post('/run-once', requireOpsAuth({ write: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const body = req.body || {};
      const wait = asBool(body.wait ?? req.query.wait, false);

      const overrides = {
        runTag: body.run_tag ?? body.runTag ?? null,
        dateFrom: body.date_from ?? body.dateFrom ?? schedulerDefaults.dateFrom,
        dateTo: body.date_to ?? body.dateTo ?? schedulerDefaults.dateTo,
        topKEval: asInt(body.top_k_eval ?? body.topKEval, schedulerDefaults.topKEval),
        dashboardLastNDays: asInt(
          body.dashboard_last_n_days ?? body.dashboardLastNDays,
          schedulerDefaults.dashboardLastNDays,
        ),
        dashboardTitle: body.dashboard_title ?? body.dashboardTitle ?? schedulerDefaults.dashboardTitle,
        alwaysSendSummary: asBool(
          body.always_send_summary ?? body.alwaysSendSummary,
          false,
        ),
        noStdout: asBool(body.no_stdout ?? body.noStdout, false),
      };

      const job = await launchRunOnceJob(overrides);

      if (!wait) {
        res.status(202).json({
          ok: true,
          accepted: true,
          message: 'Run started',
          job: serializeJob(job),
        });
        return;
      }

      const finalJob = await waitForJobCompletion(job);
      const [schedulerState, allocationPlan] = await Promise.all([
        readJsonSafe(cfg.schedulerStatePath),
        readJsonSafe(cfg.allocationPlanPath),
      ]);

      const success = finalJob.exitCode === 0;
      res.status(success ? 200 : 500).json({
        ok: success,
        completed: true,
        job: finalJob,
        scheduler_state: schedulerState,
        allocation_summary: summarizeAllocation(allocationPlan),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err?.message === 'RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE') {
        res.status(err.httpStatus || 409).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE',
          active_job: err.payload || serializeJob(runState.activeJob),
        });
        return;
      }

      if (err?.message === 'RUN_ONCE_DISABLED') {
        res.status(err.httpStatus || 403).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'RUN_ONCE_DISABLED',
        });
        return;
      }

      error('[ops/run-once] error:', err);
      res.status(err.httpStatus || 500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'RUN_ONCE_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  app.use(cfg.routePrefix, router);

  info('[ops] APEX V3.1 routes mounted', {
    routePrefix: cfg.routePrefix,
    dashboardHtmlPath: cfg.dashboardHtmlPath,
    schedulerEntry: cfg.schedulerEntry,
  });
}

// Mount routes
mountApexV31OpsRoutes({
  app,
  express,
  logger: console, // thay bằng logger hiện tại của bạn nếu có
});

// =======================
// APEX V3.1 OPS PATCH END
// =======================

5) Ví dụ gọi API
Xem trạng thái
curl -H "x-ops-token: your-secret-token" \
  http://localhost:3000/ops/status
Xem allocation
curl -H "x-ops-token: your-secret-token" \
  http://localhost:3000/ops/allocation
Xem leaderboard
curl -H "x-ops-token: your-secret-token" \
  "http://localhost:3000/ops/leaderboard?limit=20&role=ACTIVE"
Chạy run-once bất đồng bộ
curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-ops-token: your-secret-token" \
  http://localhost:3000/ops/run-once \
  -d '{
    "run_tag": "manual_ops_2026_04_09",
    "date_from": "2020-01-01",
    "date_to": "2026-04-09",
    "top_k_eval": 3
  }'
Chạy run-once và đợi hoàn tất
curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-ops-token: your-secret-token" \
  "http://localhost:3000/ops/run-once?wait=1" \
  -d '{
    "run_tag": "manual_sync_2026_04_09",
    "always_send_summary": true
  }'

    }

    .flash.show { display: block; }
    .flash.ok { border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.35); background: rgba(34,197,94,0.12); }
    .flash.warn { border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.35); background: rgba(245,158,11,0.12); }
    .flash.bad { border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.35); background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12); }
    .flash.info { border-color: rgba(96,165,250,0.35); background: rgba(96,165,250,0.12); }

    .split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .table-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      overflow: auto;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border-radius: 14px;
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      min-width: 980px;
      background: rgba(5, 10, 25, 0.12);
    }

    th, td {
      padding: 12px 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: top;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    th {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      background: #13204a;
      z-index: 1;
      color: #cfe0ff;
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    tr:hover td {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    }

    pre {
      margin: 0;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      word-break: break-word;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      background: #0a1127;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 14px;
      min-height: 200px;
      max-height: 560px;
      overflow: auto;
    }

    details summary {
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .raw-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .small {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .inline-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .checkbox {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding-top: 24px;
    }

    .checkbox input {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .form-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .toolbar { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .split { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .raw-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .container {
        width: min(100vw - 16px, 1440px);
        padding-top: 12px;
      }
      .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .toolbar { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .span-2, .span-3, .span-6 { grid-column: auto; }
      h1 { font-size: 24px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container">
    <header class="hero">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <h1>APEX V3.1 Ops Console</h1>
            <p class="subtitle">
              Mini UI vận hành trực tiếp trên browser qua gateway route
              <code>${routePrefix}</code>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="badge-row">
            <span class="badge info">Read protected: ${readProtected ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}</span>
            <span class="badge ${allowRunOnce ? 'ok' : 'bad'}">Run once: ${allowRunOnce ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div id="flash" class="flash"></div>

    <section class="panel" style="margin-bottom: 16px;">
      <div class="section-head">
        <h2>Phiên làm việc</h2>
        <div id="authState" class="small">Chưa có token trong phiên trình duyệt.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="toolbar">
        <div>
          <label for="tokenInput">OPS token</label>
          <input id="tokenInput" type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Nhập OPS token nếu route đang được bảo vệ" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="applyTokenBtn" type="button">Dùng token</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="clearTokenBtn" type="button" class="ghost">Xóa token</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="refreshBtn" type="button" class="ghost">Refresh</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="autoRefreshBtn" type="button" class="ghost">Auto refresh: ON</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="openDashboardBtn" type="button" class="ghost">Mở dashboard</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="grid cards">
      <article class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2>Tổng quan</h2>
          <span id="overviewHint" class="small">Đang chờ dữ liệu...</span>
        </div>
        <div id="overviewCard"></div>
      </article>

      <article class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2>Champion / Shadow</h2>
          <span class="small">Từ allocation + governance snapshot</span>
        </div>
        <div id="championCard"></div>
      </article>

      <article class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2>Scheduler</h2>
          <span class="small">Run state + lock + active job</span>
        </div>
        <div id="schedulerCard"></div>
      </article>

      <article class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2>Manifest / Governance</h2>
          <span class="small">Snapshot / latest manifest</span>
        </div>
        <div id="manifestCard"></div>
      </article>
    </section>

    <section class="panel">
      <div class="section-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Run once</h2>
          <div class="small">Gửi lệnh chạy scheduler V3.1 trực tiếp từ browser.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="badge-row" id="runOnceCapabilities"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-grid">
        <div class="span-2">
          <label for="runTagInput">run_tag</label>
          <input id="runTagInput" type="text" placeholder="ví dụ: manual_ops_2026_04_09_01" />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="dateFromInput">date_from</label>
          <input id="dateFromInput" type="date" />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="dateToInput">date_to</label>
          <input id="dateToInput" type="date" />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="topKEvalInput">top_k_eval</label>
          <input id="topKEvalInput" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="3" />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="dashboardLastNDaysInput">dashboard_last_n_days</label>
          <input id="dashboardLastNDaysInput" type="number" min="7" step="1" value="90" />
        </div>

        <div class="span-3">
          <label for="dashboardTitleInput">dashboard_title</label>
          <input id="dashboardTitleInput" type="text" placeholder="Để trống để dùng default từ server" />
        </div>

        <div class="checkbox">
          <input id="alwaysSendSummaryInput" type="checkbox" />
          <label for="alwaysSendSummaryInput" style="margin: 0;">always_send_summary</label>
        </div>

        <div class="checkbox">
          <input id="noStdoutInput" type="checkbox" />
          <label for="noStdoutInput" style="margin: 0;">no_stdout</label>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="runAsyncBtn" type="button">Run once (async)</button>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="runSyncBtn" type="button" class="success">Run once + wait</button>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="resetRunFormBtn" type="button" class="ghost">Reset form</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="split">
      <section class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <h2>Job hiện tại / gần nhất</h2>
            <div class="small">Auto refresh nhanh hơn khi job đang chạy.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="inline-actions">
            <button id="refreshStatusBtn" type="button" class="ghost">Refresh status</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="jobMeta" style="margin-bottom: 12px;"></div>
        <pre id="jobLog">Chưa có job nào.</pre>
      </section>

      <section class="panel">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <h2>Allocation summary</h2>
            <div class="small">Tóm tắt runtime allocation mới nhất.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="allocationSummary"></div>
      </section>
    </section>

    <section class="panel" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <div class="section-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Leaderboard</h2>
          <div class="small">Query trực tiếp từ <code>${routePrefix}/leaderboard</code>.</div>
        </div>
        <div id="leaderboardMeta" class="small">Chưa có dữ liệu.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-grid" style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
        <div class="span-2">
          <label for="lbQueryInput">Tìm kiếm</label>
          <input id="lbQueryInput" type="text" placeholder="method_id / label / band / role..." />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="lbRoleInput">role</label>
          <input id="lbRoleInput" type="text" placeholder="ACTIVE / SHADOW / ..." />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="lbBandInput">band</label>
          <input id="lbBandInput" type="text" placeholder="A / B / C / ..." />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="lbLifecycleInput">lifecycle</label>
          <input id="lbLifecycleInput" type="text" placeholder="ACTIVE / INCUBATING / ..." />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="lbLimitInput">limit</label>
          <input id="lbLimitInput" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="50" />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>&nbsp;</label>
          <button id="refreshLeaderboardBtn" type="button" class="ghost">Refresh leaderboard</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="leaderboardCounts" class="badge-row" style="margin-bottom: 12px;"></div>

      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>#</th>
              <th>Method</th>
              <th>Label</th>
              <th>Band</th>
              <th>Role</th>
              <th>Lifecycle</th>
              <th>Score</th>
              <th>Diagnostics</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="leaderboardBody">
            <tr>
              <td colspan="8" class="muted">Đang chờ dữ liệu...</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <details class="panel" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <summary>Raw API payload</summary>
      <div class="raw-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="small" style="margin-bottom: 8px;">/status</div>
          <pre id="rawStatus"></pre>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="small" style="margin-bottom: 8px;">/allocation</div>
          <pre id="rawAllocation"></pre>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="small" style="margin-bottom: 8px;">/leaderboard</div>
          <pre id="rawLeaderboard"></pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>

  <script>
    const UI_CONFIG = ${uiConfigJson};
    const STORAGE_KEY = 'apex_v31_ops_token';
    const state = {
      token: '',
      autoRefresh: true,
      timer: null,
      refreshing: false,
      lastStatus: null,
      lastAllocation: null,
      lastLeaderboard: null,
    };

    function qs(id) {
      return document.getElementById(id);
    }

    function h(value) {
      return String(value ?? '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }

    function toneForJobStatus(status) {
      const s = String(status || '').toUpperCase();
      if (s === 'SUCCESS') return 'ok';
      if (s === 'RUNNING') return 'info';
      if (s === 'ERROR') return 'bad';
      return 'warn';
    }

    function badge(text, tone) {
      return '<span class="badge ' + h(tone || '') + '">' + h(text) + '</span>';
    }

    function metric(label, valueHtml) {
      return '<div class="kv"><span>' + h(label) + '</span><strong>' + valueHtml + '</strong></div>';
    }

    function listBadges(items, tone, emptyText) {
      const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items.filter(Boolean) : [];
      if (arr.length === 0) {
        return '<span class="muted">' + h(emptyText || '—') + '</span>';
      }
      return '<div class="badge-row">' + arr.map(function (x) {
        return badge(String(x), tone || 'info');
      }).join('') + '</div>';
    }

    function fmtTime(value) {
      if (!value) return '—';
      const d = new Date(value);
      if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return h(String(value));
      return h(d.toLocaleString());
    }

    function fmtNum(value, digits) {
      const n = Number(value);
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '—';
      return h(n.toFixed(typeof digits === 'number' ? digits : 4));
    }

    function compactJson(value, maxLen) {
      const text = JSON.stringify(value ?? null, null, 2);
      const limit = typeof maxLen === 'number' ? maxLen : 20000;
      if (text.length <= limit) return text;
      return text.slice(0, limit) + '\\n... [truncated]';
    }

    function pick(row, keys) {
      if (!row || !Array.isArray(keys)) return undefined;
      for (const key of keys) {
        if (row[key] !== undefined && row[key] !== null && row[key] !== '') {
          return row[key];
        }
      }
      return undefined;
    }

    function setFlash(message, tone) {
      const el = qs('flash');
      if (!message) {
        el.className = 'flash';
        el.textContent = '';
        return;
      }
      el.className = 'flash show ' + (tone || 'info');
      el.textContent = message;
    }

    function saveToken(token) {
      state.token = String(token || '').trim();
      try {
        if (state.token) {
          sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, state.token);
        } else {
          sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        }
      } catch (_) {
        // ignore
      }
      qs('tokenInput').value = state.token;
      renderAuthState();
    }

    function restoreToken() {
      try {
        const saved = sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '';
        state.token = saved.trim();
      } catch (_) {
        state.token = '';
      }
      qs('tokenInput').value = state.token;
      renderAuthState();
    }

    function renderAuthState() {
      const hasToken = !!state.token;
      qs('authState').innerHTML = hasToken
        ? 'Đang dùng token trong session trình duyệt. ' + badge('TOKEN READY', 'ok')
        : 'Chưa có token trong phiên trình duyệt. ' + badge('NO TOKEN', 'warn');
      qs('runOnceCapabilities').innerHTML =
        badge('Read protected: ' + (UI_CONFIG.readProtected ? 'ON' : 'OFF'), UI_CONFIG.readProtected ? 'warn' : 'ok') +
        badge('Run once: ' + (UI_CONFIG.allowRunOnce ? 'ENABLED' : 'DISABLED'), UI_CONFIG.allowRunOnce ? 'ok' : 'bad');
      qs('runAsyncBtn').disabled = !UI_CONFIG.allowRunOnce;
      qs('runSyncBtn').disabled = !UI_CONFIG.allowRunOnce;
    }

    function buildHeaders(extraHeaders, hasJsonBody) {
      const headers = new Headers(extraHeaders || {});
      if (state.token) {
        headers.set('x-ops-token', state.token);
      }
      if (hasJsonBody) {
        headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
      }
      return headers;
    }

    async function requestJson(path, options) {
      const opts = options || {};
      const hasBody = opts.body !== undefined;
      const response = await fetch(UI_CONFIG.routePrefix + path, {
        method: opts.method || 'GET',
        headers: buildHeaders(opts.headers, hasBody),
        body: hasBody ? JSON.stringify(opts.body) : undefined,
        cache: 'no-store',
      });

      const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      const payload = contentType.includes('application/json')
        ? await response.json()
        : await response.text();

      if (!response.ok) {
        const err = new Error(
          (payload && payload.message) ||
          (payload && payload.error) ||
          ('HTTP_' + response.status)
        );
        err.status = response.status;
        err.payload = payload;
        throw err;
      }
      return payload;
    }

    async function requestText(path) {
      const response = await fetch(UI_CONFIG.routePrefix + path, {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: buildHeaders({}, false),
        cache: 'no-store',
      });

      const payload = await response.text();
      if (!response.ok) {
        const err = new Error('HTTP_' + response.status);
        err.status = response.status;
        err.payload = payload;
        throw err;
      }
      return payload;
    }

    async function maybeJson(path) {
      try {
        return await requestJson(path);
      } catch (err) {
        if (err && err.status === 404) return null;
        throw err;
      }
    }

    function renderOverview(status) {
      const security = UI_CONFIG.readProtected ? badge('READ PROTECTED', 'warn') : badge('READ OPEN', 'ok');
      const allowRun = UI_CONFIG.allowRunOnce ? badge('RUN ENABLED', 'ok') : badge('RUN DISABLED', 'bad');
      const dashboardExists = status && status.dashboard && status.dashboard.exists;

      qs('overviewHint').textContent = status && status.gateway_time_utc
        ? 'Gateway time: ' + new Date(status.gateway_time_utc).toLocaleString()
        : 'Đang chờ dữ liệu...';

      qs('overviewCard').innerHTML = [
        metric('Gateway time', fmtTime(status && status.gateway_time_utc)),
        metric('Route prefix', '<code>' + h(UI_CONFIG.routePrefix) + '</code>'),
        metric('Security', security + ' ' + allowRun),
        metric('Dashboard', dashboardExists ? badge('READY', 'ok') : badge('MISSING', 'bad')),
      ].join('');
    }

    function renderChampionCard(status, allocationResponse) {
      const allocation = allocationResponse && allocationResponse.summary
        ? allocationResponse.summary
        : (status && status.allocation ? status.allocation : null);

      const top3 = status && status.governance && Array.isArray(status.governance.top3)
        ? status.governance.top3
        : [];

      const champion = allocation && allocation.champion_method_id
        ? allocation.champion_method_id
        : (top3[0] && top3[0].method_id ? top3[0].method_id : '—');

      const challengers = allocation && Array.isArray(allocation.challenger_method_ids)
        ? allocation.challenger_method_ids
        : top3.slice(1).map(function (x) { return x.method_id; }).filter(Boolean);

      const shadows = allocation && Array.isArray(allocation.shadow_method_ids)
        ? allocation.shadow_method_ids
        : [];

      const reserves = allocation && Array.isArray(allocation.reserve_method_ids)
        ? allocation.reserve_method_ids
        : [];

      qs('championCard').innerHTML = [
        metric('Champion', champion === '—' ? champion : badge(champion, 'ok')),
        metric('Production method', allocation && allocation.production_method_id ? badge(allocation.production_method_id, 'info') : '—'),
        metric('Challengers', listBadges(challengers, 'warn', 'Không có challenger')),
        metric('Shadows', listBadges(shadows, 'info', 'Không có shadow')),
        metric('Reserves', listBadges(reserves, 'warn', 'Không có reserve')),
        metric('Switch action', allocation && allocation.switch_action ? h(allocation.switch_action) : '—'),
        metric('Switch reason', allocation && allocation.switch_reason ? h(allocation.switch_reason) : '—'),
      ].join('');
    }

    function renderSchedulerCard(status) {
      const scheduler = status && status.scheduler ? status.scheduler : {};
      const schedulerState = scheduler.state || {};
      const activeJob = scheduler.active_job || null;
      const recentJob = Array.isArray(scheduler.recent_jobs) && scheduler.recent_jobs.length > 0
        ? scheduler.recent_jobs[0]
        : null;
      const current = activeJob || recentJob;

      qs('schedulerCard').innerHTML = [
        metric('Allow run once', UI_CONFIG.allowRunOnce ? badge('YES', 'ok') : badge('NO', 'bad')),
        metric('Active job', current ? badge(current.status || 'UNKNOWN', toneForJobStatus(current.status)) : 'Không có job'),
        metric('Job ID', current && current.jobId ? '<code>' + h(current.jobId) + '</code>' : '—'),
        metric('Started', fmtTime(current && current.startedAtUtc)),
        metric('Finished', fmtTime(current && current.finishedAtUtc)),
        metric('Last scheduler state', schedulerState && schedulerState.last_run_utc ? fmtTime(schedulerState.last_run_utc) : '—'),
      ].join('');
    }

    function renderManifestCard(status) {
      const governance = status && status.governance ? status.governance : {};
      const latestManifest = status && status.latest_manifest ? status.latest_manifest : null;
      const paths = status && status.paths ? status.paths : {};

      qs('manifestCard').innerHTML = [
        metric('Governance snapshot time', fmtTime(governance.generated_at_utc)),
        metric('Leaderboard size', h(String(governance.leaderboard_size ?? '—'))),
        metric('Latest manifest time', fmtTime(latestManifest && latestManifest.generated_at_utc)),
        metric('Snapshot path', paths && paths.governance_snapshot ? '<code>' + h(paths.governance_snapshot) + '</code>' : '—'),
        metric('Manifest path', latestManifest && latestManifest.manifest_path ? '<code>' + h(latestManifest.manifest_path) + '</code>' : '—'),
      ].join('');
    }

    function renderAllocationSummary(allocationResponse) {
      const summary = allocationResponse && allocationResponse.summary ? allocationResponse.summary : null;
      if (!summary) {
        qs('allocationSummary').innerHTML = [
          metric('Status', badge('NO ALLOCATION YET', 'warn')),
          metric('Message', 'Chưa có allocation_plan.json hoặc route trả về 404.'),
        ].join('');
        return;
      }

      qs('allocationSummary').innerHTML = [
        metric('Generated', fmtTime(summary.generated_at_utc)),
        metric('Source snapshot', summary.source_governance_snapshot ? '<code>' + h(summary.source_governance_snapshot) + '</code>' : '—'),
        metric('Production', summary.production_method_id ? badge(summary.production_method_id, 'ok') : '—'),
        metric('Champion', summary.champion_method_id ? badge(summary.champion_method_id, 'info') : '—'),
        metric('Challengers', listBadges(summary.challenger_method_ids, 'warn', 'Không có challenger')),
        metric('Shadow methods', listBadges(summary.shadow_method_ids, 'info', 'Không có shadow')),
        metric('Reserve methods', listBadges(summary.reserve_method_ids, 'warn', 'Không có reserve')),
        metric('Switch action', summary.switch_action ? h(summary.switch_action) : '—'),
        metric('Switch reason', summary.switch_reason ? h(summary.switch_reason) : '—'),
      ].join('');
    }

    function renderJob(status) {
      const scheduler = status && status.scheduler ? status.scheduler : {};
      const job = scheduler.active_job || (Array.isArray(scheduler.recent_jobs) ? scheduler.recent_jobs[0] : null);

      if (!job) {
        qs('jobMeta').innerHTML = [
          metric('Job', badge('NO JOB', 'warn')),
          metric('Message', 'Chưa có active job hoặc lịch sử run gần đây.'),
        ].join('');
        qs('jobLog').textContent = 'Chưa có job nào.';
        return;
      }

      const requestInfo = job.request || {};
      const command = Array.isArray(job.command) ? job.command.join(' ') : '';
      const logParts = [];
      if (job.stdoutTail) {
        logParts.push('===== STDOUT (tail) =====\\n' + String(job.stdoutTail).trim());
      }
      if (job.stderrTail) {
        logParts.push('===== STDERR (tail) =====\\n' + String(job.stderrTail).trim());
      }
      if (logParts.length === 0) {
        logParts.push('Chưa có log tail cho job này.');
      }

      qs('jobMeta').innerHTML = [
        metric('Status', badge(job.status || 'UNKNOWN', toneForJobStatus(job.status))),
        metric('Job ID', job.jobId ? '<code>' + h(job.jobId) + '</code>' : '—'),
        metric('PID', job.pid !== undefined && job.pid !== null ? h(String(job.pid)) : '—'),
        metric('Started', fmtTime(job.startedAtUtc)),
        metric('Finished', fmtTime(job.finishedAtUtc)),
        metric('Exit code', job.exitCode !== undefined && job.exitCode !== null ? h(String(job.exitCode)) : '—'),
        metric('run_tag', requestInfo.runTag ? h(requestInfo.runTag) : '—'),
        metric('Log path', job.logPath ? '<code>' + h(job.logPath) + '</code>' : '—'),
        metric('Command', command ? '<code>' + h(command) + '</code>' : '—'),
      ].join('');

      qs('jobLog').textContent = logParts.join('\\n\\n');
    }

    function renderCounts(counts) {
      const chips = [];
      const groups = counts || {};

      function pushGroup(title, obj, tone) {
        if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return;
        Object.keys(obj).sort().forEach(function (key) {
          chips.push(badge(title + ': ' + key + ' = ' + obj[key], tone));
        });
      }

      pushGroup('band', groups.by_band, 'info');
      pushGroup('role', groups.by_role, 'ok');
      pushGroup('lifecycle', groups.by_lifecycle, 'warn');

      qs('leaderboardCounts').innerHTML = chips.length > 0
        ? chips.join('')
        : '<span class="muted">Chưa có counts.</span>';
    }

    function renderLeaderboard(data) {
      const rows = data && Array.isArray(data.rows) ? data.rows : [];
      const offset = Number(data && data.offset ? data.offset : 0);

      qs('leaderboardMeta').innerHTML = [
        'count: <strong>' + h(String(data && data.count !== undefined ? data.count : rows.length)) + '</strong>',
        data && data.generated_at_utc ? 'generated: <strong>' + fmtTime(data.generated_at_utc) + '</strong>' : '',
        data && data.source ? 'source: <code>' + h(data.source) + '</code>' : '',
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' &nbsp; | &nbsp; ');

      renderCounts(data ? data.counts : null);

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        qs('leaderboardBody').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" class="muted">Không có dòng nào khớp filter hiện tại.</td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      qs('leaderboardBody').innerHTML = rows.map(function (row, idx) {
        const rank = pick(row, ['rank', 'position']) ?? (offset + idx + 1);
        const methodId = pick(row, ['method_id', 'id', 'method']) ?? '—';
        const label = pick(row, ['label', 'name', 'title']) ?? '—';
        const band = pick(row, ['band']) ?? '—';
        const role = pick(row, ['portfolio_role', 'role']) ?? '—';
        const lifecycle = pick(row, ['lifecycle_status', 'lifecycle']) ?? '—';
        const score = pick(row, ['overall_score', 'score', 'blended_score', 'current_score', 'eval_score', 'composite_score']);
        const coverage = pick(row, ['coverage', 'coverage_rate', 'trailing_30d_coverage', 'hit_rate']);
        const stability = pick(row, ['stability_score', 'stability']);
        const note = pick(row, ['switch_reason', 'reason', 'note']) ?? '';

        const diagnostics = [
          coverage !== undefined ? 'coverage=' + Number(coverage).toFixed(4) : '',
          stability !== undefined ? 'stability=' + Number(stability).toFixed(4) : '',
          note ? String(note) : '',
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');

        return '<tr>' +
          '<td>' + h(String(rank)) + '</td>' +
          '<td><code>' + h(String(methodId)) + '</code></td>' +
          '<td>' + h(String(label)) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + h(String(band)) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + h(String(role)) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + h(String(lifecycle)) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + (score !== undefined ? fmtNum(score, 4) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + h(diagnostics || '—') + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('');
    }

    function renderRaw() {
      qs('rawStatus').textContent = compactJson(state.lastStatus);
      qs('rawAllocation').textContent = compactJson(state.lastAllocation);
      qs('rawLeaderboard').textContent = compactJson(state.lastLeaderboard);
    }

    function updateAutoRefreshButton() {
      const active = !!(state.lastStatus && state.lastStatus.scheduler && state.lastStatus.scheduler.active_job && state.lastStatus.scheduler.active_job.status === 'RUNNING');
      const intervalSec = active ? 4 : 15;
      qs('autoRefreshBtn').textContent = 'Auto refresh: ' + (state.autoRefresh ? 'ON' : 'OFF') + ' (' + intervalSec + 's)';
    }

    function scheduleNextRefresh() {
      if (state.timer) {
        clearTimeout(state.timer);
        state.timer = null;
      }
      updateAutoRefreshButton();
      if (!state.autoRefresh) return;

      const active = !!(state.lastStatus && state.lastStatus.scheduler && state.lastStatus.scheduler.active_job && state.lastStatus.scheduler.active_job.status === 'RUNNING');
      const delay = active ? 4000 : 15000;

      state.timer = setTimeout(function () {
        refreshAll({ quiet: true }).catch(function () {});
      }, delay);
    }

    function buildLeaderboardPath() {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      const q = qs('lbQueryInput').value.trim();
      const role = qs('lbRoleInput').value.trim();
      const band = qs('lbBandInput').value.trim();
      const lifecycle = qs('lbLifecycleInput').value.trim();
      const limit = qs('lbLimitInput').value.trim();

      if (q) params.set('q', q);
      if (role) params.set('role', role);
      if (band) params.set('band', band);
      if (lifecycle) params.set('lifecycle', lifecycle);
      if (limit) params.set('limit', limit);

      const query = params.toString();
      return '/leaderboard' + (query ? '?' + query : '');
    }

    async function refreshAll(options) {
      const opts = options || {};
      if (state.refreshing) return;

      state.refreshing = true;
      if (!opts.quiet) {
        setFlash('Đang refresh dữ liệu vận hành...', 'info');
      }

      try {
        const results = await Promise.allSettled([
          requestJson('/status'),
          maybeJson('/allocation'),
          requestJson(buildLeaderboardPath()),
        ]);

        const statusResult = results[0];
        const allocationResult = results[1];
        const leaderboardResult = results[2];

        if (statusResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
          state.lastStatus = statusResult.value;
        } else {
          throw statusResult.reason;
        }

        if (allocationResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
          state.lastAllocation = allocationResult.value;
        } else {
          throw allocationResult.reason;
        }

        if (leaderboardResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
          state.lastLeaderboard = leaderboardResult.value;
        } else {
          throw leaderboardResult.reason;
        }

        renderOverview(state.lastStatus);
        renderChampionCard(state.lastStatus, state.lastAllocation);
        renderSchedulerCard(state.lastStatus);
        renderManifestCard(state.lastStatus);
        renderAllocationSummary(state.lastAllocation);
        renderJob(state.lastStatus);
        renderLeaderboard(state.lastLeaderboard);
        renderRaw();
        scheduleNextRefresh();

        if (!opts.quiet) {
          setFlash('Đã refresh thành công.', 'ok');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        const payload = err && err.payload ? err.payload : null;
        const message =
          (payload && payload.message) ||
          (payload && payload.error) ||
          (err && err.message) ||
          'Refresh failed';

        if (err && err.status === 401) {
          setFlash('API yêu cầu token hợp lệ. Hãy nhập OPS token rồi refresh lại.', 'warn');
        } else {
          setFlash('Refresh lỗi: ' + message, 'bad');
        }
      } finally {
        state.refreshing = false;
      }
    }

    function collectRunPayload() {
      const payload = {};

      const runTag = qs('runTagInput').value.trim();
      const dateFrom = qs('dateFromInput').value.trim();
      const dateTo = qs('dateToInput').value.trim();
      const topKEval = qs('topKEvalInput').value.trim();
      const dashboardLastNDays = qs('dashboardLastNDaysInput').value.trim();
      const dashboardTitle = qs('dashboardTitleInput').value.trim();
      const alwaysSendSummary = qs('alwaysSendSummaryInput').checked;
      const noStdout = qs('noStdoutInput').checked;

      if (runTag) payload.run_tag = runTag;
      if (dateFrom) payload.date_from = dateFrom;
      if (dateTo) payload.date_to = dateTo;
      if (topKEval) payload.top_k_eval = Number(topKEval);
      if (dashboardLastNDays) payload.dashboard_last_n_days = Number(dashboardLastNDays);
      if (dashboardTitle) payload.dashboard_title = dashboardTitle;
      if (alwaysSendSummary) payload.always_send_summary = true;
      if (noStdout) payload.no_stdout = true;

      return payload;
    }

    async function triggerRun(waitForCompletion) {
      if (!UI_CONFIG.allowRunOnce) {
        setFlash('Server đang tắt OPS_ALLOW_RUN_ONCE.', 'warn');
        return;
      }

      const payload = collectRunPayload();
      const query = waitForCompletion ? '?wait=1' : '';
      const btn = waitForCompletion ? qs('runSyncBtn') : qs('runAsyncBtn');
      const originalText = btn.textContent;

      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = waitForCompletion ? 'Đang chạy sync...' : 'Đang gửi lệnh...';

      try {
        const response = await requestJson('/run-once' + query, {
          method: 'POST',
          body: payload,
        });

        if (response && response.accepted) {
          setFlash(
            'Đã nhận lệnh chạy. Job ID: ' + (response.job && response.job.jobId ? response.job.jobId : 'unknown'),
            'ok'
          );
        } else if (response && response.completed) {
          const ok = !!response.ok;
          setFlash(
            (ok ? 'Run hoàn tất thành công.' : 'Run hoàn tất nhưng có lỗi.') +
              ' Job ID: ' + (response.job && response.job.jobId ? response.job.jobId : 'unknown'),
            ok ? 'ok' : 'bad'
          );
        } else {
          setFlash('Đã gửi lệnh chạy.', 'ok');
        }

        await refreshAll({ quiet: true });
      } catch (err) {
        const payloadErr = err && err.payload ? err.payload : null;
        const message =
          (payloadErr && payloadErr.message) ||
          (payloadErr && payloadErr.error) ||
          (err && err.message) ||
          'Run failed';

        if (err && err.status === 409) {
          setFlash('Đã có một job đang chạy. Hãy đợi job hiện tại hoàn tất.', 'warn');
        } else if (err && err.status === 401) {
          setFlash('POST /run-once yêu cầu token hợp lệ.', 'warn');
        } else {
          setFlash('Run lỗi: ' + message, 'bad');
        }
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = originalText;
        scheduleNextRefresh();
      }
    }

    function resetRunForm() {
      qs('runTagInput').value = '';
      qs('dateFromInput').value = '';
      qs('dateToInput').value = '';
      qs('topKEvalInput').value = '3';
      qs('dashboardLastNDaysInput').value = '90';
      qs('dashboardTitleInput').value = '';
      qs('alwaysSendSummaryInput').checked = false;
      qs('noStdoutInput').checked = false;
    }

    function injectBaseHref(html, baseHref) {
      const safeBase = String(baseHref || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      const baseTag = '<base href="' + safeBase + '">';
      if (/<head[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
        return html.replace(/<head([^>]*)>/i, '<head$1>' + baseTag);
      }
      if (/<html[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
        return html.replace(/<html([^>]*)>/i, '<html$1><head>' + baseTag + '</head>');
      }
      return '<head>' + baseTag + '</head>' + html;
    }

    async function openDashboard() {
      const win = window.open('', '_blank');
      if (!win) {
        setFlash('Trình duyệt đang chặn popup. Hãy cho phép popup rồi thử lại.', 'warn');
        return;
      }

      win.document.open();
      win.document.write('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Loading dashboard...</title></head><body style="font-family:sans-serif;padding:24px;">Loading dashboard...</body></html>');
      win.document.close();

      try {
        const html = await requestText('/dashboard');
        const withBase = injectBaseHref(
          html,
          window.location.origin + UI_CONFIG.routePrefix + '/dashboard'
        );
        win.document.open();
        win.document.write(withBase);
        win.document.close();
        setFlash('Đã mở dashboard ở tab mới.', 'ok');
      } catch (err) {
        const message = (err && err.message) ? err.message : 'Dashboard open failed';
        win.document.open();
        win.document.write('<!DOCTYPE html><html><body style="font-family:sans-serif;padding:24px;"><h2>Không mở được dashboard</h2><pre>' + h(message) + '</pre></body></html>');
        win.document.close();

        if (err && err.status === 401) {
          setFlash('Dashboard route yêu cầu token hợp lệ.', 'warn');
        } else {
          setFlash('Không mở được dashboard: ' + message, 'bad');
        }
      }
    }

    function bindEvents() {
      qs('applyTokenBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        saveToken(qs('tokenInput').value);
        setFlash('Đã cập nhật token trong session trình duyệt.', 'ok');
      });

      qs('clearTokenBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        saveToken('');
        setFlash('Đã xóa token khỏi session trình duyệt.', 'ok');
      });

      qs('refreshBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        refreshAll().catch(function () {});
      });

      qs('refreshStatusBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        refreshAll().catch(function () {});
      });

      qs('refreshLeaderboardBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        refreshAll().catch(function () {});
      });

      qs('autoRefreshBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        state.autoRefresh = !state.autoRefresh;
        updateAutoRefreshButton();
        scheduleNextRefresh();
        setFlash('Auto refresh: ' + (state.autoRefresh ? 'ON' : 'OFF'), 'info');
      });

      qs('openDashboardBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        openDashboard().catch(function () {});
      });

      qs('runAsyncBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        triggerRun(false).catch(function () {});
      });

      qs('runSyncBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        triggerRun(true).catch(function () {});
      });

      qs('resetRunFormBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
        resetRunForm();
      });

      ['lbQueryInput', 'lbRoleInput', 'lbBandInput', 'lbLifecycleInput', 'lbLimitInput'].forEach(function (id) {
        qs(id).addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
          if (event.key === 'Enter') {
            event.preventDefault();
            refreshAll().catch(function () {});
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function boot() {
      restoreToken();
      renderAuthState();
      bindEvents();
      resetRunForm();
      refreshAll().catch(function () {});
    }

    boot();
  </script>
</body>
</html>`;
  }

  // Intentionally public shell:

Dán block này vào trong mountApexV31OpsRoutes(...), trước const router = express.Router();
  const OPS_JOB_HISTORY_LIMIT = Math.max(
    20,
    Number(process.env.OPS_JOB_HISTORY_LIMIT || 100),
  );

  const OPS_LOG_READ_MAX_BYTES = Math.max(
    8 * 1024,
    Number(process.env.OPS_LOG_READ_MAX_BYTES || 128 * 1024),
  );

  const OPS_LOG_STREAM_INTERVAL_MS = Math.max(
    250,
    Number(process.env.OPS_LOG_STREAM_INTERVAL_MS || 1000),
  );

  const opsJobsById = new Map();
  const opsJobOrder = [];

  function clampInt(value, min, max, fallback) {
    const n = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return fallback;
    return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.trunc(n)));
  }

  function isTerminalJobStatus(status) {
    const s = String(status || '').toUpperCase();
    return (
      s === 'SUCCESS' ||
      s === 'ERROR' ||
      s === 'FAILED' ||
      s === 'CANCELLED' ||
      s === 'ABORTED'
    );
  }

  function resolveOpsJobLogPath(job) {
    if (!job || typeof job !== 'object') return null;
    const value =
      job.logPath ||
      job.log_path ||
      (job.log && job.log.path) ||
      null;
    return value ? String(value) : null;
  }

  function sanitizeJobForApi(job) {
    if (!job || typeof job !== 'object') return null;

    const safe = {};
    for (const key of [
      'jobId',
      'status',
      'pid',
      'startedAtUtc',
      'finishedAtUtc',
      'exitCode',
      'signal',
      'error',
      'errorMessage',
      'cwd',
      'createdAtUtc',
      'runTag',
    ]) {
      if (job[key] !== undefined) {
        safe[key] = job[key];
      }
    }

    if (Array.isArray(job.command)) {
      safe.command = job.command.slice();
    }

    if (job.request && typeof job.request === 'object') {
      safe.request = { ...job.request };
    }

    if (job.stdoutTail != null) {
      safe.stdoutTail = String(job.stdoutTail);
    }

    if (job.stderrTail != null) {
      safe.stderrTail = String(job.stderrTail);
    }

    const logPath = resolveOpsJobLogPath(job);
    if (logPath) {
      safe.logPath = logPath;
    }

    if (job.startedAtUtc && job.finishedAtUtc) {
      const startedMs = new Date(job.startedAtUtc).getTime();
      const finishedMs = new Date(job.finishedAtUtc).getTime();
      if (Number.isFinite(startedMs) && Number.isFinite(finishedMs)) {
        safe.duration_ms = Math.max(0, finishedMs - startedMs);
      }
    }

    return safe;
  }

  function rememberOpsJob(job) {
    if (!job || !job.jobId) return null;

    const existing = opsJobsById.get(job.jobId);
    if (existing) {
      Object.assign(existing, job);
      return existing;
    }

    opsJobsById.set(job.jobId, job);
    opsJobOrder.unshift(job.jobId);

    while (opsJobOrder.length > OPS_JOB_HISTORY_LIMIT) {
      const evicted = opsJobOrder.pop();
      if (evicted) opsJobsById.delete(evicted);
    }

    return job;
  }

  function captureJobsFromStatusPayload(payload) {
    const scheduler = payload && payload.scheduler ? payload.scheduler : null;
    if (!scheduler) return;

    const candidates = [];

    if (scheduler.active_job && scheduler.active_job.jobId) {
      candidates.push(scheduler.active_job);
    }

    if (Array.isArray(scheduler.recent_jobs)) {
      for (const job of scheduler.recent_jobs) {
        if (job && job.jobId) {
          candidates.push(job);
        }
      }
    }

    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      rememberOpsJob({ ...candidate });
    }
  }

  function listOpsJobsSnapshot() {
    return opsJobOrder
      .map((jobId) => opsJobsById.get(jobId))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const tb = new Date(b.startedAtUtc || b.finishedAtUtc || 0).getTime();
        const ta = new Date(a.startedAtUtc || a.finishedAtUtc || 0).getTime();
        return tb - ta;
      });
  }

  function findOpsJob(jobId) {
    return opsJobsById.get(String(jobId || '').trim()) || null;
  }

  async function statIfExists(filePath) {
    if (!filePath) return null;
    try {
      return await fsp.stat(filePath);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err && err.code === 'ENOENT') return null;
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async function readUtf8Slice(filePath, startByte, endByte) {
    const length = Math.max(0, endByte - startByte);
    if (length <= 0) return '';

    const fd = await fsp.open(filePath, 'r');
    try {
      const buf = Buffer.alloc(length);
      await fd.read(buf, 0, length, startByte);
      return buf.toString('utf8');
    } finally {
      await fd.close();
    }
  }

  async function readJobLogTail(job, options = {}) {
    const logPath = resolveOpsJobLogPath(job);
    const maxBytes = clampInt(
      options.maxBytes,
      1024,
      1024 * 1024,
      OPS_LOG_READ_MAX_BYTES,
    );
    const tailLines = clampInt(options.tailLines, 1, 5000, 200);

    const stat = await statIfExists(logPath);
    if (!stat) {
      return {
        exists: false,
        path: logPath,
        size_bytes: 0,
        start_byte: 0,
        end_byte: 0,
        next_cursor: 0,
        truncated: false,
        text: '',
        updated_at_utc: null,
      };
    }

    const startByte = Math.max(0, stat.size - maxBytes);
    let text = await readUtf8Slice(logPath, startByte, stat.size);
    let truncated = startByte > 0;

    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
    if (lines.length > tailLines) {
      text = lines.slice(-tailLines).join('\n');
      truncated = true;
    }

    return {
      exists: true,
      path: logPath,
      size_bytes: stat.size,
      start_byte: startByte,
      end_byte: stat.size,
      next_cursor: stat.size,
      truncated,
      text,
      updated_at_utc: stat.mtime ? stat.mtime.toISOString() : null,
    };
  }

  async function readJobLogChunk(job, options = {}) {
    const logPath = resolveOpsJobLogPath(job);
    const stat = await statIfExists(logPath);

    const maxBytes = clampInt(
      options.maxBytes,
      1024,
      1024 * 1024,
      OPS_LOG_READ_MAX_BYTES,
    );

    let cursor = clampInt(options.cursor, 0, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, 0);

    if (!stat) {
      return {
        exists: false,
        path: logPath,
        size_bytes: 0,
        start_byte: 0,
        end_byte: 0,
        next_cursor: 0,
        truncated: false,
        reset: false,
        text: '',
        updated_at_utc: null,
      };
    }

    let reset = false;
    if (cursor > stat.size) {
      cursor = stat.size;
      reset = true;
    }

    const startByte = cursor;
    const endByte = Math.min(stat.size, startByte + maxBytes);
    const text = await readUtf8Slice(logPath, startByte, endByte);

    return {
      exists: true,
      path: logPath,
      size_bytes: stat.size,
      start_byte: startByte,
      end_byte: endByte,
      next_cursor: endByte,
      truncated: endByte < stat.size,
      reset,
      text,
      updated_at_utc: stat.mtime ? stat.mtime.toISOString() : null,
    };
  }

2) Seed job registry từ /status
Trong route GET /status, ngay trước res.json(payload) hoặc tương đương, thêm:
captureJobsFromStatusPayload(payload);
Ví dụ:
router.get('/status', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const payload = {
      ok: true,
      // ...
    };

    captureJobsFromStatusPayload(payload);

    res.json(payload);
  } catch (err) {
    // ...
  }
});

3) Hook rất nhỏ vào flow /run-once
Trong route POST /run-once, ở chỗ bạn tạo object job, thêm:
rememberOpsJob(job);
Và ở các chỗ status job đổi trạng thái, thêm lại cùng dòng này để cập nhật registry.
Ví dụ:
const job = {
  jobId,
  status: 'RUNNING',
  startedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
  request: requestPayload,
  command,
  logPath,
  pid: child.pid,
};

rememberOpsJob(job);
Khi job hoàn tất:
job.status = exitCode === 0 ? 'SUCCESS' : 'ERROR';
job.exitCode = exitCode;
job.finishedAtUtc = new Date().toISOString();
rememberOpsJob(job);
Khi error:
job.status = 'ERROR';
job.errorMessage = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err);
job.finishedAtUtc = new Date().toISOString();
rememberOpsJob(job);
Nếu hiện tại object job đã được mutate in-place trong listeners stdout/stderr/close, thì chỉ cần rememberOpsJob(job) lúc tạo + lúc kết thúc là đủ.
