5) Thêm các route backend mới
Dán block này sau route /ui hoặc trước /dashboard đều được:
  router.get('/jobs', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const limit = clampInt(req.query.limit, 1, 200, 25);
      const q = String(req.query.q || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const statusFilter = String(req.query.status || '').trim().toUpperCase();

      let rows = listOpsJobsSnapshot();

      if (statusFilter) {
        rows = rows.filter(
          (job) => String(job.status || '').toUpperCase() === statusFilter,
        );
      }

      if (q) {
        rows = rows.filter((job) => {
          const haystack = [
            job.jobId,
            job.status,
            job.pid,
            job.runTag,
            job.request && job.request.run_tag,
            resolveOpsJobLogPath(job),
            Array.isArray(job.command) ? job.command.join(' ') : '',
          ]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(' ')
            .toLowerCase();

          return haystack.includes(q);
        });
      }

      const sliced = rows.slice(0, limit);

      res.json({
        ok: true,
        count: sliced.length,
        total_known_jobs: rows.length,
        rows: sliced.map(sanitizeJobForApi),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/jobs] error:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'OPS_JOBS_LIST_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  router.get('/jobs/:jobId', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const job = findOpsJob(req.params.jobId);
      if (!job) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'OPS_JOB_NOT_FOUND',
          jobId: req.params.jobId,
        });
      }

      const logPath = resolveOpsJobLogPath(job);
      const stat = await statIfExists(logPath);

      res.json({
        ok: true,
        job: sanitizeJobForApi(job),
        log: {
          path: logPath,
          exists: !!stat,
          size_bytes: stat ? stat.size : 0,
          updated_at_utc: stat && stat.mtime ? stat.mtime.toISOString() : null,
        },
        endpoints: {
          log: `${cfg.routePrefix}/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(job.jobId)}/log`,
          stream: `${cfg.routePrefix}/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(job.jobId)}/log/stream`,
        },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/jobs/:jobId] error:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'OPS_JOB_DETAIL_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  router.get('/jobs/:jobId/log', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const job = findOpsJob(req.params.jobId);
      if (!job) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'OPS_JOB_NOT_FOUND',
          jobId: req.params.jobId,
        });
      }

      const hasCursor = req.query.cursor !== undefined && req.query.cursor !== null;
      const maxBytes = clampInt(
        req.query.max_bytes,
        1024,
        1024 * 1024,
        OPS_LOG_READ_MAX_BYTES,
      );

      const log = hasCursor
        ? await readJobLogChunk(job, {
            cursor: req.query.cursor,
            maxBytes,
          })
        : await readJobLogTail(job, {
            tailLines: req.query.tail_lines,
            maxBytes,
          });

      res.json({
        ok: true,
        jobId: job.jobId,
        status: job.status || 'UNKNOWN',
        log,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/jobs/:jobId/log] error:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        ok: false,
        error: 'OPS_JOB_LOG_READ_FAILED',
        details: sanitizeError(err),
      });
    }
  });

  router.get('/jobs/:jobId/log/stream', requireOpsAuth({ read: true }), async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const job = findOpsJob(req.params.jobId);
      if (!job) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'OPS_JOB_NOT_FOUND',
          jobId: req.params.jobId,
        });
      }

      let cursor = clampInt(req.query.cursor, 0, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, 0);
      const follow = String(req.query.follow ?? '1') !== '0';
      const intervalMs = clampInt(
        req.query.interval_ms,
        250,
        5000,
        OPS_LOG_STREAM_INTERVAL_MS,
      );
      const maxBytes = clampInt(
        req.query.max_bytes,
        1024,
        1024 * 1024,
        OPS_LOG_READ_MAX_BYTES,
      );

      res.status(200);
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8');
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate');
      res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive');
      res.setHeader('X-Accel-Buffering', 'no');
      if (typeof res.flushHeaders === 'function') {
        res.flushHeaders();
      }

      let closed = false;
      let timer = null;

      const cleanup = () => {
        closed = true;
        if (timer) {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          timer = null;
        }
      };

      const send = (event) => {
        if (closed || res.writableEnded) return;
        res.write(`${JSON.stringify(event)}\n`);
      };

      req.on('close', cleanup);
      req.on('aborted', cleanup);
      res.on('close', cleanup);

      send({
        type: 'init',
        jobId: job.jobId,
        cursor,
        follow,
        interval_ms: intervalMs,
      });

      const loop = async () => {
        if (closed) return;

        try {
          const currentJob = findOpsJob(job.jobId) || job;
          const chunk = await readJobLogChunk(currentJob, {
            cursor,
            maxBytes,
          });

          if (chunk.reset) {
            cursor = chunk.next_cursor;
            send({
              type: 'reset',
              jobId: currentJob.jobId,
              cursor,
              reason: 'cursor_beyond_eof',
            });
          } else if (chunk.text) {
            cursor = chunk.next_cursor;
            send({
              type: 'chunk',
              jobId: currentJob.jobId,
              cursor,
              from_byte: chunk.start_byte,
              to_byte: chunk.end_byte,
              truncated: chunk.truncated,
              status: currentJob.status || 'UNKNOWN',
              text: chunk.text,
            });
          } else {
            send({
              type: 'heartbeat',
              jobId: currentJob.jobId,
              cursor,
              status: currentJob.status || 'UNKNOWN',
            });
          }

          if (!follow || (isTerminalJobStatus(currentJob.status) && cursor >= chunk.size_bytes)) {
            send({
              type: 'end',
              jobId: currentJob.jobId,
              cursor,
              status: currentJob.status || 'UNKNOWN',
            });
            cleanup();
            res.end();
            return;
          }

          timer = setTimeout(() => {
            loop().catch((err) => {
              send({
                type: 'error',
                jobId: currentJob.jobId,
                message: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err),
              });
              cleanup();
              res.end();
            });
          }, intervalMs);
        } catch (err) {
          send({
            type: 'error',
            jobId: job.jobId,
            message: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err),
          });
          cleanup();
          res.end();
        }
      };

      loop().catch((err) => {
        send({
          type: 'error',
          jobId: job.jobId,
          message: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err),
        });
        cleanup();
        res.end();
      });
    } catch (err) {
      error('[ops/jobs/:jobId/log/stream] error:', err);
      if (!res.headersSent) {
        res.status(500).json({
          ok: false,
          error: 'OPS_JOB_LOG_STREAM_FAILED',
          details: sanitizeError(err),
        });
      } else {
        res.end();
      }
    }
  });

6.4. Thêm helper JS mới
Dán block này vào trong <script>, sau các helper hiện có như fmtNum, compactJson, pick... và trước refreshAll(...):
    function getActiveJobIdFromStatus() {
      const job =
        state.lastStatus &&
        state.lastStatus.scheduler &&
        state.lastStatus.scheduler.active_job
          ? state.lastStatus.scheduler.active_job
          : null;

      return job && job.jobId ? String(job.jobId) : '';
    }

    function setJobDetailStreamState(text, tone) {
      qs('jobDetailStreamState').innerHTML = badge(text || 'STREAM OFF', tone || 'warn');
    }

    function buildJobsPath() {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set('limit', '30');
      return '/jobs?' + params.toString();
    }

    function formatDurationMs(value) {
      const n = Number(value);
      if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return '—';
      const sec = Math.floor(n / 1000);
      const hh = Math.floor(sec / 3600);
      const mm = Math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60);
      const ss = sec % 60;
      return [hh, mm, ss].map((x) => String(x).padStart(2, '0')).join(':');
    }

    function renderJobsList(data) {
      const rows = data && Array.isArray(data.rows) ? data.rows : [];
      if (rows.length === 0) {
        qs('jobsBody').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" class="muted">Chưa có recent jobs.</td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      qs('jobsBody').innerHTML = rows.map(function (job) {
        const runTag =
          (job.request && job.request.run_tag) ||
          job.runTag ||
          '—';

        const activeClass = state.selectedJobId && state.selectedJobId === job.jobId
          ? 'active'
          : '';

        return '<tr class="' + activeClass + '" data-job-id="' + h(job.jobId) + '">' +
          '<td>' + badge(job.status || 'UNKNOWN', toneForJobStatus(job.status)) + '</td>' +
          '<td><code>' + h(job.jobId || '—') + '</code></td>' +
          '<td>' + h(runTag) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + fmtTime(job.startedAtUtc) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + fmtTime(job.finishedAtUtc) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + h(job.exitCode !== undefined && job.exitCode !== null ? String(job.exitCode) : '—') + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('');

      Array.from(qs('jobsBody').querySelectorAll('tr[data-job-id]')).forEach(function (row) {
        row.addEventListener('click', function () {
          const jobId = row.getAttribute('data-job-id');
          selectJob(jobId, { autoStream: true }).catch(function () {});
        });
      });
    }

    function renderSelectedJobDetailMeta(detailResponse) {
      const job = detailResponse && detailResponse.job ? detailResponse.job : null;
      const log = detailResponse && detailResponse.log ? detailResponse.log : null;

      if (!job) {
        qs('jobDetailMeta').innerHTML = [
          metric('State', badge('NO JOB SELECTED', 'warn')),
          metric('Hint', 'Hãy chọn một job ở bảng bên trái.'),
        ].join('');
        return;
      }

      const runTag =
        (job.request && job.request.run_tag) ||
        job.runTag ||
        '—';

      qs('jobDetailMeta').innerHTML = [
        metric('Status', badge(job.status || 'UNKNOWN', toneForJobStatus(job.status))),
        metric('Job ID', job.jobId ? '<code>' + h(job.jobId) + '</code>' : '—'),
        metric('PID', job.pid !== undefined && job.pid !== null ? h(String(job.pid)) : '—'),
        metric('run_tag', h(runTag)),
        metric('Started', fmtTime(job.startedAtUtc)),
        metric('Finished', fmtTime(job.finishedAtUtc)),
        metric('Duration', formatDurationMs(job.duration_ms)),
        metric('Exit code', job.exitCode !== undefined && job.exitCode !== null ? h(String(job.exitCode)) : '—'),
        metric('Log path', log && log.path ? '<code>' + h(log.path) + '</code>' : '—'),
        metric('Log size', log && log.size_bytes !== undefined ? h(String(log.size_bytes)) + ' bytes' : '—'),
        metric('Command', Array.isArray(job.command) ? '<code>' + h(job.command.join(' ')) + '</code>' : '—'),
      ].join('');
    }

    function setJobDetailLogText(text) {
      const el = qs('jobDetailLog');
      el.textContent = text || 'Log trống.';
      el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    }

    function appendJobDetailLog(text) {
      if (!text) return;
      const el = qs('jobDetailLog');
      const stayPinned = el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight >= el.scrollHeight - 32;
      const next = (el.textContent + text).slice(-300000);
      el.textContent = next;
      if (stayPinned) {
        el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
      }
    }

    function stopJobLogStream(reason) {
      if (state.jobStreamController) {
        try {
          state.jobStreamController.abort(reason || 'manual_stop');
        } catch (_) {
          // ignore
        }
      }
      state.jobStreamController = null;
      state.jobStreamActive = false;
      setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM OFF', 'warn');
    }

    function fallbackLogTextFromJob(job) {
      if (!job) return 'Log chưa sẵn sàng.';
      const parts = [];
      if (job.stdoutTail) {
        parts.push('===== STDOUT (tail) =====\n' + String(job.stdoutTail).trim());
      }
      if (job.stderrTail) {
        parts.push('===== STDERR (tail) =====\n' + String(job.stderrTail).trim());
      }
      return parts.join('\n\n') || 'Log chưa sẵn sàng.';
    }

    async function loadSelectedJobDetail(options) {
      const opts = options || {};
      const jobId = opts.jobId || state.selectedJobId;
      if (!jobId) {
        renderSelectedJobDetailMeta(null);
        setJobDetailLogText('Chọn một job để xem chi tiết.');
        setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM OFF', 'warn');
        return;
      }

      const loadSeq = ++state.selectedJobLoadSeq;

      try {
        const detailPath = '/jobs/' + encodeURIComponent(jobId);
        const logPath = '/jobs/' + encodeURIComponent(jobId) + '/log?tail_lines=200&max_bytes=131072';

        const results = await Promise.all([
          requestJson(detailPath),
          requestJson(logPath),
        ]);

        if (loadSeq !== state.selectedJobLoadSeq) {
          return;
        }

        const detailResponse = results[0];
        const logResponse = results[1];
        const job = detailResponse && detailResponse.job ? detailResponse.job : null;
        const logMeta = detailResponse && detailResponse.log ? detailResponse.log : null;
        const log = logResponse && logResponse.log ? logResponse.log : null;

        state.selectedJobId = jobId;
        state.selectedJobDetail = detailResponse;
        state.selectedJobLogCursor = log && Number.isFinite(Number(log.next_cursor))
          ? Number(log.next_cursor)
          : 0;

        renderJobsList(state.lastJobs);
        renderSelectedJobDetailMeta({
          job,
          log: logMeta,
        });

        const text = log && log.text
          ? String(log.text)
          : fallbackLogTextFromJob(job);

        setJobDetailLogText(text);

        const shouldAutoStream =
          opts.startStream === true ||
          (opts.autoStream !== false &&
            job &&
            String(job.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'RUNNING');

        if (shouldAutoStream) {
          await startJobLogStream(jobId, {
            cursor: state.selectedJobLogCursor,
            silent: true,
          });
        } else if (!opts.preserveStream) {
          stopJobLogStream('detail_loaded_no_stream');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (loadSeq !== state.selectedJobLoadSeq) {
          return;
        }

        const payloadErr = err && err.payload ? err.payload : null;
        const message =
          (payloadErr && payloadErr.message) ||
          (payloadErr && payloadErr.error) ||
          (err && err.message) ||
          'Load job detail failed';

        renderSelectedJobDetailMeta(null);
        setJobDetailLogText('Không tải được job detail: ' + message);
        setJobDetailStreamState('DETAIL ERROR', 'bad');
      }
    }

    function handleJobLogStreamEvent(jobId, event) {
      if (!event || jobId !== state.selectedJobId) return;

      if (event.type === 'init') {
        state.selectedJobLogCursor = Number(event.cursor || 0);
        setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM CONNECTED', 'ok');
        return;
      }

      if (event.type === 'reset') {
        state.selectedJobLogCursor = Number(event.cursor || 0);
        appendJobDetailLog('\n[log cursor reset]\n');
        setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM RESET', 'warn');
        return;
      }

      if (event.type === 'chunk') {
        state.selectedJobLogCursor = Number(event.cursor || state.selectedJobLogCursor || 0);
        appendJobDetailLog(String(event.text || ''));
        setJobDetailStreamState('LIVE @ ' + state.selectedJobLogCursor, 'ok');
        return;
      }

      if (event.type === 'heartbeat') {
        setJobDetailStreamState(
          'WAITING (' + h(event.status || 'UNKNOWN') + ')',
          String(event.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'RUNNING' ? 'info' : 'warn'
        );
        return;
      }

      if (event.type === 'end') {
        state.jobStreamActive = false;
        state.jobStreamController = null;
        setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM ENDED (' + String(event.status || 'DONE') + ')', 'warn');
        refreshAll({ quiet: true }).catch(function () {});
        return;
      }

      if (event.type === 'error') {
        state.jobStreamActive = false;
        state.jobStreamController = null;
        appendJobDetailLog('\n[stream error] ' + String(event.message || 'unknown error') + '\n');
        setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM ERROR', 'bad');
      }
    }

    async function startJobLogStream(jobId, options) {
      const opts = options || {};
      if (!jobId) {
        setFlash('Chưa chọn job để stream log.', 'warn');
        return;
      }

      stopJobLogStream('restart_stream');

      const controller = new AbortController();
      state.jobStreamController = controller;
      state.jobStreamActive = true;
      setJobDetailStreamState('CONNECTING...', 'info');

      try {
        const cursor = Number.isFinite(Number(opts.cursor))
          ? Number(opts.cursor)
          : state.selectedJobLogCursor || 0;

        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.set('cursor', String(cursor));
        params.set('follow', '1');
        params.set('interval_ms', '1000');
        params.set('max_bytes', '65536');

        const response = await fetch(
          UI_CONFIG.routePrefix +
            '/jobs/' +
            encodeURIComponent(jobId) +
            '/log/stream?' +
            params.toString(),
          {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: buildHeaders({}, false),
            cache: 'no-store',
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        if (!response.ok) {
          let payload = null;
          try {
            const ct = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
            payload = ct.includes('application/json')
              ? await response.json()
              : await response.text();
          } catch (_) {
            payload = null;
          }

          const message =
            (payload && payload.message) ||
            (payload && payload.error) ||
            ('HTTP_' + response.status);

          const err = new Error(message);
          err.status = response.status;
          err.payload = payload;
          throw err;
        }

        if (!response.body) {
          throw new Error('STREAM_BODY_UNAVAILABLE');
        }

        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder();
        let buffer = '';

        while (true) {
          const result = await reader.read();
          if (result.done) break;

          buffer += decoder.decode(result.value, { stream: true });

          let newlineIndex = buffer.indexOf('\n');
          while (newlineIndex >= 0) {
            const line = buffer.slice(0, newlineIndex).trim();
            buffer = buffer.slice(newlineIndex + 1);

            if (line) {
              try {
                const event = JSON.parse(line);
                handleJobLogStreamEvent(jobId, event);
              } catch (parseErr) {
                appendJobDetailLog('\n[stream parse error] ' + String(parseErr && parseErr.message || parseErr) + '\n');
              }
            }

            newlineIndex = buffer.indexOf('\n');
          }
        }

        if (buffer.trim()) {
          try {
            const event = JSON.parse(buffer.trim());
            handleJobLogStreamEvent(jobId, event);
          } catch (_) {
            // ignore trailing partial line
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) {
          setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM STOPPED', 'warn');
          return;
        }

        const payloadErr = err && err.payload ? err.payload : null;
        const message =
          (payloadErr && payloadErr.message) ||
          (payloadErr && payloadErr.error) ||
          (err && err.message) ||
          'Stream failed';

        state.jobStreamController = null;
        state.jobStreamActive = false;
        setJobDetailStreamState('STREAM ERROR', 'bad');
        setFlash('Log stream lỗi: ' + message, 'bad');
      }
    }

    async function selectJob(jobId, options) {
      if (!jobId) return;
      state.selectedJobId = String(jobId);
      renderJobsList(state.lastJobs);
      await loadSelectedJobDetail(options || {});
    }

6.5. Thay refreshAll(...) bằng bản này
Thay toàn bộ hàm refreshAll cũ bằng:
    async function refreshAll(options) {
      const opts = options || {};
      if (state.refreshing) return;

      state.refreshing = true;
      if (!opts.quiet) {
        setFlash('Đang refresh dữ liệu vận hành...', 'info');
      }

      try {
        const results = await Promise.allSettled([
          requestJson('/status'),
          maybeJson('/allocation'),
          requestJson(buildLeaderboardPath()),
          requestJson(buildJobsPath()),
        ]);

        const statusResult = results[0];
        const allocationResult = results[1];
        const leaderboardResult = results[2];
        const jobsResult = results[3];

        if (statusResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
          state.lastStatus = statusResult.value;
        } else {
          throw statusResult.reason;
        }

        if (allocationResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
          state.lastAllocation = allocationResult.value;
        } else {
          throw allocationResult.reason;
        }

        if (leaderboardResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
          state.lastLeaderboard = leaderboardResult.value;
        } else {
          throw leaderboardResult.reason;
        }

        if (jobsResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
          state.lastJobs = jobsResult.value;
        } else {
          throw jobsResult.reason;
        }

        renderOverview(state.lastStatus);
        renderChampionCard(state.lastStatus, state.lastAllocation);
        renderSchedulerCard(state.lastStatus);
        renderManifestCard(state.lastStatus);
        renderAllocationSummary(state.lastAllocation);
        renderJob(state.lastStatus);
        renderLeaderboard(state.lastLeaderboard);
        renderJobsList(state.lastJobs);
        renderRaw();
        scheduleNextRefresh();

        const activeJobId = getActiveJobIdFromStatus();
        const firstKnownJobId =
          state.lastJobs &&
          Array.isArray(state.lastJobs.rows) &&
          state.lastJobs.rows[0] &&
          state.lastJobs.rows[0].jobId
            ? state.lastJobs.rows[0].jobId
            : '';

        if (!state.selectedJobId) {
          const preferredJobId = activeJobId || firstKnownJobId;
          if (preferredJobId) {
            loadSelectedJobDetail({
              jobId: preferredJobId,
              autoStream: true,
            }).catch(function () {});
          }
        } else if (activeJobId && state.selectedJobId === activeJobId && !state.jobStreamActive) {
          loadSelectedJobDetail({
            jobId: state.selectedJobId,
            autoStream: true,
            preserveStream: true,
          }).catch(function () {});
        }

        if (!opts.quiet) {
          setFlash('Đã refresh thành công.', 'ok');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        const payload = err && err.payload ? err.payload : null;
        const message =
          (payload && payload.message) ||
          (payload && payload.error) ||
          (err && err.message) ||
          'Refresh failed';

        if (err && err.status === 401) {
          setFlash('API yêu cầu token hợp lệ. Hãy nhập OPS token rồi refresh lại.', 'warn');
        } else {
          setFlash('Refresh lỗi: ' + message, 'bad');
        }
      } finally {
        state.refreshing = false;
      }
    }

9) Ghi chú triển khai
Patch này đọc log từ job.logPath. Nếu current run chưa ghi ra file log thật, bạn cần bảo đảm /run-once vẫn tạo logPath và stdout/stderr được append vào file đó.
Registry jobs là in-memory, nhưng được seed lại từ /status nên khá ổn cho UI mini.
Nếu restart gateway, registry reset; nhưng chỉ cần /status đã expose active_job / recent_jobs, UI sẽ nạp lại được danh sách gần đây.

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from enum import Enum
from io import BytesIO
from typing import Any, Literal

import httpx
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError, field_validator, model_validator
from PIL import Image

APP_VERSION = "2.0.0"

OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
OPENAI_BASE_URL = os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", "gpt-4o")
OPENAI_VISION_VERIFY_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_VERIFY_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")

GEMINI_API_KEY = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", "")
GEMINI_BASE_URL = os.getenv("GEMINI_BASE_URL", "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta")
GEMINI_VISION_MODEL = os.getenv("GEMINI_VISION_MODEL", "gemini-2.5-pro")
GEMINI_VISION_VERIFY_MODEL = os.getenv("GEMINI_VISION_VERIFY_MODEL", "gemini-2.5-flash")

VISION_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.getenv("VISION_TIMEOUT_S", "120"))
STRICT_VERIFY_FAIL_CLOSED = os.getenv("STRICT_VERIFY_FAIL_CLOSED", "1") != "0"

SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES = {
    "image/png",
    "image/jpeg",
    "image/webp",
    "image/gif",
    "image/heic",
    "image/heif",
}


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class ProviderName(str, Enum):
    OPENAI = "openai"
    GEMINI = "gemini"


class SourceKind(str, Enum):
    HANDWRITTEN_NOTE = "handwritten_note"
    SCREENSHOT = "screenshot"
    MIXED = "mixed"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"


class ParseStatus(str, Enum):
    OK = "OK"
    ABSTAIN = "ABSTAIN"


class AbstainReason(str, Enum):
    NO_READABLE_TEXT = "no_readable_text"
    AMBIGUOUS_SEMANTICS = "ambiguous_semantics"
    MISSING_OPERATOR = "missing_operator"
    CROPPED_OR_OCCLUDED = "cropped_or_occluded"
    LOW_VISUAL_CONFIDENCE = "low_visual_confidence"
    MISSING_SPATIAL_ANCHOR = "missing_spatial_anchor"
    UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM = "unsupported_claim"
    PROVIDER_REFUSAL = "provider_refusal"
    VERIFIER_REJECT = "verifier_reject"
    OTHER = "other"


class RuleKind(str, Enum):
    TOUCH = "touch"
    SUM = "sum"
    TRANSLATE = "translate"
    REST = "rest"
    FILTER = "filter"
    SELECT = "select"
    PAIR = "pair"
    SEQUENCE = "sequence"
    CONDITION = "condition"
    COPY = "copy"
    NOTE = "note"
    OTHER = "other"


class OperandKind(str, Enum):
    NUMBER = "number"
    NUMBER_SET = "number_set"
    RANGE = "range"
    KEYWORD = "keyword"
    SYMBOL = "symbol"
    REFERENCE = "reference"
    TEXT = "text"


class BBoxNorm(StrictModel):
    left: int = Field(ge=0, le=1000)
    top: int = Field(ge=0, le=1000)
    right: int = Field(ge=0, le=1000)
    bottom: int = Field(ge=0, le=1000)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_order(self) -> "BBoxNorm":
        if self.right < self.left:
            raise ValueError("bbox.right must be >= bbox.left")
        if self.bottom < self.top:
            raise ValueError("bbox.bottom must be >= bbox.top")
        return self

    @classmethod
    def zero(cls) -> "BBoxNorm":
        return cls(left=0, top=0, right=0, bottom=0)


class SpatialAnchor(StrictModel):
    has_bbox: bool = False
    bbox_norm: BBoxNorm = Field(default_factory=BBoxNorm.zero)
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class SourceMeta(StrictModel):
    kind: SourceKind
    sha256: str
    mime_type: str
    width: int = Field(ge=1)
    height: int = Field(ge=1)


class DocumentMeta(StrictModel):
    language: str = ""
    title: str = ""
    note_type: str = ""


class ParserMeta(StrictModel):
    provider: ProviderName
    model: str
    verifier_enabled: bool
    verifier_model: str
    trace_id: str = ""
    provider_request_id: str = ""
    verifier_request_id: str = ""


class Evidence(StrictModel):
    id: str
    text: str = Field(min_length=1)
    text_normalized: str = ""
    spatial: SpatialAnchor = Field(default_factory=SpatialAnchor)
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class RuleOperand(StrictModel):
    kind: OperandKind
    value: str
    raw_text: str = ""
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class TranslationSpec(StrictModel):
    present: bool = False
    mode: str = ""
    offset: str = ""
    target: str = ""
    raw_text: str = ""
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class RestCadence(StrictModel):
    present: bool = False
    count: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    unit: str = ""
    raw_text: str = ""
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class Rule(StrictModel):
    rule_id: str
    kind: RuleKind
    label: str = ""
    raw_text: str = ""
    operands: list[RuleOperand] = Field(default_factory=list)
    translation: TranslationSpec = Field(default_factory=TranslationSpec)
    rest_cadence: RestCadence = Field(default_factory=RestCadence)
    conditions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    spatial: SpatialAnchor = Field(default_factory=SpatialAnchor)
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class Stage(StrictModel):
    stage_id: str
    order: int = Field(ge=1)
    label: str = ""
    raw_text: str = ""
    evidence_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    spatial: SpatialAnchor = Field(default_factory=SpatialAnchor)
    rules: list[Rule] = Field(default_factory=list)


class VisionParseResult(StrictModel):
    dsl_version: Literal["2.0"]
    parser_contract: Literal["apex-neural-vision-v2"]
    parse_status: ParseStatus
    abstain_reasons: list[AbstainReason] = Field(default_factory=list)
    source: SourceMeta
    document: DocumentMeta
    evidence: list[Evidence] = Field(default_factory=list)
    stages: list[Stage] = Field(default_factory=list)
    global_rest_cadence: RestCadence = Field(default_factory=RestCadence)
    warnings: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    no_hallucination: bool = True
    parser_meta: ParserMeta

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_status_shape(self) -> "VisionParseResult":
        if self.parse_status == ParseStatus.ABSTAIN and self.stages:
            raise ValueError("ABSTAIN result must not contain stages")
        if self.parse_status == ParseStatus.OK and not self.stages:
            raise ValueError("OK result must contain at least one stage")
        return self


class ParseRequest(StrictModel):
    image_b64: str
    mime_type: str = "image/png"
    source_kind: SourceKind = SourceKind.SCREENSHOT
    provider: ProviderName = ProviderName.OPENAI
    model: str = ""
    verifier_model: str = ""
    verify: bool = True
    require_spatial: bool = True
    trace_id: str = ""

    @field_validator("image_b64")
    @classmethod
    def strip_b64(cls, value: str) -> str:
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
            raise ValueError("image_b64 is required")
        return value.strip()


class VerificationIssue(StrictModel):
    path: str
    code: str
    message: str


class VerificationVerdict(StrictModel):
    verdict: Literal["ACCEPT", "REJECT"]
    reject_reasons: list[AbstainReason] = Field(default_factory=list)
    issues: list[VerificationIssue] = Field(default_factory=list)


def obj(properties: dict[str, Any], required: list[str] | None = None, description: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": False,
        "properties": properties,
        "required": required or list(properties.keys()),
    }
    if description:
        payload["description"] = description
    return payload


def arr(items: dict[str, Any], description: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = {"type": "array", "items": items}
    if description:
        payload["description"] = description
    return payload


def s_string(enum_values: list[str] | None = None, description: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {"type": "string"}
    if enum_values:
        payload["enum"] = enum_values
    if description:
        payload["description"] = description
    return payload


def s_int(minimum: int | None = None, maximum: int | None = None, description: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {"type": "integer"}
    if minimum is not None:
        payload["minimum"] = minimum
    if maximum is not None:
        payload["maximum"] = maximum
    if description:
        payload["description"] = description
    return payload


def s_num(minimum: float | None = None, maximum: float | None = None, description: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {"type": "number"}
    if minimum is not None:
        payload["minimum"] = minimum
    if maximum is not None:
        payload["maximum"] = maximum
    if description:
        payload["description"] = description
    return payload


def dsl_schema() -> dict[str, Any]:
    bbox = obj({
        "left": s_int(0, 1000),
        "top": s_int(0, 1000),
        "right": s_int(0, 1000),
        "bottom": s_int(0, 1000),
    })

    spatial = obj({
        "has_bbox": {"type": "boolean"},
        "bbox_norm": bbox,
        "confidence": s_num(0.0, 1.0),
    })

    evidence = obj({
        "id": s_string(),
        "text": s_string(),
        "text_normalized": s_string(),
        "spatial": spatial,
        "confidence": s_num(0.0, 1.0),
    })

    operand = obj({
        "kind": s_string([x.value for x in OperandKind]),
        "value": s_string(),
        "raw_text": s_string(),
        "evidence_ids": arr(s_string()),
    })

    translation = obj({
        "present": {"type": "boolean"},
        "mode": s_string(),
        "offset": s_string(),
        "target": s_string(),
        "raw_text": s_string(),
        "evidence_ids": arr(s_string()),
    })

    cadence = obj({
        "present": {"type": "boolean"},
        "count": s_int(0),
        "unit": s_string(),
        "raw_text": s_string(),
        "evidence_ids": arr(s_string()),
    })

    rule = obj({
        "rule_id": s_string(),
        "kind": s_string([x.value for x in RuleKind]),
        "label": s_string(),
        "raw_text": s_string(),
        "operands": arr(operand),
        "translation": translation,
        "rest_cadence": cadence,
        "conditions": arr(s_string()),
        "evidence_ids": arr(s_string()),
        "spatial": spatial,
        "confidence": s_num(0.0, 1.0),
    })

    stage = obj({
        "stage_id": s_string(),
        "order": s_int(1),
        "label": s_string(),
        "raw_text": s_string(),
        "evidence_ids": arr(s_string()),
        "spatial": spatial,
        "rules": arr(rule),
    })

    return obj({
        "dsl_version": s_string(["2.0"]),
        "parser_contract": s_string(["apex-neural-vision-v2"]),
        "parse_status": s_string([x.value for x in ParseStatus]),
        "abstain_reasons": arr(s_string([x.value for x in AbstainReason])),
        "source": obj({
            "kind": s_string([x.value for x in SourceKind]),
            "sha256": s_string(),
            "mime_type": s_string(),
            "width": s_int(1),
            "height": s_int(1),
        }),
        "document": obj({
            "language": s_string(),
            "title": s_string(),
            "note_type": s_string(),
        }),
        "evidence": arr(evidence),
        "stages": arr(stage),
        "global_rest_cadence": cadence,
        "warnings": arr(s_string()),
        "no_hallucination": {"type": "boolean"},
        "parser_meta": obj({
            "provider": s_string([x.value for x in ProviderName]),
            "model": s_string(),
            "verifier_enabled": {"type": "boolean"},
            "verifier_model": s_string(),
            "trace_id": s_string(),
            "provider_request_id": s_string(),
            "verifier_request_id": s_string(),
        }),
    })


def verifier_schema() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return obj({
        "verdict": s_string(["ACCEPT", "REJECT"]),
        "reject_reasons": arr(s_string([x.value for x in AbstainReason])),
        "issues": arr(obj({
            "path": s_string(),
            "code": s_string(),
            "message": s_string(),
        })),
    })


def build_parse_prompt(req: ParseRequest, sha256_hex: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
    return f"""
You are APEX NEURAL VISION.

Task:
Read the attached image and convert it DIRECTLY into the target DSL.

Hard rules:
1. Only extract what is visibly present in the image.
2. Do NOT invent numbers, offsets, stages, operators, labels, or relationships.
3. If semantics are unclear, ambiguous, cropped, overlapped, or unreadable, return parse_status=ABSTAIN.
4. Every stage and every rule MUST be grounded by evidence_ids.
5. Evidence text must be directly visible text snippets from the image.
6. bbox_norm is normalized to 0..1000.
7. If require_spatial=true and you cannot localize a stage or rule, return ABSTAIN.
8. Use these normalized rule kinds only when the image explicitly supports them:
   - touch
   - sum
   - translate
   - rest
   - filter
   - select
   - pair
   - sequence
   - condition
   - copy
   - note
   - other
9. "other" is allowed only if there is a visible instruction but it does not fit the known kinds.
10. If the image mostly contains naked numbers with no clear method semantics, ABSTAIN.

Semantic hints:
- visible words like "chạm" => touch
- visible words like "tổng" => sum
- visible words like "tịnh tiến", "dịch", "dịch chuyển" => translate
- visible words like "nghỉ", "nhịp nghỉ" => rest
Never apply these labels unless the image actually supports them.

Input metadata:
- source_kind={req.source_kind.value}
- mime_type={req.mime_type}
- sha256={sha256_hex}
- width={width}
- height={height}
- require_spatial={str(req.require_spatial).lower()}

Return JSON only.
""".strip()


def build_verifier_prompt(candidate_json: str, require_spatial: bool) -> str:
    return f"""
You are the APEX VISION GROUNDING VERIFIER.

Check whether the candidate JSON is FULLY supported by the attached image.

Reject the candidate if:
- any number is not visibly supported
- any operator/semantic label is inferred but not explicit enough
- any stage split/order is not visually grounded
- any evidence_id mapping is unsupported
- require_spatial=true and stage/rule localization is missing or implausible

If there is any unsupported claim, return verdict=REJECT.
Be strict. Prefer rejection over hallucination.

require_spatial={str(require_spatial).lower()}

Candidate JSON:
{candidate_json}

Return JSON only.
""".strip()


def sha256_hex(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def decode_image_payload(image_b64: str, mime_hint: str) -> tuple[str, bytes, str, int, int]:
    payload = image_b64.strip()
    mime_type = mime_hint.strip() if mime_hint else ""

    if payload.startswith("data:"):
        header, payload = payload.split(",", 1)
        match = re.match(r"^data:(.+?);base64$", header)
        if match:
            mime_type = match.group(1).strip()

    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(payload, validate=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"BAD_BASE64_IMAGE: {exc}") from exc

    try:
        with Image.open(BytesIO(raw)) as img:
            img.load()
            width, height = img.size
            detected_mime = Image.MIME.get(img.format or "", "")
            if detected_mime:
                mime_type = detected_mime
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"BAD_IMAGE_BYTES: {exc}") from exc

    if mime_type not in SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"UNSUPPORTED_MIME_TYPE: {mime_type}")

    return payload, raw, mime_type, width, height


def extract_openai_output_text(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if isinstance(data.get("output_text"), str) and data["output_text"].strip():
        return data["output_text"].strip()

    parts: list[str] = []
    for item in data.get("output", []):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        for content in item.get("content", []):
            if not isinstance(content, dict):
                continue
            if isinstance(content.get("text"), str):
                parts.append(content["text"])
            elif isinstance(content.get("text"), dict) and isinstance(content["text"].get("value"), str):
                parts.append(content["text"]["value"])
    return "\n".join(x for x in parts if x).strip()


def extract_gemini_output_text(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []
    for candidate in data.get("candidates", []):
        content = candidate.get("content", {})
        for part in content.get("parts", []):
            if isinstance(part, dict) and isinstance(part.get("text"), str):
                parts.append(part["text"])
    return "\n".join(x for x in parts if x).strip()


class ProviderCallResult(StrictModel):
    text: str
    request_id: str = ""


class VisionProvider:
    async def generate_json(
        self,
        *,
        model: str,
        prompt: str,
        image_b64: str,
        mime_type: str,
        schema: dict[str, Any],
        trace_id: str,
    ) -> ProviderCallResult:
        raise NotImplementedError


class OpenAIVisionProvider(VisionProvider):
    async def generate_json(
        self,
        *,
        model: str,
        prompt: str,
        image_b64: str,
        mime_type: str,
        schema: dict[str, Any],
        trace_id: str,
    ) -> ProviderCallResult:
        if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="OPENAI_API_KEY is not configured")

        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }
        if trace_id:
            headers["X-Client-Request-Id"] = trace_id

        data_url = f"data:{mime_type};base64,{image_b64}"
        payload = {
            "model": model,
            "store": False,
            "input": [
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": [
                        {"type": "input_text", "text": prompt},
                        {"type": "input_image", "image_url": data_url},
                    ],
                }
            ],
            "text": {
                "format": {
                    "type": "json_schema",
                    "name": "apex_neural_vision_dsl",
                    "strict": True,
                    "schema": schema,
                }
            },
        }

        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=VISION_TIMEOUT_S) as client:
            response = await client.post(f"{OPENAI_BASE_URL}/responses", headers=headers, json=payload)

        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"OPENAI_VISION_FAILED: {response.text}")

        body = response.json()
        text = extract_openai_output_text(body)
        return ProviderCallResult(
            text=text,
            request_id=response.headers.get("x-request-id", ""),
        )


class GeminiVisionProvider(VisionProvider):
    async def generate_json(
        self,
        *,
        model: str,
        prompt: str,
        image_b64: str,
        mime_type: str,
        schema: dict[str, Any],
        trace_id: str,
    ) -> ProviderCallResult:
        if not GEMINI_API_KEY:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured")

        url = f"{GEMINI_BASE_URL}/models/{model}:generateContent?key={GEMINI_API_KEY}"
        payload = {
            "contents": [{
                "parts": [
                    {"text": prompt},
                    {"inline_data": {"mime_type": mime_type, "data": image_b64}},
                ]
            }],
            "generationConfig": {
                "responseMimeType": "application/json",
                "responseJsonSchema": schema,
            },
        }

        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }
        if trace_id:
            headers["X-Client-Request-Id"] = trace_id

        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=VISION_TIMEOUT_S) as client:
            response = await client.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"GEMINI_VISION_FAILED: {response.text}")

        body = response.json()
        text = extract_gemini_output_text(body)
        return ProviderCallResult(
            text=text,
            request_id=response.headers.get("x-request-id", ""),
        )


def get_provider(name: ProviderName) -> VisionProvider:
    if name == ProviderName.OPENAI:
        return OpenAIVisionProvider()
    if name == ProviderName.GEMINI:
        return GeminiVisionProvider()
    raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"UNKNOWN_PROVIDER: {name}")


def default_model(provider: ProviderName) -> str:
    return OPENAI_VISION_MODEL if provider == ProviderName.OPENAI else GEMINI_VISION_MODEL


def default_verifier_model(provider: ProviderName) -> str:
    return OPENAI_VISION_VERIFY_MODEL if provider == ProviderName.OPENAI else GEMINI_VISION_VERIFY_MODEL


def support_text(evidence_map: dict[str, Evidence], evidence_ids: list[str]) -> str:
    return " ".join(evidence_map[x].text.lower() for x in evidence_ids if x in evidence_map)


def assert_ids_exist(evidence_map: dict[str, Evidence], evidence_ids: list[str], path: str) -> None:
    for ref in evidence_ids:
        if ref not in evidence_map:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: unknown evidence_id={ref}")


def assert_visible_numbers(text: str, evidence_map: dict[str, Evidence], evidence_ids: list[str], path: str) -> None:
    digits = re.findall(r"\d+", text or "")
    if not digits:
        return
    supported = support_text(evidence_map, evidence_ids)
    for token in digits:
        if token not in supported:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: unsupported numeric token={token}")


def validate_grounding(result: VisionParseResult, require_spatial: bool) -> None:
    evidence_map = {e.id: e for e in result.evidence}
    if len(evidence_map) != len(result.evidence):
        raise ValueError("duplicate evidence ids")

    if result.parse_status == ParseStatus.ABSTAIN:
        return

    if not result.evidence:
        raise ValueError("OK result must contain evidence")

    for stage in result.stages:
        assert_ids_exist(evidence_map, stage.evidence_ids, f"stage[{stage.stage_id}]")
        if require_spatial and not stage.spatial.has_bbox:
            raise ValueError(f"stage[{stage.stage_id}] missing spatial anchor")
        if not stage.rules:
            raise ValueError(f"stage[{stage.stage_id}] must contain rules")

        for rule in stage.rules:
            assert_ids_exist(evidence_map, rule.evidence_ids, f"rule[{rule.rule_id}]")
            if require_spatial and not rule.spatial.has_bbox:
                raise ValueError(f"rule[{rule.rule_id}] missing spatial anchor")

            assert_visible_numbers(rule.raw_text, evidence_map, rule.evidence_ids, f"rule[{rule.rule_id}].raw_text")

            if rule.kind == RuleKind.TRANSLATE and not rule.translation.present:
                raise ValueError(f"rule[{rule.rule_id}] translate kind without translation.present=true")
            if rule.kind == RuleKind.REST and not rule.rest_cadence.present:
                raise ValueError(f"rule[{rule.rule_id}] rest kind without rest_cadence.present=true")

            if rule.translation.present:
                assert_ids_exist(evidence_map, rule.translation.evidence_ids, f"rule[{rule.rule_id}].translation")
                assert_visible_numbers(
                    rule.translation.offset,
                    evidence_map,
                    rule.translation.evidence_ids or rule.evidence_ids,
                    f"rule[{rule.rule_id}].translation.offset",
                )

            if rule.rest_cadence.present:
                assert_ids_exist(evidence_map, rule.rest_cadence.evidence_ids, f"rule[{rule.rule_id}].rest_cadence")
                if rule.rest_cadence.count > 0:
                    assert_visible_numbers(
                        str(rule.rest_cadence.count),
                        evidence_map,
                        rule.rest_cadence.evidence_ids or rule.evidence_ids,
                        f"rule[{rule.rule_id}].rest_cadence.count",
                    )

            for idx, operand in enumerate(rule.operands):
                assert_ids_exist(evidence_map, operand.evidence_ids, f"rule[{rule.rule_id}].operands[{idx}]")
                assert_visible_numbers(
                    operand.value,
                    evidence_map,
                    operand.evidence_ids or rule.evidence_ids,
                    f"rule[{rule.rule_id}].operands[{idx}].value",
                )

    if result.global_rest_cadence.present:
        assert_ids_exist(evidence_map, result.global_rest_cadence.evidence_ids, "global_rest_cadence")
        if result.global_rest_cadence.count > 0:
            assert_visible_numbers(
                str(result.global_rest_cadence.count),
                evidence_map,
                result.global_rest_cadence.evidence_ids,
                "global_rest_cadence.count",
            )


def downgrade_to_abstain(
    draft: VisionParseResult,
    reasons: list[AbstainReason],
    warning_messages: list[str],
) -> VisionParseResult:
    return VisionParseResult(
        dsl_version="2.0",
        parser_contract="apex-neural-vision-v2",
        parse_status=ParseStatus.ABSTAIN,
        abstain_reasons=list(dict.fromkeys(reasons or [AbstainReason.OTHER])),
        source=draft.source,
        document=draft.document,
        evidence=draft.evidence,
        stages=[],
        global_rest_cadence=RestCadence(),
        warnings=list(dict.fromkeys(draft.warnings + warning_messages)),
        no_hallucination=True,
        parser_meta=draft.parser_meta,
    )


def empty_result(
    *,
    req: ParseRequest,
    sha256_value: str,
    mime_type: str,
    width: int,
    height: int,
    model_name: str,
    verifier_model_name: str,
    reasons: list[AbstainReason],
    warnings: list[str],
) -> VisionParseResult:
    return VisionParseResult(
        dsl_version="2.0",
        parser_contract="apex-neural-vision-v2",
        parse_status=ParseStatus.ABSTAIN,
        abstain_reasons=reasons,
        source=SourceMeta(
            kind=req.source_kind,
            sha256=sha256_value,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            width=width,
            height=height,
        ),
        document=DocumentMeta(),
        evidence=[],
        stages=[],
        global_rest_cadence=RestCadence(),
        warnings=warnings,
        no_hallucination=True,
        parser_meta=ParserMeta(
            provider=req.provider,
            model=model_name,
            verifier_enabled=req.verify,
            verifier_model=verifier_model_name,
            trace_id=req.trace_id,
            provider_request_id="",
            verifier_request_id="",
        ),
    )

@app.post("/v2/vision/parse")
async def parse_image(req: ParseRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    image_b64, raw, mime_type, width, height = decode_image_payload(req.image_b64, req.mime_type)
    sha = sha256_hex(raw)

    primary_model = req.model or default_model(req.provider)
    verify_model = req.verifier_model or default_verifier_model(req.provider)
    provider = get_provider(req.provider)

    parse_prompt = build_parse_prompt(req, sha, width, height)

    try:
        first_pass = await provider.generate_json(
            model=primary_model,
            prompt=parse_prompt,
            image_b64=image_b64,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            schema=dsl_schema(),
            trace_id=req.trace_id,
        )
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"PRIMARY_PROVIDER_CALL_FAILED: {exc}") from exc

    if not first_pass.text.strip():
        result = empty_result(
            req=req,
            sha256_value=sha,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            width=width,
            height=height,
            model_name=primary_model,
            verifier_model_name=verify_model,
            reasons=[AbstainReason.PROVIDER_REFUSAL],
            warnings=["Primary provider returned empty structured output."],
        )
        return result.model_dump(mode="json")

    try:
        parsed = VisionParseResult.model_validate_json(first_pass.text)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        result = empty_result(
            req=req,
            sha256_value=sha,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            width=width,
            height=height,
            model_name=primary_model,
            verifier_model_name=verify_model,
            reasons=[AbstainReason.OTHER],
            warnings=[f"Primary provider returned schema-invalid JSON: {exc.errors()}"],
        )
        return result.model_dump(mode="json")

    parsed.source = SourceMeta(
        kind=req.source_kind,
        sha256=sha,
        mime_type=mime_type,
        width=width,
        height=height,
    )
    parsed.parser_meta = ParserMeta(
        provider=req.provider,
        model=primary_model,
        verifier_enabled=req.verify,
        verifier_model=verify_model,
        trace_id=req.trace_id,
        provider_request_id=first_pass.request_id,
        verifier_request_id="",
    )
    parsed.no_hallucination = True

    try:
        validate_grounding(parsed, req.require_spatial)
    except Exception as exc:
        parsed = downgrade_to_abstain(
            parsed,
            reasons=[AbstainReason.UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM],
            warning_messages=[f"Local grounding validator rejected draft: {exc}"],
        )

    if req.verify and parsed.parse_status == ParseStatus.OK:
        try:
            verifier_pass = await provider.generate_json(
                model=verify_model,
                prompt=build_verifier_prompt(
                    candidate_json=json.dumps(parsed.model_dump(mode="json"), ensure_ascii=False),
                    require_spatial=req.require_spatial,
                ),
                image_b64=image_b64,
                mime_type=mime_type,
                schema=verifier_schema(),
                trace_id=req.trace_id,
            )

            parsed.parser_meta.verifier_request_id = verifier_pass.request_id

            if not verifier_pass.text.strip():
                if STRICT_VERIFY_FAIL_CLOSED:
                    parsed = downgrade_to_abstain(
                        parsed,
                        reasons=[AbstainReason.VERIFIER_REJECT],
                        warning_messages=["Verifier returned empty structured output."],
                    )
            else:
                verdict = VerificationVerdict.model_validate_json(verifier_pass.text)
                if verdict.verdict == "REJECT":
                    parsed = downgrade_to_abstain(
                        parsed,
                        reasons=verdict.reject_reasons or [AbstainReason.VERIFIER_REJECT],
                        warning_messages=[
                            "Verifier rejected candidate JSON."
                        ] + [f"{x.path}: {x.code}: {x.message}" for x in verdict.issues],
                    )
        except Exception as exc:
            if STRICT_VERIFY_FAIL_CLOSED:
                parsed = downgrade_to_abstain(
                    parsed,
                    reasons=[AbstainReason.VERIFIER_REJECT],
                    warning_messages=[f"Verifier pass failed closed: {exc}"],
                )
            else:
                parsed.warnings.append(f"Verifier pass failed open: {exc}")

    return parsed.model_dump(mode="json")

import express from "express";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const app = express();
app.use(express.json({ limit: "25mb" }));

const APP_VERSION = "2.0.0";
const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT || 8090);
const VISION_WORKER_URL =
  process.env.VISION_WORKER_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8001/v2/vision/parse";
const OUT_DIR = process.env.OUT_DIR || "data/vision_runs";
const CACHE_DIR = path.join(OUT_DIR, "_cache");
const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = Math.max(
  1_000_000,
  Number(process.env.MAX_IMAGE_BYTES || 15 * 1024 * 1024),
);

const SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  "image/png",
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/webp",
  "image/gif",
  "image/heic",
  "image/heif",
]);

function sha256(value) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
}

function nowTag() {
  return new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
}

function extFromMime(mimeType) {
  switch (mimeType) {
    case "image/png":
      return "png";
    case "image/jpeg":
      return "jpg";
    case "image/webp":
      return "webp";
    case "image/gif":
      return "gif";
    case "image/heic":
      return "heic";
    case "image/heif":
      return "heif";
    default:
      return "bin";
  }
}

function parseIncomingImage(imageB64, mimeHint = "") {
  if (!imageB64 || typeof imageB64 !== "string") {
    throw new Error("MISSING_image_b64");
  }

  let payload = imageB64.trim();
  let mimeType = String(mimeHint || "").trim();

  if (payload.startsWith("data:")) {
    const commaIndex = payload.indexOf(",");
    if (commaIndex < 0) {
      throw new Error("BAD_DATA_URL");
    }

    const header = payload.slice(0, commaIndex);
    payload = payload.slice(commaIndex + 1);

    const match = /^data:(.+?);base64$/i.exec(header);
    if (match) {
      mimeType = match[1].toLowerCase();
    }
  }

  if (!mimeType || !SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType)) {
    throw new Error(`UNSUPPORTED_MIME_TYPE:${mimeType || "unknown"}`);
  }

  let raw;
  try {
    raw = Buffer.from(payload, "base64");
  } catch {
    throw new Error("BAD_BASE64");
  }

  if (!raw || raw.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("EMPTY_IMAGE");
  }

  if (raw.length > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) {
    throw new Error(`IMAGE_TOO_LARGE:${raw.length}`);
  }

  return {
    payloadBase64: payload,
    raw,
    mimeType,
    ext: extFromMime(mimeType),
    sha256: sha256(raw),
    sizeBytes: raw.length,
  };
}

async function ensureDir(dirPath) {
  await fs.mkdir(dirPath, { recursive: true });
}

async function readJsonIfExists(filePath) {
  try {
    const text = await fs.readFile(filePath, "utf8");
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err && err.code === "ENOENT") return null;
    throw err;
  }
}

async function writeJson(filePath, value) {
  await ensureDir(path.dirname(filePath));
  await fs.writeFile(filePath, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2), "utf8");
}

function countRules(result) {
  const stages = Array.isArray(result?.stages) ? result.stages : [];
  return stages.reduce((sum, stage) => {
    const rules = Array.isArray(stage?.rules) ? stage.rules.length : 0;
    return sum + rules;
  }, 0);
}

function assertStrictDsl(result) {
  if (!result || typeof result !== "object") {
    throw new Error("INVALID_RESULT_OBJECT");
  }

  if (result.dsl_version !== "2.0") {
    throw new Error("UNSUPPORTED_DSL_VERSION");
  }

  if (result.parser_contract !== "apex-neural-vision-v2") {
    throw new Error("UNSUPPORTED_PARSER_CONTRACT");
  }

  if (result.no_hallucination !== true) {
    throw new Error("MISSING_no_hallucination");
  }

  const status = String(result.parse_status || "");
  if (status !== "OK" && status !== "ABSTAIN") {
    throw new Error("INVALID_parse_status");
  }

  if (status === "OK" && (!Array.isArray(result.stages) || result.stages.length === 0)) {
    throw new Error("OK_result_requires_stages");
  }

  if (status === "ABSTAIN" && Array.isArray(result.stages) && result.stages.length > 0) {
    throw new Error("ABSTAIN_must_not_contain_stages");
  }
}

function buildCacheKey(input) {
  return sha256(
    JSON.stringify({
      parser_contract: "apex-neural-vision-v2",
      source_sha256: input.sourceSha256,
      source_kind: input.sourceKind,
      mime_type: input.mimeType,
      provider: input.provider,
      model: input.model || "",
      verifier_model: input.verifierModel || "",
      verify: !!input.verify,
      require_spatial: !!input.requireSpatial,
    }),
  );
}

async function persistRun({
  runId,
  image,
  requestPayload,
  result,
  cacheKey,
}) {
  const runDir = path.join(OUT_DIR, runId);
  const rawDir = path.join(runDir, "raw");
  const reqDir = path.join(runDir, "request");
  const dslDir = path.join(runDir, "dsl");

  await ensureDir(rawDir);
  await ensureDir(reqDir);
  await ensureDir(dslDir);
  await ensureDir(CACHE_DIR);

  const rawPath = path.join(rawDir, `input.${image.ext}`);
  const requestPath = path.join(reqDir, "ingest_request.json");
  const resultPath = path.join(dslDir, "result.json");
  const cachePath = path.join(CACHE_DIR, `${cacheKey}.json`);

  await fs.writeFile(rawPath, image.raw);
  await writeJson(requestPath, requestPayload);
  await writeJson(resultPath, result);

  const summary = {
    ok: true,
    run_id: runId,
    cache_hit: false,
    source: {
      sha256: image.sha256,
      mime_type: image.mimeType,
      size_bytes: image.sizeBytes,
    },
    stats: {
      parse_status: result.parse_status,
      evidence_count: Array.isArray(result.evidence) ? result.evidence.length : 0,
      stage_count: Array.isArray(result.stages) ? result.stages.length : 0,
      rule_count: countRules(result),
      abstained: result.parse_status === "ABSTAIN",
    },
    parser_meta: result.parser_meta || {},
    artifacts: {
      run_dir: runDir,
      raw_path: rawPath,
      request_path: requestPath,
      result_path: resultPath,
      cache_key: cacheKey,
    },
    result,
  };

  await writeJson(cachePath, summary);

  const manifestRow = {
    ts: new Date().toISOString(),
    run_id: runId,
    cache_key: cacheKey,
    source_sha256: image.sha256,
    source_mime_type: image.mimeType,
    source_size_bytes: image.sizeBytes,
    parse_status: result.parse_status,
    evidence_count: summary.stats.evidence_count,
    stage_count: summary.stats.stage_count,
    rule_count: summary.stats.rule_count,
    provider: result?.parser_meta?.provider || requestPayload.provider,
    model: result?.parser_meta?.model || requestPayload.model || "",
    verifier_model:
      result?.parser_meta?.verifier_model || requestPayload.verifier_model || "",
    trace_id: result?.parser_meta?.trace_id || requestPayload.trace_id || "",
  };

  await fs.appendFile(
    path.join(OUT_DIR, "manifest.ndjson"),
    JSON.stringify(manifestRow) + "\n",
    "utf8",
  );

  return summary;
}

app.get("/health", async (_req, res) => {

    ok: true,
    service: "apex-omni-vision-gateway",
    version: APP_VERSION,

  });

app.post("/v2/vision/ingest", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      image_b64,
      mime_type = "image/png",
      source_kind = "screenshot",
      provider = process.env.VISION_PROVIDER_DEFAULT || "openai",
      model = "",
      verifier_model = "",
      verify = true,
      require_spatial = true,
      force = false,
    } = req.body || {};

    const image = parseIncomingImage(image_b64, mime_type);
    const traceId = crypto.randomUUID();

    const workerPayload = {
      image_b64: image.payloadBase64,
      mime_type: image.mimeType,
      source_kind,
      provider,
      model,
      verifier_model,
      verify: !!verify,
      require_spatial: !!require_spatial,
      trace_id: traceId,
    };

    const cacheKey = buildCacheKey({
      sourceSha256: image.sha256,
      sourceKind: source_kind,
      mimeType: image.mimeType,
      provider,
      model,
      verifierModel: verifier_model,
      verify,
      requireSpatial: require_spatial,
    });

    const cachePath = path.join(CACHE_DIR, `${cacheKey}.json`);
    if (!force) {
      const cached = await readJsonIfExists(cachePath);
      if (cached) {
        return res.json({
          ...cached,
          cache_hit: true,
        });
      }
    }

    const workerResponse = await fetch(VISION_WORKER_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Client-Request-Id": traceId,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(workerPayload),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(180_000),
    });

    let workerBody;
    const workerCt = workerResponse.headers.get("content-type") || "";
    if (workerCt.includes("application/json")) {
      workerBody = await workerResponse.json();
    } else {
      workerBody = await workerResponse.text();
    }

    if (!workerResponse.ok) {
      return res.status(502).json({
        ok: false,
        error: "VISION_WORKER_FAILED",
        trace_id: traceId,
        detail: workerBody,
      });
    }

    assertStrictDsl(workerBody);

    const runId = `run_${nowTag()}_${image.sha256.slice(0, 10)}`;
    const summary = await persistRun({
      runId,
      image,
      requestPayload: workerPayload,
      result: workerBody,
      cacheKey,
    });

    return res.json(summary);
  } catch (err) {
    return res.status(500).json({
      ok: false,
      error: "VISION_INGEST_FAILED",
      detail: String(err?.message || err),
    });
  }
});

app.listen(PORT, async () => {
  await ensureDir(OUT_DIR);
  await ensureDir(CACHE_DIR);
  console.log(`apex-omni-vision-gateway listening on :${PORT}`);
});

9) Ghi chú production
OpenAI request trong worker có gắn X-Client-Request-Id để truy vết; docs của OpenAI nói có thể tự gửi header này và OpenAI sẽ log nó cho các endpoint được hỗ trợ như responses. (platform.openai.com)
Nếu dùng Gemini với ảnh lớn hơn inline budget, hãy đổi adapter sang File API; docs Gemini ghi inline request nên dưới 20MB và File API phù hợp hơn cho file lớn hoặc tái sử dụng nhiều lần. (ai.google.dev)
Với OpenAI, nếu sau này bạn muốn thay base64 bằng file upload, docs hiện tại cho biết image input trong Responses API có thể đi bằng base64 data URL hoặc file ID. (platform.openai.com)

Gemini thì là multimodal native, nhận ảnh qua generateContent, và structured output dùng response_mime_type: "application/json" cùng response_json_schema. Google cũng có lớp OpenAI-compatible endpoint, nhưng với app này tôi khuyến nghị Node = OpenAI, Python worker = Gemini để tách trách nhiệm rõ và ít xung đột hơn. (platform.openai.com)

2) DSL chuẩn OMNI-VISION
Dùng chung cho OpenAI pass, Gemini pass, RX, và Phase 2 scraping.
backend/node/src/schemas.ts
import { z } from "zod";

const Confidence = z.number().min(0).max(1);

export const VisionDSLSchema = z.object({
  request_id: z.string(),
  provider: z.enum(["openai", "gemini", "hybrid"]),
  mode: z.enum(["text", "image", "image+text", "audio+text"]),
  intent: z.enum([
    "lottery_board_parse",
    "special_table_parse",
    "lottery_chat_assist",
    "scrape_candidate",
    "general_vision",
  ]),
  summary: z.string(),
  detected_language: z.string().nullable().default("vi"),
  confidence: Confidence,
  needs_human_review: z.boolean().default(false),

  extracted_text: z.array(z.object({
    text: z.string(),
    bbox: z.array(z.number()).length(4).optional(), // [x1,y1,x2,y2]
    confidence: Confidence.optional(),
  })).default([]),

  entities: z.array(z.object({
    type: z.enum([
      "region",
      "station",
      "prize",
      "special",
      "loto_pair",
      "date",
      "time",
      "command",
      "table_cell",
    ]),
    value: z.string(),
    confidence: Confidence.optional(),
  })).default([]),

  lottery: z.object({
    region: z.enum(["mb", "mn", "mt", "vl"]).nullable().default(null),
    station: z.string().nullable().default(null),
    date: z.string().nullable().default(null),
    special: z.string().nullable().default(null),
    loto_pairs: z.array(z.string().regex(/^\d{2}$/)).default([]),
    rows: z.array(z.object({
      label: z.string(),
      values: z.array(z.string()),
    })).default([]),
  }),

  rx: z.object({
    route: z.enum(["ai_hub", "live_room", "stats_matrix", "scrape_gate"]).default("ai_hub"),
    recommended_actions: z.array(z.enum([
      "highlight_special",
      "fill_loto_table",
      "open_overlay",
      "queue_scrape",
      "ask_clarification",
    ])).default([]),
  }),
});

export const ChatReplySchema = z.object({
  reply: z.string(),
  badges: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
  targets: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
  command: z.enum(["none", "scan", "analyze", "scrape_prepare", "generate_image"]).default("none"),
  dsl_patch: VisionDSLSchema.partial().default({}),
});

export const ScrapeRunSchema = z.object({
  source: z.string().min(2),
  url: z.string().url(),
  region: z.enum(["mb", "mn", "mt", "vl"]).nullable().default(null),
  target_table: z.enum(["loto", "special", "hybrid"]).default("hybrid"),
  live_enabled: z.boolean().default(false),
});

export const RXIngestSchema = z.object({
  job_id: z.string(),
  records: z.array(z.object({
    source: z.string(),
    url: z.string().url().optional(),
    html: z.string().optional(),
    text: z.string().optional(),
    captured_at: z.string(),
  })).min(1),
});

export type VisionDSL = z.infer<typeof VisionDSLSchema>;
export type ChatReply = z.infer<typeof ChatReplySchema>;
