backend/node/src/server.ts
import "dotenv/config";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import express from "express";
import cors from "cors";
import multer from "multer";
import OpenAI from "openai";
import { z } from "zod";
import { zodTextFormat } from "openai/helpers/zod";
import {
  ChatReplySchema,
  RXIngestSchema,
  ScrapeRunSchema,
  VisionDSLSchema,
  type VisionDSL,
} from "./schemas";

const app = express();
const upload = multer({
  storage: multer.memoryStorage(),
  limits: { fileSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024 },
});

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json({ limit: "10mb" }));

const OPENAI_API_KEY = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
if (!OPENAI_API_KEY) throw new Error("Missing OPENAI_API_KEY");

const PY_WORKER_URL = process.env.PY_WORKER_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:8001";
const OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = process.env.OPENAI_VISION_MODEL ?? "gpt-4.1-mini";
const OPENAI_STRUCTURED_MODEL = process.env.OPENAI_STRUCTURED_MODEL ?? "gpt-4o-2024-08-06";
const OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL = process.env.OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL ?? "gpt-image-1";
const OPENAI_TRANSCRIBE_MODEL = process.env.OPENAI_TRANSCRIBE_MODEL ?? "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe";

const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY });

function toDataUrl(file: Express.Multer.File): string {
  return `data:${file.mimetype};base64,${file.buffer.toString("base64")}`;
}

function dedupe<T>(items: T[], keyFn: (x: T) => string): T[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return items.filter((x) => {
    const key = keyFn(x);
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });
}

function mergeVision(a: VisionDSL, b: VisionDSL): VisionDSL {
  const sameSpecial =
    a.lottery.special &&
    b.lottery.special &&
    a.lottery.special === b.lottery.special;

  const sameRegion =
    a.lottery.region &&
    b.lottery.region &&
    a.lottery.region === b.lottery.region;

  const conflict =
    !!a.lottery.special &&
    !!b.lottery.special &&
    a.lottery.special !== b.lottery.special;

  return {
    ...a,
    request_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    provider: "hybrid",
    summary: a.summary || b.summary,
    detected_language: a.detected_language ?? b.detected_language ?? "vi",
    confidence: Math.min(
      1,
      Math.max(a.confidence, b.confidence) + (sameSpecial ? 0.1 : 0) + (sameRegion ? 0.05 : 0)
    ),
    needs_human_review: conflict || a.needs_human_review || b.needs_human_review,
    extracted_text: dedupe(
      [...a.extracted_text, ...b.extracted_text],
      (x) => `${x.text}:${(x.bbox ?? []).join(",")}`
    ),
    entities: dedupe(
      [...a.entities, ...b.entities],
      (x) => `${x.type}:${x.value}`
    ),
    lottery: {
      region: a.lottery.region ?? b.lottery.region,
      station: a.lottery.station ?? b.lottery.station,
      date: a.lottery.date ?? b.lottery.date,
      special: a.lottery.special ?? b.lottery.special,
      loto_pairs: [...new Set([...(a.lottery.loto_pairs ?? []), ...(b.lottery.loto_pairs ?? [])])],
      rows: a.lottery.rows.length ? a.lottery.rows : b.lottery.rows,
    },
    rx: {
      route: a.rx.route ?? b.rx.route,
      recommended_actions: [...new Set([
        ...(a.rx.recommended_actions ?? []),
        ...(b.rx.recommended_actions ?? []),
      ])],
    },
  };
}

async function callOpenAIChat(text: string, history?: Array<{ role: "user" | "assistant" | "system"; content: string }>) {
  const response = await openai.responses.parse({
    model: OPENAI_STRUCTURED_MODEL,
    instructions:
      "Bạn là OMNI CORE cho ứng dụng xổ số. Trả đúng schema. Ưu tiên tiếng Việt. Không bịa kết quả xổ số nếu không có dữ liệu.",
    input: [
      ...(history ?? []),
      { role: "user", content: text },
    ],
    text: {
      format: zodTextFormat(ChatReplySchema, "ai_hub_reply"),
    },
  });

  return response.output_parsed;
}

async function callOpenAIVision(
  file: Express.Multer.File | undefined,
  prompt: string,
  textContext?: string
) {
  const content: any[] = [
    {
      type: "input_text",
      text: [
        "Chuẩn hóa đầu vào thị giác thành Vision DSL.",
        "Nếu là bảng xổ số, cố gắng nhận dạng: miền, đài, ngày, giải ĐB, các cặp lô tô, các hàng giải.",
        "Nếu dữ liệu không chắc chắn, needs_human_review=true.",
        `Prompt nghiệp vụ: ${prompt || "Phân tích bảng xổ số"}`,
        textContext ? `Ngữ cảnh chữ: ${textContext}` : "",
      ].filter(Boolean).join("\n"),
    },
  ];

  if (file) {
    content.push({
      type: "input_image",
      image_url: toDataUrl(file),
      detail: "high",
    });
  }

  const response = await openai.responses.parse({
    model: OPENAI_VISION_MODEL,
    input: [{ role: "user", content }],
    text: {
      format: zodTextFormat(VisionDSLSchema, "vision_dsl"),
    },
  });

  return response.output_parsed;
}

async function callGeminiWorker(
  file: Express.Multer.File | undefined,
  prompt: string,
  textContext?: string
): Promise<VisionDSL> {
  const form = new FormData();
  form.set("prompt", prompt);
  form.set("text_context", textContext ?? "");
  if (file) {
    form.set(
      "image",
      new Blob([file.buffer], { type: file.mimetype }),
      file.originalname || "upload.jpg"
    );
  }

  const r = await fetch(`${PY_WORKER_URL}/v1/vision/gemini-dsl`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: form,
  });

  if (!r.ok) {
    const body = await r.text();
    throw new Error(`Gemini worker failed: ${r.status} ${body}`);
  }

  const json = await r.json();
  return VisionDSLSchema.parse(json.dsl);
}

async function transcribeAudio(file: Express.Multer.File): Promise<string> {
  const form = new FormData();
  form.set("model", OPENAI_TRANSCRIBE_MODEL);
  form.set(
    "file",
    new Blob([file.buffer], { type: file.mimetype }),
    file.originalname || "mic.webm"
  );

  const r = await fetch("https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${OPENAI_API_KEY}`,
    },
    body: form,
  });

  if (!r.ok) {
    const body = await r.text();
    throw new Error(`Transcription failed: ${r.status} ${body}`);
  }

  const json = await r.json() as { text: string };
  return json.text;
}

app.get("/healthz", (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ ok: true, service: "omni-gateway" });
});

app.post("/api/omni/chat", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const body = z.object({
      text: z.string().min(1),
      history: z.array(z.object({
        role: z.enum(["user", "assistant", "system"]),
        content: z.string(),
      })).optional(),
    }).parse(req.body);

    const parsed = await callOpenAIChat(body.text, body.history);
    res.json({ ok: true, reply: parsed });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

app.post("/api/omni/vision", upload.single("image"), async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const prompt = String(req.body.prompt ?? "Phân tích ảnh xổ số");
    const textContext = String(req.body.text_context ?? "");

    const [openaiDsl, geminiDsl] = await Promise.all([
      callOpenAIVision(req.file, prompt, textContext),
      callGeminiWorker(req.file, prompt, textContext),
    ]);

    const merged = mergeVision(openaiDsl, geminiDsl);
    res.json({
      ok: true,
      dsl: merged,
      providers: {
        openai: openaiDsl,
        gemini: geminiDsl,
      },
    });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

app.post("/api/omni/mic/transcribe", upload.single("audio"), async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    if (!req.file) throw new Error("Missing audio file");

    const transcript = await transcribeAudio(req.file);
    const reply = await callOpenAIChat(transcript);

    res.json({
      ok: true,
      transcript,
      reply,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

app.post("/api/omni/image", upload.single("image"), async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const prompt = String(req.body.prompt ?? "").trim();
    if (!prompt) throw new Error("Missing image prompt");

    if (req.file) {
      const image = await openai.images.edit({
        model: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL,
        prompt,
        image: new File([req.file.buffer], req.file.originalname || "edit.png", {
          type: req.file.mimetype,
        }),
      });
      return res.json({ ok: true, mode: "edit", data: image.data });
    }

    const generated = await openai.images.generate({
      model: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL,
      prompt,
      size: (req.body.size as "1024x1024" | "1024x1536" | "1536x1024") ?? "1024x1024",
    });

    res.json({ ok: true, mode: "generate", data: generated.data });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

/* =======================
   SCRAPING GATES - STANDBY
   ======================= */
const scrapeJobs = new Map<string, any>();

app.get("/api/scrape/standby/providers", (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    enabled: false,
    providers: ["html_fetch", "rss_fetch", "json_fetch"],
    next_hop: "/api/scrape/standby/ingest",
  });
});

app.post("/api/scrape/standby/run", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const payload = ScrapeRunSchema.parse(req.body);
    const jobId = crypto.randomUUID();

    scrapeJobs.set(jobId, {
      id: jobId,
      status: payload.live_enabled ? "queued" : "standby",
      payload,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    res.status(202).json({
      ok: true,
      job_id: jobId,
      status: payload.live_enabled ? "queued" : "standby",
      message: payload.live_enabled
        ? "Live scrape queue accepted."
        : "Standby gate armed. No external crawling executed.",
    });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

app.post("/api/scrape/standby/ingest", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const payload = RXIngestSchema.parse(req.body);

    const r = await fetch(`${PY_WORKER_URL}/v1/rx/analyze`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });

    if (!r.ok) {
      const body = await r.text();
      throw new Error(`RX worker failed: ${r.status} ${body}`);
    }

    const rx = await r.json();
    res.json({ ok: true, rx });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

app.get("/api/scrape/standby/:jobId", (req, res) => {
  const job = scrapeJobs.get(req.params.jobId);
  if (!job) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: "job_not_found" });
  res.json({ ok: true, job });
});

app.use((err: any, _req: express.Request, res: express.Response, _next: express.NextFunction) => {
  console.error(err);
  res.status(500).json({
    ok: false,
    error: err?.message ?? "internal_error",
  });
});

const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 8787);
app.listen(port, () => {
  console.log(`OMNI Gateway listening on :${port}`);
});

backend/python/worker.py
import io
import os
import re
import hashlib
from typing import Literal, Optional, List

from fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, UploadFile, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from PIL import Image, ImageOps
from google import genai

app = FastAPI(title="omni-python-worker")
gemini = genai.Client(api_key=os.environ["GEMINI_API_KEY"])
GEMINI_MODEL = os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL", "gemini-2.5-flash")


class TextBlock(BaseModel):
    text: str
    bbox: Optional[List[float]] = None
    confidence: Optional[float] = None


class Entity(BaseModel):
    type: Literal[
        "region", "station", "prize", "special", "loto_pair",
        "date", "time", "command", "table_cell"
    ]
    value: str
    confidence: Optional[float] = None


class LotteryData(BaseModel):
    region: Optional[Literal["mb", "mn", "mt", "vl"]] = None
    station: Optional[str] = None
    date: Optional[str] = None
    special: Optional[str] = None
    loto_pairs: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    rows: List[dict] = Field(default_factory=list)


class RXAdvice(BaseModel):
    route: Literal["ai_hub", "live_room", "stats_matrix", "scrape_gate"] = "ai_hub"
    recommended_actions: List[
        Literal["highlight_special", "fill_loto_table", "open_overlay", "queue_scrape", "ask_clarification"]
    ] = Field(default_factory=list)


class VisionDSL(BaseModel):
    request_id: str
    provider: Literal["openai", "gemini", "hybrid"] = "gemini"
    mode: Literal["text", "image", "image+text", "audio+text"]
    intent: Literal[
        "lottery_board_parse",
        "special_table_parse",
        "lottery_chat_assist",
        "scrape_candidate",
        "general_vision",
    ]
    summary: str
    detected_language: Optional[str] = "vi"
    confidence: float
    needs_human_review: bool = False
    extracted_text: List[TextBlock] = Field(default_factory=list)
    entities: List[Entity] = Field(default_factory=list)
    lottery: LotteryData = Field(default_factory=LotteryData)
    rx: RXAdvice = Field(default_factory=RXAdvice)


class RXRecord(BaseModel):
    source: str
    url: Optional[str] = None
    html: Optional[str] = None
    text: Optional[str] = None
    captured_at: str


class RXIngest(BaseModel):
    job_id: str
    records: List[RXRecord]


@app.get("/healthz")
def healthz():
    return {"ok": True, "service": "omni-python-worker"}


@app.post("/v1/vision/gemini-dsl")
async def gemini_dsl(
    prompt: str = Form("Phân tích ảnh xổ số"),
    text_context: str = Form(""),
    image: UploadFile | None = File(default=None),
):
    try:
        contents = []
        mode: Literal["text", "image", "image+text", "audio+text"] = "text"
        request_id = os.urandom(8).hex()

        if image is not None:
            raw = await image.read()
            if not raw:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="empty image")

            img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw))
            img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert("RGB")
            contents.append(img)
            mode = "image+text" if text_context else "image"

            sha256 = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            image_note = f"sha256={sha256}, size={img.width}x{img.height}, mime={image.content_type}"
        else:
            image_note = "no_image"

        system_prompt = f"""
Bạn là GEMINI OMNI-VISION WORKER.
Nhiệm vụ: chuyển đầu vào thành JSON đúng schema VisionDSL.
Ưu tiên tiếng Việt. Nếu không chắc chắn, đặt needs_human_review=true.
Chỉ trả JSON hợp lệ.
Prompt nghiệp vụ: {prompt}
Ngữ cảnh chữ: {text_context or "N/A"}
Ảnh meta: {image_note}
"""
        contents.append(system_prompt.strip())

        response = gemini.models.generate_content(
            model=GEMINI_MODEL,
            contents=contents,
            config={
                "response_mime_type": "application/json",
                "response_json_schema": VisionDSL.model_json_schema(),
            },
        )

        dsl = VisionDSL.model_validate_json(response.text)
        dsl.request_id = request_id
        dsl.provider = "gemini"
        dsl.mode = mode
        return {"ok": True, "dsl": dsl.model_dump()}
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"gemini_worker_error: {exc}")


@app.post("/v1/rx/analyze")
def rx_analyze(payload: RXIngest):
    text_blob = "\n".join(
        filter(
            None,
            [r.text for r in payload.records] + [re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", r.html or "") for r in payload.records]
        )
    )

    pairs = re.findall(r"\b\d{2}\b", text_blob)
    freq = {}
    for p in pairs:
        freq[p] = freq.get(p, 0) + 1

    sorted_pairs = sorted(freq.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    top_pairs = [p for p, _ in sorted_pairs[:10]]

    special_candidates = re.findall(r"\b\d{5,6}\b", text_blob)[:5]

    return {
        "job_id": payload.job_id,
        "status": "rx_preanalyzed",
        "summary": {
            "records": len(payload.records),
            "top_pairs": top_pairs,
            "special_candidates": special_candidates,
        },
        "route": {
            "loto": top_pairs,
            "special": special_candidates,
        },
        "ready_for_phase_2": True,
    }

<script>
(() => {
  const API = {
    chat: "/api/omni/chat",
    vision: "/api/omni/vision",
    mic: "/api/omni/mic/transcribe",
  };

  const state = {
    recorder: null,
    chunks: [],
    stream: null,
    busy: false,
  };

  async function postJSON(url, payload) {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const json = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !json.ok) throw new Error(json.error || "request_failed");
    return json;
  }

  async function postForm(url, formData) {
    const res = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", body: formData });
    const json = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !json.ok) throw new Error(json.error || "request_failed");
    return json;
  }

  function logToTV(text, tone = "system") {
    const tvLog = document.getElementById("tv-log");
    if (!tvLog) return;
    const color =
      tone === "ok" ? "var(--ai-green)" :
      tone === "warn" ? "var(--ai-yellow)" :
      tone === "err" ? "var(--ai-red)" : "#10b981";
    tvLog.innerHTML += `<div style="color:${color}">> ${escapeHtml(text)}</div>`;
    tvLog.scrollTop = tvLog.scrollHeight;
  }

  function escapeHtml(input) {
    return String(input)
      .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
      .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
      .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
      .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
      .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
  }

  async function withSupremeScan(label, fn) {
    if (state.busy) return;
    state.busy = true;

    document.querySelectorAll(".omni-scan-shell").forEach((el) => {
      el.classList.add("is-analyzing");
    });

    if (window.HUD) {
      HUD.updateBadge(`● ${label}`, "#67e8f9");
      HUD.activateScanMode();
      HUD.fireLaser("cyan");
    }

    try {
      const result = await fn();
      if (window.HUD) HUD.updateBadge("● VISION LOCKED", "#10b981");
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      if (window.HUD) HUD.updateBadge("● SYSTEM FAULT", "#ef4444");
      throw err;
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll(".omni-scan-shell").forEach((el) => {
          el.classList.remove("is-analyzing");
        });
        if (window.HUD) HUD.reset();
        state.busy = false;
      }, 700);
    }
  }

  function applyDslToUI(dsl) {
    if (!dsl) return;

    if (document.getElementById("top-text-1")) {
      document.getElementById("top-text-1").innerText = dsl.intent || "OMNI";
    }
    if (document.getElementById("top-text-2")) {
      document.getElementById("top-text-2").innerText =
        dsl.lottery?.special || dsl.lottery?.region || "LOCKED";
    }
    if (document.getElementById("top-text-3")) {
      document.getElementById("top-text-3").innerText = "VISION READY";
    }

    if (dsl.summary) logToTV(dsl.summary, "ok");

    if (dsl.lottery?.special) {
      const maybeDB = document.querySelector(".row-db .number-text");
      if (maybeDB) maybeDB.innerHTML = escapeHtml(dsl.lottery.special);
    }
  }

  async function sendChatText(text) {
    const payload = await withSupremeScan("AI CHAT LINK", async () => {
      return postJSON(API.chat, { text });
    });

    if (payload.reply?.reply) {
      const box = document.getElementById("chat-msg-container") || document.querySelector(".chat-messages");
      if (box) {
        const div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "msg ai";
        div.innerHTML = payload.reply.reply;
        box.appendChild(div);
        box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
      }
    }

    applyDslToUI(payload.reply?.dsl_patch);
    return payload;
  }

  async function analyzeImage(file, prompt = "Đọc ảnh xổ số và chuyển thành DSL có cấu trúc") {
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("image", file);
    form.append("prompt", prompt);

    const payload = await withSupremeScan("OMNI VISION", async () => {
      return postForm(API.vision, form);
    });

    applyDslToUI(payload.dsl);
    return payload;
  }

  async function startMicCapture() {
    if (state.recorder) return;

    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: "audio/webm" });

    state.stream = stream;
    state.recorder = recorder;
    state.chunks = [];

    recorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
      if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) state.chunks.push(e.data);
    };

    recorder.start();

    document.getElementById("ui-mic")?.classList.add("listening");
    const micBtn = document.getElementById("btn-mic");
    if (micBtn) micBtn.classList.add("recording");
  }

  async function stopMicAndSubmit() {
    if (!state.recorder) return;

    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      state.recorder.onstop = resolve;
      state.recorder.stop();
    });

    const blob = new Blob(state.chunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("audio", blob, "omni-mic.webm");

    state.stream?.getTracks()?.forEach((t) => t.stop());
    state.stream = null;
    state.recorder = null;
    state.chunks = [];

    document.getElementById("ui-mic")?.classList.remove("listening");
    document.getElementById("btn-mic")?.classList.remove("recording");

    const payload = await withSupremeScan("VOICE -> RX", async () => {
      return postForm(API.mic, form);
    });

    if (payload.transcript) logToTV(`VOICE: ${payload.transcript}`, "warn");
    applyDslToUI(payload.reply?.dsl_patch);

    if (payload.reply?.reply) {
      const tvMessage = document.getElementById("tv-message");
      if (tvMessage) tvMessage.innerHTML = payload.reply.reply;
    }

    return payload;
  }

  // bind upload input
  const uploadInput = document.getElementById("omni-upload-input");
  if (uploadInput) {
    uploadInput.addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
      const file = e.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      try {
        await analyzeImage(file);
      } catch (err) {
        logToTV(`UPLOAD ERROR: ${err.message}`, "err");
      } finally {
        e.target.value = "";
      }
    });
  }

  // public API
  window.OMNI = {
    sendChatText,
    analyzeImage,
    startMicCapture,
    stopMicAndSubmit,
    openUpload: () => document.getElementById("omni-upload-input")?.click(),
  };

  // monkey patch các hàm mock cũ
  window.activateVoice = () => window.OMNI.startMicCapture();
  window.processUserMethod = () => window.OMNI.stopMicAndSubmit();

  window.sendChatMessage = async function () {
    const input =
      document.getElementById("chat-input-field") ||
      document.getElementById("voice-input-mb") ||
      document.getElementById("voice-input-mn") ||
      document.getElementById("voice-input-mt") ||
      document.getElementById("voice-input-vl");

    if (!input || !input.value.trim()) return;
    const text = input.value.trim();
    input.value = "";
    await window.OMNI.sendChatText(text);
  };
})();
</script>

CSS patch
/* =========================
   OMNI SUPREME SCAN PATCH
   ========================= */
.omni-scan-shell {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  contain: paint;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.omni-scan-shell::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 4;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(103,232,249,0.10), transparent 45%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,165,233,0.05), rgba(168,85,247,0.05));
  transition: opacity 180ms ease;
}

.omni-scan-shell::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -20% 0 auto 0;
  height: 2px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 5;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(34,211,238,0.6) 20%,
    rgba(255,255,255,0.95) 50%,
    rgba(34,211,238,0.6) 80%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.9),
    0 0 32px rgba(14,165,233,0.55),
    0 12px 32px rgba(168,85,247,0.18);
  transform: translate3d(0, -120%, 0);
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}

.omni-scan-shell.is-analyzing::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.omni-scan-shell.is-analyzing::after {
  opacity: 1;
  animation: omniLaserSweep 1350ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite;
}

.omni-scan-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(103,232,249,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(103,232,249,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 18px 18px;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

.omni-scan-shell.is-analyzing .omni-scan-grid {
  opacity: 1;
  animation: omniGridPulse 900ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes omniLaserSweep {
  0%   { transform: translate3d(0, -120%, 0); }
  100% { transform: translate3d(0, 720px, 0); }
}

@keyframes omniGridPulse {
  0%   { opacity: 0.10; filter: saturate(1); }
  100% { opacity: 0.22; filter: saturate(1.35); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .omni-scan-shell::before,
  .omni-scan-shell::after,
  .omni-scan-grid {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

In general examples, response_format is the standard, but for custom voices, it switches to format. I should check the docs thoroughly to see if there's any mention of aliases for these fields. It seems like the main guide prefers response_format, especially since the cURL example for getting a WAV file uses it. To maintain consistency, I think I’ll stick with response_format for built-in voices and consider format for custom voice objects, if necessary. However, as I'm finding, the custom voice examples prefer format, which adds a bit of complexity. Let's keep this clear!
Deciding on API Parameters
I'm thinking about whether to set both response_format and format in the API call. It seems potentially redundant, but is it acceptable? My instinct leans toward setting just response_format. If there’s a custom voice ID, I might still include voice: {id:...} since it should work on the same endpoint. The custom voice examples use format, which could be an older style or alias. I should check the API reference for clarity and see if the actual parameter varies between REST and SDK. Let's figure this out!
Exploring code syntax
I'm looking at potential code syntax for CSS and JavaScript. The CSS part includes rules like .span-2 { grid-column: span 2; } and a media query for smaller screens. I also see that I'll use details > summary elements. In JavaScript, I've noted const SAMPLE_SCHEMA = {...}; along with setting the schemaEditor.value to a formatted string version of that schema. I need to produce full code with comments to clarify these points.

<!doctype html>

    .badge-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}

    }

    .grid{

    }

    .row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}

    .hr{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:18px 0}

    }

    @media (max-width: 1100px){
      .card.two-thirds,.card.one-third,.card.half{grid-column:span 12}

  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="app">
    <header class="hero">
      <div>
        <h1>Bản hợp nhất 1 file HTML duy nhất</h1>
        <p>

        <div class="card-header">

        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="openaiImagePrompt">Prompt phân tích ảnh</label>
            <textarea id="openaiImagePrompt">Hãy mô tả chi tiết ảnh này, liệt kê các vật thể chính và đưa ra 3 từ khóa quan trọng.</textarea>

      <article class="card half">
        <div class="card-header">
          <h2>5) Gemini Image Understanding</h2>

        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="geminiImagePrompt">Prompt phân tích ảnh</label>
            <textarea id="geminiImagePrompt">Hãy mô tả nội dung ảnh này bằng tiếng Việt và nêu ra các chi tiết đáng chú ý.</textarea>

      <article class="card half">

  <script>
    (() => {
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

      const els = {
        status: $("status"),

        openaiKey: $("openaiKey"),
        geminiKey: $("geminiKey"),
        openaiModel: $("openaiModel"),
        sttModel: $("sttModel"),
        ttsModel: $("ttsModel"),
        geminiModel: $("geminiModel"),
        maxOutputTokens: $("maxOutputTokens"),
        openaiBase: $("openaiBase"),
        geminiBase: $("geminiBase"),

        textInstructions: $("textInstructions"),
        textPrompt: $("textPrompt"),
        btnText: $("btnText"),
        btnTextDemo: $("btnTextDemo"),
        btnTextClear: $("btnTextClear"),
        textOutput: $("textOutput"),
        textRaw: $("textRaw"),

        schemaInstructions: $("schemaInstructions"),
        schemaPrompt: $("schemaPrompt"),
        schemaName: $("schemaName"),
        schemaStrict: $("schemaStrict"),
        schemaEditor: $("schemaEditor"),
        btnSchema: $("btnSchema"),
        btnSchemaDemo: $("btnSchemaDemo"),
        btnSchemaClear: $("btnSchemaClear"),
        schemaOutput: $("schemaOutput"),
        schemaRaw: $("schemaRaw"),

        openaiImagePrompt: $("openaiImagePrompt"),
        openaiImageFile: $("openaiImageFile"),
        openaiImagePreview: $("openaiImagePreview"),
        openaiImageMeta: $("openaiImageMeta"),
        btnOpenAIVision: $("btnOpenAIVision"),
        btnOpenAIVisionClear: $("btnOpenAIVisionClear"),
        openaiVisionOutput: $("openaiVisionOutput"),
        openaiVisionRaw: $("openaiVisionRaw"),

        geminiImagePrompt: $("geminiImagePrompt"),
        geminiImageFile: $("geminiImageFile"),
        geminiImagePreview: $("geminiImagePreview"),
        geminiImageMeta: $("geminiImageMeta"),
        btnGeminiVision: $("btnGeminiVision"),
        btnGeminiVisionClear: $("btnGeminiVisionClear"),
        geminiVisionOutput: $("geminiVisionOutput"),
        geminiVisionRaw: $("geminiVisionRaw"),

        sttFile: $("sttFile"),
        sttResponseFormat: $("sttResponseFormat"),
        sttPrompt: $("sttPrompt"),
        btnSTT: $("btnSTT"),
        btnSTTClear: $("btnSTTClear"),
        sttOutput: $("sttOutput"),
        sttRaw: $("sttRaw"),

        ttsInput: $("ttsInput"),
        ttsInstructions: $("ttsInstructions"),
        ttsVoice: $("ttsVoice"),
        ttsCustomVoiceId: $("ttsCustomVoiceId"),
        ttsFormat: $("ttsFormat"),
        btnTTS: $("btnTTS"),
        btnTTSClear: $("btnTTSClear"),
        ttsPlayer: $("ttsPlayer"),
        ttsDownload: $("ttsDownload"),
        ttsMeta: $("ttsMeta"),
      };

      const BUILTIN_VOICES = [
        "alloy", "ash", "ballad", "coral", "echo", "fable",
        "nova", "onyx", "sage", "shimmer", "verse", "marin", "cedar"
      ];

      const SAMPLE_SCHEMA = {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
          title: { type: "string" },
          summary: { type: "string" },
          capabilities: {
            type: "array",
            items: { type: "string" }
          },
          audience: {
            type: "array",
            items: { type: "string" }
          }
        },
        required: ["title", "summary", "capabilities", "audience"],
        additionalProperties: false
      };

      const state = {
        previewUrls: new Map(),
        ttsUrl: null
      };

      function init() {
        BUILTIN_VOICES.forEach((voice) => {
          const opt = document.createElement("option");
          opt.value = voice;
          opt.textContent = voice;
          if (voice === "marin") opt.selected = true;
          els.ttsVoice.appendChild(opt);
        });

        els.schemaEditor.value = JSON.stringify(SAMPLE_SCHEMA, null, 2);

        bindImagePreview(els.openaiImageFile, els.openaiImagePreview, els.openaiImageMeta, "openai-preview");
        bindImagePreview(els.geminiImageFile, els.geminiImagePreview, els.geminiImageMeta, "gemini-preview");

        els.btnText.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnText, "Đang gọi OpenAI...", handleText));
        els.btnTextDemo.addEventListener("click", loadTextDemo);
        els.btnTextClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearTextOutputs());

        els.btnSchema.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnSchema, "Đang sinh JSON...", handleStructured));
        els.btnSchemaDemo.addEventListener("click", loadSchemaDemo);
        els.btnSchemaClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearStructuredOutputs());

        els.btnOpenAIVision.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnOpenAIVision, "Đang phân tích ảnh...", handleOpenAIVision));
        els.btnOpenAIVisionClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearOpenAIVisionOutputs());

        els.btnGeminiVision.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnGeminiVision, "Đang phân tích ảnh...", handleGeminiVision));
        els.btnGeminiVisionClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearGeminiVisionOutputs());

        els.btnSTT.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnSTT, "Đang nhận dạng...", handleSTT));
        els.btnSTTClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearSTTOutputs());

        els.btnTTS.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnTTS, "Đang tạo audio...", handleTTS));
        els.btnTTSClear.addEventListener("click", clearTTSOutput);
      }

      function setStatus(message, type = "info") {
        els.status.className = "status " + type;
        els.status.textContent = message;
      }

      function loadTextDemo() {
        els.textInstructions.value = "Bạn là trợ lý kỹ thuật. Hãy trả lời ngắn gọn, ưu tiên bullet, tiếng Việt.";
        els.textPrompt.value = "Viết checklist 8 bước để chuyển một prototype AI client-side sang production an toàn.";
        setStatus("Đã nạp ví dụ cho Responses API.", "info");
      }

      function loadSchemaDemo() {
        els.schemaName.value = "feature_summary";
        els.schemaInstructions.value = "Trả về dữ liệu theo đúng JSON schema. Không thêm chữ ngoài JSON.";
        els.schemaPrompt.value = "Mô tả ứng dụng này: một dashboard AI có chat văn bản, phân tích ảnh, chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản, và tạo giọng đọc.";
        els.schemaEditor.value = JSON.stringify(SAMPLE_SCHEMA, null, 2);
        els.schemaStrict.value = "true";
        setStatus("Đã nạp schema demo.", "info");
      }

      function trimBase(url) {
        return (url || "").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
      }

      function getOpenAIBase() {
        return trimBase(els.openaiBase.value) || "https://api.openai.com/v1";
      }

      function getGeminiBase() {
        return trimBase(els.geminiBase.value) || "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta";
      }

      function getOpenAIKey() {
        const key = (els.openaiKey.value || "").trim();
        if (!key) throw new Error("Thiếu OpenAI API key.");
        return key;
      }

      function getGeminiKey() {
        const key = (els.geminiKey.value || "").trim();
        if (!key) throw new Error("Thiếu Gemini API key.");
        return key;
      }

      function getResponsesMaxTokens() {
        const n = Number(els.maxOutputTokens.value || 0);
        return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? Math.floor(n) : 1800;
      }

      function maybeClientRequestId(headers) {
        if (window.crypto && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
          headers["X-Client-Request-Id"] = crypto.randomUUID();
        }
        return headers;
      }

      async function readAsDataURL(file) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Không đọc được file."));
          reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
      }

      async function readAsBase64(file) {
        const dataUrl = await readAsDataURL(file);
        const parts = String(dataUrl).split(",", 2);
        if (parts.length !== 2) throw new Error("Không thể chuyển file sang base64.");
        return parts[1];
      }

      function formatBytes(bytes) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "";
        const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
        let i = 0;
        let num = bytes;
        while (num >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
          num /= 1024;
          i++;
        }
        return `${num.toFixed(num < 10 && i > 0 ? 1 : 0)} ${units[i]}`;
      }

      function bindImagePreview(fileInput, imgEl, metaEl, key) {
        fileInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
          const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
          if (!file) {
            cleanupPreview(key);
            imgEl.hidden = true;
            imgEl.removeAttribute("src");
            metaEl.textContent = "Chưa có ảnh";
            return;
          }
          cleanupPreview(key);
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
          state.previewUrls.set(key, url);
          imgEl.src = url;
          imgEl.hidden = false;
          metaEl.textContent = `${file.name} • ${file.type || "image/*"} • ${formatBytes(file.size)}`;
        });
      }

      function cleanupPreview(key) {
        const old = state.previewUrls.get(key);
        if (old) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(old);
          state.previewUrls.delete(key);
        }
      }

      function pretty(value) {
        if (typeof value === "string") return value;
        try {
          return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
        } catch {
          return String(value);
        }
      }

      function clearTextOutputs() {
        els.textOutput.textContent = "";
        els.textRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearStructuredOutputs() {
        els.schemaOutput.textContent = "";
        els.schemaRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearOpenAIVisionOutputs() {
        els.openaiVisionOutput.textContent = "";
        els.openaiVisionRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearGeminiVisionOutputs() {
        els.geminiVisionOutput.textContent = "";
        els.geminiVisionRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearSTTOutputs() {
        els.sttOutput.textContent = "";
        els.sttRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearTTSOutput() {
        if (state.ttsUrl) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(state.ttsUrl);
          state.ttsUrl = null;
        }
        els.ttsPlayer.pause();
        els.ttsPlayer.hidden = true;
        els.ttsPlayer.removeAttribute("src");
        els.ttsDownload.hidden = true;
        els.ttsDownload.removeAttribute("href");
        els.ttsMeta.textContent = "Chưa có audio";
      }

      async function runTask(button, busyText, fn) {
        const original = button.textContent;
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = busyText;
        try {
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(err);
          setStatus(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err), "error");
        } finally {
          button.disabled = false;
          button.textContent = original;
        }
      }

      async function fetchAsJsonOrText(response) {
        const raw = await response.text();
        const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
        let data = raw;
        if (contentType.includes("application/json") || /^[\s\n\r]*[{\[]/.test(raw)) {
          try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch {}
        }
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}\n${typeof data === "string" ? data : pretty(data)}`);
        }
        return data;
      }

      async function postOpenAIJson(path, body) {
        const key = getOpenAIKey();
        const headers = maybeClientRequestId({
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        });
        const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers,
          body: JSON.stringify(body)
        });
        return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
      }

      async function postOpenAIMultipart(path, formData) {
        const key = getOpenAIKey();
        const headers = maybeClientRequestId({
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`
        });
        const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers,
          body: formData
        });
        return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
      }

      async function postOpenAIBlob(path, body) {
        const key = getOpenAIKey();
        const headers = maybeClientRequestId({
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        });
        const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers,
          body: JSON.stringify(body)
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const raw = await res.text();
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}\n${raw}`);
        }
        return {
          blob: await res.blob(),
          contentType: res.headers.get("content-type") || ""
        };
      }

      async function postGeminiGenerateContent(body) {
        const key = getGeminiKey();
        const model = (els.geminiModel.value || "").trim() || "gemini-3-flash-preview";
        const res = await fetch(`${getGeminiBase()}/models/${encodeURIComponent(model)}:generateContent`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "x-goog-api-key": key,
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(body)
        });
        return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
      }

      function extractOpenAIOutputText(data) {
        const chunks = [];
        if (data && typeof data.output_text === "string" && data.output_text.trim()) {
          chunks.push(data.output_text.trim());
        }
        if (data && Array.isArray(data.output)) {
          for (const item of data.output) {
            const content = Array.isArray(item?.content) ? item.content : [];
            for (const part of content) {
              if (part?.type === "output_text" && typeof part.text === "string") {
                chunks.push(part.text);
              } else if (part?.type === "refusal" && typeof part.refusal === "string") {
                chunks.push(`[Refusal] ${part.refusal}`);
              }
            }
          }
        }
        return chunks.join("\n\n").trim();
      }

      function extractGeminiText(data) {
        const parts = [];
        const candidates = Array.isArray(data?.candidates) ? data.candidates : [];
        for (const candidate of candidates) {
          const candidateParts = Array.isArray(candidate?.content?.parts) ? candidate.content.parts : [];
          for (const part of candidateParts) {
            if (typeof part?.text === "string" && part.text.trim()) {
              parts.push(part.text);
            }
          }
        }
        return parts.join("\n\n").trim();
      }

      async function handleText() {
        clearTextOutputs();

        const model = (els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-5.4-mini";
        const instructions = (els.textInstructions.value || "").trim();
        const prompt = (els.textPrompt.value || "").trim();

        if (!prompt) throw new Error("Prompt văn bản đang trống.");

        const body = {
          model,
          input: prompt,
          max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens()
        };
        if (instructions) body.instructions = instructions;

        const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
        els.textRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
        els.textOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được output_text]";
        setStatus("Đã nhận phản hồi văn bản từ OpenAI.", "success");
      }

      async function handleStructured() {
        clearStructuredOutputs();

        const model = (els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-5.4-mini";
        const instructions = (els.schemaInstructions.value || "").trim();
        const prompt = (els.schemaPrompt.value || "").trim();
        const schemaName = (els.schemaName.value || "").trim() || "structured_response";
        const strict = els.schemaStrict.value === "true";

        if (!prompt) throw new Error("Prompt structured output đang trống.");

        let schema;
        try {
          schema = JSON.parse(els.schemaEditor.value);
        } catch (err) {
          throw new Error("JSON Schema không hợp lệ.");
        }

        const body = {
          model,
          input: [
            { role: "system", content: instructions || "Return valid JSON only." },
            { role: "user", content: prompt }
          ],
          max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens(),
          text: {
            format: {
              type: "json_schema",
              name: schemaName,
              schema,
              strict
            }
          }
        };

        const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
        els.schemaRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        if (data?.status === "incomplete" && data?.incomplete_details?.reason === "max_output_tokens") {
          throw new Error("Kết quả JSON bị cắt do max_output_tokens.");
        }

        const first = data?.output?.[0]?.content?.[0];
        if (first?.type === "refusal") {
          els.schemaOutput.textContent = `Model từ chối trả lời:\n${first.refusal || ""}`;
          setStatus("Model từ chối structured output.", "warn");
          return;
        }

        const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
        if (!text) {
          throw new Error("Không có output_text cho structured response.");
        }

        let parsed;
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(text);
        } catch {
          els.schemaOutput.textContent = text;
          setStatus("Đã nhận text nhưng parse JSON thất bại.", "warn");
          return;
        }

        els.schemaOutput.textContent = pretty(parsed);
        setStatus("Đã sinh JSON có cấu trúc.", "success");
      }

      async function handleOpenAIVision() {
        clearOpenAIVisionOutputs();

        const model = (els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-5.4-mini";
        const prompt = (els.openaiImagePrompt.value || "").trim() || "Describe this image.";
        const file = els.openaiImageFile.files && els.openaiImageFile.files[0];

        if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn ảnh cho OpenAI Vision.");

        const dataUrl = await readAsDataURL(file);

        const body = {
          model,
          max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens(),
          input: [
            {
              role: "user",
              content: [
                { type: "input_text", text: prompt },
                { type: "input_image", image_url: dataUrl }
              ]
            }
          ]
        };

        const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
        els.openaiVisionRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
        els.openaiVisionOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được mô tả ảnh]";
        setStatus("Đã phân tích ảnh bằng OpenAI.", "success");
      }

      async function handleGeminiVision() {
        clearGeminiVisionOutputs();

        const prompt = (els.geminiImagePrompt.value || "").trim() || "Describe this image.";
        const file = els.geminiImageFile.files && els.geminiImageFile.files[0];

        if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn ảnh cho Gemini.");

        const base64 = await readAsBase64(file);
        const mimeType = file.type || "image/jpeg";

        const body = {
          contents: [
            {
              parts: [
                {
                  inline_data: {
                    mime_type: mimeType,
                    data: base64
                  }
                },
                { text: prompt }
              ]
            }
          ]
        };

        const data = await postGeminiGenerateContent(body);
        els.geminiVisionRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        const text = extractGeminiText(data);
        els.geminiVisionOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được text từ Gemini response]";
        setStatus("Đã phân tích ảnh bằng Gemini.", "success");
      }

      async function handleSTT() {
        clearSTTOutputs();

        const file = els.sttFile.files && els.sttFile.files[0];
        if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn file audio.");

        const model = (els.sttModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4o-transcribe";
        const responseFormat = (els.sttResponseFormat.value || "text").trim();
        const prompt = (els.sttPrompt.value || "").trim();

        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append("file", file, file.name);
        fd.append("model", model);
        fd.append("response_format", responseFormat);
        if (prompt) fd.append("prompt", prompt);

        const data = await postOpenAIMultipart("/audio/transcriptions", fd);
        els.sttRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        if (typeof data === "string") {
          els.sttOutput.textContent = data;
        } else if (data && typeof data.text === "string") {
          els.sttOutput.textContent = data.text;
        } else {
          els.sttOutput.textContent = pretty(data);
        }

        setStatus("Đã chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản.", "success");
      }

      async function handleTTS() {
        clearTTSOutput();

        const model = (els.ttsModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4o-mini-tts";
        const input = (els.ttsInput.value || "").trim();
        const instructions = (els.ttsInstructions.value || "").trim();
        const builtInVoice = (els.ttsVoice.value || "").trim() || "marin";
        const customVoiceId = (els.ttsCustomVoiceId.value || "").trim();
        const responseFormat = (els.ttsFormat.value || "mp3").trim();

        if (!input) throw new Error("Văn bản TTS đang trống.");

        const body = {
          model,
          input,
          response_format: responseFormat
        };

        if (instructions) body.instructions = instructions;
        if (customVoiceId) {
          body.voice = { id: customVoiceId };
        } else {
          body.voice = builtInVoice;
        }

        const { blob, contentType } = await postOpenAIBlob("/audio/speech", body);

        state.ttsUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        els.ttsPlayer.src = state.ttsUrl;
        els.ttsPlayer.hidden = false;

        els.ttsDownload.href = state.ttsUrl;
        els.ttsDownload.download = `openai-tts.${responseFormat}`;
        els.ttsDownload.hidden = false;

        els.ttsMeta.textContent = `${contentType || "audio/*"} • ${formatBytes(blob.size)}`;
        setStatus("Đã tạo audio từ văn bản.", "success");
      }

      init();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
File trên mặc định dùng gpt-5.4-mini cho text/JSON/vision vì model này hiện hỗ trợ text+image input, Responses API và structured outputs; dùng gpt-4o-transcribe cho speech-to-text; gpt-4o-mini-tts cho text-to-speech; và gemini-3-flash-preview cho hiểu ảnh. (developers.openai.com)
Quan trọng: đây chỉ nên dùng để test nhanh ở local. OpenAI nêu rõ API key là bí mật và không nên nhúng trực tiếp trong mã client/browser; nếu triển khai thật, bạn nên đặt các lệnh gọi API sau backend/proxy. (platform.openai.com)

HTML gốc, và
từng patch/diff
mình sẽ xuất lại bản exact merge đúng 1 file cuối cùng theo patch của bạn.

Planning HTML transformation
I think it’s better to provide a sensible "HTML gốc" as an initial skeleton, then outline patch sets that transform it into the final merged HTML. Since the user asked for "cung cấp HTML gốc và từng patch để hợp nhất," they likely want the exact inputs for final production.
I’ll follow a reconstructed workflow, which includes base HTML and various patches for styles, forms, responses, outputs, and more. However, I want to keep the answer manageable and not overly complicated. It seems we don’t need web resources since it’s based on user content.
Clarifying the HTML request
I need to ensure I present the content correctly and not misrepresent it as exact extracts from links. It's essential to label my response as "bản dựng lại."
If the user literally wants "Hãy cung cấp HTML gốc và từng patch để hợp nhất," I could respond in Vietnamese. I can mention that the provided content doesn't include the original HTML, so I’ll give them a base HTML and the patch files.
I think I'll need to include all code for the patches because the instructions specify that any modifications to HTML should come with complete code.
Considering HTML patches
I think the instruction about modifying existing code relates to how I handle patches, which are a form of code. I might consider providing a minimal skeleton like index.base.html along with patch files named 01-add-styles-and-config.patch and so on.
These could be applied sequentially, but the patches need to refer to exact lines for consistency. It could be beneficial to create a simpler base file with patches that are sufficient to build the final result. However, generating correct patch hunks over a large file can be tricky. I could also use placeholder markers like <!-- PATCH_SLOT:... --> to make things easier, but I recognize the user still wants the original HTML and all patches. Presenting it as "HTML gốc" with each patch in POSIX diff -u format could work, even if it's a longer response.
Exploring alternative patching approach
I can consider providing the original HTML as the first version and then have each patch as a "search/replace patch" with clear anchors instead of traditional diffs. This could be a simpler option that still meets the user's request.
For instance, I'd start with a base file index.base.html that includes the basic structure. Patch 1 could replace a style placeholder, Patch 2 would add sections' HTML, and Patch 3 could insert full JavaScript.
The user mentioned they want "từng patch để hợp nhất," and providing original HTML with designated placeholders along with separate patch payloads is practical and less error-prone. I should remember to mention the sequence of application too!
Crafting the HTML structure
I want to create a short note for the user that says: "Không có dữ liệu exact từ Poe; bộ dưới đây là base + patches được tách ngược từ bản merged trước."
Then, I’ll provide the base HTML structure in index.base.html, including placeholders for styles, sections, and JavaScript.
After that, I can outline four patches:
Styles (CSS).
Shell content (hero, status text, footer).
Main UI sections (config, text, structured, vision, audio).
JavaScript behaviors and API integration.
This approach keeps things manageable while ensuring all necessary HTML markup for the main UI is included.
Structuring the HTML patches
This is quite a bit, but I think it will work. I might separate the main UI sections into multiple patches if it becomes too large, but I believe it’s manageable as is. I need to ensure that the patches reference the exact insertion positions clearly.
Here’s how I’d apply them:
Patch 1: replace /* PATCH: styles */.
Patch 2: replace the header and footer elements and set the status text.
Patch 3: replace <!-- PATCH: sections -->.
Patch 4: replace // PATCH: js.
I should include the actual content from our previous merged HTML, even if it’s large. It’s clear the user wants the code now. I may mention that if a unified diff is preferred later, I can convert these to standard .patch format. But for now, I’ll provide everything they need.
Constructing the base file and patches
I need to be careful not to use single dollar signs for math that's not relevant. I’ll accurately construct the base file and patches from the merged HTML. To reduce repetition, the base file will include placeholders for styles, hero, sections, footer, and scripts.
Patch 1 should contain all the CSS from the previous HTML, while Patch 2 will fill in the shell content like the hero, initial status, and footer. Patch 3 will provide the section markup, and Patch 4 will have the complete JavaScript.
Since there's some interdependence, it’s easier to set minimal base placeholders. I can provide explicit instructions for applying the patches in the order of 1 to 4. I'll also ensure that the base HTML includes a <div id="status" class="status warn"></div>, with placeholders inside the header, footer, and status for clarity.
Creating the base and patches
I’m setting up the base structure like this:
Then, Patch 2 will provide the HTML and text for the hero, status, and footer. Patch 3 will fill in the sections, Patch 1 will have the styles, and Patch 4 will cover the JavaScript.
I need to ensure the JS doesn’t depend on the status text being pre-set, just the element ID. I should mention that this is a reconstructed version and not an exact extraction. Since the user asked for "HTML gốc và từng patch," I can say, “Nếu bạn cần bản exact từ nguồn, dán nguyên HTML/patch gốc. Còn dưới đây là bộ base + patch có thể tái tạo đúng bản merged tôi đã dựng.” Perhaps later, I could provide a git-style unified diff after the base and patches, but that might not be necessary right now.
Constructing the patches with clear labels
The user didn’t ask for an exact diff format, but since "patch" implies specific changes, I’ll label them as "patch chèn" with clear insertion targets. Here’s my plan:
Patch 1 will replace /* PATCH: styles */.
Patch 2 will replace <!-- PATCH: hero -->, <!-- PATCH: status-text -->, and <!-- PATCH: footer -->.
Patch 3 will replace <!-- PATCH: sections -->.
Patch 4 will replace // PATCH: js.
I want to make sure that Patch 3 doesn’t include the surrounding <section> tags. The base file should be minimal but include a title and the root container, so I’ll add <title>Unified AI Demo</title>.
I’ll ensure that all IDs match with the JavaScript. For Patch 3, I’ll craft the HTML content from the previously merged HTML’s article cards. It’s quite long, but since the user wants the content, I can include it exactly from prior merged HTML, excluding the already-initialized status and hero/footer. I’ll format this using markdown headings and code fences.

2) Patch 1 — CSS
Vị trí chèn: thay toàn bộ dòng:
/* PATCH: styles */
bằng:
:root{
  --bg:#0b1220;
  --panel:#111a2b;
  --panel-2:#182338;
  --text:#e8eefc;
  --muted:#9fb0d2;
  --line:#283652;
  --accent:#61a8ff;
  --accent-2:#8b5cf6;
  --ok:#16a34a;
  --warn:#d97706;
  --err:#dc2626;
  --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  --radius:18px;
  --mono:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Monaco,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;
  --sans:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(97,168,255,.12), transparent 28%),
    radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(139,92,246,.12), transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #08101d, #0b1220 28%, #0b1220 100%);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--sans)
}
body{min-height:100vh}
.app{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px}
.hero{
  display:flex;
  gap:20px;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
.hero h1{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,42px);line-height:1.08}
.hero p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);max-width:900px}
.badge-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
.badge{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:6px;
  padding:6px 10px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  color:#dbe7ff;
  font-size:12px
}
.status{
  margin:16px 0 22px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  color:#dbe7ff
}
.status.info{border-color:#31518a;background:rgba(49,81,138,.18)}
.status.success{border-color:#1e7f45;background:rgba(22,163,74,.16)}
.status.error{border-color:#8f2e2e;background:rgba(220,38,38,.16)}
.status.warn{border-color:#8a5a18;background:rgba(217,119,6,.16)}

.grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:18px;
}
.card{
  grid-column:span 12;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.04), rgba(255,255,255,.02));
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.card.two-thirds{grid-column:span 8}
.card.one-third{grid-column:span 4}
.card.half{grid-column:span 6}
.card-header{
  padding:16px 18px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.03), rgba(255,255,255,.01));
}
.card-header h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}
.card-body{padding:18px}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.tiny{font-size:12px}
.row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.grow{flex:1 1 0}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}
.field label,.field .label{font-size:13px;color:#dce7ff;font-weight:600}
input[type="text"],
input[type="password"],
input[type="number"],
select,
textarea{
  width:100%;
  border:1px solid #334461;
  background:#0c1526;
  color:var(--text);
  padding:12px 13px;
  border-radius:14px;
  outline:none;
  transition:.18s border-color,.18s box-shadow,.18s background;
  font:inherit;
}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
  border-color:var(--accent);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(97,168,255,.14);
  background:#0e182c;
}
textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
textarea.code, pre.code{
  font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}
.toolbar{
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  align-items:center;
  margin:4px 0 14px;
}
button{
  border:0;
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:11px 14px;
  cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:700;
  color:white;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(70,112,255,.22);
}
button.secondary{
  background:#1b2942;
  box-shadow:none;
  border:1px solid #32425f;
  color:#dce7ff
}
button.ghost{
  background:transparent;
  box-shadow:none;
  border:1px dashed #415271;
  color:#dce7ff
}
button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:not-allowed}
.inline-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:14px;
}
.inline-grid-3{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:14px;
}
.preview{
  border:1px dashed #44557a;
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:12px;
  background:#0c1526;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:10px;
  min-height:120px
}
.preview img{
  width:100%;
  max-height:360px;
  object-fit:contain;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#09111f
}
.output{
  border:1px solid #344664;
  background:#09111f;
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:14px;
  min-height:140px;
  white-space:pre-wrap;
  word-break:break-word
}
pre.output{
  margin:0;
  font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.58;
  overflow:auto
}
details{
  border:1px solid #31415d;
  background:#0c1526;
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:10px 12px
}
details > summary{
  cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:700;
  color:#dce7ff;
  outline:none
}
.hr{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:18px 0}
.footer{
  margin-top:22px;
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:13px
}
.download-link{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:6px;
  color:#cfe1ff;
  text-decoration:none;
  border:1px solid #3a4a68;
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  background:#13203a;
}
.pill-note{
  display:inline-block;
  padding:5px 9px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(139,92,246,.16);
  border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.45);
  font-size:12px
}

@media (max-width: 1100px){
  .card.two-thirds,.card.one-third,.card.half{grid-column:span 12}
}
@media (max-width: 760px){
  .inline-grid,.inline-grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .app{padding:16px}
  .card-body{padding:14px}
  .card-header{padding:14px}
}

// PATCH: js

  sttFile: $("sttFile"),
  sttResponseFormat: $("sttResponseFormat"),
  sttPrompt: $("sttPrompt"),
  btnSTT: $("btnSTT"),
  btnSTTClear: $("btnSTTClear"),
  sttOutput: $("sttOutput"),
  sttRaw: $("sttRaw"),

  ttsInput: $("ttsInput"),
