};

const BUILTIN_VOICES = [
  "alloy", "ash", "ballad", "coral", "echo", "fable",
  "nova", "onyx", "sage", "shimmer", "verse", "marin", "cedar"
];

const SAMPLE_SCHEMA = {
  type: "object",
  properties: {
    title: { type: "string" },
    summary: { type: "string" },
    capabilities: {
      type: "array",
      items: { type: "string" }
    },
    audience: {
      type: "array",
      items: { type: "string" }
    }
  },
  required: ["title", "summary", "capabilities", "audience"],
  additionalProperties: false
};

const state = {
  previewUrls: new Map(),
  ttsUrl: null
};

function init() {
  BUILTIN_VOICES.forEach((voice) => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = voice;
    opt.textContent = voice;
    if (voice === "marin") opt.selected = true;
    els.ttsVoice.appendChild(opt);
  });

  els.schemaEditor.value = JSON.stringify(SAMPLE_SCHEMA, null, 2);

  bindImagePreview(els.openaiImageFile, els.openaiImagePreview, els.openaiImageMeta, "openai-preview");
  bindImagePreview(els.geminiImageFile, els.geminiImagePreview, els.geminiImageMeta, "gemini-preview");

  els.btnText.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnText, "Đang gọi OpenAI...", handleText));
  els.btnTextDemo.addEventListener("click", loadTextDemo);
  els.btnTextClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearTextOutputs());

  els.btnSchema.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnSchema, "Đang sinh JSON...", handleStructured));
  els.btnSchemaDemo.addEventListener("click", loadSchemaDemo);
  els.btnSchemaClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearStructuredOutputs());

  els.btnOpenAIVision.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnOpenAIVision, "Đang phân tích ảnh...", handleOpenAIVision));
  els.btnOpenAIVisionClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearOpenAIVisionOutputs());

  els.btnGeminiVision.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnGeminiVision, "Đang phân tích ảnh...", handleGeminiVision));
  els.btnGeminiVisionClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearGeminiVisionOutputs());

  els.btnSTT.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnSTT, "Đang nhận dạng...", handleSTT));
  els.btnSTTClear.addEventListener("click", () => clearSTTOutputs());

  els.btnTTS.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnTTS, "Đang tạo audio...", handleTTS));
  els.btnTTSClear.addEventListener("click", clearTTSOutput);
}

function setStatus(message, type = "info") {
  els.status.className = "status " + type;
  els.status.textContent = message;
}

function loadTextDemo() {
  els.textInstructions.value = "Bạn là trợ lý kỹ thuật. Hãy trả lời ngắn gọn, ưu tiên bullet, tiếng Việt.";
  els.textPrompt.value = "Viết checklist 8 bước để chuyển một prototype AI client-side sang production an toàn.";
  setStatus("Đã nạp ví dụ cho Responses API.", "info");
}

function loadSchemaDemo() {
  els.schemaName.value = "feature_summary";
  els.schemaInstructions.value = "Trả về dữ liệu theo đúng JSON schema. Không thêm chữ ngoài JSON.";
  els.schemaPrompt.value = "Mô tả ứng dụng này: một dashboard AI có chat văn bản, phân tích ảnh, chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản, và tạo giọng đọc.";
  els.schemaEditor.value = JSON.stringify(SAMPLE_SCHEMA, null, 2);
  els.schemaStrict.value = "true";
  setStatus("Đã nạp schema demo.", "info");
}

function trimBase(url) {
  return (url || "").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

function getOpenAIBase() {
  return trimBase(els.openaiBase.value) || "https://api.openai.com/v1";
}

function getGeminiBase() {
  return trimBase(els.geminiBase.value) || "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta";
}

function getOpenAIKey() {
  const key = (els.openaiKey.value || "").trim();
  if (!key) throw new Error("Thiếu OpenAI API key.");
  return key;
}

function getGeminiKey() {
  const key = (els.geminiKey.value || "").trim();
  if (!key) throw new Error("Thiếu Gemini API key.");
  return key;
}

function getResponsesMaxTokens() {
  const n = Number(els.maxOutputTokens.value || 0);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? Math.floor(n) : 1800;
}

function maybeClientRequestId(headers) {
  if (window.crypto && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
    headers["X-Client-Request-Id"] = crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return headers;
}

async function readAsDataURL(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Không đọc được file."));
    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

async function readAsBase64(file) {
  const dataUrl = await readAsDataURL(file);
  const parts = String(dataUrl).split(",", 2);
  if (parts.length !== 2) throw new Error("Không thể chuyển file sang base64.");
  return parts[1];
}

function formatBytes(bytes) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  let i = 0;
  let num = bytes;
  while (num >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
    num /= 1024;
    i++;
  }
  return `${num.toFixed(num < 10 && i > 0 ? 1.1 : 0)} ${units[i]}`;
}

function bindImagePreview(fileInput, imgEl, metaEl, key) {
  fileInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
    if (!file) {
      cleanupPreview(key);
      imgEl.hidden = true;
      imgEl.removeAttribute("src");
      metaEl.textContent = "Chưa có ảnh";
      return;
    }
    cleanupPreview(key);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    state.previewUrls.set(key, url);
    imgEl.src = url;
    imgEl.hidden = false;
    metaEl.textContent = `${file.name} • ${file.type || "image/*"} • ${formatBytes(file.size)}`;
  });
}

function cleanupPreview(key) {
  const old = state.previewUrls.get(key);
  if (old) {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(old);
    state.previewUrls.delete(key);
  }
}

function pretty(value) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
  } catch {
    return String(value);
  }
}

function clearTextOutputs() {
  els.textOutput.textContent = "";
  els.textRaw.textContent = "";
}

function clearStructuredOutputs() {
  els.schemaOutput.textContent = "";
  els.schemaRaw.textContent = "";
}

function clearOpenAIVisionOutputs() {
  els.openaiVisionOutput.textContent = "";
  els.openaiVisionRaw.textContent = "";
}

function clearGeminiVisionOutputs() {
  els.geminiVisionOutput.textContent = "";
  els.geminiVisionRaw.textContent = "";
}

function clearSTTOutputs() {
  els.sttOutput.textContent = "";
  els.sttRaw.textContent = "";
}

function clearTTSOutput() {
  if (state.ttsUrl) {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(state.ttsUrl);
    state.ttsUrl = null;
  }
  els.ttsPlayer.pause();
  els.ttsPlayer.hidden = true;
  els.ttsPlayer.removeAttribute("src");
  els.ttsDownload.hidden = true;
  els.ttsDownload.removeAttribute("href");
  els.ttsMeta.textContent = "Chưa có audio";
}

async function runTask(button, busyText, fn) {
  const original = button.textContent;
  button.disabled = true;
  button.textContent = busyText;
  try {
    await fn();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    setStatus(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err), "error");
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
    button.textContent = original;
  }
}

async function fetchAsJsonOrText(response) {
  const raw = await response.text();
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  let data = raw;
  if (contentType.includes("application/json") || /^[\s\n\r]*[{[]/.test(raw)) {
    try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch {}
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}\n${typeof data === "string" ? data : pretty(data)}`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function postOpenAIJson(path, body) {
  const key = getOpenAIKey();
  const headers = maybeClientRequestId({
    "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  });
  const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
}

async function postOpenAIMultipart(path, formData) {
  const key = getOpenAIKey();
  const headers = maybeClientRequestId({
    "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`
  });
  const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: formData
  });
  return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
}

async function postOpenAIBlob(path, body) {
  const key = getOpenAIKey();
  const headers = maybeClientRequestId({
    "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  });
  const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const raw = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}\n${raw}`);
  }
  return {
    blob: await res.blob(),
    contentType: res.headers.get("content-type") || ""
  };
}

async function postGeminiGenerateContent(body) {
  const key = getGeminiKey();
  const model = (els.geminiModel.value || "").trim() || "gemini-3-flash-preview";
  const res = await fetch(`${getGeminiBase()}/models/${encodeURIComponent(model)}:generateContent`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "x-goog-api-key": key,
      "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
}

function extractOpenAIOutputText(data) {
  const chunks = [];
  if (data && typeof data.output_text === "string" && data.output_text.trim()) {
    chunks.push(data.output_text.trim());
  }
  if (data && Array.isArray(data.output)) {
    for (const item of data.output) {
      const content = Array.isArray(item?.content) ? item.content : [];
      for (const part of content) {
        if (part?.type === "output_text" && typeof part.text === "string") {
          chunks.push(part.text);
        } else if (part?.type === "refusal" && typeof part.refusal === "string") {
          chunks.push(`[Refusal] ${part.refusal}`);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return chunks.join("\n\n").trim();
}

function extractGeminiText(data) {
  const parts = [];
  const candidates = Array.isArray(data?.candidates) ? data.candidates : [];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const candidateParts = Array.isArray(candidate?.content?.parts) ? candidate.content.parts : [];
    for (const part of candidateParts) {
      if (typeof part?.text === "string" && part.text.trim()) {
        parts.push(part.text);
      }
    }
  }
  return parts.join("\n\n").trim();
}

async function handleText() {
  clearTextOutputs();

  const model = (els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-5.4-mini";
  const instructions = (els.textInstructions.value || "").trim();
  const prompt = (els.textPrompt.value || "").trim();

  if (!prompt) throw new Error("Prompt văn bản đang trống.");

  const body = {
    model,
    input: prompt,
    max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens()
  };
  if (instructions) body.instructions = instructions;

  const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
  els.textRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

  const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
  els.textOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được output_text]";
  setStatus("Đã nhận phản hồi văn bản từ OpenAI.", "success");
}

async function handleStructured() {
  clearStructuredOutputs();

  const model = (els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-5.4-mini";
  const instructions = (els.schemaInstructions.value || "").trim();
  const prompt = (els.schemaPrompt.value || "").trim();
  const schemaName = (els.schemaName.value || "").trim() || "structured_response";
  const strict = els.schemaStrict.value === "true";

  if (!prompt) throw new Error("Prompt structured output đang trống.");

  let schema;
  try {
    schema = JSON.parse(els.schemaEditor.value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("JSON Schema không hợp lệ.");
  }

  const body = {
    model,
    input: [
      { role: "system", content: instructions || "Return valid JSON only." },
      { role: "user", content: prompt }
    ],
    max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens(),
    text: {
      format: {
        type: "json_schema",
        name: schemaName,
        schema,
        strict
      }
    }
  };

  const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
  els.schemaRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

  if (data?.status === "incomplete" && data?.incomplete_details?.reason === "max_output_tokens") {
    throw new Error("Kết quả JSON bị cắt do max_output_tokens.");
  }

  const first = data?.output?.[0]?.content?.[0];
  if (first?.type === "refusal") {
    els.schemaOutput.textContent = `Model từ chối trả lời:\n${first.refusal || ""}`;
    setStatus("Model từ chối structured output.", "warn");
    return;
  }

  const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
  if (!text) {
    throw new Error("Không có output_text cho structured response.");
  }

  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    els.schemaOutput.textContent = text;
    setStatus("Đã nhận text nhưng parse JSON thất bại.", "warn");
    return;
  }

  els.schemaOutput.textContent = pretty(parsed);
  setStatus("Đã sinh JSON có cấu trúc.", "success");
}

async function handleOpenAIVision() {
  clearOpenAIVisionOutputs();

  const model = (els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-5.4-mini";
  const prompt = (els.openaiImagePrompt.value || "").trim() || "Describe this image.";
  const file = els.openaiImageFile.files && els.openaiImageFile.files[0];

  if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn ảnh cho OpenAI Vision.");

  const dataUrl = await readAsDataURL(file);

  const body = {
    model,
    max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens(),
    input: [
      {
        role: "user",
        content: [
          { type: "input_text", text: prompt },
          { type: "input_image", image_url: dataUrl }
        ]
      }
    ]
  };

  const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
  els.openaiVisionRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

  const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
  els.openaiVisionOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được mô tả ảnh]";
  setStatus("Đã phân tích ảnh bằng OpenAI.", "success");
}

async function handleGeminiVision() {
  clearGeminiVisionOutputs();

  const prompt = (els.geminiImagePrompt.value || "").trim() || "Describe this image.";
  const file = els.geminiImageFile.files && els.geminiImageFile.files[0];

  if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn ảnh cho Gemini.");

  const base64 = await readAsBase64(file);
  const mimeType = file.type || "image/jpeg";

  const body = {
    contents: [
      {
        parts: [
          {
            inline_data: {
              mime_type: mimeType,
              data: base64
            }
          },
          { text: prompt }
        ]
      }
    ]
  };

  const data = await postGeminiGenerateContent(body);
  els.geminiVisionRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

  const text = extractGeminiText(data);
  els.geminiVisionOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được text từ Gemini response]";
  setStatus("Đã phân tích ảnh bằng Gemini.", "success");
}

async function handleSTT() {
  clearSTTOutputs();

  const file = els.sttFile.files && els.sttFile.files[0];
  if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn file audio.");

  const model = (els.sttModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4o-transcribe";
  const responseFormat = (els.sttResponseFormat.value || "text").trim();
  const prompt = (els.sttPrompt.value || "").trim();

  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("file", file, file.name);
  fd.append("model", model);
  fd.append("response_format", responseFormat);
  if (prompt) fd.append("prompt", prompt);

  const data = await postOpenAIMultipart("/audio/transcriptions", fd);
  els.sttRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

  if (typeof data === "string") {
    els.sttOutput.textContent = data;
  } else if (data && typeof data.text === "string") {
    els.sttOutput.textContent = data.text;
  } else {
    els.sttOutput.textContent = pretty(data);
  }

  setStatus("Đã chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản.", "success");
}

async function handleTTS() {
  clearTTSOutput();

  const model = (els.ttsModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4o-mini-tts";
  const input = (els.ttsInput.value || "").trim();
  const instructions = (els.ttsInstructions.value || "").trim();
  const builtInVoice = (els.ttsVoice.value || "").trim() || "marin";
  const customVoiceId = (els.ttsCustomVoiceId.value || "").trim();
  const responseFormat = (els.ttsFormat.value || "mp3").trim();

  if (!input) throw new Error("Văn bản TTS đang trống.");

  const body = {
    model,
    input,
    response_format: responseFormat
  };

  if (instructions) body.instructions = instructions;
  if (customVoiceId) {
    body.voice = { id: customVoiceId };
  } else {
    body.voice = builtInVoice;
  }

  const { blob, contentType } = await postOpenAIBlob("/audio/speech", body);

  state.ttsUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  els.ttsPlayer.src = state.ttsUrl;
  els.ttsPlayer.hidden = false;

  els.ttsDownload.href = state.ttsUrl;
  els.ttsDownload.download = `openai-tts.${responseFormat}`;
  els.ttsDownload.hidden = false;

  els.ttsMeta.textContent = `${contentType || "audio/*"} • ${formatBytes(blob.size)}`;
  setStatus("Đã tạo audio từ văn bản.", "success");
}

init();

          </div>
          <div class="inline-grid">
            <div class="field">
              <label for="schemaName">Schema name</label>
              <input id="schemaName" type="text" value="feature_summary" />
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="schemaStrict">Strict mode</label>
              <select id="schemaStrict">
                <option value="true" selected>true</option>
                <option value="false">false</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="schemaEditor">JSON Schema</label>
            <textarea id="schemaEditor" class="code"></textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <button id="btnSchema">Sinh JSON</button>
            <button id="btnSchemaDemo" class="secondary" type="button">Nạp schema demo</button>
            <button id="btnSchemaClear" class="ghost" type="button">Xóa output</button>
          </div>
          <pre id="schemaOutput" class="output code"></pre>
          <div class="hr"></div>
          <details>
            <summary>Raw response</summary>
            <div class="hr"></div>
            <pre id="schemaRaw" class="output code"></pre>
          </details>
        </div>
      </article>

      <!-- OPENAI VISION -->
      <article class="card half">
        <div class="card-header">
          <h2>4) OpenAI Vision</h2>
          <span class="muted tiny">Responses API + input_image</span>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="openaiImagePrompt">Prompt phân tích ảnh</label>
            <textarea id="openaiImagePrompt">Hãy mô tả chi tiết ảnh này, liệt kê các vật thể chính và đưa ra 3 từ khóa quan trọng.</textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="openaiImageFile">Chọn ảnh</label>
            <input id="openaiImageFile" type="file" accept="image/*" />
          </div>
          <div class="preview">
            <div class="muted tiny" id="openaiImageMeta">Chưa có ảnh</div>
            <img id="openaiImagePreview" alt="OpenAI preview" hidden />
          </div>
          <div class="toolbar" style="margin-top:14px">
            <button id="btnOpenAIVision">Phân tích bằng OpenAI</button>
            <button id="btnOpenAIVisionClear" class="ghost" type="button">Xóa output</button>
          </div>
          <pre id="openaiVisionOutput" class="output code"></pre>
          <div class="hr"></div>
          <details>
            <summary>Raw response</summary>
            <div class="hr"></div>
            <pre id="openaiVisionRaw" class="output code"></pre>
          </details>
        </div>
      </article>

      <!-- GEMINI VISION -->
      <article class="card half">
        <div class="card-header">
          <h2>5) Gemini Image Understanding</h2>
          <span class="muted tiny">generateContent + inline_data</span>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="geminiImagePrompt">Prompt phân tích ảnh</label>
            <textarea id="geminiImagePrompt">Hãy mô tả nội dung ảnh này bằng tiếng Việt và nêu ra các chi tiết đáng chú ý.</textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="geminiImageFile">Chọn ảnh</label>
            <input id="geminiImageFile" type="file" accept="image/*" />
          </div>
          <div class="preview">
            <div class="muted tiny" id="geminiImageMeta">Chưa có ảnh</div>
            <img id="geminiImagePreview" alt="Gemini preview" hidden />
          </div>
          <div class="toolbar" style="margin-top:14px">
            <button id="btnGeminiVision">Phân tích bằng Gemini</button>
            <button id="btnGeminiVisionClear" class="ghost" type="button">Xóa output</button>
          </div>
          <pre id="geminiVisionOutput" class="output code"></pre>
          <div class="hr"></div>
          <details>
            <summary>Raw response</summary>
            <div class="hr"></div>
            <pre id="geminiVisionRaw" class="output code"></pre>
          </details>
        </div>
      </article>

      <!-- STT -->
      <article class="card half">
        <div class="card-header">
          <h2>6) Speech-to-Text</h2>
          <span class="muted tiny">/audio/transcriptions</span>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="sttFile">Tệp âm thanh</label>
            <input id="sttFile" type="file" accept="audio/*,.mp3,.wav,.m4a,.ogg,.webm,.flac,.aac,.mp4" />
          </div>
          <div class="inline-grid">
            <div class="field">
              <label for="sttResponseFormat">Response format</label>
              <select id="sttResponseFormat">
                <option value="json" selected>json</option>
                <option value="text">text</option>
                <option value="diarized_json">diarized_json</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="sttPrompt">Prompt hỗ trợ nhận dạng (optional)</label>
              <input id="sttPrompt" type="text" placeholder="Ví dụ: đây là bài giảng về AI và OpenAI" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="note-box" style="margin-bottom:14px">
            Tùy model STT, response format hợp lệ có thể khác nhau. File này sẽ tự điều chỉnh request nếu format bạn chọn không phù hợp với model hiện tại.
          </div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <button id="btnSTT">Chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản</button>
            <button id="btnSTTClear" class="ghost" type="button">Xóa output</button>
          </div>
          <pre id="sttOutput" class="output code"></pre>
          <div class="hr"></div>
          <details>
            <summary>Raw response</summary>
            <div class="hr"></div>
            <pre id="sttRaw" class="output code"></pre>
          </details>
        </div>
      </article>

      <!-- TTS -->
      <article class="card half">
        <div class="card-header">
          <h2>7) Text-to-Speech</h2>
          <span class="muted tiny">/audio/speech</span>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="field">
            <label for="ttsInput">Văn bản cần đọc</label>
            <textarea id="ttsInput">Xin chào! Đây là bản demo hợp nhất một file HTML duy nhất cho OpenAI và Gemini.</textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="ttsInstructions">Instructions giọng đọc (optional)</label>
            <textarea id="ttsInstructions">Đọc rõ ràng, tự nhiên, tốc độ vừa phải.</textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="inline-grid-3">
            <div class="field">
              <label for="ttsVoice">Built-in voice</label>
              <select id="ttsVoice"></select>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="ttsCustomVoiceId">Hoặc custom voice ID</label>
              <input id="ttsCustomVoiceId" type="text" placeholder="voice_123abc" />
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="ttsFormat">Response format</label>
              <select id="ttsFormat">
                <option value="mp3" selected>mp3</option>
                <option value="wav">wav</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <button id="btnTTS">Tạo audio</button>
            <button id="btnTTSClear" class="ghost" type="button">Xóa audio</button>
          </div>
          <div class="preview">
            <div class="muted tiny" id="ttsMeta">Chưa có audio</div>
            <audio id="ttsPlayer" controls hidden></audio>
            <a id="ttsDownload" class="download-link" href="#" download hidden>Tải audio xuống</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    </section>

    <footer class="footer">
      Nếu cần, bạn có thể đổi toàn bộ endpoint sang proxy nội bộ bằng Base URL ở trên để gom request về backend của bạn.
    </footer>
  </div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

      const els = {
        status: $("status"),

        openaiKey: $("openaiKey"),
        geminiKey: $("geminiKey"),
        openaiModel: $("openaiModel"),
        sttModel: $("sttModel"),
        ttsModel: $("ttsModel"),
        geminiModel: $("geminiModel"),
        maxOutputTokens: $("maxOutputTokens"),
        openaiBase: $("openaiBase"),
        geminiBase: $("geminiBase"),

        textInstructions: $("textInstructions"),
        textPrompt: $("textPrompt"),
        btnText: $("btnText"),
        btnTextDemo: $("btnTextDemo"),
        btnTextClear: $("btnTextClear"),
        textOutput: $("textOutput"),
        textRaw: $("textRaw"),

        schemaInstructions: $("schemaInstructions"),
        schemaPrompt: $("schemaPrompt"),
        schemaName: $("schemaName"),
        schemaStrict: $("schemaStrict"),
        schemaEditor: $("schemaEditor"),
        btnSchema: $("btnSchema"),
        btnSchemaDemo: $("btnSchemaDemo"),
        btnSchemaClear: $("btnSchemaClear"),
        schemaOutput: $("schemaOutput"),
        schemaRaw: $("schemaRaw"),

        openaiImagePrompt: $("openaiImagePrompt"),
        openaiImageFile: $("openaiImageFile"),
        openaiImagePreview: $("openaiImagePreview"),
        openaiImageMeta: $("openaiImageMeta"),
        btnOpenAIVision: $("btnOpenAIVision"),
        btnOpenAIVisionClear: $("btnOpenAIVisionClear"),
        openaiVisionOutput: $("openaiVisionOutput"),
        openaiVisionRaw: $("openaiVisionRaw"),

        geminiImagePrompt: $("geminiImagePrompt"),
        geminiImageFile: $("geminiImageFile"),
        geminiImagePreview: $("geminiImagePreview"),
        geminiImageMeta: $("geminiImageMeta"),
        btnGeminiVision: $("btnGeminiVision"),
        btnGeminiVisionClear: $("btnGeminiVisionClear"),
        geminiVisionOutput: $("geminiVisionOutput"),
        geminiVisionRaw: $("geminiVisionRaw"),

        sttFile: $("sttFile"),
        sttResponseFormat: $("sttResponseFormat"),
        sttPrompt: $("sttPrompt"),
        btnSTT: $("btnSTT"),
        btnSTTClear: $("btnSTTClear"),
        sttOutput: $("sttOutput"),
        sttRaw: $("sttRaw"),

        ttsInput: $("ttsInput"),
        ttsInstructions: $("ttsInstructions"),
        ttsVoice: $("ttsVoice"),
        ttsCustomVoiceId: $("ttsCustomVoiceId"),
        ttsFormat: $("ttsFormat"),
        btnTTS: $("btnTTS"),
        btnTTSClear: $("btnTTSClear"),
        ttsPlayer: $("ttsPlayer"),
        ttsDownload: $("ttsDownload"),
        ttsMeta: $("ttsMeta"),
      };

      const BUILTIN_VOICES = [
        "alloy", "ash", "ballad", "coral", "echo", "fable",
        "nova", "onyx", "sage", "shimmer", "verse", "marin", "cedar"
      ];

      const SAMPLE_SCHEMA = {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
          title: { type: "string" },
          summary: { type: "string" },
          capabilities: {
            type: "array",
            items: { type: "string" }
          },
          audience: {
            type: "array",
            items: { type: "string" }
          }
        },
        required: ["title", "summary", "capabilities", "audience"],
        additionalProperties: false
      };

      const state = {
        previewUrls: new Map(),
        ttsUrl: null
      };

      function init() {
        BUILTIN_VOICES.forEach((voice) => {
          const opt = document.createElement("option");
          opt.value = voice;
          opt.textContent = voice;
          if (voice === "marin") opt.selected = true;
          els.ttsVoice.appendChild(opt);
        });

        els.schemaEditor.value = JSON.stringify(SAMPLE_SCHEMA, null, 2);

        bindImagePreview(els.openaiImageFile, els.openaiImagePreview, els.openaiImageMeta, "openai-preview");
        bindImagePreview(els.geminiImageFile, els.geminiImagePreview, els.geminiImageMeta, "gemini-preview");

        els.btnText.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnText, "Đang gọi OpenAI...", handleText));
        els.btnTextDemo.addEventListener("click", loadTextDemo);
        els.btnTextClear.addEventListener("click", clearTextOutputs);

        els.btnSchema.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnSchema, "Đang sinh JSON...", handleStructured));
        els.btnSchemaDemo.addEventListener("click", loadSchemaDemo);
        els.btnSchemaClear.addEventListener("click", clearStructuredOutputs);

        els.btnOpenAIVision.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnOpenAIVision, "Đang phân tích ảnh...", handleOpenAIVision));
        els.btnOpenAIVisionClear.addEventListener("click", clearOpenAIVisionOutputs);

        els.btnGeminiVision.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnGeminiVision, "Đang phân tích ảnh...", handleGeminiVision));
        els.btnGeminiVisionClear.addEventListener("click", clearGeminiVisionOutputs);

        els.btnSTT.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnSTT, "Đang nhận dạng...", handleSTT));
        els.btnSTTClear.addEventListener("click", clearSTTOutputs);

        els.btnTTS.addEventListener("click", () => runTask(els.btnTTS, "Đang tạo audio...", handleTTS));
        els.btnTTSClear.addEventListener("click", clearTTSOutput);
      }

      function setStatus(message, type = "info") {
        els.status.className = "status " + type;
        els.status.textContent = message;
      }

      function loadTextDemo() {
        els.textInstructions.value = "Bạn là trợ lý kỹ thuật. Hãy trả lời ngắn gọn, ưu tiên bullet, tiếng Việt.";
        els.textPrompt.value = "Viết checklist 8 bước để chuyển một prototype AI client-side sang production an toàn.";
        setStatus("Đã nạp ví dụ cho Responses API.", "info");
      }

      function loadSchemaDemo() {
        els.schemaName.value = "feature_summary";
        els.schemaInstructions.value = "Trả về dữ liệu theo đúng JSON schema. Không thêm chữ ngoài JSON.";
        els.schemaPrompt.value = "Mô tả ứng dụng này: một dashboard AI có chat văn bản, phân tích ảnh, chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản, và tạo giọng đọc.";
        els.schemaEditor.value = JSON.stringify(SAMPLE_SCHEMA, null, 2);
        els.schemaStrict.value = "true";
        setStatus("Đã nạp schema demo.", "info");
      }

      function trimBase(url) {
        return String(url || "").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
      }

      function getOpenAIBase() {
        return trimBase(els.openaiBase.value) || "https://api.openai.com/v1";
      }

      function getGeminiBase() {
        return trimBase(els.geminiBase.value) || "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta";
      }

      function getOpenAIKey() {
        const key = String(els.openaiKey.value || "").trim();
        if (!key) throw new Error("Thiếu OpenAI API key.");
        return key;
      }

      function getGeminiKey() {
        const key = String(els.geminiKey.value || "").trim();
        if (!key) throw new Error("Thiếu Gemini API key.");
        return key;
      }

      function getResponsesMaxTokens() {
        const n = Number(els.maxOutputTokens.value || 0);
        return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? Math.floor(n) : 1800;
      }

      async function readAsDataURL(file) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Không đọc được file."));
          reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
      }

      async function readAsBase64(file) {
        const dataUrl = await readAsDataURL(file);
        const parts = String(dataUrl).split(",", 2);
        if (parts.length !== 2) throw new Error("Không thể chuyển file sang base64.");
        return parts[1];
      }

      function formatBytes(bytes) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "";
        const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
        let i = 0;
        let num = bytes;
        while (num >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
          num /= 1024;
          i++;
        }
        return `${num.toFixed(num < 10 && i > 0 ? 1 : 0)} ${units[i]}`;
      }

      function bindImagePreview(fileInput, imgEl, metaEl, key) {
        fileInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
          const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
          if (!file) {
            cleanupPreview(key);
            imgEl.hidden = true;
            imgEl.removeAttribute("src");
            metaEl.textContent = "Chưa có ảnh";
            return;
          }
          cleanupPreview(key);
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
          state.previewUrls.set(key, url);
          imgEl.src = url;
          imgEl.hidden = false;
          metaEl.textContent = `${file.name} • ${file.type || "image/*"} • ${formatBytes(file.size)}`;
        });
      }

      function cleanupPreview(key) {
        const old = state.previewUrls.get(key);
        if (old) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(old);
          state.previewUrls.delete(key);
        }
      }

      function pretty(value) {
        if (typeof value === "string") return value;
        try {
          return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
        } catch {
          return String(value);
        }
      }

      function clearTextOutputs() {
        els.textOutput.textContent = "";
        els.textRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearStructuredOutputs() {
        els.schemaOutput.textContent = "";
        els.schemaRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearOpenAIVisionOutputs() {
        els.openaiVisionOutput.textContent = "";
        els.openaiVisionRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearGeminiVisionOutputs() {
        els.geminiVisionOutput.textContent = "";
        els.geminiVisionRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearSTTOutputs() {
        els.sttOutput.textContent = "";
        els.sttRaw.textContent = "";
      }

      function clearTTSOutput() {
        if (state.ttsUrl) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(state.ttsUrl);
          state.ttsUrl = null;
        }
        els.ttsPlayer.pause();
        els.ttsPlayer.hidden = true;
        els.ttsPlayer.removeAttribute("src");
        els.ttsPlayer.load();
        els.ttsDownload.hidden = true;
        els.ttsDownload.removeAttribute("href");
        els.ttsMeta.textContent = "Chưa có audio";
      }

      async function runTask(button, busyText, fn) {
        const original = button.textContent;
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = busyText;
        try {
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(err);
          setStatus(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err), "error");
        } finally {
          button.disabled = false;
          button.textContent = original;
        }
      }

      async function fetchAsJsonOrText(response) {
        const raw = await response.text();
        const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
        let data = raw;

        if (contentType.includes("application/json") || /^[\s\r\n]*[{[]/.test(raw)) {
          try {
            data = JSON.parse(raw);
          } catch {
            data = raw;
          }
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}\n${typeof data === "string" ? data : pretty(data)}`);
        }

        return data;
      }

      async function postOpenAIJson(path, body) {
        const key = getOpenAIKey();
        const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(body)
        });
        return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
      }

      async function postOpenAIMultipart(path, formData) {
        const key = getOpenAIKey();
        const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`
          },
          body: formData
        });
        return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
      }

      async function postOpenAIBlob(path, body) {
        const key = getOpenAIKey();
        const res = await fetch(`${getOpenAIBase()}${path}`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Authorization": `Bearer ${key}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(body)
        });

        if (!res.ok) {
          const raw = await res.text();
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}\n${raw}`);
        }

        return {
          blob: await res.blob(),
          contentType: res.headers.get("content-type") || ""
        };
      }

      async function postGeminiGenerateContent(body) {
        const key = getGeminiKey();
        const model = String(els.geminiModel.value || "").trim() || "gemini-2.5-flash";

        const res = await fetch(`${getGeminiBase()}/models/${encodeURIComponent(model)}:generateContent`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "x-goog-api-key": key,
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(body)
        });

        return fetchAsJsonOrText(res);
      }

      function extractOpenAIOutputText(data) {
        const chunks = [];

        if (data && typeof data.output_text === "string" && data.output_text.trim()) {
          chunks.push(data.output_text.trim());
        }

        if (data && Array.isArray(data.output)) {
          for (const item of data.output) {
            const content = Array.isArray(item && item.content) ? item.content : [];
            for (const part of content) {
              if (part && part.type === "output_text" && typeof part.text === "string") {
                chunks.push(part.text);
              } else if (part && part.type === "refusal" && typeof part.refusal === "string") {
                chunks.push(`[Refusal] ${part.refusal}`);
              }
            }
          }
        }

        return chunks.join("\n\n").trim();
      }

      function extractGeminiText(data) {
        const parts = [];
        const candidates = Array.isArray(data && data.candidates) ? data.candidates : [];
        for (const candidate of candidates) {
          const candidateParts = Array.isArray(candidate && candidate.content && candidate.content.parts)
            ? candidate.content.parts
            : [];
          for (const part of candidateParts) {
            if (part && typeof part.text === "string" && part.text.trim()) {
              parts.push(part.text);
            }
          }
        }
        return parts.join("\n\n").trim();
      }

      function normalizeSTTRequest(model, requestedFormat, prompt) {
        const m = String(model || "").trim();
        let responseFormat = String(requestedFormat || "json").trim() || "json";
        let note = "";
        let finalPrompt = String(prompt || "").trim();

        if (m === "gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize") {
          if (!["json", "text", "diarized_json"].includes(responseFormat)) {
            responseFormat = "json";
            note = "Model diarize không hỗ trợ format này, nên đã tự đổi sang json.";
          }
          finalPrompt = "";
        } else {
          if (responseFormat !== "json") {
            responseFormat = "json";
            note = "Model STT hiện tại chỉ hỗ trợ json, nên đã tự đổi response_format sang json.";
          }
        }

        return { responseFormat, prompt: finalPrompt, note };
      }

      async function handleText() {
        clearTextOutputs();

        const model = String(els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4.1-mini";
        const instructions = String(els.textInstructions.value || "").trim();
        const prompt = String(els.textPrompt.value || "").trim();

        if (!prompt) throw new Error("Prompt văn bản đang trống.");

        const body = {
          model,
          input: prompt,
          max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens()
        };

        if (instructions) body.instructions = instructions;

        const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
        els.textRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
        els.textOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được output text]";
        setStatus("Đã nhận phản hồi văn bản từ OpenAI.", "success");
      }

      async function handleStructured() {
        clearStructuredOutputs();

        const model = String(els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4.1-mini";
        const instructions = String(els.schemaInstructions.value || "").trim();
        const prompt = String(els.schemaPrompt.value || "").trim();
        const schemaName = String(els.schemaName.value || "").trim() || "structured_response";
        const strict = els.schemaStrict.value === "true";

        if (!prompt) throw new Error("Prompt structured output đang trống.");

        let schema;
        try {
          schema = JSON.parse(els.schemaEditor.value);
        } catch {
          throw new Error("JSON Schema không hợp lệ.");
        }

        const body = {
          model,
          input: [
            { role: "system", content: instructions || "Return valid JSON only." },
            { role: "user", content: prompt }
          ],
          max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens(),
          text: {
            format: {
              type: "json_schema",
              name: schemaName,
              schema,
              strict
            }
          }
        };

        const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
        els.schemaRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        if (data && data.status === "incomplete" && data.incomplete_details && data.incomplete_details.reason === "max_output_tokens") {
          throw new Error("Kết quả JSON bị cắt do max_output_tokens.");
        }

        const first = data && data.output && data.output[0] && data.output[0].content && data.output[0].content[0];
        if (first && first.type === "refusal") {
          els.schemaOutput.textContent = `Model từ chối trả lời:\n${first.refusal || ""}`;
          setStatus("Model từ chối structured output.", "warn");
          return;
        }

        const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
        if (!text) {
          throw new Error("Không có output text cho structured response.");
        }

        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
          els.schemaOutput.textContent = pretty(parsed);
          setStatus("Đã sinh JSON có cấu trúc.", "success");
        } catch {
          els.schemaOutput.textContent = text;
          setStatus("Đã nhận phản hồi nhưng parse JSON thất bại.", "warn");
        }
      }

      async function handleOpenAIVision() {
        clearOpenAIVisionOutputs();

        const model = String(els.openaiModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4.1-mini";
        const prompt = String(els.openaiImagePrompt.value || "").trim() || "Describe this image.";
        const file = els.openaiImageFile.files && els.openaiImageFile.files[0];

        if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn ảnh cho OpenAI Vision.");

        const dataUrl = await readAsDataURL(file);

        const body = {
          model,
          max_output_tokens: getResponsesMaxTokens(),
          input: [
            {
              role: "user",
              content: [
                { type: "input_text", text: prompt },
                { type: "input_image", image_url: dataUrl }
              ]
            }
          ]
        };

        const data = await postOpenAIJson("/responses", body);
        els.openaiVisionRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        const text = extractOpenAIOutputText(data);
        els.openaiVisionOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được mô tả ảnh]";
        setStatus("Đã phân tích ảnh bằng OpenAI.", "success");
      }

      async function handleGeminiVision() {
        clearGeminiVisionOutputs();

        const prompt = String(els.geminiImagePrompt.value || "").trim() || "Describe this image.";
        const file = els.geminiImageFile.files && els.geminiImageFile.files[0];

        if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn ảnh cho Gemini.");

        const base64 = await readAsBase64(file);
        const mimeType = file.type || "image/jpeg";

        const body = {
          contents: [
            {
              parts: [
                { text: prompt },
                {
                  inline_data: {
                    mime_type: mimeType,
                    data: base64
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          ]
        };

        const data = await postGeminiGenerateContent(body);
        els.geminiVisionRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        const text = extractGeminiText(data);
        els.geminiVisionOutput.textContent = text || "[Không trích được text từ Gemini response]";
        setStatus("Đã phân tích ảnh bằng Gemini.", "success");
      }

      async function handleSTT() {
        clearSTTOutputs();

        const file = els.sttFile.files && els.sttFile.files[0];
        if (!file) throw new Error("Bạn chưa chọn file audio.");

        const model = String(els.sttModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe";
        const requestedFormat = String(els.sttResponseFormat.value || "json").trim();
        const promptValue = String(els.sttPrompt.value || "").trim();

        const normalized = normalizeSTTRequest(model, requestedFormat, promptValue);

        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append("file", file, file.name);
        fd.append("model", model);
        fd.append("response_format", normalized.responseFormat);
        if (normalized.prompt) {
          fd.append("prompt", normalized.prompt);
        }

        const data = await postOpenAIMultipart("/audio/transcriptions", fd);
        els.sttRaw.textContent = pretty(data);

        if (typeof data === "string") {
          els.sttOutput.textContent = data;
        } else if (data && typeof data.text === "string") {
          els.sttOutput.textContent = data.text;
        } else {
          els.sttOutput.textContent = pretty(data);
        }

        const message = normalized.note
          ? `Đã chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản. ${normalized.note}`
          : "Đã chuyển giọng nói thành văn bản.";

        setStatus(message, normalized.note ? "warn" : "success");
      }

      async function handleTTS() {
        clearTTSOutput();

        const model = String(els.ttsModel.value || "").trim() || "gpt-4o-mini-tts";
        const input = String(els.ttsInput.value || "").trim();
        const instructions = String(els.ttsInstructions.value || "").trim();
        const builtInVoice = String(els.ttsVoice.value || "").trim() || "marin";
        const customVoiceId = String(els.ttsCustomVoiceId.value || "").trim();
        const responseFormat = String(els.ttsFormat.value || "mp3").trim();

        if (!input) throw new Error("Văn bản TTS đang trống.");

        const body = {
          model,
          input,
          response_format: responseFormat
        };

        if (instructions) body.instructions = instructions;

        if (customVoiceId) {
          body.voice = { id: customVoiceId };
        } else {
          body.voice = builtInVoice;
        }

        const { blob, contentType } = await postOpenAIBlob("/audio/speech", body);

        state.ttsUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        els.ttsPlayer.src = state.ttsUrl;
        els.ttsPlayer.hidden = false;

        els.ttsDownload.href = state.ttsUrl;
        els.ttsDownload.download = `openai-tts.${responseFormat}`;
        els.ttsDownload.hidden = false;

        els.ttsMeta.textContent = `${contentType || "audio/*"} • ${formatBytes(blob.size)}`;
        setStatus("Đã tạo audio từ văn bản.", "success");
      }

      init();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

For screens, I might set default stats and consider lazy-loading the live feed upon DOMContentLoaded.
It's important to preserve the board-cd-overlay countdown since room boards are built only once. I’ll need to manage countdown colors by resetting inline styles, ensuring careful updates.
Regarding isMockSpinningMode, I could maintain a single global property or use isMockSpinningByRegion. I'm leaning towards keeping it simple with one global boolean for locking. Lastly, I'll need to set up fake chat intervals and manage voice bar inputs for a read-only state with a silence timer.
Should I open the global AI overlay from the live section?
Integrating the Stats Module
I could add a small ⚛ AI button next to the back button in the live room header, but relying on a floating global AI button might be sufficient since the user mentioned that they can call AI from any room.
For the stats module integration with the command center, I’ll need some extra HTML and CSS, though I want to keep it lightweight. I’m thinking of adding a section that includes a command header, buttons for AI controls, and a terminal view for interaction.
The JavaScript will render matrices for years and weeks. I also want to ensure the AI button triggers the "PHÒNG AI" function, not just a terminal log. This approach should effectively combine features while keeping styles consistent with the command center. Since the user provided all components, we can merge them smoothly into the design.
Creating the Final Code Structure
I realize the final code might be lengthy, so I could present it as "Mình đã nắm rõ, và vì bạn đã gửi đủ mã, dưới đây là bản SPA hợp nhất hoàn chỉnh." It's essential to ensure that the HTML code is complete and self-contained while being mindful of escaping backticks in JavaScript string templates inside the markdown code block.
To build the final HTML methodically, I plan to outline the CSS sections: starting with root global variables, global resets, app shell and screens, bottom navigation, the floating AI button, utility styles like toast and modal, global AI overlay, stats styles with specific namespaces, and bridge region styles for MB/MN/MT. For everything, I might use theme-specific CSS variables.
Streamlining with Shared Classes
I’m thinking of simplifying by sharing the br- classes across MB, MN, and MT. For instance, I can define:
.br-screen { ... }
.br-theme-mb { --region-accent:#ef4444; --region-accent-2:#38bdf8 }
.br-theme-mn { --region-accent:#0288d1; ... }

However, MB doesn't have a station nav, but it could still use the same br-head and br-smartbar.

The br-sheet-header could have three buttons for actions like manual, AI, and global. The MB buttons might be "Tự soi cầu," "Phòng AI," and "Soi cầu TĐ". For MN/MT, they would be similar but include the visible station nav. The "AI SMART MODE: ..." could be shown in the AI smart bar as well.
I’m considering allowing br-theme-mn to have a blue accent, br-theme-mt a purple accent, and keeping br-theme-mb red for the title while the smart bar could remain blue. This way, we can maintain some visual consistency!
Designing a Global Popup Overlay
I need to create a global popup overlay for the bridge, like this:
This overlay will be shared across MB, MN, and MT. Next, I need to think about the order of bottom nav items. I'm considering using stats as the main layout first, leading to an order of: Thống Kê, Miền Bắc, Live, Miền Nam, Miền Trung. This way feels a bit more balanced.
I should also center the live item and make the nav-item widths 20%. Additionally, I’m thinking of adding a small floating YouTube button, #td-channel-btn, at the top right inside the shell, which could open YouTube or be part of the AI overlay's menu. A quick command like "Mở kênh Tuấn Đức" would be nice too. Maybe a subtle button in the shell header corner? Although, if the AI overlay already includes it, it might not be necessary. But the initial design had a dedicated nav item, so perhaps a mini fixed 📺 button just above the AI fab could work. The only concern is that the nav area is already full!
Implementing UI Elements and JavaScript Functions
I want to add a small circular td-channel-fab button next to the AI fab or just above it for easier access. To style these, I'll use position:absolute; right:18px; bottom:128px; for the channel fab, placing the AI fab a bit lower at bottom 84. This way, we'll set the channel fab at bottom 142, making sure they’re not covered when in use.
Next, I'll create some JavaScript classes for the app functions like modals and toasts. For instance, I could set up an App object that includes a lazy loader and a toast method. I might also add a haptic feedback feature using navigator.vibrate, though it's optional.
For the ripple effect on buttons, I’ll use an event listener for clicks on elements with .js-ripple. After the DOMContentLoaded event, I’ll initialize the necessary modules, starting with Stats, since it must initialize right away. The other modules can be lazy-loaded, but for simplicity, I'll initialize all once the DOM is ready.
Optimizing Module Rendering
Rendering all 200 boards and live elements could get heavy, so I think lazy loading is the way to go while keeping it manageable. I could design an ensureModule(screen) function that initializes a module when navigating to a screen or following an AI command. For global commands, using Router.go(screen, {onReady:...}) can ensure the module is initialized beforehand.
I'll set Stats.init() and Live.init() to load immediately since the live countdown is necessary, while MB/MN/MT can be initialized lazily. This might also mean that AI commands could trigger a Router.go, followed by a Bus.emit('route:change') to finalize the module initialization.
I also want to keep the live timer running, even if it’s not yet initialized. If the user opens the live feature later, it can start then!
Setting Up AI Overlay Actions
I think we should add a quick action in the AI overlay for "Quay thử miền bắc" that routes to live and triggers its initialization. This will ensure that Live.init() is called properly. It might be smart to start the stats initialization during load as well.
Now, regarding the stats implementation, I want to go about it carefully. Data generation and row analysis should follow the original structure. Using async functions with a cancel token could simplify operations. For instance, stRunTerminal(mode) will increment terminalRunId, and I can write lines sequentially with setTimeout. We'll need buttons that include data-mode attributes and view switch buttons for year/week options.
Generating Year and Week Matrices
I need to create a function to generate the year matrix for 2026, placing it inside #cc-year-matrix. The logic will include checking for valid days in each month and adding empty spaces for invalid ones.
For the week matrix, I'll set up a structure with days of the week headers and 200 rows. I might keep just seven columns without row labels to preserve the design.
I also want to incorporate a sticky header for the stats matrix, adding functionality to reset scroll positions accurately. I'll ensure features like focusSection(el) work to smoothly navigate on the stats screen. Additionally, I need to implement click actions for frequency cells and manage displaying stats efficiently.
Enhancing Query Selectors and Module Templates
I need to avoid duplicate query selectors by using namespaced root selectors, specifically focusing on the stats screen. That's a good step forward!
For the Bridge Module, I’m planning to generate board markup with data-num on number boxes for AI searches. I’ll define a helper function to create the HTML for these boxes, while ensuring digit wrapping maintains the correct format.
However, since the CSS currently uses a generic .digit class, I might run into conflicts, especially since live modules also use similar number text. To avoid this, I can prefix the class with .br-digit and implement module-specific classes like br-number-box, br-number-text, and br-digit. This should keep everything organized and functional, allowing proper event delegation and handling of digit displays.
Creating a Module Constructor
I need to develop a constructor for the bridge module with necessary initialization. The function will include a state object and methods for binding buttons, setting the initial station, and rendering data. I'll listen for events using Bus.on to manage AI and route changes.
For the configuration, the manual and AI button IDs will be included, along with the smart text element. The module types like mb will require specific settings, such as a count of 200 and a method to get the current station name.
For the MN/MT configuration, I’ll have an array for the station names and a default station map to organize the settings efficiently. Having separate generate functions will help streamline the process and allow for methods to manage station labels, board rendering, AI bridge interactions, and event handling effectively. This should keep the module functional and user-friendly.
Setting Up the Bridge Popup
I'm planning to create a global BridgePopup object. However, there's a potential issue since there are three modules, each using button classes like .br-glass-btn. I need to ensure that the triggerMenu(btn, scopeRoot) function only affects elements within the respective module root.
The toggleManual function could set an active state and show a toast. For global AI buttons, I’ll use GlobalAI.open(key, prompt). There’s also a potential problem if the route changes after a screen is hidden, as renderBridgeLines() might not display correctly due to a display: none property. I plan to call this function after 80ms to avoid this.
Using document.querySelectorAll('.br-digit.marked') across all modules can cause issues when clearing bridges, but it might be acceptable since it's targeting hidden modules. Still, sticking to module-specific queries could be a better approach. Lastly, I’ll consider that runAIBridge(targetNumber) might need to handle target numbers as two-digit values.
Implementing AI Search Logic
I’m working on setting up the search functionality for number boxes. The dataset needs to filter boxes based on whether their numbers end with the target number. If no candidates are found, I might select boxes at intervals (like every 17th) or choose random ones if necessary.
Once I identify suitable candidates, I’ll highlight the last two digits for the target number or mark random digits otherwise. If the target number has two digits, I’ll make sure the selected boxes meet this criterion. I'll add smooth scrolling for visual clarity and update the interface with relevant messages, possibly using toasts for notifications.
Additionally, I need to implement buttons like SOI CẦU TĐ to call runAIBridge() directly for immediate AI action, while another button, "PHÒNG AI," can be used to open a related overlay. It's all about making the user experience smoother!
Managing AI and Manual Functions
I’m creating a toggling mechanism for manual and instant AI with the button TỰ SOI CẦU. This will ensure users can seamlessly switch between modes. I also need to make sure the buttons reflect their active states when clicked.
For the bridge popup, I'll set up the HTML structure to contain digit buttons and establish functions within a BridgePopup object. This allows users to choose digits, which I'll set up by attaching event listeners dynamically.
Regarding the Live Module, I need unique class names to prevent conflicts with bridge modules, opting for names like .lv-number-box. I’ll also adapt the existing functions for this context. However, I must watch out for potential issues with multiple instances of SpeechRecognition, ensuring they don’t conflict during use.
Optimizing Live Module Functions
I’m considering whether to use let activeRecognizerTag, but it might not be necessary. I should create start and stop functions for the voice bar that are namespaced within the LiveModule to avoid using global functions.
I’ll also need a "drop heart" container and implement AI bubble timeouts based on regions. It’s important that the startCountdowns function updates states even when the user isn’t on the live screen, as long as it’s initialized.
For building the board, I’ll combine Mega 6/45 and Max 3D if both are scheduled for the day. I'll also need to address specific trigger functions and potential issues with queries, like document.querySelectorAll('.live-board-cd-overlay'), ensuring it functions correctly during AI command triggers.
Creating AI Command Parser
I’m drafting a parser function called parseAICommand. It takes user input, normalizes the text, and identifies commands like live draws or statistics based on keywords. For example, it checks if the user mentioned regions like "miền bắc" to determine their intent while extracting numeric values if present.
Once I’ve parsed the input, I’ll route commands appropriately. I’m also considering if certain phrases should auto-close chat and how to manage overlays without losing previous conversations. The goal is to enhance user experience while implementing features like AI messaging and quick command buttons effectively.
I’ll also add support functions and ensure the overall javascript is structured neatly for better readability and maintenance. I need to verify syntax as I go and include CSS elements for auxiliary interfaces.
This approach allows us to maintain a responsive system as we integrate new AI functionalities while managing previous complexities in the command structure.
Setting Up Row Analysis
I need to enable the row headers for analysis by using the data-num attributes and event delegation for better efficiency. In the rendered matrix, I'll include a header that contains both the number and any badges.
When a header is clicked, I’ll use an event listener to find the closest corner button and position the row laser accurately. Managing the rhythm count and gap conditions is essential, so I’ll ensure the logic aligns perfectly with the original setup.
Additionally, I’ll need to implement drag scroll events and configure styles for highlighting gaps and analyzed rows to improve the user experience.
Resetting Matrix and Setting Up Commands
I need to ensure the matrix container properly resets the scroll positions for left and top.
For the command suite, I’m planning to create buttons in HTML, potentially five in total, with click handlers attached. I'll have matrix view toggle buttons, including year and week matrix options, with the year matrix as the default. When the "PHONG AI" button is clicked, I should run the terminal and then open GlobalAI after a brief delay.
As for the live module, I'll use namespaced selectors within the live root and create HTML for the lobby and room sections, including necessary functions to build the board markup effectively.
Addressing SpeechRecognition and HTML Management
I'm considering the possibility that the SpeechRecognition object might not be supported on all devices, so showing toasts for unsupported features seems like a good plan.
I wonder if it would be simpler to exclude local live voice chat, but since we want to avoid regression, I'll keep it. I’ll set up event handlers for lobby and room buttons programmatically, possibly using data attributes and event listeners.
To manage output length, I could generate room HTML through JS instead of writing everything out, which might be more complex. However, I could create minimal placeholder containers for the live rooms and let JS render the boards dynamically, which should help reduce HTML size!
Building Live Screen HTML
I'm laying out the HTML for the live screen, starting with a section that encapsulates everything, including a top bar, lobby, and room host area.
Next, I plan to generate the lobby cards and room DOM templates with JavaScript. The user prefers complete code instead of placeholders, so I need to ensure I add the necessary CSS selectors for the live room structure.
I’m thinking it might also be efficient to create static wrappers for the MB/MN/MT boards since they aren't too large. Let’s start drafting the actual HTML, keeping it concise while ensuring the syntax is correct!
