<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>HỆ SINH THÁI XỔ SỐ | CORE 5.4 PRO | SINGLE PAGE APP</title>
  <style>
    :root{
      --bg-main:#0a0d12;
      --bg-panel:#0f172a;
      --bg-panel-2:#111827;
      --bg-soft:rgba(15,23,42,.72);
      --line:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      --line-2:#334155;
      --text:#f8fafc;
      --muted:#94a3b8;
      --blue:#38bdf8;
      --blue-2:#0ea5e9;
      --red:#ef4444;
      --red-2:#d40000;
      --yellow:#facc15;
      --green:#10b981;
      --purple:#8b5cf6;
      --pink:#ec4899;
      --shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
      --radius:16px;
      --nav-h:72px;
      --z-nav:90;
      --z-fab:130;
      --z-popup:200;
      --z-ai:9999;
      --font-ui:Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
      --font-mono:ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    }

    *{
      box-sizing:border-box;
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
      scrollbar-width:none;
      font-family:var(--font-ui);
    }
    *::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

    html,body{
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      overflow:hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56,189,248,.10), transparent 25%),
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(139,92,246,.10), transparent 25%),
        linear-gradient(180deg,#06090f,#0a0d12 45%,#090c11);
      color:var(--text);
    }

    body{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:stretch;
    }

    .app-shell{
      width:100%;
      max-width:480px;
      height:100%;
      position:relative;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0d12,#0c1018);
      overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:0 0 48px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
      border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.03);
      border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.03);
      isolation:isolate;
    }

    .eco-screen{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      display:none;
      flex-direction:column;
      overflow-y:auto;
      overflow-x:hidden;
      padding-bottom:calc(var(--nav-h) + 18px);
      background:transparent;
      animation:ecoFade .28s ease-out;
    }
    .eco-screen.active{
      display:flex;
    }
    @keyframes ecoFade{
      from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}
      to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
    }

    .eco-bottom-nav{
      position:absolute;
      left:0;
      right:0;
      bottom:0;
      height:var(--nav-h);
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-around;
      background:rgba(8,13,22,.92);
      backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
      border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      z-index:var(--z-nav);
      padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
      box-shadow:0 -6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
    }

    .eco-nav-item{
      width:20%;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:4px;
      color:#64748b;
      cursor:pointer;
      user-select:none;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .eco-nav-item .icon{font-size:19px;transition:.25s}
    .eco-nav-item .label{
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:.5px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
    }
    .eco-nav-item.active{
      color:var(--blue);
    }
    .eco-nav-item.active .icon{
      transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.08);
      filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--blue));
    }

    .eco-nav-item.center-live{
      position:relative;
      top:-14px;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .eco-nav-item.center-live .live-circle{
      width:50px;
      height:50px;
      border-radius:50%;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d40000,#ff4d4f);
      border:4px solid #0a0d12;
      box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(212,0,0,.45);
      animation:pulseLive 2s infinite;
    }
    .eco-nav-item.center-live .icon{font-size:22px;margin-left:2px}
    @keyframes pulseLive{
      0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(212,0,0,.5)}
      70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(212,0,0,0)}
      100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(212,0,0,0)}
    }

    .eco-ai-fab,
    .eco-yt-fab{
      position:absolute;
      right:16px;
      width:52px;
      height:52px;
      border-radius:50%;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      cursor:pointer;
      z-index:var(--z-fab);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
      user-select:none;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .eco-ai-fab{
      bottom:calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px);
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(14,165,233,.95),rgba(99,102,241,.95));
      color:#fff;
      font-size:22px;
      animation:aiPulseFab 2s infinite;
    }
    .eco-yt-fab{
      bottom:calc(var(--nav-h) + 76px);
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(239,68,68,.9),rgba(220,38,38,.9));
      color:#fff;
      font-size:22px;
    }
    .eco-ai-fab:active,.eco-yt-fab:active{transform:scale(.92)}
    @keyframes aiPulseFab{
      0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,.45), var(--shadow)}
      70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(56,189,248,0), var(--shadow)}
      100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0), var(--shadow)}
    }

    .toast-stack{
      position:absolute;
      top:14px;
      left:12px;
      right:12px;
      z-index:9500;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:8px;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .toast{
      padding:12px 14px;
      border-radius:14px;
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:13px;
      line-height:1.45;
      animation:toastIn .28s ease;
    }
    .toast.info{background:rgba(15,23,42,.9)}
    .toast.success{background:rgba(16,185,129,.16);border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.45)}
    .toast.warn{background:rgba(250,204,21,.14);border-color:rgba(250,204,21,.45)}
    .toast.error{background:rgba(239,68,68,.16);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.45)}
    @keyframes toastIn{
      from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}
      to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
    }

    .modal-overlay{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      z-index:9600;
      display:none;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);
      backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
      padding:18px;
    }
    .modal-overlay.show{display:flex}
    .modal-card{
      width:100%;
      max-width:360px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0f172a,#0b1220);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      border-radius:18px;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      padding:18px;
    }
    .modal-title{
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:900;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .modal-message{
      color:#dbe6f5;
      font-size:13px;
      line-height:1.55;
      margin-bottom:16px;
    }
    .modal-actions{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:flex-end;
      gap:10px;
    }

    .btn{
      border:none;
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:11px 14px;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-size:13px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:#fff;
      transition:.22s;
      user-select:none;
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    .btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}
    .btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-2),#6366f1)}
    .btn.secondary{background:#1f2937;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    .btn.danger{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#b91c1c)}
    .btn.ghost{
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      color:#e5eef9;
    }

    .js-ripple .ripple{
      position:absolute;
      border-radius:50%;
      transform:scale(0);
      animation:ripple .6s linear;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    @keyframes ripple{
      to{transform:scale(4);opacity:0}
    }

    .screen-flash{
      animation:screenFlash .55s ease;
    }
    @keyframes screenFlash{
      0%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0)}
      50%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(56,189,248,.06)}
      100%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0)}
    }

    /* =========================
       GLOBAL AI OVERLAY
       ========================= */
    .gai-overlay{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      z-index:var(--z-ai);
      display:none;
      flex-direction:column;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(56,189,248,.12), transparent 26%),
        radial-gradient(circle at bottom left, rgba(139,92,246,.12), transparent 26%),
        linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,6,23,.88),rgba(0,0,0,.92));
      backdrop-filter:blur(22px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px);
      padding:18px;
    }
    .gai-overlay.show{display:flex}
    .gai-head{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:12px;
      padding-bottom:14px;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.28);
      margin-bottom:16px;
    }
    .gai-title{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:10px;
      font-size:16px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      color:#fff;
      text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(56,189,248,.4);
    }
    .gai-pulse{
      width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--blue);
      box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--blue);
      animation:gaiPulse 1.4s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes gaiPulse{
      0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,.55)}
      70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(56,189,248,0)}
      100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0)}
    }

    .gai-meta{
      color:#cbd5e1;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:800;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
    }

    .gai-body{
      flex:1;
      min-height:0;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.28);
      border-radius:18px;
      overflow:hidden;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.42);
      box-shadow:0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset 0 0 24px rgba(56,189,248,.06);
    }
    .gai-stream{
      flex:1;
      min-height:0;
      overflow-y:auto;
      padding:16px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:12px;
      scroll-behavior:smooth;
    }
    .gai-msg{
      max-width:86%;
      padding:13px 15px;
      border-radius:16px;
      font-size:13.5px;
      line-height:1.55;
      font-weight:500;
      animation:msgIn .24s ease;
    }
    .gai-msg.ai{
      align-self:flex-start;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(30,41,59,.92),rgba(15,23,42,.96));
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      color:#e2e8f0;
      border-bottom-left-radius:4px;
      box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
    }
    .gai-msg.user{
      align-self:flex-end;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-2),#2563eb);
      color:#fff;
      border-bottom-right-radius:4px;
      border:1px solid rgba(125,211,252,.55);
      box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(14,165,233,.34);
    }
    .gai-msg small{
      display:block;
      margin-top:8px;
      opacity:.75;
      font-size:11px;
    }
    @keyframes msgIn{
      from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}
      to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
    }

    .gai-chips{
      display:flex;
      gap:8px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      padding:0 16px 14px;
      border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      background:rgba(2,6,23,.35);
    }
    .gai-chip{
      margin-top:12px;
      padding:8px 12px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      color:#dbeafe;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:800;
      cursor:pointer;
      user-select:none;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .gai-chip:active{transform:scale(.96)}
    .gai-chip:hover{
      border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.45);
      background:rgba(56,189,248,.10);
    }

    .gai-input-wrap{
      position:relative;
      padding:14px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:8px;
      background:rgba(2,6,23,.92);
      border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }
    .gai-plus-menu{
      position:absolute;
      left:14px;
      bottom:74px;
      width:230px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:7px;
      padding:10px;
      border-radius:16px;
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(15,23,42,.96),rgba(2,6,23,.98));
      border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.34);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow);
      transform:scale(0);
      transform-origin:bottom left;
      opacity:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .gai-plus-menu.show{
      transform:scale(1);
      opacity:1;
      pointer-events:auto;
    }
    .gai-plus-item{
      padding:12px 13px;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      color:#e2e8f0;
      font-size:13px;
      font-weight:700;
      cursor:pointer;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:10px;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .gai-plus-item:hover{
      border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.35);
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(56,189,248,.14),transparent);
      transform:translateX(4px);
    }

    .gai-icon-btn,
    .gai-send-btn{
      width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      cursor:pointer;border:none;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .gai-icon-btn{
      background:rgba(30,41,59,.82);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      font-size:18px;
    }
    .gai-icon-btn.recording{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,.16);
      border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.5);
      color:#fca5a5;
      animation:gaiMicPulse 1.4s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes gaiMicPulse{
      0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,.48)}
      70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(239,68,68,0)}
      100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,0)}
    }
    .gai-send-btn{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-2),#2563eb);
      box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(56,189,248,.32);
      font-size:16px;
      padding-left:2px;
    }
    .gai-input{
      flex:1;
      min-width:0;
      height:44px;
      border-radius:24px;
      border:1px solid #475569;
      background:rgba(30,41,59,.65);
      color:#fff;
      padding:0 15px;
      outline:none;
      font-size:14px;
    }
    .gai-input:focus{
      border-color:var(--blue);
      box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(56,189,248,.12);
    }

    /* =========================
       STATS SCREEN
       ========================= */
    .st-wrap{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      min-height:100%;
      background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20%, #0f172a 0%, #020617 80%);
    }
    .st-sheet-header{
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      z-index:40;
      padding:14px 16px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      background:rgba(2,6,23,.82);
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    }
    .st-title{
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:2px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      text-align:center;
      color:#fff;
      text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    }
    .st-title span{
      color:var(--blue);
      text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--blue);
    }

    .st-content{
      padding:14px 10px 94px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:14px;
    }

    .st-card{
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.48);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
      border-radius:16px;
      box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      overflow:hidden;
      position:relative;
    }

    .st-slider-viewport{
      min-height:500px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
    }
    .st-matrix-toggle{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      padding:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(153,27,27,.34),rgba(220,38,38,.16),rgba(153,27,27,.34));
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.45);
      border-top:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.15);
      backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
      z-index:2;
    }
    .st-mode-btn{
      flex:1;
      padding:14px 8px;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(2,6,23,.85),rgba(15,23,42,.85));
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      color:rgba(255,255,255,.52);
      font-weight:900;
      font-size:11px;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.25s;
      box-shadow:4px 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.42), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
    }
    .st-mode-btn.active{
      color:#fff;
      border-color:var(--yellow);
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(250,204,21,.24),rgba(202,138,4,.48));
      box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(250,204,21,.65), inset 0 0 12px rgba(250,204,21,.3);
      text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(250,204,21,.8);
      transform:translateY(-1px);
    }

    .st-matrix-container{
      position:relative;
      flex:1;
      overflow:auto;
      outline:none;
      cursor:grab;
      padding-right:2px;
      min-height:420px;
    }
    .st-matrix-container:active{cursor:grabbing}
    .st-matrix-table{
      border-collapse:separate;
      border-spacing:0;
      width:max-content;
      table-layout:fixed;
      transition:.35s;
    }
    .st-matrix-table th,
    .st-matrix-table td{
      width:30px;
      min-width:30px;
      height:30px;
      border-right:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.08);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.08);
      text-align:center;
      font-size:10.5px;
      font-weight:700;
      color:#94a3b8;
      position:relative;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .st-matrix-table tr:hover td{
      background:rgba(14,165,233,.05);
      color:#fff;
    }
    .st-matrix-table thead th{
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      z-index:2;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.95);
      color:var(--blue);
      font-weight:900;
      text-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(14,165,233,.3);
      backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
    }
    .st-corner{
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      z-index:20 !important;
      background:#000 !important;
      color:#fff !important;
    }
    .st-corner-btn{
      position:sticky;
      left:0;
      z-index:15;
      background:rgba(2,6,23,.95);
      color:#fff;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-size:13px !important;
      font-weight:900 !important;
      box-shadow:4px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
      backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
      overflow:visible !important;
    }
    .st-corner-btn:hover{
      color:var(--blue);
      text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--blue);
      background:#0f172a;
    }
    .st-matrix-table.double-mode .st-corner-btn{
      color:var(--yellow);
      text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(250,204,21,.35);
    }

    .st-row-badge{
      position:absolute;
      right:-6px;
      top:-6px;
      font-size:7px;
      padding:2px 5px;
      border-radius:8px;
      z-index:25;
      font-weight:900;
      white-space:nowrap;
      box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.8);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .st-badge-gan{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#991b1b);
      color:#fff;
      animation:pulseGan 1.3s infinite alternate;
    }
    .st-badge-hot{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#facc15,#b45309);
      color:#000;
    }
    @keyframes pulseGan{
      0%{box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(239,68,68,.32);transform:scale(.96)}
      100%{box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.75);transform:scale(1.05)}
    }

    .st-row-laser{
      position:absolute;
      left:0;
      height:2px;
      width:0;
      background:#fff;
      box-shadow:0 0 10px #fff,0 0 20px var(--blue),0 0 38px var(--blue);
      z-index:30;
      opacity:0;
      border-radius:999px;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .st-row-laser.fire{
      animation:rowSweep 1.5s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94) forwards;
    }
    @keyframes rowSweep{
      0%{width:0;opacity:1;left:30px}
      50%{width:250px;opacity:1}
      100%{left:100%;width:0;opacity:0}
    }

    .st-row-analyzed td{
      border-top:1px solid rgba(14,165,233,.4);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(14,165,233,.4);
      background-color:rgba(14,165,233,.04);
    }
    .st-highlight-gap{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,.15)!important;
      color:rgba(239,68,68,.62)!important;
      border-top:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.46)!important;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.46)!important;
    }
    .st-highlight-hit{
      background:rgba(16,185,129,.20)!important;
      color:#10b981!important;
      text-shadow:0 0 10px #10b981;
      font-size:16px!important;
      font-weight:900!important;
      border:1px solid var(--green)!important;
      position:relative;
      border-radius:4px;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(16,185,129,.22);
      z-index:2;
    }
    .st-highlight-hit::before{
      content:"🎯";
      position:absolute;
      top:-12px;
      right:-10px;
      font-size:16px;
      animation:pinDrop .58s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275) forwards;
    }
    .st-highlight-hit::after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      left:50%;
      width:34px;height:34px;
      margin-top:-17px;margin-left:-17px;
      border:2px solid var(--green);
      border-radius:50%;
      animation:hitRipple 1.5s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pinDrop{
      0%{transform:translateY(-25px) scale(2.5) rotate(-20deg);opacity:0}
      100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0);opacity:1}
    }
    @keyframes hitRipple{
      0%{transform:scale(.5);opacity:1}
      100%{transform:scale(2.5);opacity:0;border-width:0}
    }

    .st-hud{
      position:absolute;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      z-index:50;
      transform:translateY(-100%);
      transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275);
      padding:15px 15px 12px;
      text-align:center;
      color:#fff;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
      box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:10px;
      border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;
    }
    .st-hud.show{transform:translateY(0)}
    .st-hud .eval{
      align-self:center;
      padding:6px 12px;
      border-radius:10px;
      font-size:12px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }
    .st-hud .hl-num,.st-hud .hl-count{
      font-size:18px;
      font-weight:900;
    }
    .st-hud .more{
      align-self:center;
      padding:10px 20px;
      border-radius:20px;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
      background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);
      color:#fff;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    .st-tier-diamond{
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(14,165,233,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
      border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.46);
      text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(56,189,248,.58);
    }
    .st-tier-diamond .eval{border-color:#38bdf8;color:#e0f2fe;background:rgba(56,189,248,.18)}
    .st-tier-diamond .hl-num,.st-tier-diamond .hl-count{color:#7dd3fc}
    .st-tier-gold{
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(245,158,11,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
      border-color:rgba(250,204,21,.46);
    }
    .st-tier-gold .eval{border-color:#facc15;color:#fef08a;background:rgba(250,204,21,.18)}
    .st-tier-gold .hl-num,.st-tier-gold .hl-count{color:#fde047}
    .st-tier-silver{
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(148,163,184,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
      border-color:rgba(148,163,184,.46);
    }
    .st-tier-silver .eval{border-color:#94a3b8;color:#f1f5f9;background:rgba(148,163,184,.18)}
    .st-tier-silver .hl-num,.st-tier-silver .hl-count{color:#e2e8f0}
    .st-tier-bronze{
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(239,68,68,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
      border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.46);
    }
    .st-tier-bronze .eval{border-color:#ef4444;color:#fca5a5;background:rgba(239,68,68,.18)}
    .st-tier-bronze .hl-num,.st-tier-bronze .hl-count{color:#fca5a5}

    .st-lo-top{
      padding:16px 14px 18px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:16px;
    }
    .st-board-head{
      display:flex;
      align-items:flex-start;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:10px;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      padding-bottom:12px;
    }
    .st-block-title{
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:900;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:8px;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .st-block-title span{
      color:var(--yellow);
      text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--yellow);
    }
    .st-clock{
      text-align:right;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:3px;
    }
    .st-clock .time{
      font-size:16px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:var(--blue);
      font-family:var(--font-mono);
      letter-spacing:2px;
      text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(14,165,233,.65);
    }
    .st-clock .date{
      font-size:9px;
      color:var(--muted);
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-weight:700;
    }

    .st-chart{
      position:relative;
      height:160px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:flex-end;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:4px;
      padding-top:28px;
      border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
    }
    .st-chart::before,
    .st-chart::after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:1px;
      border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    }
    .st-chart::before{bottom:30px}
    .st-chart::after{bottom:80px}
    .st-bar-wrap{
      flex:1;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:flex-end;
      height:100%;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.25s;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .st-bar-wrap:hover{transform:translateY(-8px)}
    .st-bar-num{
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:900;
      margin-bottom:6px;
      text-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
    }
    .st-bar-col{
      width:100%;
      border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      padding-bottom:8px;
      transform-origin:bottom;
      animation:growUp 1.3s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) forwards;
      transform:scaleY(0);
      position:relative;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,.14),0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.42);
    }
    .st-bar-col::before{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      top:0;left:0;right:0;
      height:6px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
      filter:blur(1px);
      border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;
    }
    .st-bar-rank{
      writing-mode:vertical-rl;
      transform:rotate(180deg);
      font-size:9px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:#fff;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.75);
    }
    @keyframes growUp{
      from{transform:scaleY(0)}
      to{transform:scaleY(1)}
    }

    .st-ai-gateway{
      width:100%;
      padding:14px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:12px;
      cursor:pointer;
      color:#fff;
      font-weight:900;
      font-size:13px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:8px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(168,85,247,.85),rgba(99,102,241,.85));
      box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(168,85,247,.28);
    }

    .st-freq{
      padding:14px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:14px;
    }
    .st-freq-head{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:10px;
    }
    .st-freq-filter{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(202,138,4,.20),rgba(250,204,21,.34),rgba(202,138,4,.20));
      padding:12px;
      border-radius:12px;
      border:1px solid rgba(250,204,21,.44);
      box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(250,204,21,.18), inset 0 0 12px rgba(250,204,21,.08);
    }
    .st-freq-btn{
      flex:1;
      padding:12px 0;
      border-radius:10px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,#020617,#0f172a);
      color:#94a3b8;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.7), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .st-freq-btn.active{
      color:var(--yellow);
      border-color:var(--yellow);
      box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(250,204,21,.46), inset 0 0 8px rgba(250,204,21,.18);
      text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(250,204,21,.8);
      transform:translateY(-1px);
    }
    .st-freq-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);
      gap:4px;
    }
    .st-freq-cell{
      position:relative;
      padding:10px 0;
      text-align:center;
      border-radius:7px;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.42);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:900;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .st-freq-cell:hover{
      transform:translateY(-2px);
      z-index:2;
      border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);
    }
    .st-freq-cell.rhythm{
      background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);
      border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.35);
      color:#67e8f9;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(16,185,129,.22);
      text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(6,182,212,.4);
    }
    .st-freq-cell.gan{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,.14);
      border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.28);
      color:#fca5a5;
      opacity:.75;
    }
    .st-freq-icon{
      position:absolute;
      top:4px;
      right:4px;
      width:12px;
      height:12px;
    }

    /* Command Suite */
    .cc-wrap{
      padding:14px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:14px;
    }
    .cc-neon-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);
      gap:8px;
    }
    .cc-btn{
      min-height:58px;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b 0%,#020617 100%);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
      box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:5px;
      cursor:pointer;
      user-select:none;
      transition:.25s;
      padding:8px 6px;
    }
    .cc-btn .txt{
      font-size:9px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:.8px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      text-align:center;
      color:#64748b;
    }
    .cc-btn .core{
      width:35%;
      height:4px;
      border-radius:4px;
      background:#334155;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .cc-btn.active{
      transform:translateY(-1px);
      border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.35);
      background:rgba(16,185,129,.05);
    }
    .cc-btn.active .txt{
      color:var(--yellow);
      text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--yellow);
    }
    .cc-btn.active .core{
      width:75%;
      background:var(--yellow);
      box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow),0 0 28px #fef08a;
    }

    .cc-terminal{
      background:rgba(0,0,0,.9);
      border:1px solid var(--green);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:12px;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(16,185,129,.08),0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      min-height:148px;
    }
    .cc-terminal::before{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(16,185,129,.12) 1px, transparent 0);
      background-size:15px 15px;
      opacity:.28;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .cc-terminal-head{
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:8px;
      border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(16,185,129,.28);
      padding-bottom:7px;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .cc-terminal-title{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:8px;
      color:var(--green);
      font-size:9px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:2px;
    }
    .cc-live-tag{
      color:var(--green);
      border:1px solid var(--green);
      border-radius:4px;
      padding:1px 4px;
      font-size:8px;
      animation:pulse 1s infinite;
    }
    .cc-terminal-body{
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
      height:92px;
      overflow:auto;
      color:var(--green);
      font-size:10px;
      line-height:1.5;
      font-family:var(--font-mono);
    }
    .cc-log{
      margin-bottom:3px;
      opacity:0;
      transform:translateX(-5px);
      animation:logAppear .28s forwards;
      font-family:var(--font-mono);
    }
    @keyframes logAppear{
      to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
    }

    .cc-switch{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
    }
    .cc-switch-btn{
      flex:1;
      padding:12px 10px;
      border-radius:10px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0f172a,#020617);
      color:#94a3b8;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .cc-switch-btn.active{
      color:var(--blue);
      border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.45);
      box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(56,189,248,.24), inset 0 0 10px rgba(56,189,248,.10);
      text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(56,189,248,.6);
    }
    .cc-matrix-card{
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      border-radius:12px;
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    .cc-matrix-head{
      padding:10px 12px;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      align-items:center;
      font-size:11px;
      color:#cbd5e1;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      background:rgba(2,6,23,.55);
    }
    .cc-matrix-view{
      max-height:340px;
      overflow:auto;
      padding:10px;
    }
    .cc-year-grid{
      display:grid;
      width:max-content;
      gap:2px;
    }
    .cc-week-grid{
      display:grid;
      width:max-content;
      gap:2px;
      justify-content:center;
    }
    .cc-cell{
      width:72px;
      height:48px;
      border-radius:4px;
      background:#1e293b;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.03);
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      flex-direction:column;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .cc-cell:hover{
      background:#0ea5e9;
      box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(14,165,233,.55);
      transform:scale(1.04);
      z-index:2;
    }
    .cc-th-col{
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      z-index:20;
      background:#020617;
      color:var(--blue);
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      border-bottom:1px solid #334155;
      box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
      height:35px;
    }
    .cc-th-row{
      position:sticky;
      left:0;
      z-index:15;
      width:50px;
      background:#020617;
      color:var(--yellow);
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      border-right:1px solid #334155;
      box-shadow:2px 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
    }
    .cc-corner{
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      z-index:30;
      background:#d40000;
      color:#fff;
      font-size:12px;
      font-weight:900;
    }
    .cc-num{
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:#fff;
      letter-spacing:.5px;
    }
    .cc-num .tail{
      color:#f87171;
      text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(248,113,113,.5);
    }
    .cc-hidden{display:none!important}

    /* =========================
       BRIDGE REGION SHARED (MB/MN/MT)
       ========================= */
    .br-wrap{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      min-height:100%;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b1017,#0a0d12);
    }
    .br-sheet-header{
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      z-index:40;
      padding:15px;
      background:rgba(18,18,18,.95);
      backdrop-filter:blur(15px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(15px);
      border-bottom:1px solid #334155;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .br-glass-group{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      width:100%;
    }
    .br-btn{
      flex:1;
      min-height:55px;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b 0%,#020617 100%);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
      box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.62), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:center;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.25s;
      padding:8px 6px;
    }
    .br-btn .txt{
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:.5px;
      color:#64748b;
      margin-bottom:4px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .br-btn .core{
      width:35%;
      height:4px;
      border-radius:4px;
      background:#334155;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .br-btn.active{
      background:rgba(16,185,129,.05);
      transform:translateY(-1px);
      border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.35);
    }
    .br-btn.active .txt{
      color:var(--yellow);
      text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--yellow);
    }
    .br-btn.active .core{
      width:75%;
      background:var(--yellow);
      box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow),0 0 30px #fef08a;
    }

    .br-smart-bar{
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,#020617,#0f172a,#020617);
      box-shadow:0 5px 25px rgba(14,165,233,.28);
      border-bottom:2px solid var(--region-accent-soft, #38bdf8);
      padding:14px 18px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:14px;
      font-size:13px;
      font-weight:900;
      letter-spacing:1.5px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      z-index:20;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .br-smart-pulse{
      width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--region-accent-soft, #38bdf8);
      box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--region-accent-soft, #38bdf8);
      animation:aiPulse 1.5s infinite;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .br-smart-text{
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--region-accent-soft, #38bdf8) 20%, #ffffff 50%, var(--region-accent-soft, #38bdf8) 80%);
      background-size:200% auto;
      -webkit-background-clip:text;
      background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
      animation:dataStream 2s linear infinite;
      text-align:center;
    }

    .br-station-nav{
      flex-shrink:0;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.82);
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      padding:10px 0;
      z-index:20;
      box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
    }
    .br-station-nav.hidden{display:none}
    .br-nav-row{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:15px;
      padding:0 15px;
      width:100%;
    }
    .br-nav-arrow{
      width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      color:var(--region-accent-soft, #0ea5e9);
      font-size:18px;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.2s;
      box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
      user-select:none;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .br-nav-arrow:active{
      transform:scale(.86);
      background:var(--region-accent-soft, #0ea5e9);
      color:#fff;
      box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--region-accent-soft, #0ea5e9);
    }
    .br-current-station{
      flex:1;
      text-align:center;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(225,29,72,.2),rgba(190,18,60,.38));
      border:1px solid rgba(254,205,211,.35);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:12px 10px;
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:#fff;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(225,29,72,.22), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      white-space:nowrap;
      overflow:hidden;
      text-overflow:ellipsis;
      transition:.2s;
    }

    .br-feed{
      flex:1;
      overflow-y:auto;
      overflow-x:hidden;
      padding:12px 8px 88px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:16px;
      position:relative;
    }
    .br-history{
      position:relative;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:16px;
    }
    .br-board{
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.72);
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:16px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      padding:14px;
      box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .br-board.flash{
      animation:boardFlash .8s ease;
    }
    @keyframes boardFlash{
      0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0), inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0)}
      50%{box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(56,189,248,.28), inset 0 0 48px rgba(56,189,248,.08)}
      100%{box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
    }
    .br-board-head{
      display:flex;
      align-items:baseline;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:10px;
      margin-bottom:12px;
      padding-bottom:8px;
      border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    }
    .br-board-title{
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:900;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      color:var(--region-accent, #fff);
    }
    .br-board-date{
      font-size:11px;
      color:#8fa4be;
      font-style:italic;
      font-weight:700;
      text-transform:capitalize;
      text-align:right;
    }
    .br-row{
      display:flex;
      align-items:stretch;
      gap:12px;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .br-prize{
      width:42px;
      flex-shrink:0;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      border-radius:10px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      color:#94a3b8;
      font-weight:900;
      font-size:14px;
    }
    .br-prize.db{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d40000,#990000);
      color:#fff;
      border-color:#ff5252;
      box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(212,0,0,.35);
    }
    .br-results{
      flex:1;
      display:grid;
      gap:6px;
    }
    .br-grid-1{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .br-grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
    .br-grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
    .br-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
    .br-grid-6{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
    .br-grid-7{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:6px;
    }
    .br-grid-7 .br-number-box{
      flex:0 0 calc(25% - 4.5px);
      max-width:calc(25% - 4.5px);
    }

    .br-number-box{
      background:rgba(2,6,23,.42);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      border-radius:8px;
      min-height:34px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.2s;
      z-index:2;
      padding:0 2px;
    }
    .br-wrap.mode-manual .br-number-box:active{
      transform:scale(.96);
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    }

    .br-number-text{
      width:100%;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      color:#fff;
      font-weight:700;
      font-family:"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    }
    .br-grid-6 .br-number-text{font-size:11px}
    .br-grid-4 .br-number-text,
    .br-grid-7 .br-number-text{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
    .br-grid-3 .br-number-text{font-size:14px}
    .br-grid-2 .br-number-text{font-size:16px}
    .br-grid-1 .br-number-text{font-size:18px}
    .br-row-db .br-number-box{min-height:50px}
    .br-row-db .br-number-text{font-size:28px}
    .br-theme-mb .br-row-db .br-number-text,
    .br-theme-mn .br-row-db .br-number-text,
    .br-theme-mt .br-row-db .br-number-text{
      color:var(--red);
    }

    .br-digit{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      border-radius:3px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .br-digit.marked{
      color:var(--yellow);
      text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow),0 0 28px #fef08a;
      transform:scale(1.4);
      font-weight:900;
    }
    .br-row-db .br-digit.marked{transform:scale(1.2)}
    .br-digit.ai-marked{
      color:var(--blue);
      text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--blue-2),0 0 28px var(--blue);
      transform:scale(1.4);
      font-weight:900;
    }
    .br-row-db .br-digit.ai-marked{transform:scale(1.2)}
    .br-number-box.ai-glow{
      box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,.55), inset 0 0 15px rgba(56,189,248,.24);
      border-color:#38bdf8;
      background:rgba(14,165,233,.15);
      z-index:3;
    }

    .br-svg{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      z-index:25;
    }
    .br-line{
      stroke:#10b981;
      stroke-width:2.5;
      fill:none;
      pointer-events:stroke;
      cursor:pointer;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #10b981);
    }
    .br-line-hit{
      stroke:transparent;
      stroke-width:20;
      fill:none;
      pointer-events:stroke;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    .br-line.to-delete{
      stroke:#ef4444;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #ef4444);
      stroke-width:3.5;
    }
    .br-line-ai{
      stroke:#0ea5e9;
      stroke-width:3;
      fill:none;
      pointer-events:none;
      stroke-dasharray:8,6;
      animation:laserFlow 1s linear infinite;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #38bdf8);
    }

    .br-theme-mb{
      --region-accent:#ffffff;
      --region-accent-soft:#38bdf8;
    }
    .br-theme-mn{
      --region-accent:#0288d1;
      --region-accent-soft:#38bdf8;
    }
    .br-theme-mt{
      --region-accent:#8b5cf6;
      --region-accent-soft:#8b5cf6;
    }

    .bridge-popup{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      z-index:var(--z-popup);
      display:none;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,.78);
      backdrop-filter:blur(5px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(5px);
      padding:18px;
    }
    .bridge-popup.show{display:flex}
    .bridge-popup-box{
      width:100%;
      max-width:340px;
      background:#0f172a;
      border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.42);
      border-radius:16px;
      padding:22px;
      box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(16,185,129,.22);
      transform:translateY(14px) scale(.95);
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .bridge-popup.show .bridge-popup-box{
      transform:translateY(0) scale(1);
    }
    .bridge-popup-title{
      text-align:center;
      font-size:12px;
      color:#94a3b8;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      font-weight:800;
    }
    .bridge-popup-digits{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      justify-content:center;
    }
    .bridge-digit-btn{
      width:50px;height:50px;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      border-radius:12px;
      background:#1e293b;
      border:2px solid #334155;
      color:#fff;
      font-size:24px;
      font-weight:900;
      cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.42);
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .bridge-digit-btn:active{
      transform:scale(.9);
      background:#0ea5e9;
      border-color:#38bdf8;
    }

    /* =========================
       LIVE MODULE
       ========================= */
    .live-wrap{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      min-height:100%;
      background:#0a0a0c;
    }
    .live-topbar{
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,#020617,#0f172a,#020617);
      padding:10px 14px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:12px;
      border-bottom:2px solid #38bdf8;
      box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(14,165,233,.25);
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      z-index:40;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .live-clock{
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:#38bdf8;
      text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(14,165,233,.65);
      letter-spacing:1px;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .live-pulse{
      width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
      background:#ef4444;
      box-shadow:0 0 12px #ef4444;
      animation:blinkPulse 1s infinite;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    @keyframes blinkPulse{
      0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
      50%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.8)}
    }

    .live-sub{
      display:none;
      flex-direction:column;
      flex:1;
      min-height:0;
      background:#0f172a;
      overflow-y:auto;
      overflow-x:hidden;
      position:relative;
    }
    .live-sub.active{
      display:flex;
    }

    .live-lobby{
      padding:15px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:18px;
    }
    .live-card{
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
      border-radius:16px;
      padding:15px;
      border:1px solid #334155;
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.22s;
    }
    .live-card:active{transform:scale(.97)}
    .live-card::before{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      left:0;top:0;bottom:0;
      width:6px;
    }
    .live-card[data-region="vl"]::before{background:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow)}
    .live-card[data-region="mb"]::before{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--red)}
    .live-card[data-region="mn"]::before{background:var(--blue-2);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--blue-2)}
    .live-card[data-region="mt"]::before{background:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--purple)}

    .live-card-head{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:10px;
      border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      padding-bottom:10px;
      margin-bottom:10px;
    }
    .live-region-name{
      font-size:18px;
      font-weight:900;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:1px;
    }
    .live-card[data-region="vl"] .live-region-name{color:var(--yellow);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(250,204,21,.35)}
    .live-card[data-region="mb"] .live-region-name{color:var(--red);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(239,68,68,.35)}
    .live-card[data-region="mn"] .live-region-name{color:var(--blue);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(14,165,233,.35)}
    .live-card[data-region="mt"] .live-region-name{color:var(--purple);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(139,92,246,.35)}

    .live-status{
      padding:4px 12px;
      border-radius:20px;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      background:#334155;
      color:#cbd5e1;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .live-status.now{
      background:#ef4444;
      color:#fff;
      box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.7);
      animation:statusBlink .55s infinite alternate;
    }
    @keyframes statusBlink{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:.55}}

    .live-countdown{
      font-size:31px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:#f8fafc;
      text-align:center;
      margin:10px 0;
      padding:15px;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);
      border-radius:12px;
      border:1px solid #475569;
      letter-spacing:4px;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,.75);
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .live-countdown span{
      display:block;
      margin-top:2px;
      font-size:12px;
      color:#94a3b8;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      font-weight:500;
    }
    .live-countdown.warning{
      color:var(--yellow);
      border-color:var(--yellow);
      text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow);
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(250,204,21,.16);
      animation:pulseWarning 1.5s infinite alternate;
    }
    .live-countdown.danger{
      color:#ef4444;
      border-color:#ef4444;
      text-shadow:0 0 18px #ef4444;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(239,68,68,.25);
      animation:pulseDanger .5s infinite alternate;
    }
    @keyframes pulseWarning{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.02)}}
    @keyframes pulseDanger{
      from{transform:scale(1);box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(239,68,68,.14)}
      to{transform:scale(1.04);box-shadow:inset 0 0 38px rgba(239,68,68,.32)}
    }

    .live-stations{
      font-size:14px;
      color:#cbd5e1;
      font-weight:700;
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:15px;
      min-height:20px;
    }
    .live-enter-btn{
      width:100%;
      padding:14px;
      border-radius:10px;
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:900;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:1px;
      border:none;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .live-card[data-region="vl"] .live-enter-btn{background:rgba(250,204,21,.10);border:1px solid var(--yellow);color:var(--yellow)}
    .live-card[data-region="mb"] .live-enter-btn{background:rgba(239,68,68,.10);border:1px solid var(--red);color:var(--red)}
    .live-card[data-region="mn"] .live-enter-btn{background:rgba(14,165,233,.10);border:1px solid var(--blue-2);color:var(--blue)}
    .live-card[data-region="mt"] .live-enter-btn{background:rgba(139,92,246,.10);border:1px solid var(--purple);color:#c4b5fd}

    .live-room-head{
      background:#0a0d12;
      padding:12px 16px;
      border-bottom:1px solid #334155;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:12px;
      position:sticky;
      top:0;
      z-index:20;
    }
    .live-back-btn{
      background:none;
      border:none;
      color:#fff;
      font-size:20px;
      cursor:pointer;
      padding:4px;
    }
    .live-room-title{
      flex:1;
      white-space:nowrap;
      font-size:16px;
      font-weight:900;
      overflow:hidden;
      text-overflow:ellipsis;
    }
    .live-shine{
      display:inline-block;
      background:linear-gradient(110deg,currentColor 35%, #ffffff 50%, currentColor 65%);
      background-size:200% auto;
      -webkit-background-clip:text;
      background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
      animation:textShineSweep 3s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes textShineSweep{
      0%{background-position:-100% center}
      100%{background-position:200% center}
    }
    .live-draw-btn{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
      color:#0ea5e9;
      border:1px solid #0284c7;
      padding:8px 14px;
      border-radius:20px;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:.2s;
      box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(14,165,233,.18);
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .live-draw-btn:disabled{
      background:#334155;
      color:#94a3b8;
      border-color:#475569;
      cursor:not-allowed;
      box-shadow:none;
    }

    .live-assistant{
      position:absolute;
      top:66px;
      right:15px;
      z-index:12;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:row-reverse;
      align-items:flex-start;
      gap:10px;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .live-avatar{
      width:45px;height:45px;border-radius:50%;
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
      border:2px solid #0ea5e9;
      box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(14,165,233,.45);
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      font-size:24px;
      animation:floatMascot 3s infinite ease-in-out;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    @keyframes floatMascot{
      0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}
      50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}
    }
    .live-bubble{
      max-width:220px;
      margin-top:5px;
      padding:10px 14px;
      border-radius:15px 0 15px 15px;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.95);
      border:1px solid #0ea5e9;
      color:#fff;
      font-size:12px;
      line-height:1.4;
      box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
      opacity:0;
      transform:translateY(5px) scale(.9);
      transform-origin:top right;
      transition:.22s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1);
      pointer-events:auto;
    }
    .live-bubble.show{
      opacity:1;
      transform:translateY(0) scale(1);
    }
    .live-highlight{
      color:var(--yellow);
      font-weight:900;
      font-size:16px;
      text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(250,204,21,.45);
    }

    .live-room-feed{
      padding:24px 15px 15px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:18px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:5;
    }
    .live-board{
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:15px;
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      transform:scale(1.01);
      box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,.62), inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border:2px solid #334155;
      transition:.25s;
    }
    .live-board::after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:200%;
      background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(14,165,233,.02) 0%, transparent 10%, transparent 90%, rgba(14,165,233,.02) 100%);
      pointer-events:none;
      z-index:1;
      animation:boardScanline 4s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes boardScanline{
      from{transform:translateY(-40%)}
      to{transform:translateY(10%)}
    }

    .live-theme-mb .live-board{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(239,68,68,.22)}
    .live-theme-mn .live-board{border-color:var(--blue-2);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(14,165,233,.22)}
    .live-theme-mt .live-board{border-color:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(139,92,246,.22)}
    .live-theme-vl .live-board{border-color:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(250,204,21,.22)}

    .live-board-head{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:15px;
      padding-bottom:10px;
      border-bottom:1px dashed #334155;
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:900;
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
    }
    .live-row{
      display:flex;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      gap:8px;
      align-items:stretch;
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
    }
    .live-prize{
      width:45px;
      flex-shrink:0;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:900;
      background:#0f172a;
      color:#94a3b8;
      border-radius:8px;
      border:1px solid #334155;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .live-prize.db{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d40000,#990000);
      color:#fff;
      border-color:#ff5252;
    }
    .live-prize.active-led{
      background:#0ea5e9;
      color:#fff;
      border-color:#38bdf8;
      box-shadow:0 0 15px #0ea5e9;
      transform:scale(1.04);
    }
    .live-results{
      flex:1;
      display:grid;
      gap:6px;
    }
    .live-grid-1{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .live-grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
    .live-grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
    .live-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
    .live-grid-6{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
    .live-grid-7{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:6px;
    }
    .live-grid-7 .live-number-box{
      width:calc(25% - 4.5px);
    }
    .live-grid-vl{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:8px;
    }
    .live-grid-vl .live-number-box{
      width:45px;
      height:45px;
      border-radius:50%;
      border:2px solid var(--yellow);
      background:rgba(250,204,21,.1);
    }

    .live-number-box{
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0f172a,#020617);
      border:1px solid #334155;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      border-radius:6px;
      min-height:36px;
      overflow:hidden;
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
      padding:0 2px;
    }
    .live-row-db .live-number-box{
      min-height:50px;
      background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(239,68,68,.1),#0f172a);
      border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.28);
      box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(239,68,68,.18);
    }

    .live-number-text{
      width:100%;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      color:#fff;
      font-weight:900;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .live-row-db .live-number-text{
      font-size:26px;
      color:var(--red);
      letter-spacing:4px;
      text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(239,68,68,.45);
    }
    .live-grid-vl .live-number-text{
      font-size:18px;
      color:var(--yellow);
      letter-spacing:0;
    }
    .live-grid-1 .live-number-text{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:4px}
    .live-grid-2 .live-number-text{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:3px}
    .live-grid-3 .live-number-text{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:1.5px}
    .live-grid-4 .live-number-text{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.5px}
    .live-grid-6 .live-number-text,
    .live-grid-7 .live-number-text{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0}

    .live-dots{
      display:flex;
      gap:2px;
    }
    .live-dot{
      width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
      background:#475569;
      box-shadow:0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
    }
    .live-number-text.spinning{
      color:#0ea5e9;
      filter:blur(.8px) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(14,165,233,.8));
      animation:cyberGlitch .2s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes cyberGlitch{
      0%{transform:translate(0) scale(1);opacity:1}
      20%{transform:translate(-1px,1px) scale(1.02);opacity:.8}
      40%{transform:translate(-1px,-1px) scale(.98);opacity:.9}
      60%{transform:translate(1px,1px) scale(1.02);opacity:1}
      80%{transform:translate(1px,-1px) scale(.98);opacity:.8}
      100%{transform:translate(0) scale(1);opacity:1}
    }

    .live-overlay-cd{
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;left:50%;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      font-size:45px;
      font-weight:900;
      color:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      white-space:nowrap;
      letter-spacing:5px;
      z-index:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      opacity:0;
      text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      transition:opacity .25s;
    }

    .live-chat-box{
      margin:10px 15px 15px;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.85);
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border:1px solid #334155;
      border-radius:12px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      height:176px;
      flex-shrink:0;
      box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      z-index:10;
    }
    .live-theme-mb .live-chat-box{border-top:3px solid var(--red);box-shadow:inset 0 20px 30px -20px rgba(239,68,68,.18)}
    .live-theme-mn .live-chat-box{border-top:3px solid var(--blue-2);box-shadow:inset 0 20px 30px -20px rgba(14,165,233,.18)}
    .live-theme-mt .live-chat-box{border-top:3px solid var(--purple);box-shadow:inset 0 20px 30px -20px rgba(139,92,246,.18)}
    .live-theme-vl .live-chat-box{border-top:3px solid var(--yellow);box-shadow:inset 0 20px 30px -20px rgba(250,204,21,.18)}

    .live-chat-head{
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:900;
      text-align:center;
      padding:6px;
      color:#94a3b8;
      border-bottom:1px dashed #334155;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    }
    .live-chat-stream{
      flex:1;
      overflow-y:auto;
      padding:8px 10px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:6px;
      scroll-behavior:smooth;
    }
    .live-chat-msg{
      font-size:12px;
      line-height:1.3;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      animation:slideInLeft .3s ease-out;
    }
    .live-chat-msg .u{
      font-weight:900;
      font-size:10px;
      margin-bottom:2px;
    }
    .live-theme-mb .live-chat-msg .u{color:#fca5a5}
    .live-theme-mn .live-chat-msg .u{color:#bae6fd}
    .live-theme-mt .live-chat-msg .u{color:#ddd6fe}
    .live-theme-vl .live-chat-msg .u{color:#fef08a}
    .live-chat-msg .t{
      display:inline-block;
      width:fit-content;
      color:#f8fafc;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
      padding:6px 10px;
      border-radius:4px 8px 8px 8px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
    }
    .live-chat-msg.self{
      align-items:flex-end;
    }
    .live-chat-msg.self .u{color:var(--green)}
    .live-chat-msg.self .t{
      background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);
      border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.3);
      border-radius:8px 4px 8px 8px;
    }
    @keyframes slideInLeft{
      from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-10px)}
      to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
    }

    .live-smart-ui{
      position:absolute;
      bottom:15px;
      right:15px;
      z-index:20;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:flex-end;
    }
    .live-smart-btn{
      width:45px;height:45px;border-radius:50%;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.85);
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
      box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      cursor:pointer;
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
      transition:.22s;
    }
    .live-smart-btn::after{
      content:"";
      width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;
      border:2px solid #94a3b8;
      transition:.22s;
    }
    .live-smart-btn:active{
      transform:scale(.94);
      border-color:#0ea5e9;
    }
    .live-smart-btn:active::after{
      border-color:#0ea5e9;
      box-shadow:0 0 10px #0ea5e9;
    }

    .live-voice-bar{
      position:absolute;
      right:22px;
      width:0;
      height:45px;
      opacity:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      overflow:hidden;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      background:rgba(15,23,42,.95);
      border-radius:25px;
      border:1px solid transparent;
      transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,0);
    }
    .live-voice-bar.active{
      width:calc(100vw - 70px);
      max-width:340px;
      opacity:1;
      pointer-events:auto;
      border-color:#0ea5e9;
      box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,.35);
    }
    .live-voice-mic,
    .live-voice-send{
      width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:50%;
      border:none;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      color:#fff;
      cursor:pointer;
      flex-shrink:0;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .live-voice-mic{
      margin-left:6px;
      background:#334155;
      font-size:14px;
    }
    .live-voice-mic.recording{
      background:#ef4444;
      box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.72);
    }
    .live-voice-send{
      margin-right:6px;
      background:#0ea5e9;
      box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(14,165,233,.25);
      font-size:16px;
      padding-left:2px;
    }
    .live-voice-send:active{transform:scale(.86)}
    .live-voice-wave{
      display:none;
      gap:3px;
      align-items:center;
      height:20px;
      margin-left:5px;
      width:25px;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .live-voice-wave.active{display:flex}
    .live-wave-bar{
      width:3px;
      border-radius:3px;
      background:#ef4444;
      animation:waveBounce .5s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
    }
    .live-wave-bar:nth-child(1){animation-delay:0s}
    .live-wave-bar:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.1s}
    .live-wave-bar:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.2s}
    .live-wave-bar:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.3s}
    @keyframes waveBounce{
      0%{height:4px}
      100%{height:18px;box-shadow:0 0 5px #ef4444}
    }
    .live-voice-input{
      flex:1;
      min-width:0;
      background:transparent;
      border:none;
      color:#fff;
      padding:0 10px;
      font-size:13px;
      font-weight:700;
      outline:none;
      width:100%;
      white-space:nowrap;
      overflow-x:auto;
      pointer-events:none;
    }
    .live-voice-input::placeholder{
      color:#64748b;
      font-size:11px;
      font-weight:400;
    }

    .live-heart-btn{
      position:absolute;
      bottom:70px;
      right:15px;
      z-index:20;
      background:none;
      border:none;
      font-size:28px;
      cursor:pointer;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(239,68,68,.5));
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .live-heart-btn:active{transform:scale(.82)}
    .live-heart-float{
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .live-floating-heart{
      position:absolute;
      font-size:20px;
      pointer-events:none;
      z-index:30;
      animation:flyUpHeart 1.5s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) forwards;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px red);
    }
    @keyframes flyUpHeart{
      0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0deg)}
      100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-120px) scale(1.5) rotate(20deg)}
    }

    @media (max-width:400px){
      .cc-neon-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
      .cc-btn{min-height:54px}
      .st-freq-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr)}
      .gai-plus-menu{width:210px}
      .live-countdown{font-size:28px}
      .br-current-station{font-size:13px}
    }
  </style>
</head>

    <!-- CONFIRM -->

    <!-- BRIDGE DIGIT POPUP -->
    <div class="bridge-popup" id="bridge-popup">
      <div class="bridge-popup-box">
        <div class="bridge-popup-title">CHỌN VỊ TRÍ CẦU (ĐIỂM NỐI)</div>

      </div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
      const $$ = (sel, root = document) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(sel));

      function normalizeText(str) {
        return (str || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .normalize("NFD")
          .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
          .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
          .trim();
      }

      const App = {
        toast(message, type = "info", timeout = 2600) {
          const stack = $("toast-stack");
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          div.className = `toast ${type}`;
          div.textContent = message;
          stack.appendChild(div);
          setTimeout(() => {
            div.style.opacity = "0";
            div.style.transform = "translateY(-8px)";
            setTimeout(() => div.remove(), 220);
          }, timeout);
        },
        confirm(message, onYes, title = "Xác nhận") {
          $("confirm-title").textContent = title;
          $("confirm-message").textContent = message;
          $("confirm-modal").classList.add("show");

          const ok = $("confirm-ok");
          const cancel = $("confirm-cancel");

          const cleanup = () => {
            $("confirm-modal").classList.remove("show");
            ok.onclick = null;
            cancel.onclick = null;
          };

          ok.onclick = () => {
            cleanup();
            if (typeof onYes === "function") onYes();
          };
          cancel.onclick = cleanup;
        },
        vibrate(ms = 40) {
          if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(ms);
        },
        openUrl(url) {
          window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
        },
        flash(el) {
          if (!el) return;
          el.classList.remove("screen-flash");
          void el.offsetWidth;
          el.classList.add("screen-flash");
          setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("screen-flash"), 560);
        },
        smoothCenter(el) {
          if (!el) return;
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        }
      };

      document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const target = e.target.closest(".js-ripple");
        if (!target) return;
        const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        const circle = document.createElement("span");
        const diameter = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
        const radius = diameter / 2;
        circle.className = "ripple";
        circle.style.width = circle.style.height = diameter + "px";
        circle.style.left = (e.clientX - rect.left - radius) + "px";
        circle.style.top = (e.clientY - rect.top - radius) + "px";
        target.appendChild(circle);
        setTimeout(() => circle.remove(), 620);
      });

      const Bus = (() => {
        const map = new Map();
        return {
          on(event, fn) {
            if (!map.has(event)) map.set(event, new Set());
            map.get(event).add(fn);
            return () => map.get(event)?.delete(fn);
          },
          emit(event, payload) {
            (map.get(event) || []).forEach(fn => {
              try { fn(payload); } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
            });
          }
        };
      })();

      const ScreenBoot = {};
      const booted = {};

      const Router = {
        current: "stats",
        ensure(screen) {
          if (booted[screen]) return;
          if (typeof ScreenBoot[screen] === "function") {
            ScreenBoot[screen]();
            booted[screen] = true;
          }
        },
        go(screen, opts = {}) {
          this.ensure(screen);

          $$(".eco-screen").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("active"));
          const targetScreen = $(`screen-${screen}`);
          if (targetScreen) {
            targetScreen.classList.add("active");
            if (opts.resetScroll !== false) targetScreen.scrollTop = 0;
          }

          $$(".eco-nav-item").forEach(item => {
            item.classList.toggle("active", item.dataset.screen === screen);
          });

          this.current = screen;

          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            Bus.emit("route:change", { screen, opts });
            if (typeof opts.afterEnter === "function") {
              setTimeout(() => opts.afterEnter(), 60);
            }
          });
        }
      };

      const BridgePopup = (() => {
        let activeModule = null;
        let activeBoxId = null;

        function open(moduleApi, boxId, digits) {
          activeModule = moduleApi;
          activeBoxId = boxId;
          const wrap = $("bridge-popup-digits");
          wrap.innerHTML = "";
          digits.forEach((digit, index) => {
            const btn = document.createElement("button");
            btn.className = "bridge-digit-btn js-ripple";
            btn.textContent = digit;
            btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
              close();
              activeModule?.pickDigit(activeBoxId, index);
            });
            wrap.appendChild(btn);
          });
          $("bridge-popup").classList.add("show");
        }

        function close() {
          $("bridge-popup").classList.remove("show");
          activeModule = null;
          activeBoxId = null;
        }

        return { open, close };
      })();

      $("bridge-popup").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target.id === "bridge-popup") BridgePopup.close();
      });

      const GlobalAI = (() => {
        const stream = $("gai-stream");
        const input = $("gai-input");
        const overlay = $("gai-overlay");
        const meta = $("gai-meta");
        const plusMenu = $("gai-plus-menu");
        const micBtn = $("gai-mic-btn");
        let recognition = null;
        let isRecording = false;
        let currentSource = "manual";

        function append(role, html) {
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          div.className = `gai-msg ${role}`;
          div.innerHTML = html;
          stream.appendChild(div);
          stream.scrollTop = stream.scrollHeight;
        }

        function bootGreeting() {
          if (stream.children.length) return;
          append("ai", `Đã kết nối <b>GLOBAL COMMAND CENTER</b>.<br><br>Tôi có thể điều hướng toàn bộ hệ sinh thái:<br>• Soi cầu Miền Bắc / Nam / Trung<br>• Mở sảnh live<br>• Quay thử từng phòng<br>• Gọi lô top, nhịp đẹp, lô gan trong Thống Kê`);
        }

        function open(source = "manual", presetText = "") {
          currentSource = source;
          meta.textContent = `GLOBAL COMMAND CENTER • ${source.toUpperCase()} • ONLINE`;
          overlay.classList.add("show");
          bootGreeting();
          input.focus();
          if (presetText) {
            input.value = presetText;
            input.setSelectionRange(input.value.length, input.value.length);
          }
        }

        function close() {
          overlay.classList.remove("show");
          plusMenu.classList.remove("show");
          if (recognition && isRecording) recognition.stop();
        }

        function togglePlusMenu() {
          plusMenu.classList.toggle("show");
        }

        function sendQuick(cmd) {
          plusMenu.classList.remove("show");
          input.value = cmd;
          send();
        }

        function detectCommand(rawText) {
          const norm = normalizeText(rawText);
          const numMatch = norm.match(/\b(\d{2})\b/);
          const num = numMatch ? numMatch[1] : null;

          if (/tuan duc|youtube|kenh/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "open-url", url: "https://www.youtube.com/@Phamlehoangtuanduc" };
          }

          const region =
            /mien bac|xsmb|\bmb\b/.test(norm) ? "mb" :
            /mien nam|xsmn|\bmn\b/.test(norm) ? "mn" :
            /mien trung|xsmt|\bmt\b/.test(norm) ? "mt" :
            /vietlott|\bvl\b/.test(norm) ? "vl" : null;

          const asksLive = /(live|truc tiep|sanh)/.test(norm);
          const asksDraw = /(quay thu|quay lai|spin|xo thu)/.test(norm);
          const asksBridge = /(soi cau|cau dong quy|cau td|bac nho)/.test(norm);
          const asksStats = /(thong ke|ma tran|tan suat|lo top|loto top|nhip dep|lo gan|lo don|lo cap|lo kep|soi lo)/.test(norm);

          if (asksDraw) {
            return { type: "live-draw", region: region || "mb" };
          }

          if (asksLive && region) {
            return { type: "live-room", region };
          }

          if (asksBridge && region && region !== "vl") {
            return { type: "bridge-region", region, num };
          }

          if (/lo top|top vip/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "stats-top" };
          }

          if (/nhip dep/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "stats-freq", filter: "RHYTHM" };
          }

          if (/lo gan/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "stats-freq", filter: "GAN" };
          }

          if (/lo don/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "stats-mode", mode: "single" };
          }

          if (/lo cap/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "stats-mode", mode: "pair" };
          }

          if (/lo kep/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "stats-mode", mode: "double" };
          }

          if (num && asksStats) {
            return { type: "stats-row", num };
          }

          if (asksStats) {
            return { type: "stats" };
          }

          if (region === "mb" || region === "mn" || region === "mt") {
            return { type: "screen", screen: region };
          }

          if (asksLive) {
            return { type: "screen", screen: "live" };
          }

          if (/phong ai|trung tam ai/.test(norm)) {
            return { type: "noop" };
          }

          return { type: "unknown", raw: rawText };
        }

        function execute(cmd, rawText) {
          switch (cmd.type) {
