            case "open-url":
              append("ai", `Đã mở <b>Kênh Tuấn Đức</b> ở tab mới.`);
              setTimeout(() => App.openUrl(cmd.url), 220);
              setTimeout(close, 380);
              return;

            case "bridge-region": {
              const labelMap = { mb: "Miền Bắc", mn: "Miền Nam", mt: "Miền Trung" };
              append("ai", `Đã nhận lệnh: <b>${rawText}</b>.<br>Đang đóng overlay, chuyển sang <b>${labelMap[cmd.region]}</b> và kích hoạt chuỗi soi cầu AI${cmd.num ? ` cho số <b>${cmd.num}</b>` : ""}.`);
              Router.go(cmd.region, {
                afterEnter: () => Bus.emit(`${cmd.region}:ai-bridge`, { targetNumber: cmd.num || null, source: "global-ai" })
              });
              setTimeout(close, 520);
              return;
            }

            case "live-room": {
              const liveMap = { mb: "Miền Bắc", mn: "Miền Nam", mt: "Miền Trung", vl: "Vietlott" };
              append("ai", `Đang chuyển sang <b>Sảnh Live</b> và mở phòng <b>${liveMap[cmd.region]}</b>.`);
              Router.go("live", {
                afterEnter: () => Bus.emit("live:enter-room", { region: cmd.region })
              });
              setTimeout(close, 520);
              return;
            }

            case "live-draw": {
              const liveMap = { mb: "Miền Bắc", mn: "Miền Nam", mt: "Miền Trung", vl: "Vietlott" };
              append("ai", `Đã khóa mục tiêu <b>${liveMap[cmd.region]}</b>. Chuyển sang live và thử kích hoạt <b>quay thử</b>.`);
              Router.go("live", {
                afterEnter: () => {
                  Bus.emit("live:enter-room", { region: cmd.region });
                  setTimeout(() => Bus.emit("live:draw", { region: cmd.region }), 380);
                }
              });
              setTimeout(close, 520);
              return;
            }

            case "stats-top":
              append("ai", `Đang chuyển về <b>Thống Kê</b> và khóa vào khu vực <b>Lô Top VIP</b>.`);
              Router.go("stats", {
                afterEnter: () => Bus.emit("stats:focus-top")
              });
              setTimeout(close, 520);
              return;

            case "stats-freq":
              append("ai", `Đang mở bảng <b>Tần suất lô thông minh</b> và lọc <b>${cmd.filter === "GAN" ? "Lô gan" : "Nhịp đẹp"}</b>.`);
              Router.go("stats", {
                afterEnter: () => Bus.emit("stats:focus-freq", { filter: cmd.filter })
              });
              setTimeout(close, 520);
              return;

            case "stats-mode":
              append("ai", `Đang chuyển về <b>Thống Kê</b> và đổi ma trận sang chế độ <b>${cmd.mode}</b>.`);
              Router.go("stats", {
                afterEnter: () => Bus.emit("stats:set-mode", { mode: cmd.mode })
              });
              setTimeout(close, 520);
              return;

            case "stats-row":
              append("ai", `Đang truy xuất <b>lô ${cmd.num}</b> trên ma trận Thống Kê.`);
              Router.go("stats", {
                afterEnter: () => Bus.emit("stats:focus-row", { num: cmd.num })
              });
              setTimeout(close, 520);
              return;

            case "stats":
              append("ai", `Đã chuyển hệ thống về <b>Thống Kê</b>.`);
              Router.go("stats");
              setTimeout(close, 420);
              return;

            case "screen":
              append("ai", `Đang điều hướng sang mô-đun <b>${cmd.screen.toUpperCase()}</b>.`);
              Router.go(cmd.screen);
              setTimeout(close, 420);
              return;

            case "noop":
              append("ai", `Tôi đang trực tuyến. Hãy ra lệnh cụ thể, ví dụ:<br><b>Soi cầu miền Bắc</b><br><b>Quay thử miền Nam</b><br><b>Lô top VIP</b>`);
              return;

            default:
              append("ai", `Tôi đã nhận: <b>${rawText}</b>.<br>Nhưng lệnh này chưa đủ rõ. Gợi ý:<br>• Soi cầu miền Bắc<br>• Soi cầu 68 miền Nam<br>• Mở live miền Trung<br>• Quay thử miền Bắc<br>• Lô nhịp đẹp`);
          }
        }

        function send() {
          const text = input.value.trim();
          if (!text) return;
          append("user", text);
          input.value = "";
          setTimeout(() => {
            const cmd = detectCommand(text);
            execute(cmd, text);
          }, 240);
        }

        function setupSpeech() {
          const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
          if (!SpeechRecognition) return;

          recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
          recognition.lang = "vi-VN";
          recognition.interimResults = true;

          recognition.onstart = () => {
            isRecording = true;
            micBtn.classList.add("recording");
            input.placeholder = "Đang lắng nghe...";
          };

          recognition.onresult = (event) => {
            let transcript = "";
            for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
              transcript += event.results[i][0].transcript;
            }
            input.value = transcript;
          };

          recognition.onerror = () => {
            isRecording = false;
            micBtn.classList.remove("recording");
            input.placeholder = "Ra lệnh cho bộ não trung tâm...";
            App.toast("Mic không khả dụng hoặc đã bị từ chối.", "warn");
          };

          recognition.onend = () => {
            isRecording = false;
            micBtn.classList.remove("recording");
            input.placeholder = "Ra lệnh cho bộ não trung tâm...";
          };
        }

        function toggleMic() {
          if (!recognition) {
            App.toast("Trình duyệt không hỗ trợ nhận diện giọng nói.", "warn");
            return;
          }
          if (isRecording) {
            recognition.stop();
          } else {
            input.value = "";
            try { recognition.start(); } catch (err) {}
          }
        }

        function init() {
          setupSpeech();

          $("global-ai-open").addEventListener("click", () => open("floating-button"));
          $("gai-close").addEventListener("click", close);
          $("gai-send-btn").addEventListener("click", send);
          $("gai-plus-btn").addEventListener("click", togglePlusMenu);
          $("gai-mic-btn").addEventListener("click", toggleMic);
          input.addEventListener("keypress", (e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") send();
          });

          document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            if (!plusMenu.contains(e.target) && e.target.id !== "gai-plus-btn") {
              plusMenu.classList.remove("show");
            }
          });

          $$("[data-ai-cmd]").forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener("click", () => sendQuick(el.getAttribute("data-ai-cmd")));
          });
        }

        return { init, open, close, append, sendQuick };
      })();

      const StatsModule = (() => {
        const state = {
          matrixData: {},
          matrixNumMap: {},
          currentAnalyzedNum: "",
          freqData: [],
          hudTimeout: null,
          currentMode: "single",
          terminalRunId: 0,
          inited: false
        };

        function initClock() {
          const timeEl = $("st-clock-time");
          const dateEl = $("st-clock-date");
          const days = ["Chủ Nhật","Thứ Hai","Thứ Ba","Thứ Tư","Thứ Năm","Thứ Sáu","Thứ Bảy"];
          const update = () => {
            const now = new Date();
            timeEl.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour12: false });
            const dd = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
            const mm = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
            const yyyy = now.getFullYear();
            dateEl.textContent = `${days[now.getDay()]}, ${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy}`;
          };
          update();
          setInterval(update, 1000);
        }

        function initMatrixHead() {
          const thead = $("st-matrix-head");
          let html = '<tr><th class="st-corner">Lô</th>';
          for (let d = 1; d <= 90; d++) html += `<th>${d}</th>`;
          html += "</tr>";
          thead.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function getMatrixItems(mode) {
          const items = [];
          if (mode === "single") {
            for (let i = 0; i <= 99; i++) items.push(String(i).padStart(2, "0"));
          } else if (mode === "pair") {
            for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
              for (let j = i + 1; j <= 9; j++) items.push(`${i}${j}-${j}${i}`);
            }
            items.push("00-55", "11-66", "22-77", "33-88", "44-99");
          } else {
            ["00","11","22","33","44","55","66","77","88","99"].forEach(v => items.push(v));
          }
          return items;
        }

        function renderMatrixData(mode) {
          const tbody = $("st-matrix-body");
          const items = getMatrixItems(mode);
          state.matrixData = {};
          state.matrixNumMap = {};
          let html = "";

          items.forEach((num, rowIdx) => {
            const days = [];
            for (let j = 0; j < 90; j++) {
              days.push(Math.random() > 0.85 ? String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) + 1) : "");
            }
            state.matrixData[rowIdx] = days;
            state.matrixNumMap[num] = rowIdx;

            let currentGap = 0;
            while (currentGap < 90 && days[currentGap] === "") currentGap++;

            let consecutiveHits = 0;
            if (currentGap === 0) {
              while (consecutiveHits < 90 && days[consecutiveHits] !== "") consecutiveHits++;
            }

            let badge = "";
            if (currentGap >= 6) {
              badge = `<span class="st-row-badge st-badge-gan">Gan ${currentGap}</span>`;
            } else if (consecutiveHits >= 2) {
              badge = `<span class="st-row-badge st-badge-hot">🔥 ${consecutiveHits} nháy</span>`;
            }

            html += `<tr id="st-row-${rowIdx}">
              <th id="st-th-${rowIdx}" class="st-corner-btn" data-row-idx="${rowIdx}" data-num="${num}">
                ${num}${badge}
              </th>`;

            days.forEach((val, colIdx) => {
              html += `<td id="st-cell-${rowIdx}-${colIdx}" data-nhay="${val}">${val}</td>`;
            });

            html += "</tr>";
          });

          tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function clearAnalysisState() {
          $$("#st-matrix-body tr").forEach(tr => tr.classList.remove("st-row-analyzed"));
          $$("#st-matrix-body td").forEach(td => td.classList.remove("st-highlight-gap", "st-highlight-hit"));
          $("st-hud").className = "st-hud";
          $("st-row-laser").classList.remove("fire");
          if (state.hudTimeout) clearTimeout(state.hudTimeout);
        }

        function switchMatrixMode(mode) {
          state.currentMode = mode;
          clearAnalysisState();
          const table = $("st-matrix-table");
          table.classList.remove("pair-mode", "double-mode");
          if (mode === "pair") table.classList.add("pair-mode");
          if (mode === "double") table.classList.add("double-mode");

          $$("[data-st-mode]").forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.getAttribute("data-st-mode") === mode));

          const tbody = $("st-matrix-body");
          tbody.style.opacity = "0";
          setTimeout(() => {
            renderMatrixData(mode);
            tbody.style.opacity = "1";
            const scroller = $("st-matrix-container");
            scroller.scrollTop = 0;
            scroller.scrollLeft = 0;
          }, 220);
        }

        function dismissHUD() {
          clearAnalysisState();
        }

        function triggerRowAnalysis(num, rowIdx) {
          const days = state.matrixData[rowIdx];
          if (!days) return;

          state.currentAnalyzedNum = num;
          clearAnalysisState();

          const row = $(`st-row-${rowIdx}`);
          const th = $(`st-th-${rowIdx}`);
          const banner = $("st-hud");
          const laser = $("st-row-laser");

          let currentGap = 0;
          while (currentGap < 90 && days[currentGap] === "") currentGap++;

          let matchData = [];
          let rhythmCount = 0;

          if (currentGap > 0) {
            let emptyCount = 0;
            let tempIndices = [];
            for (let j = currentGap + 1; j < 90; j++) {
              if (days[j] === "") {
                emptyCount++;
                tempIndices.push(j);
              } else {
                if (emptyCount === currentGap) {
                  rhythmCount++;
                  tempIndices.forEach(col => matchData.push({ c: col, t: "gap" }));
                  matchData.push({ c: j - emptyCount - 1, t: "hit" });
                }
                emptyCount = 0;
                tempIndices = [];
              }
            }
          }

          if (currentGap === 0) rhythmCount = 99;

          if (th) {
            laser.style.top = (th.offsetTop + 14) + "px";
            void laser.offsetWidth;
            laser.classList.add("fire");
          }

          if (row) row.classList.add("st-row-analyzed");

          const tierClass =
            rhythmCount >= 4 ? "st-tier-diamond" :
            rhythmCount === 3 ? "st-tier-gold" :
            rhythmCount === 2 ? "st-tier-silver" : "st-tier-bronze";

          setTimeout(() => {
            matchData.forEach(m => {
              const cell = $(`st-cell-${rowIdx}-${m.c}`);
              if (cell) cell.classList.add(m.t === "gap" ? "st-highlight-gap" : "st-highlight-hit");
            });

            const evalText =
              tierClass === "st-tier-diamond" ? "💎 KIM CƯƠNG" :
              tierClass === "st-tier-gold" ? "🏆 VÀNG (GOLD)" :
              tierClass === "st-tier-silver" ? "🥈 BẠC (SILVER)" : "🪨 ĐỒNG (GAN)";

            $("st-hud-eval").textContent = evalText;
            if (currentGap === 0) {
              $("st-hud-text").innerHTML = `Lô <span class="hl-num">${num}</span>: ĐANG NỔ RƠI LIÊN TỤC.`;
            } else {
              $("st-hud-text").innerHTML = `Lô <span class="hl-num">${num}</span>: Đang vào form nhịp nghỉ <span class="hl-num">${currentGap}</span> ngày.<br>Dữ liệu AI ghi nhận <span class="hl-count">${rhythmCount}</span> lần nổ chu kỳ này.`;
            }

            banner.className = `st-hud ${tierClass} show`;
          }, 320);

          state.hudTimeout = setTimeout(dismissHUD, 20000);
        }

        function renderTopLo() {
          const c = $("st-top-chart");
          const data = [
            {n:"68",r:1,h:100,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#b91c1c,#ef4444)"},
            {n:"86",r:2,h:85,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#c2410c,#f97316)"},
            {n:"79",r:3,h:75,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#d97706,#fbbf24)"},
            {n:"97",r:4,h:65,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#65a30d,#a3e635)"},
            {n:"12",r:5,h:55,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#0f766e,#14b8a6)"},
            {n:"21",r:6,h:45,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#0369a1,#0ea5e9)"},
            {n:"33",r:7,h:35,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#4338ca,#6366f1)"},
            {n:"55",r:8,h:28,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#7e22ce,#a855f7)"},
            {n:"99",r:9,h:22,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#be185d,#ec4899)"},
            {n:"00",r:10,h:15,c:"linear-gradient(to top,#334155,#64748b)"}
          ];

          c.innerHTML = data.map((i, idx) => `
            <div class="st-bar-wrap" data-num="${i.n}">
              <div class="st-bar-num" style="${i.r===1 ? "color:var(--red);text-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.8);transform:scale(1.25)" : ""}">${i.n}</div>
              <div class="st-bar-col" style="height:${i.h}%;background:${i.c};animation-delay:${idx * .08}s">
                <div class="st-bar-rank">TOP ${i.r}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          `).join("");
        }

        function generateFreqMockData() {
          state.freqData = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            const number = String(i).padStart(2, "0");
            const daysSinceLast = Math.floor(Math.random() * 25);
            const freq30 = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15);
            state.freqData.push({
              number,
              daysSinceLast,
              freq30,
              isGan: daysSinceLast >= 14,
              isRhythm: freq30 >= 8 && daysSinceLast <= 3
            });
          }
        }

        function renderFreqBoard(filter = "ALL") {
          const grid = $("st-freq-grid");
          let html = "";
          state.freqData.forEach(item => {
            if (filter === "GAN" && !item.isGan) return;
            if (filter === "RHYTHM" && !item.isRhythm) return;

            let cls = "st-freq-cell";
            let icon = "";
            if (item.isRhythm) {
              cls += " rhythm";
              icon = `<svg class="st-freq-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#67e8f9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="22" y1="12" x2="18" y2="12"></line><line x1="6" y1="12" x2="2" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" y1="6" x2="12" y2="2"></line><line x1="12" y1="22" x2="12" y2="18"></line></svg>`;
            } else if (item.isGan) {
              cls += " gan";
              icon = `<svg class="st-freq-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fca5a5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"></path><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"></line><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"></line></svg>`;
            }

            html += `<div class="${cls}" data-num="${item.number}" title="Gan: ${item.daysSinceLast} ngày • Về: ${item.freq30} lần">${item.number}${icon}</div>`;
          });
          grid.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function activateFreqFilter(filter) {
          $$("[data-st-filter]").forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.getAttribute("data-st-filter") === filter));
          renderFreqBoard(filter);
        }

        function focusTop() {
          App.smoothCenter($("st-lo-top-board"));
          App.flash($("st-lo-top-board"));
        }

        function focusFreq(filter = "ALL") {
          activateFreqFilter(filter);
          App.smoothCenter($("st-freq-board"));
          App.flash($("st-freq-board"));
        }

        function focusRow(num) {
          switchMatrixMode("single");
          setTimeout(() => {
            const idx = state.matrixNumMap[num];
            if (idx === undefined) {
              App.toast(`Không tìm thấy lô ${num}`, "warn");
              return;
            }
            App.smoothCenter($("st-slider-viewport"));
            App.flash($("st-slider-viewport"));
            setTimeout(() => triggerRowAnalysis(num, idx), 280);
          }, 320);
        }

        function initDragToScroll() {
          const slider = $("st-matrix-container");
          let isDown = false, startX = 0, scrollLeft = 0;

          slider.addEventListener("touchstart", dismissHUD, { passive: true });
          slider.addEventListener("mousedown", dismissHUD);

          slider.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
            isDown = true;
            startX = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
            scrollLeft = slider.scrollLeft;
          });
          slider.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { isDown = false; });
          slider.addEventListener("mouseup", () => { isDown = false; });
          slider.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
            if (!isDown) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            const x = e.pageX - slider.offsetLeft;
            const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
            slider.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
          });
        }

        function renderYearMatrix() {
          const grid = $("cc-year-grid");
          let html = "";
          const year = 2026;
          grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `50px repeat(12, 72px)`;

          html += `<div class="cc-cell cc-corner">${year}</div>`;
          for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
            html += `<div class="cc-cell cc-th-col">T.${String(m).padStart(2,"0")}</div>`;
          }

          for (let d = 1; d <= 31; d++) {
            html += `<div class="cc-cell cc-th-row">N.${String(d).padStart(2,"0")}</div>`;
            for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
              const date = new Date(year, m - 1, d);
              if (date.getMonth() !== m - 1) {
                html += `<div class="cc-cell" style="opacity:.06"></div>`;
              } else {
                const n1 = String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)).padStart(3,"0");
                const n2 = String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)).padStart(2,"0");
                html += `<div class="cc-cell"><div class="cc-num"><span style="opacity:.4;font-size:10px">${n1}</span><span class="tail">${n2}</span></div></div>`;
              }
            }
          }
          grid.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function renderWeekMatrix() {
          const grid = $("cc-week-grid");
          grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(7, 72px)`;
          const days = ["T.2","T.3","T.4","T.5","T.6","T.7","C.N"];
          let html = "";
          days.forEach(d => html += `<div class="cc-cell cc-th-col">${d}</div>`);
          for (let r = 1; r <= 200; r++) {
            for (let c = 0; c < 7; c++) {
              const n1 = String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)).padStart(3,"0");
              const n2 = String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)).padStart(2,"0");
              html += `<div class="cc-cell"><div class="cc-num"><span style="opacity:.4;font-size:10px">${n1}</span><span class="tail">${n2}</span></div></div>`;
            }
          }
          grid.innerHTML = html;
        }

        async function runTerminal(mode) {
          state.terminalRunId += 1;
          const runId = state.terminalRunId;
          const body = $("cc-terminal-body");
          body.innerHTML = "";

          const scripts = {
            "SOI CAU": [
              "> INITIALIZING BRIDGE ENGINE [v5.4]...",
              "> SCANNING HISTORICAL MATRIX (90 DAYS + 200 BOARDS)...",
              "> ANALYZING PATTERN: 3-DAY BRIDGE...",
              "> DETECTING CORRELATION: POS [12] -> POS [45]",
              "> CALIBRATING SUCCESS PROBABILITY... 89.4%",
              "> [SUCCESS]: AI BRIDGE LOCKED.",
              "> SEARCH COMPLETE."
            ],
            "BAC NHO": [
              "> LOADING 10-YEAR DATA HUB...",
              "> MATCHING CURRENT SPECIAL NUMBER...",
              "> DETECTING RECURRENCE RATIO...",
              "> RESULT: IF [68] THEN [86] (FREQ: 15/30)",
              "> STATUS: HIGH CONFIDENCE DETECTED.",
              "> COMMAND: RECOMMEND NEXT CYCLE 86-68."
            ],
            "THONG KE": [
              "> COMPILING STATISTICS...",
              "> CALCULATING GAN LIMITS...",
              "> TOP 3 MOST FREQUENT: 05, 12, 99",
              "> TOP 3 LEAST FREQUENT: 47, 83, 21",
              "> EXPORTING DATA TO GRID VIEW... SUCCESS."
            ],
            "PHONG AI": [
              "> SECURE LINK TO MASTER AI OVERLAY INITIATED...",
              "> ROUTING CONTROL TO GLOBAL COMMAND CENTER...",
              "> ALL MODULES ARE NOW ADDRESSABLE FROM 1 BRAIN...",
              "> HANDOFF COMPLETE."
            ],
            "TRO VE": [
              "> INITIATING RETURN PROTOCOL...",
              "> CLOSING SECONDARY INSTANCES...",
              "> SWITCHING BACK TO STATISTICS WORKSPACE...",
              "> SYSTEM STANDBY."
            ]
          };

          const lines = scripts[mode] || [];
          for (const line of lines) {
            if (runId !== state.terminalRunId) return;
            const div = document.createElement("div");
            div.className = "cc-log";
            div.textContent = line;
            body.appendChild(div);
            body.scrollTop = body.scrollHeight;
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 420));
          }

          if (mode === "PHONG AI") {
            setTimeout(() => GlobalAI.open("command-suite"), 220);
          }
          if (mode === "TRO VE") {
            App.smoothCenter($("st-slider-viewport"));
          }
        }

        function switchCommandView(view) {
          $$("[data-cc-view]").forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.getAttribute("data-cc-view") === view));
          $("cc-year-card").classList.toggle("cc-hidden", view !== "year");
          $("cc-week-card").classList.toggle("cc-hidden", view !== "week");
        }

        function initEvents() {
          $$("[data-st-mode]").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => switchMatrixMode(btn.getAttribute("data-st-mode"))));
          $$("[data-st-filter]").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => activateFreqFilter(btn.getAttribute("data-st-filter"))));

          $("st-matrix-body").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            const th = e.target.closest(".st-corner-btn");
            if (!th) return;
            const rowIdx = Number(th.getAttribute("data-row-idx"));
            const num = th.getAttribute("data-num");
            triggerRowAnalysis(num, rowIdx);
          });

          $("st-freq-grid").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            const cell = e.target.closest(".st-freq-cell");
            if (!cell) return;
            focusRow(cell.getAttribute("data-num"));
          });

          $("st-top-chart").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            const bar = e.target.closest(".st-bar-wrap");
            if (!bar) return;
            focusRow(bar.getAttribute("data-num"));
          });

          $("st-ai-gateway").addEventListener("click", () => GlobalAI.open("stats-lotop", "Phân tích loto tốp"));
          $("st-hud-more").addEventListener("click", () => {
            if (!state.currentAnalyzedNum) return;
            GlobalAI.open("stats-hud", `Soi cầu ${state.currentAnalyzedNum} miền Bắc`);
          });

          $$("[data-cc-mode]").forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
              $$("[data-cc-mode]").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
              btn.classList.add("active");
              runTerminal(btn.getAttribute("data-cc-mode"));
            });
          });

          $$("[data-cc-view]").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => switchCommandView(btn.getAttribute("data-cc-view"))));
          $("cc-open-ai-btn").addEventListener("click", () => GlobalAI.open("command-suite"));

          initDragToScroll();
        }

        function initBus() {
          Bus.on("stats:focus-top", () => focusTop());
          Bus.on("stats:focus-freq", ({ filter }) => focusFreq(filter || "ALL"));
          Bus.on("stats:focus-row", ({ num }) => focusRow(num));
          Bus.on("stats:set-mode", ({ mode }) => {
            switchMatrixMode(mode || "single");
            App.smoothCenter($("st-slider-viewport"));
            App.flash($("st-slider-viewport"));
          });
        }

        function init() {
          if (state.inited) return;
          state.inited = true;
          initClock();
          initMatrixHead();
          switchMatrixMode("single");
          renderTopLo();
          generateFreqMockData();
          renderFreqBoard("ALL");
          renderYearMatrix();
          renderWeekMatrix();
          switchCommandView("year");
          initEvents();
          initBus();
          runTerminal("SOI CAU");
        }

        return {
          init,
          switchMatrixMode,
          focusTop,
          focusFreq,
          focusRow,
          triggerRowAnalysis
        };
      })();

      function createBridgeModule(config) {
        const state = {
          inited: false,
          manualMode: false,
          selectedNodes: [],
          connections: [],
          currentStationIndex: 0
        };

        const ids = {
          root: `${config.key}-root`,
          feed: `${config.key}-feed`,
          history: `${config.key}-history`,
          btnManual: `${config.key}-btn-manual`,
          btnAiRoom: `${config.key}-btn-ai-room`,
          btnAiDirect: `${config.key}-btn-ai-direct`,
          smartText: `${config.key}-smart-text`,
          currentStation: `${config.key}-current-station`,
          prev: `${config.key}-prev`,
          next: `${config.key}-next`
        };

        function root() { return $(ids.root); }
        function feed() { return $(ids.feed); }
        function history() { return $(ids.history); }

        function wrapDigits(numStr) {
          return (numStr || "").split("").map(d => `<span class="br-digit">${d}</span>`).join("");
        }

        function numberBox(num, extraClass = "") {
          return `<div class="br-number-box ${extraClass}" data-num="${num}"><span class="br-number-text">${wrapDigits(num)}</span></div>`;
        }

        function randomNumber(length) {
          let s = "";
          for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) s += Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
          return s;
        }

        function mbSchedule(dayIndex) {
          const map = { 0:"Thái Bình",1:"Hà Nội",2:"Quảng Ninh",3:"Bắc Ninh",4:"Hà Nội",5:"Hải Phòng",6:"Nam Định" };
          return map[dayIndex];
        }

        function generateData() {
          const data = [];
          const today = new Date();

          if (config.type === "mb") {
            for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
              const d = new Date(today);
              d.setDate(today.getDate() - i);
              data.push({
                region: mbSchedule(d.getDay()),
                date: d.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { weekday:"long", year:"numeric", month:"2-digit", day:"2-digit" }),
                prizes: {
                  DB: [randomNumber(5)],
                  G1: [randomNumber(5)],
                  G2: [randomNumber(5), randomNumber(5)],
                  G3: Array(6).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(5)),
                  G4: Array(4).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(4)),
                  G5: Array(6).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(4)),
                  G6: Array(3).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(3)),
                  G7: Array(4).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(2))
                }
              });
            }
          } else {
            const stationName = config.stations[state.currentStationIndex];
            for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
              const d = new Date(today);
              d.setDate(today.getDate() - (i * 7));
              data.push({
                region: stationName,
                date: d.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN", { weekday:"long", year:"numeric", month:"2-digit", day:"2-digit" }),
                prizes: {
                  DB: [randomNumber(6)],
                  G1: [randomNumber(5)],
                  G2: [randomNumber(5)],
                  G3: Array(2).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(5)),
                  G4: Array(7).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(5)),
                  G5: [randomNumber(4)],
                  G6: Array(3).fill(0).map(() => randomNumber(4)),
                  G7: [randomNumber(3)],
                  G8: [randomNumber(2)]
                }
              });
            }
          }

          return data;
        }

        function boardHtml(item, boardIdx) {
          if (config.type === "mb") {
            return `
              <div class="br-board" id="${config.key}-board-${boardIdx}">
                <div class="br-board-head">
                  <div class="br-board-title">XSMB - ĐÀI ${item.region.toUpperCase()}</div>
                  <div class="br-board-date">${item.date}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="br-row br-row-db"><div class="br-prize db">ĐB</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.DB[0])}</div></div>
                <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G1</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.G1[0])}</div></div>
                <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G2</div><div class="br-results br-grid-2">${item.prizes.G2.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
                <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G3</div><div class="br-results br-grid-6">${item.prizes.G3.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
                <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G4</div><div class="br-results br-grid-4">${item.prizes.G4.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
                <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G5</div><div class="br-results br-grid-6">${item.prizes.G5.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
                <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G6</div><div class="br-results br-grid-3">${item.prizes.G6.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
                <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G7</div><div class="br-results br-grid-4">${item.prizes.G7.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
              </div>
            `;
          }

          return `
            <div class="br-board" id="${config.key}-board-${boardIdx}">
              <div class="br-board-head">
                <div class="br-board-title">XS${config.key.toUpperCase()} - ĐÀI ${item.region.toUpperCase()}</div>
                <div class="br-board-date">${item.date}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="br-row br-row-db"><div class="br-prize db">ĐB</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.DB[0])}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G1</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.G1[0])}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G2</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.G2[0])}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G3</div><div class="br-results br-grid-2">${item.prizes.G3.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G4</div><div class="br-results br-grid-7">${item.prizes.G4.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G5</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.G5[0])}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G6</div><div class="br-results br-grid-3">${item.prizes.G6.map(v => numberBox(v)).join("")}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G7</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.G7[0])}</div></div>
              <div class="br-row"><div class="br-prize">G8</div><div class="br-results br-grid-1">${numberBox(item.prizes.G8[0])}</div></div>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        function renderBoards() {
          const data = generateData();
          history().innerHTML = data.map(boardHtml).join("");
          clearAllBridges();
          if (config.type !== "mb") updateStationLabel();
        }

        function updateStationLabel() {
          const label = $(ids.currentStation);
          if (!label) return;
          label.textContent = `ĐÀI ${config.stations[state.currentStationIndex].toUpperCase()}`;
        }

        function setSmartText(text) {
          const el = $(ids.smartText);
          if (el) el.textContent = text;
        }

        function setActiveButton(targetId) {
          [ids.btnManual, ids.btnAiRoom, ids.btnAiDirect].forEach(id => {
            const el = $(id);
            if (el) el.classList.toggle("active", id === targetId);
          });
        }

        function createSvgIfNeeded() {
          let svg = history().querySelector(".br-svg");
          if (svg) return svg;

          svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
          svg.classList.add("br-svg");
          svg.id = `${config.key}-bridge-canvas`;
          svg.innerHTML = `
            <defs>
              <marker id="${config.key}-arrow-green" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#10b981"></polygon>
              </marker>
              <marker id="${config.key}-arrow-red" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#ef4444"></polygon>
              </marker>
              <marker id="${config.key}-arrow-blue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#0ea5e9"></polygon>
              </marker>
            </defs>
          `;
          history().appendChild(svg);
          return svg;
        }

        function clearAllBridges() {
          state.selectedNodes = [];
          state.connections = [];
          $$(".br-digit.marked", root()).forEach(el => el.classList.remove("marked"));
          $$(".br-digit.ai-marked", root()).forEach(el => el.classList.remove("ai-marked"));
          $$(".br-number-box.ai-glow", root()).forEach(el => el.classList.remove("ai-glow"));
          renderBridgeLines();
        }

        function renderBridgeLines() {
          const svg = createSvgIfNeeded();
          const defs = svg.querySelector("defs")?.outerHTML || "";
          svg.innerHTML = defs;

          const containerRect = history().getBoundingClientRect();

          state.connections.forEach((conn, index) => {
            const rectA = conn.nodeA.getBoundingClientRect();
            const rectB = conn.nodeB.getBoundingClientRect();

            const x1 = rectA.left - containerRect.left + rectA.width / 2;
            const y1 = rectA.top - containerRect.top + rectA.height / 2;
            const x2 = rectB.left - containerRect.left + rectB.width / 2;
            const y2 = rectB.top - containerRect.top + rectB.height / 2;

            const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
            path.setAttribute("d", `M ${x1} ${y1} L ${x2} ${y2}`);

            if (conn.isAI) {
              path.setAttribute("class", "br-line-ai");
              path.setAttribute("marker-end", `url(#${config.key}-arrow-blue)`);
              svg.appendChild(path);
              return;
            }

            path.setAttribute("class", "br-line");
            path.setAttribute("marker-end", `url(#${config.key}-arrow-green)`);

            const hitbox = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
            hitbox.setAttribute("d", `M ${x1} ${y1} L ${x2} ${y2}`);
            hitbox.setAttribute("class", "br-line-hit");

            const deleteAction = () => {
              path.classList.add("to-delete");
              path.setAttribute("marker-end", `url(#${config.key}-arrow-red)`);
              App.confirm("Xóa đường cầu này?", () => {
                conn.cleanup?.();
                state.connections.splice(index, 1);
                renderBridgeLines();
              }, "Xóa đường cầu");
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (state.connections[index] === conn) {
                  path.classList.remove("to-delete");
                  path.setAttribute("marker-end", `url(#${config.key}-arrow-green)`);
                }
              }, 400);
            };

            hitbox.addEventListener("click", deleteAction);
            path.addEventListener("click", deleteAction);
            svg.appendChild(path);
            svg.appendChild(hitbox);
          });
        }

        function toggleManualMode() {
          state.manualMode = !state.manualMode;
          root().classList.toggle("mode-manual", state.manualMode);
          setActiveButton(ids.btnManual);

          if (state.manualMode) {
            clearAllBridges();
            App.toast(`Đã bật Tự Soi Cầu ${config.label}. Hãy chạm vào ô số để nối.`, "success");
          } else {
            clearAllBridges();
            App.toast(`Đã reset bàn soi cầu ${config.label}.`, "info");
          }
        }

        function handleBoxClick(e) {
          if (!state.manualMode) return;
          const box = e.target.closest(".br-number-box");
          if (!box || !history().contains(box)) return;
          if (!box.id) box.id = `${config.key}-box-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
          const digits = $$(".br-digit", box).map(d => d.textContent);
          BridgePopup.open(api, box.id, digits);
        }

        function pickDigit(boxId, digitIndex) {
          const box = $(boxId);
          if (!box) return;
          const digit = $$(".br-digit", box)[digitIndex];
          if (!digit) return;

          digit.classList.add("marked");
          state.selectedNodes.push(digit);

          if (state.selectedNodes.length >= 2) {
            const nodeA = state.selectedNodes[state.selectedNodes.length - 2];
            const nodeB = state.selectedNodes[state.selectedNodes.length - 1];
            state.connections.push({
              nodeA,
              nodeB,
              isAI: false,
              cleanup: () => {
                nodeA.classList.remove("marked");
                nodeB.classList.remove("marked");
              }
            });
            renderBridgeLines();
          }
        }

        function findCandidateBoxes(targetNumber) {
          const boxes = $$(".br-number-box", history());
          if (targetNumber) {
            const matched = boxes.filter(box => String(box.dataset.num || "").endsWith(targetNumber));
            if (matched.length >= 2) return matched;
          }
          return boxes.filter((_, idx) => idx % 17 === 0);
        }

        function highlightAiDigits(box, targetNumber) {
          box.classList.add("ai-glow");
          const digits = $$(".br-digit", box);
          if (targetNumber && targetNumber.length <= digits.length) {
            digits.slice(-targetNumber.length).forEach(d => d.classList.add("ai-marked"));
          } else {
            const lucky = digits[Math.floor(Math.random() * digits.length)];
            if (lucky) lucky.classList.add("ai-marked");
          }
        }

        function runAIBridge(targetNumber = null, source = "local-ai") {
          state.manualMode = false;
          root().classList.remove("mode-manual");
          setActiveButton(ids.btnAiDirect);
          clearAllBridges();

          const candidates = findCandidateBoxes(targetNumber);
          const allBoxes = $$(".br-number-box", history());
          if (!allBoxes.length) return;

          const boxA = candidates[0] || allBoxes[4];
          const boxB = candidates[Math.min(candidates.length - 1, Math.max(1, Math.floor(candidates.length / 2)))] || allBoxes[Math.max(8, allBoxes.length - 20)];

          highlightAiDigits(boxA, targetNumber);
          highlightAiDigits(boxB, targetNumber);

          state.connections.push({
            nodeA: boxA,
            nodeB: boxB,
            isAI: true,
            cleanup: () => {
              boxA.classList.remove("ai-glow");
              boxB.classList.remove("ai-glow");
              $$(".br-digit.ai-marked", boxA).forEach(d => d.classList.remove("ai-marked"));
              $$(".br-digit.ai-marked", boxB).forEach(d => d.classList.remove("ai-marked"));
            }
          });

          renderBridgeLines();

          const board = boxB.closest(".br-board");
          if (board) {
            board.classList.add("flash");
            setTimeout(() => board.classList.remove("flash"), 900);
            setTimeout(() => App.smoothCenter(board), 280);
          }

          const stationName = config.type === "mb" ? "chu kỳ lịch sử" : config.stations[state.currentStationIndex];
          setSmartText(`AI SMART MODE: KHÓA CẦU ${targetNumber || "NGẪU NHIÊN"} • ${stationName.toUpperCase()} • SOURCE ${source.toUpperCase()}`);
          App.flash(root());
          App.toast(`AI đã khóa cầu ${targetNumber ? targetNumber + " " : ""}${config.label}.`, "success");
        }

        function changeStation(dir) {
          if (!config.stations) return;
          state.currentStationIndex = (state.currentStationIndex + dir + config.stations.length) % config.stations.length;
          const label = $(ids.currentStation);
          if (label) {
            label.style.opacity = ".55";
            setTimeout(() => {
              updateStationLabel();
              label.style.opacity = "1";
            }, 120);
          }
          feed().style.opacity = ".35";
          setTimeout(() => {
            renderBoards();
            feed().style.opacity = "1";
            feed().scrollTop = 0;
            App.toast(`Đã chuyển sang đài ${config.stations[state.currentStationIndex]}`, "info");
          }, 220);
        }

        function getTodayStationIndex() {
          if (!config.stations || !config.dailyMap) return 0;
          const today = new Date().getDay();
          const station = config.dailyMap[today];
          const idx = config.stations.indexOf(station);
          return idx >= 0 ? idx : 0;
        }

        function initEvents() {
          $(ids.btnManual).addEventListener("click", toggleManualMode);
          $(ids.btnAiRoom).addEventListener("click", () => {
            setActiveButton(ids.btnAiRoom);
            GlobalAI.open(`${config.key}-module`, `Soi cầu ${config.label}`);
          });
          $(ids.btnAiDirect).addEventListener("click", () => runAIBridge(null, "direct-button"));
          feed().addEventListener("click", handleBoxClick);

          if (config.stations) {
            $(ids.prev).addEventListener("click", () => changeStation(-1));
            $(ids.next).addEventListener("click", () => changeStation(1));
          }

          window.addEventListener("resize", () => setTimeout(renderBridgeLines, 60));
        }

        function initBus() {
          Bus.on(`${config.key}:ai-bridge`, ({ targetNumber, source }) => runAIBridge(targetNumber, source || "bus"));
          Bus.on("route:change", ({ screen }) => {
            if (screen === config.key) {
              setTimeout(renderBridgeLines, 80);
              App.flash(root());
            }
          });
        }

        function init() {
          if (state.inited) return;
          state.inited = true;

          if (config.stations) {
            state.currentStationIndex = getTodayStationIndex();
          }

          renderBoards();
          initEvents();
          initBus();

          if (config.type === "mb") {
            setTimeout(() => setSmartText("AI SMART MODE: ĐÃ TẢI XONG 200 BẢNG LỊCH SỬ!"), 900);
          } else if (config.key === "mt") {
            setTimeout(() => setSmartText("AI SMART MODE: ĐÃ TẢI XONG 200 BẢNG LỊCH SỬ MT!"), 900);
          }
        }

        const api = {
          init,
          pickDigit,
          runAIBridge,
          clearAllBridges,
          changeStation
        };

        return api;
      }

      const MBModule = createBridgeModule({
        key: "mb",
        type: "mb",
        label: "Miền Bắc"
      });

      const MNModule = createBridgeModule({
        key: "mn",
        type: "mn",
        label: "Miền Nam",
        stations: [
          "TP. HCM","Đồng Tháp","Cà Mau","Bến Tre","Vũng Tàu","Bạc Liêu",
          "Đồng Nai","Cần Thơ","Sóc Trăng","Tây Ninh","An Giang","Bình Thuận",
          "Vĩnh Long","Bình Dương","Trà Vinh","Long An","Bình Phước","Hậu Giang",
          "Tiền Giang","Kiên Giang","Đà Lạt"
        ],
        dailyMap: { 0:"Tiền Giang",1:"TP. HCM",2:"Bến Tre",3:"Đồng Nai",4:"Tây Ninh",5:"Vĩnh Long",6:"TP. HCM" }
      });

      const MTModule = createBridgeModule({
        key: "mt",
        type: "mt",
        label: "Miền Trung",
        stations: [
          "Thừa T. Huế","Phú Yên","Đắk Lắk","Quảng Nam","Đà Nẵng","Khánh Hòa",
          "Bình Định","Quảng Trị","Quảng Bình","Gia Lai","Ninh Thuận",
          "Quảng Ngãi","Đắk Nông","Kon Tum"
        ],
        dailyMap: { 0:"Khánh Hòa",1:"Thừa T. Huế",2:"Đắk Lắk",3:"Đà Nẵng",4:"Bình Định",5:"Gia Lai",6:"Đà Nẵng" }
      });

      const LiveModule = (() => {
        const SCHEDULE = {
          MB: { 0:"Thái Bình",1:"Hà Nội",2:"Quảng Ninh",3:"Bắc Ninh",4:"Hà Nội",5:"Hải Phòng",6:"Nam Định" },
          MN: { 0:["Tiền Giang","Kiên Giang","Đà Lạt"],1:["TP. HCM","Đồng Tháp","Cà Mau"],2:["Bến Tre","Vũng Tàu","Bạc Liêu"],3:["Đồng Nai","Cần Thơ","Sóc Trăng"],4:["Tây Ninh","An Giang","Bình Thuận"],5:["Vĩnh Long","Bình Dương","Trà Vinh"],6:["TP. HCM","Long An","Bình Phước","Hậu Giang"] },
          MT: { 0:["Khánh Hòa","Kon Tum"],1:["Thừa T. Huế","Phú Yên"],2:["Đắk Lắk","Quảng Nam"],3:["Đà Nẵng","Khánh Hòa"],4:["Bình Định","Quảng Trị","Quảng Bình"],5:["Gia Lai","Ninh Thuận"],6:["Đà Nẵng","Quảng Ngãi","Đắk Nông"] },
          VL: { 0:"Mega 6/45",1:"Max 3D",2:"Power 6/55",3:"Mega 6/45",4:"Power 6/55",5:"Mega 6/45 - Max 3D",6:"Power 6/55" }
        };
        const TIMERS = {
          mn: { target: "16:15:00" },
          mt: { target: "17:15:00" },
          vl: { target: "18:00:00" },
          mb: { target: "18:15:00" }
        };

        const state = {
          inited: false,
          activeStreams: {},
          bubbleTimers: {},
          sessionSeenNumbers: {},
          mockLoGan: {},
          isMockSpinning: false,
          recognition: null,
          isRecording: false,
          silenceTimer: null,
          currentVoiceRegion: null
        };

        const FAKE_USERS = ["[USER-984]","[VIP-LODE]","[THẦY-BA]","[AI-BOT]","[CAO-THỦ]"];
        const FAKE_MSGS = [
          "Hôm nay cầu báo chạm 4 anh em ạ!",
          "Bạch thủ lô 68 nhé",
          "Tuyệt vời quá",
          "Đang chờ kết quả hồi hộp ghê",
          "Anh em thả tim mạnh lên",
          "Hôm qua ai ăn con đề 99 điểm danh",
          "Đài phụ nổ con 12 rồi"
        ];

        function getDots(n) {
          return `<div class="live-dots">${'<span class="live-dot"></span>'.repeat(n)}</div>`;
        }

        function box(n) {
          return `<div class="live-number-box"><span class="live-number-text" data-len="${n}">${getDots(n)}</span></div>`;
        }

        function buildBoardMB(stationName) {
          return `
            <div class="live-board" id="live-board-mb-main">
              <div class="live-board-head" style="color:var(--red)">ĐÀI ${stationName.toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div class="live-row live-row-db" data-prize="ĐB"><div class="live-prize db">ĐB</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(5)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G1"><div class="live-prize">G1</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(5)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G2"><div class="live-prize">G2</div><div class="live-results live-grid-2">${box(5).repeat(2)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G3"><div class="live-prize">G3</div><div class="live-results live-grid-6">${box(5).repeat(6)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G4"><div class="live-prize">G4</div><div class="live-results live-grid-4">${box(4).repeat(4)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G5"><div class="live-prize">G5</div><div class="live-results live-grid-6">${box(4).repeat(6)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G6"><div class="live-prize">G6</div><div class="live-results live-grid-3">${box(3).repeat(3)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G7"><div class="live-prize">G7</div><div class="live-results live-grid-4">${box(2).repeat(4)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-overlay-cd" id="live-overlay-mb">--:--:--</div>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        function buildBoardMNMT(stationName, themeColor) {
          return `
            <div class="live-board" id="live-board-${stationName.replace(/\s/g,'')}">
              <div class="live-board-head" style="color:${themeColor}">ĐÀI ${stationName.toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div class="live-row live-row-db" data-prize="ĐB"><div class="live-prize db">ĐB</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(6)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G1"><div class="live-prize">G1</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(5)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G2"><div class="live-prize">G2</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(5)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G3"><div class="live-prize">G3</div><div class="live-results live-grid-2">${box(5).repeat(2)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G4"><div class="live-prize">G4</div><div class="live-results live-grid-7">${box(5).repeat(7)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G5"><div class="live-prize">G5</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(4)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G6"><div class="live-prize">G6</div><div class="live-results live-grid-3">${box(4).repeat(3)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G7"><div class="live-prize">G7</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(3)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-row" data-prize="G8"><div class="live-prize">G8</div><div class="live-results live-grid-1">${box(2)}</div></div>
              <div class="live-overlay-cd">--:--:--</div>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        function buildBoardVL(type) {
          let html = `<div class="live-board" id="live-board-vl-main"><div class="live-board-head" style="color:var(--yellow)">ĐANG CHỜ QUAY ${type.toUpperCase()}...</div>`;
          if (type.includes("Mega") || type.includes("Power")) {
            const maxNum = type.includes("Mega") ? 45 : 55;
            html += `<div class="live-row live-row-db" data-prize="JACKPOT"><div class="live-prize db" style="font-size:10px">JACKPOT</div><div class="live-results live-grid-vl">${Array(6).fill(0).map(() => `<div class="live-number-box"><span class="live-number-text" data-len="2" data-max="${maxNum}">${getDots(2)}</span></div>`).join("")}</div></div>`;
          }
          if (type.includes("Max 3D")) {
            html += `<div class="live-row" data-prize="G1"><div class="live-prize" style="font-size:10px">GIẢI 1</div><div class="live-results live-grid-2">${box(3).repeat(2)}</div></div>`;
            html += `<div class="live-row" data-prize="G2"><div class="live-prize" style="font-size:10px">GIẢI 2</div><div class="live-results live-grid-4">${box(3).repeat(4)}</div></div>`;
            html += `<div class="live-row" data-prize="G3"><div class="live-prize" style="font-size:10px">GIẢI 3</div><div class="live-results live-grid-6">${box(3).repeat(6)}</div></div>`;
          }
          html += `<div class="live-overlay-cd" id="live-overlay-vl">--:--:--</div></div>`;
          return html;
        }

        function buildLobby() {
          const dow = new Date().getDay();
          $("live-lobby").innerHTML = `
            <div class="live-lobby">
              ${["vl","mn","mt","mb"].map(region => {
                const nameMap = { vl:"VIETLOTT", mn:"MIỀN NAM", mt:"MIỀN TRUNG", mb:"MIỀN BẮC" };
                const stationMap = {
                  vl: SCHEDULE.VL[dow],
                  mn: SCHEDULE.MN[dow].join(" - "),
                  mt: SCHEDULE.MT[dow].join(" - "),
                  mb: SCHEDULE.MB[dow]
                };
                return `
                  <div class="live-card js-ripple" data-live-enter="${region}" data-region="${region}">
                    <div class="live-card-head">
                      <div class="live-region-name">${nameMap[region]}</div>
                      <div class="live-status" id="live-badge-${region}">CHỜ QUAY</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="live-countdown" id="live-countdown-${region}">--:--:--<span>ĐANG TÍNH TOÁN</span></div>
                    <div class="live-stations" id="live-stations-${region}">Đài quay: ${stationMap[region]}</div>
                    <button class="live-enter-btn">${region === "vl" ? "VÀO PHÒNG VIETLOTT" : `VÀO PHÒNG ${nameMap[region]}`} ▶</button>
                  </div>
                `;
              }).join("")}
            </div>
          `;
        }

        function buildRoomShell(region) {
          const titleMap = {
            mb: ["🔴 TRỰC TIẾP MIỀN BẮC", "var(--red)"],
            mn: ["🔴 TRỰC TIẾP MIỀN NAM", "var(--blue-2)"],
            mt: ["🔴 TRỰC TIẾP MIỀN TRUNG", "var(--purple)"],
            vl: ["🔴 TRỰC TIẾP VIETLOTT", "var(--yellow)"]
          };
          const channelMap = {
            mb: "KÊNH GIAO TIẾP TẦN SỐ CAO - MIỀN BẮC",
            mn: "KÊNH GIAO TIẾP TẦN SỐ CAO - MIỀN NAM",
            mt: "KÊNH GIAO TIẾP TẦN SỐ CAO - MIỀN TRUNG",
            vl: "KÊNH GIAO TIẾP TẦN SỐ CAO - VIETLOTT"
          };

          const html = `
            <div class="live-room-head">
              <button class="live-back-btn js-ripple" data-live-back="1">🔙</button>
              <div class="live-room-title" style="color:${titleMap[region][1]}"><span class="live-shine">${titleMap[region][0]}</span></div>
              <button class="live-draw-btn js-ripple" id="live-draw-btn-${region}">QUAY THỬ</button>
            </div>

            <div class="live-assistant">
              <div class="live-avatar">🤖</div>
              <div class="live-bubble" id="live-bubble-${region}">AI đã sẵn sàng...</div>
            </div>

            <div class="live-room-feed" id="live-feed-${region}"></div>

            <div class="live-chat-box">
              <div class="live-chat-head">${channelMap[region]}</div>
              <div class="live-chat-stream" id="live-chat-stream-${region}"></div>
              <button class="live-heart-btn js-ripple" data-live-heart="${region}">❤️<div class="live-heart-float" id="live-heart-float-${region}"></div></button>
              <div class="live-smart-ui">
                <div class="live-voice-bar" id="live-voice-bar-${region}">
                  <button class="live-voice-mic js-ripple" id="live-voice-mic-${region}" data-live-mic="${region}">🎙</button>
                  <div class="live-voice-wave" id="live-voice-wave-${region}">
                    <div class="live-wave-bar"></div><div class="live-wave-bar"></div><div class="live-wave-bar"></div><div class="live-wave-bar"></div>
                  </div>
                  <input class="live-voice-input" id="live-voice-input-${region}" placeholder="Vui lòng bấm Mic để nói..." readonly autocomplete="off" />
                  <button class="live-voice-send js-ripple" data-live-send="${region}">➤</button>
                </div>
                <button class="live-smart-btn js-ripple" data-live-toggle="${region}"></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;

          $(`live-room-${region}`).innerHTML = html;
        }

        function buildRooms() {
          buildRoomShell("mb");
          buildRoomShell("mn");
          buildRoomShell("mt");
          buildRoomShell("vl");

          const dow = new Date().getDay();
          $("live-feed-mb").innerHTML = buildBoardMB(SCHEDULE.MB[dow]);
          $("live-feed-mn").innerHTML = SCHEDULE.MN[dow].map(st => buildBoardMNMT(st, "#0ea5e9")).join("");
          $("live-feed-mt").innerHTML = SCHEDULE.MT[dow].map(st => buildBoardMNMT(st, "#8b5cf6")).join("");
          $("live-feed-vl").innerHTML = buildBoardVL(SCHEDULE.VL[dow]);
        }

        function showSub(id) {
          $$(".live-sub").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("active"));
          $(id).classList.add("active");
        }

        function enterRoom(region) {
          showSub(`live-room-${region}`);
          startFakeChatStream(region);
          triggerBubble(region, `Hệ thống AI đã kích hoạt tại đài ${region.toUpperCase()}! Đang theo dõi...`);
        }

        function exitRoom() {
          showSub("live-lobby");
        }

        function triggerBubble(region, html) {
          const bubble = $(`live-bubble-${region}`);
          if (!bubble) return;
          bubble.innerHTML = html;
          bubble.classList.add("show");
          clearTimeout(state.bubbleTimers[region]);
          state.bubbleTimers[region] = setTimeout(() => bubble.classList.remove("show"), 2000);
        }

        function initMockGan() {
          state.mockLoGan = {};
          for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            const num = String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)).padStart(2, "0");
            const days = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 5;
            state.mockLoGan[num] = days;
          }
        }

        function analyzeRealtime(region, numberStr) {
          if (!numberStr || numberStr.length < 2) return;
          const last2 = numberStr.slice(-2);
          if (!state.sessionSeenNumbers[region]) state.sessionSeenNumbers[region] = {};

          if (!state.sessionSeenNumbers[region][last2]) {
            state.sessionSeenNumbers[region][last2] = 1;
            if (state.mockLoGan[last2]) {
              triggerBubble(region, `Trời ơi! Lô gan <span class="live-highlight">${last2}</span> giam ${state.mockLoGan[last2]} ngày nay mới chịu nổ!`);
            } else if (Math.random() < 0.1) {
              triggerBubble(region, `Quá chuẩn! Con <span class="live-highlight">${last2}</span> này đi đúng nhịp cầu 3 ngày.`);
            }
          } else {
            state.sessionSeenNumbers[region][last2]++;
            const count = state.sessionSeenNumbers[region][last2];
            triggerBubble(region, `Rực rỡ! Lô <span class="live-highlight">${last2}</span> rớt nháy thứ ${count} rồi anh em ơi!`);
          }
        }

        const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
        const randomDigits = (len) => Array(len).fill(0).map(() => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)).join("");

        async function triggerDraw(region) {
          const btn = $(`live-draw-btn-${region}`);
          if (!btn || btn.disabled) {
            App.toast("Phòng quay đang khóa hoặc chưa sẵn sàng.", "warn");
            return;
          }

          if (region === "vl") {
            await triggerDrawVL();
            return;
          }

          btn.disabled = true;
          state.isMockSpinning = true;
          state.sessionSeenNumbers[region] = {};

          $$(".live-overlay-cd").forEach(el => el.style.opacity = "0");
          const original = btn.textContent;
          btn.textContent = "🔴 ĐANG QUAY...";

          const container = $(`live-feed-${region}`);
          const numberTexts = $$(".live-number-text", container);
          numberTexts.forEach(el => {
            const len = Number(el.getAttribute("data-len") || "2");
            el.innerHTML = getDots(len);
          });

          const order = region === "mb"
            ? ["G1","G2","G3","G4","G5","G6","G7","ĐB"]
            : ["G8","G7","G6","G5","G4","G3","G2","G1","ĐB"];

          for (const prize of order) {
            const rows = $$(`.live-row[data-prize="${prize}"]`, container);
            rows.forEach(row => {
              const prizeCell = row.querySelector(".live-prize");
              if (prizeCell) prizeCell.classList.add("active-led");
            });

            const allNumberTexts = [];
            rows.forEach(row => row.querySelectorAll(".live-number-text").forEach(el => allNumberTexts.push(el)));

            allNumberTexts.forEach(el => el.classList.add("spinning"));
            const spinInterval = setInterval(() => {
              allNumberTexts.forEach(el => {
                const len = Number(el.getAttribute("data-len") || "2");
                el.textContent = randomDigits(len);
              });
            }, 50);

            await sleep(500);
            clearInterval(spinInterval);

            allNumberTexts.forEach(el => {
              el.classList.remove("spinning");
              const len = Number(el.getAttribute("data-len") || "2");
              const finalNumber = randomDigits(len);
              el.textContent = finalNumber;
              analyzeRealtime(region, finalNumber);
            });

            rows.forEach(row => {
              const prizeCell = row.querySelector(".live-prize");
              if (prizeCell) prizeCell.classList.remove("active-led");
            });

            await sleep(4000);
          }

          btn.textContent = original;
          btn.disabled = false;
          state.isMockSpinning = false;
          triggerBubble(region, `✅ Đã xổ xong đài ${region.toUpperCase()}! Chúc mừng các anh em trúng lớn.`);
        }

        async function triggerDrawVL() {
          const btn = $("live-draw-btn-vl");
          if (!btn || btn.disabled) {
            App.toast("Phòng quay đang khóa hoặc chưa sẵn sàng.", "warn");
            return;
          }

          btn.disabled = true;
          state.isMockSpinning = true;
          const original = btn.textContent;
          btn.textContent = "🔴 ĐANG QUAY...";
          $$(".live-overlay-cd").forEach(el => el.style.opacity = "0");

          const container = $("live-feed-vl");
          const all = $$(".live-number-text", container);
          all.forEach(el => el.classList.add("spinning"));

          const spinInterval = setInterval(() => {
            all.forEach(el => {
              const max = Number(el.getAttribute("data-max") || 0);
              if (max) {
                const num = Math.floor(Math.random() * max) + 1;
                el.textContent = String(num).padStart(2, "0");
              } else {
                const len = Number(el.getAttribute("data-len") || "3");
                el.textContent = randomDigits(len);
              }
            });
          }, 50);

          await sleep(1500);
          clearInterval(spinInterval);

          all.forEach(el => {
            el.classList.remove("spinning");
            const max = Number(el.getAttribute("data-max") || 0);
            if (!max) {
              const len = Number(el.getAttribute("data-len") || "3");
              el.textContent = randomDigits(len);
            }
          });

          btn.textContent = original;
          btn.disabled = false;
          state.isMockSpinning = false;
          triggerBubble("vl", "✅ Vietlott đã quay xong! Có lụm được Jackpot không?");
        }

        function updateClockAndCountdown() {
          const clock = $("live-global-clock");
          const now = new Date();
          const days = ["CHỦ NHẬT","THỨ 2","THỨ 3","THỨ 4","THỨ 5","THỨ 6","THỨ 7"];
          clock.textContent = `${days[now.getDay()]}, ${now.toLocaleDateString("vi-VN")} | ${now.toLocaleTimeString("vi-VN", { hour12: false })}`;

          Object.keys(TIMERS).forEach(region => {
            const countdownEl = $(`live-countdown-${region}`);
            const badge = $(`live-badge-${region}`);
            const btn = $(`live-draw-btn-${region}`);
            if (!countdownEl || !badge) return;

            countdownEl.className = "live-countdown";
            countdownEl.style.color = "";
            countdownEl.style.borderColor = "";
            countdownEl.style.textShadow = "";
            badge.className = "live-status";
            badge.style.background = "";
            badge.style.color = "";

            const [h, m, s] = TIMERS[region].target.split(":").map(Number);
            const target = new Date();
            target.setHours(h, m, s || 0, 0);

            const diff = target - now;

            if (diff > 0) {
              const hh = String(Math.floor((diff / 3600000) % 24)).padStart(2, "0");
              const mm = String(Math.floor((diff / 60000) % 60)).padStart(2, "0");
              const ss = String(Math.floor((diff / 1000) % 60)).padStart(2, "0");
              countdownEl.innerHTML = `${hh}:${mm}:${ss}<span>THỜI GIAN ĐẾM NGƯỢC</span>`;

              if (diff <= 5 * 60 * 1000) {
                countdownEl.classList.add("danger");
                badge.textContent = "SẮP QUAY";
                badge.classList.add("now");
                if (btn && !state.isMockSpinning) {
                  btn.disabled = true;
                  btn.textContent = "🔒 ĐANG KHÓA BẢNG";
                }
              } else if (diff <= 60 * 60 * 1000) {
                countdownEl.classList.add("warning");
                badge.textContent = "SẮP ĐẾN GIỜ";
                if (btn && !state.isMockSpinning) {
                  btn.disabled = false;
                  btn.textContent = "QUAY THỬ";
                }
              } else {
                badge.textContent = "CHỜ QUAY";
                if (btn && !state.isMockSpinning) {
                  btn.disabled = false;
                  btn.textContent = "QUAY THỬ";
                }
              }
            } else if (diff > -35 * 60 * 1000) {
              countdownEl.classList.add("danger");
              countdownEl.innerHTML = `00:00:00<span>KẾT NỐI VỚI TRƯỜNG QUAY</span>`;
              badge.textContent = "ĐANG QUAY";
              badge.classList.add("now");
              if (btn && !state.isMockSpinning) {
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.textContent = "🔴 ĐANG QUAY THẬT";
                btn.style.color = "#ef4444";
                btn.style.borderColor = "#ef4444";
              }
            } else {
              countdownEl.innerHTML = `ĐÃ KẾT THÚC<span>HẸN GẶP LẠI NGÀY MAI</span>`;
              countdownEl.style.color = "#10b981";
              countdownEl.style.borderColor = "#10b981";
              countdownEl.style.textShadow = "0 0 15px rgba(16,185,129,.4)";
              badge.textContent = "ĐÃ QUAY XONG";
              badge.style.background = "#10b981";
              badge.style.color = "#fff";
              if (btn && !state.isMockSpinning) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = "QUAY THỬ LẠI";
                btn.style.color = "#0ea5e9";
                btn.style.borderColor = "#0284c7";
              }
            }

            if (state.isMockSpinning) return;

            const startCountTime = new Date();
            startCountTime.setHours(8, 0, 0, 0);
            const nextTargetTime = new Date(target);
            if (now > nextTargetTime) {
              nextTargetTime.setDate(nextTargetTime.getDate() + 1);
              startCountTime.setDate(startCountTime.getDate() + 1);
            }

            const diffToNext = nextTargetTime - now;
            const diffFrom8AM = now - startCountTime;
            const roomFeed = $(`live-feed-${region}`);
            if (!roomFeed) return;
            const overlays = $$(".live-overlay-cd", roomFeed);

            if (diffFrom8AM < 0 || diffToNext <= 5 * 60 * 1000) {
              overlays.forEach(el => el.style.opacity = "0");
            } else {
              const hh = String(Math.floor((diffToNext / 3600000) % 24)).padStart(2, "0");
              const mm = String(Math.floor((diffToNext / 60000) % 60)).padStart(2, "0");
              const ss = String(Math.floor((diffToNext / 1000) % 60)).padStart(2, "0");
              overlays.forEach(el => {
                el.style.opacity = "1";
                el.textContent = `${hh}:${mm}:${ss}`;
              });
            }
          });
        }

        function appendMessage(region, user, text, isSelf = false) {
          const stream = $(`live-chat-stream-${region}`);
          if (!stream) return;
          const div = document.createElement("div");
          div.className = `live-chat-msg ${isSelf ? "self" : ""}`;
          div.innerHTML = `<span class="u">${user}</span><span class="t">${text}</span>`;
          stream.appendChild(div);
          stream.scrollTop = stream.scrollHeight;
        }

        function startFakeChatStream(region) {
          clearInterval(state.activeStreams[region]);
          const stream = $(`live-chat-stream-${region}`);
          if (!stream) return;
          stream.innerHTML = "";
          appendMessage(region, "[HỆ THỐNG]", `Chào mừng đến Kênh Tần Số Cao đài ${region.toUpperCase()}`, false);

          state.activeStreams[region] = setInterval(() => {
            if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
              const u = FAKE_USERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * FAKE_USERS.length)];
              const m = FAKE_MSGS[Math.floor(Math.random() * FAKE_MSGS.length)];
              appendMessage(region, u, m, false);
              if (Math.random() > 0.8) dropHeart(region);
            }
          }, 1500);
        }

        function dropHeart(region) {
          const wrap = $(`live-heart-float-${region}`);
          if (!wrap) return;
          const heart = document.createElement("div");
          heart.className = "live-floating-heart";
          heart.textContent = "❤️";
          heart.style.left = `${Math.random() * 20 - 10}px`;
          wrap.appendChild(heart);
          setTimeout(() => heart.remove(), 1500);
        }

        function setupSpeech() {
          const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
          if (!SpeechRecognition) return;

          state.recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
          state.recognition.continuous = true;
          state.recognition.lang = "vi-VN";
          state.recognition.interimResults = true;
          state.recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;

          state.recognition.onresult = (event) => {
            const region = state.currentVoiceRegion;
            if (!region) return;
            const input = $(`live-voice-input-${region}`);
            if (!input) return;

            let finalTranscript = "";
            let interimTranscript = "";
            for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
              if (event.results[i].isFinal) finalTranscript += event.results[i][0].transcript;
              else interimTranscript += event.results[i][0].transcript;
            }
            input.value = finalTranscript || interimTranscript;
            resetSilenceTimer(region);
          };

          state.recognition.onstart = () => {
            const region = state.currentVoiceRegion;
            if (!region) return;
            state.isRecording = true;
            $(`live-voice-mic-${region}`)?.classList.add("recording");
            $(`live-voice-wave-${region}`)?.classList.add("active");
            const input = $(`live-voice-input-${region}`);
            if (input) {
              input.value = "";
              input.placeholder = "Đang nghe... (tự gửi sau 5s im lặng)";
            }
            resetSilenceTimer(region);
          };

          state.recognition.onend = () => {
            const region = state.currentVoiceRegion;
            clearTimeout(state.silenceTimer);
            state.isRecording = false;
            if (region) {
              $(`live-voice-mic-${region}`)?.classList.remove("recording");
              $(`live-voice-wave-${region}`)?.classList.remove("active");
              const input = $(`live-voice-input-${region}`);
              if (input && !input.value) input.placeholder = "Vui lòng bấm Mic để nói...";
            }
          };

          state.recognition.onerror = () => {
            const region = state.currentVoiceRegion;
            clearTimeout(state.silenceTimer);
            state.isRecording = false;
            if (region) {
              $(`live-voice-mic-${region}`)?.classList.remove("recording");
              $(`live-voice-wave-${region}`)?.classList.remove("active");
              const input = $(`live-voice-input-${region}`);
              if (input) input.placeholder = "Lỗi mic, thử lại!";
            }
            App.toast("Mic live không khả dụng.", "warn");
          };
        }

        function resetSilenceTimer(region) {
          clearTimeout(state.silenceTimer);
          state.silenceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (state.isRecording && state.recognition) {
              state.recognition.stop();
              sendVoiceMessage(region);
            }
          }, 5000);
        }

        function toggleVoiceBar(region) {
          const bar = $(`live-voice-bar-${region}`);
          if (!bar) return;
          if (bar.classList.contains("active")) {
            bar.classList.remove("active");
            if (state.isRecording && state.recognition) {
              state.recognition.stop();
              clearTimeout(state.silenceTimer);
            }
          } else {
            bar.classList.add("active");
          }
        }

        function startSmartRecording(region) {
          if (!state.recognition) {
            App.toast("Trình duyệt không hỗ trợ thu âm live.", "warn");
            return;
          }
          state.currentVoiceRegion = region;

          if (state.isRecording) {
            state.recognition.stop();
            clearTimeout(state.silenceTimer);
            return;
          }

          try { state.recognition.start(); } catch (err) {}
        }

        function sendVoiceMessage(region) {
          const input = $(`live-voice-input-${region}`);
          const bar = $(`live-voice-bar-${region}`);
          if (!input || !bar) return;
          const text = input.value.trim();

          if (text) {
            appendMessage(region, "[TÔI]", text, true);
            input.value = "";
          }
          bar.classList.remove("active");
          if (state.isRecording && state.recognition) {
            state.recognition.stop();
            clearTimeout(state.silenceTimer);
          }
        }

        function bindEvents() {
          $("live-lobby").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            const card = e.target.closest("[data-live-enter]");
            if (!card) return;
            enterRoom(card.getAttribute("data-live-enter"));
          });

          ["mb","mn","mt","vl"].forEach(region => {
            $(`live-room-${region}`).addEventListener("click", (e) => {
              if (e.target.closest("[data-live-back]")) exitRoom();
              if (e.target.closest(`[data-live-heart="${region}"]`)) dropHeart(region);
              if (e.target.closest(`[data-live-toggle="${region}"]`)) toggleVoiceBar(region);
              if (e.target.closest(`[data-live-mic="${region}"]`)) startSmartRecording(region);
              if (e.target.closest(`[data-live-send="${region}"]`)) sendVoiceMessage(region);
            });
            $(`live-draw-btn-${region}`).addEventListener("click", () => triggerDraw(region));
          });

          Bus.on("live:enter-room", ({ region }) => {
            enterRoom(region);
            App.flash($(`live-room-${region}`));
          });
          Bus.on("live:draw", ({ region }) => {
            enterRoom(region);
            setTimeout(() => triggerDraw(region), 180);
          });
        }

        function init() {
          if (state.inited) return;
          state.inited = true;
          initMockGan();
          buildLobby();
          buildRooms();
          setupSpeech();
          bindEvents();
          updateClockAndCountdown();
          setInterval(updateClockAndCountdown, 1000);
        }

        return {
          init,
          enterRoom,
          exitRoom,
          triggerDraw
        };
      })();

      ScreenBoot.stats = () => StatsModule.init();
      ScreenBoot.mb = () => MBModule.init();
      ScreenBoot.mn = () => MNModule.init();
      ScreenBoot.mt = () => MTModule.init();
      ScreenBoot.live = () => LiveModule.init();

      function bindBaseEvents() {
        $$(".eco-nav-item").forEach(item => {
          item.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const screen = item.dataset.screen;
            if (screen) Router.go(screen);
          });
        });

        $("yt-open-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
          App.vibrate(40);
          App.openUrl("https://www.youtube.com/@Phamlehoangtuanduc");
        });
      }

      function initApp() {
        bindBaseEvents();
        GlobalAI.init();
        Router.go("stats");
      }

      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initApp);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
