Phương án tối ưu 300 bảng
1) Không render cùng lúc 300 bảng
Mình dùng virtual scroll:
Tổng chiều cao danh sách vẫn đủ 300 kỳ.
Nhưng DOM thật chỉ render vùng đang thấy + overscan vài bảng quanh đó.
Kết quả: số node thấp, không đứng máy trên mobile yếu.
2) SVG cầu tách riêng khỏi DOM bảng
Phần tia cầu SVG nằm trên một overlay riêng:
Không phụ thuộc việc 300 bảng có render cùng lúc hay không.
Khi nối cầu xa 150 ngày, line vẫn tính theo tọa độ tuyệt đối của danh sách ảo.
Nhờ vậy vừa mượt, vừa không phải render toàn bộ 300 bảng.
3) Throttle/Debounce thật sự
scroll dùng throttle kiểu requestAnimationFrame
resize dùng debounce
interval/socket mock được tắt khi ẩn screen / tab
redraw cầu chỉ chạy khi cần
4) Popup “tự làm cầu” + auto-scroll
Chạm ô số → popup tiếng Việt
Chọn digit trong ô → digit sáng lên
Chọn đủ 2 điểm → tự vẽ mũi tên cầu SVG
Nếu điểm thứ 2 nằm sâu phía dưới, hệ thống smooth scroll + scrollIntoView
5) Smart Keyboard riêng
Toàn bộ input chính đều readonly + inputmode="none"
Dùng bàn phím số ảo từ đáy màn hình
Có thêm quick command để gọi AI
6) AI trợ lý có context + adapter layer realtime mock
AI nhớ ngữ cảnh: đang ở Bắc / Trung / Nam, đang ở Lịch sử / Thống kê / Live
Có parser intent cơ bản cho:
soi cầu số
đổi đài
mở live
mở thống kê
phân tích chạm / tổng / kết nối cầu
Có sẵn adapter:
WebSocket giả lập
API Polling giả lập

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>AI 5.4 Pro - Soi Cầu SPA Full Roadmap</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #04101d;
      --bg-soft: #0a1730;
      --panel: rgba(11, 25, 48, 0.92);
      --panel-2: rgba(14, 34, 64, 0.9);
      --line: rgba(123, 173, 255, 0.18);
      --line-strong: rgba(123, 173, 255, 0.32);
      --text: #edf4ff;
      --muted: #8ea4c8;
      --cyan: #6de8ff;
      --cyan-2: #24c8ff;
      --green: #49f3b2;
      --gold: #ffd66b;
      --red: #ff6b90;
      --violet: #ae8cff;
      --shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
      --radius: 18px;
      --label-w: 52px;
      --board-slot-h: 360px;
      --board-card-h: 348px;
      --board-head-h: 46px;
      --row-h: 34px;
      --gap: 8px;
      --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      height: 100%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(43, 116, 255, 0.12), transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(circle at left center, rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.10), transparent 24%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #04101d 0%, #081426 100%);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    body.app-paused .laser-path {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    button, input {
      font: inherit;
    }

    .app-shell {
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 0;
    }

    .topbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 20;
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      background: rgba(4, 12, 25, 0.82);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    }

    .brand-group {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: center;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .brand-logo {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.22), rgba(174, 140, 255, 0.18)),
        rgba(9, 23, 44, 0.92);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.35);
      color: var(--cyan);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.08);
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .brand-copy {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .brand-title {
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .brand-subtitle {
      margin-top: 3px;
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      max-width: min(68vw, 580px);
    }

    .topbar-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .segment {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 6px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(10, 24, 46, 0.78);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .tab-btn,
    .ghost-btn,
    .chip-btn,
    .primary-btn,
    .secondary-btn,
    .mini-action,
    .table-action,
    .quick-ai,
    .key-btn,
    .command-chip,
    .digit-pick,
    .heat-cell,
    .result-cell {
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.18s ease, filter 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
    }

    .tab-btn {
      height: 38px;
      padding: 0 13px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 700;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .tab-btn.active {
      color: var(--text);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(47, 105, 214, 0.22), rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.12));
      border-color: rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.28);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.06), 0 8px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    }

    .ghost-btn {
      height: 40px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(13, 31, 58, 0.92);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.18);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .ghost-btn:hover,
    .primary-btn:hover,
    .secondary-btn:hover,
    .mini-action:hover,
    .table-action:hover,
    .quick-ai:hover,
    .key-btn:hover,
    .command-chip:hover,
    .digit-pick:hover,
    .heat-cell:hover,
    .result-cell:hover {
      filter: brightness(1.06);
    }

    .ghost-btn:active,
    .primary-btn:active,
    .secondary-btn:active,
    .tab-btn:active,
    .mini-action:active,
    .table-action:active,
    .quick-ai:active,
    .key-btn:active,
    .command-chip:active,
    .digit-pick:active,
    .heat-cell:active,
    .result-cell:active {
      transform: translateY(1px);
    }

    .main {
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .screen {
      display: none;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 0;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .screen.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    .controls {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px;
      background: rgba(5, 18, 36, 0.72);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .field {
      min-width: 0;
      background: rgba(10, 24, 46, 0.76);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 10px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain: layout paint style;
    }

    .field-label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .smart-input {
      width: 100%;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      background: rgba(4, 12, 23, 0.88);
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 0 12px;
      outline: none;
      caret-color: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }

    .smart-input::placeholder {
      color: #6d84aa;
    }

    .field-note {
      font-size: 0.83rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .field-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .primary-btn,
    .secondary-btn {
      height: 44px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .primary-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.95), rgba(79, 137, 255, 0.95));
      color: #02101d;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.18);
    }

    .secondary-btn {
      background: rgba(11, 28, 55, 0.95);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.18);
    }

    .status-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .status-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 32px;
      padding: 0 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 38, 70, 0.96);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.18);
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .status-pill.accent {
      color: var(--cyan);
      border-color: rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.34);
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.75);
    }

    .selection-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.76);
      min-height: 52px;
    }

    .selection-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      min-height: 34px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(13, 31, 58, 0.96);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.18);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .selection-pill.strong {
      border-color: rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.34);
      color: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .selection-empty {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .mini-action,
    .table-action {
      min-height: 32px;
      padding: 0 11px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(13, 31, 58, 0.98);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.18);
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .mini-action.danger {
      border-color: rgba(255, 107, 144, 0.28);
      color: #ffd7e2;
    }

    .history-viewport {
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      overscroll-behavior: contain;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-gutter: stable;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.46), rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.16)),
        radial-gradient(circle at top center, rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.06), transparent 22%);
    }

    .history-canvas {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100%;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .virtual-layer {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    #bridgeSvg {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: visible;
    }

    .board-slot {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: var(--board-slot-h);
      padding: 6px 8px;
    }

    .board-card {
      position: relative;
      height: var(--board-card-h);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10, 22, 44, 0.96), rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.96)),
        rgba(8, 18, 35, 0.95);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain: layout paint style;
      contain-intrinsic-size: 348px;
    }

    .board-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: var(--board-head-h);
      padding: 0 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(123, 173, 255, 0.12);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13, 31, 58, 0.92), rgba(13, 31, 58, 0.4));
    }

    .board-title {
      font-size: 0.97rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .board-subtitle {
      margin-top: 2px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }

    .board-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      text-align: right;
    }

    .mini-badge {
      min-height: 28px;
      padding: 0 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(9, 23, 44, 0.92);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.14);
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .mini-badge.live {
      color: #02101d;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.98), rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.98));
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .result-table {
      padding: 8px 10px 10px;
    }

    .result-row {
      display: grid;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--gap);
      min-height: var(--row-h);
      height: var(--row-h);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .row-label {
      min-width: 0;
      height: var(--row-h);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(10, 24, 46, 0.95);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.10);
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .result-cell {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
      height: var(--row-h);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12, 30, 56, 0.96), rgba(7, 19, 36, 0.96));
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.10);
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 2px;
      padding: 0 6px;
      user-select: none;
      touch-action: manipulation;
      font-weight: 900;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      font-size: clamp(12px, 2.9vw, 17px);
      box-shadow: inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
    }

    .result-cell.query-hit {
      border-color: rgba(255, 214, 107, 0.34);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 214, 107, 0.14), 0 8px 16px rgba(255, 214, 107, 0.05);
    }

    .result-cell.ai-match {
      border-color: rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.38);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.14), 0 8px 20px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.08);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18, 44, 74, 0.98), rgba(8, 23, 42, 0.98));
    }

    .result-cell.selected-point {
      border-color: rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.4);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.16), 0 10px 20px rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.08);
    }

    .digits {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 1px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .digit {
      display: inline-flex;
      width: 0.76em;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 7px;
      line-height: 1;
      padding: 1px 0;
    }

    .digit.active-digit {
      color: #03121f;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.98), rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.24);
    }

    .point-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 4px;
      right: 4px;
      min-width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      padding: 0 4px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.66rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #02101d;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.98), rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.22);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .laser-shadow {
      fill: none;
      stroke: rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.18);
      stroke-width: 10;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      filter: blur(9px);
    }

    .laser-path {
      fill: none;
      stroke: url(#bridgeGradient);
      stroke-width: 4;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
      stroke-dasharray: 18 10;
      animation: dash 1.18s linear infinite;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.56));
    }

    .endpoint {
      fill: #ffffff;
      stroke: #6de8ff;
      stroke-width: 3;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.72));
    }

    .bridge-text {
      fill: var(--text);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    @keyframes dash {
      to {
        stroke-dashoffset: -28;
      }
    }

    .scroll-screen {
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding: 12px;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    .toolbar-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain: layout paint style;
    }

    .chip-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .chip-btn {
      min-height: 36px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(12, 29, 55, 0.94);
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      font-weight: 800;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .chip-btn.active {
      color: var(--text);
      border-color: rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.30);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(47, 105, 214, 0.22), rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.12));
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.06);
    }

    .conn-badge {
      min-height: 36px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.16);
      background: rgba(12, 29, 55, 0.94);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .conn-badge.connected {
      color: var(--green);
      border-color: rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.28);
    }

    .conn-badge.disconnected {
      color: #ffafc0;
      border-color: rgba(255, 107, 144, 0.24);
    }

    .full-width-panel {
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(9, 22, 43, 0.92);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      padding: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain: layout paint style;
    }

    .panel-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .panel-title {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .panel-subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.87rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .stats-summary,
    .live-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .summary-card,
    .live-card {
      min-width: 0;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12, 29, 55, 0.95), rgba(8, 18, 34, 0.95));
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain: layout paint style;
    }

    .summary-label,
    .live-label {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .summary-value,
    .live-value {
      font-size: 1.16rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .summary-foot,
    .live-foot {
      margin-top: 6px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .heat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(62px, 1fr));
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .heat-cell {
      min-height: 60px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 8px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18, 34, 64, 0.92), rgba(11, 21, 39, 0.98)),
        rgba(11, 21, 39, 0.98);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.03);
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .heat-cell.active {
      border-color: rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.36);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12), 0 10px 18px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .heat-cell span {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .heat-cell small {
      color: #d5e6ff;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .wide-table-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      overflow: auto;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.10);
    }

    .wide-table {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 760px;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      background: rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.72);
    }

    .wide-table th,
    .wide-table td {
      padding: 12px 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.08);
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: middle;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
    }

    .wide-table th {
      color: #c7dbff;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
      background: rgba(10, 24, 46, 0.92);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .wide-table tbody tr:hover {
      background: rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .bar-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .bar-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr auto auto;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(10, 24, 46, 0.72);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .bar-label {
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .bar-track {
      position: relative;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .bar-fill {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.98), rgba(174, 140, 255, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.18);
    }

    .bar-value {
      min-width: 34px;
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #d8e6ff;
    }

    .trend-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(30, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: end;
      min-height: 160px;
      padding-top: 10px;
    }

    .trend-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: end;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .trend-bar {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 18px;
      border-radius: 10px 10px 4px 4px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.98), rgba(79, 137, 255, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.14);
    }

    .trend-col span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      writing-mode: vertical-rl;
      transform: rotate(180deg);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .sparkline {
      display: flex;
      align-items: end;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 128px;
    }

    .spark-bar {
      flex: 1 1 0;
      min-width: 0;
      border-radius: 10px 10px 4px 4px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.98), rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.12);
    }

    .feed-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .feed-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr 0.8fr 0.8fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: rgba(10, 24, 46, 0.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.08);
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain: layout paint style;
    }

    .feed-primary {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .feed-title {
      font-weight: 900;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .feed-sub {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }

    .feed-kpi {
      text-align: right;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .feed-kpi small {
      display: block;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-top: 3px;
      font-size: 0.76rem;
    }

    .drawer-mask {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.22s ease;
      z-index: 59;
    }

    .drawer-mask.active {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: min(420px, 100vw);
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.24s ease;
      z-index: 60;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.98);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
      box-shadow: -18px 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }

    .drawer.active {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }

    .drawer-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .drawer-title {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .drawer-subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.83rem;
      margin-top: 3px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .drawer-body {
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      padding: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .chat-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      align-content: start;
    }

    .chat-msg {
      max-width: 92%;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-size: 0.93rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      word-break: break-word;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
    }

    .chat-msg.assistant {
      background: rgba(12, 29, 55, 0.96);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--text);
      justify-self: start;
    }

    .chat-msg.user {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.94), rgba(79, 137, 255, 0.94));
      color: #03111c;
      justify-self: end;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .chat-time {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 0.74rem;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
    }

    .ai-quick-wrap {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .quick-ai {
      min-height: 36px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(13, 31, 58, 0.96);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.14);
      font-weight: 800;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .drawer-foot {
      padding: 12px 14px calc(12px + var(--safe-bottom));
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.96);
    }

    .drawer-foot-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .keyboard-sheet {
      position: fixed;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      z-index: 80;
      transform: translateY(110%);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease;
      background: rgba(7, 18, 36, 0.985);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
      box-shadow: 0 -18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      padding: 12px 12px calc(14px + var(--safe-bottom));
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .keyboard-sheet.active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .keyboard-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .keyboard-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .keyboard-subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      margin-top: 3px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .keyboard-preview {
      min-height: 40px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 12px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(10, 24, 46, 0.92);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 800;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .command-chips {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin: 12px 0 10px;
    }

    .command-chip {
      min-height: 34px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(12, 29, 55, 0.96);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 800;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .keyboard-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .key-btn {
      min-height: 56px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14, 34, 64, 0.98), rgba(8, 18, 34, 0.98));
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .key-btn.danger {
      color: #ffd7e2;
      border-color: rgba(255, 107, 144, 0.2);
    }

    .keyboard-actions {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .modal {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 70;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 16px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    }

    .modal.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    .modal-card {
      width: min(460px, 100%);
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(8, 18, 34, 0.985);
      border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
      box-shadow: 0 26px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .modal-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .modal-title {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .modal-subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      margin-top: 4px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .modal-body {
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .digit-choice-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(84px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .digit-pick {
      min-height: 82px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14, 34, 64, 0.98), rgba(8, 18, 34, 0.98));
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .digit-pick strong {
      font-size: 1.32rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .digit-pick span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .modal-note {
      margin-top: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.87rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .close-icon {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(12, 29, 55, 0.96);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.12);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .fab {
      position: fixed;
      right: 14px;
      bottom: calc(18px + var(--safe-bottom));
      z-index: 30;
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: #02101d;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(73, 243, 178, 0.98), rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.98));
      box-shadow: 0 18px 30px rgba(36, 200, 255, 0.26);
    }

    .toast {
      position: fixed;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: calc(92px + var(--safe-bottom));
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(12px);
      z-index: 90;
      min-width: min(86vw, 360px);
      max-width: min(90vw, 420px);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(8, 18, 34, 0.98);
      border: 1px solid rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      color: var(--text);
      text-align: center;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .toast.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    }

    @media (max-width: 1180px) {
      .stats-summary,
      .live-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 920px) {
      .controls {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .feed-item {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .topbar {
        padding: 10px 12px;
      }

      .brand-subtitle {
        max-width: 92vw;
      }

      .controls {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .stats-summary,
      .live-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }

      .drawer {
        width: 100vw;
      }

      .drawer-foot-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .keyboard-actions {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .bar-row {
        grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr auto;
      }

      .bar-row .mini-action {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
      }

      .feed-item {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .fab {
        width: 56px;
        height: 56px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="app-shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="brand-group">
        <div class="brand-logo">AI</div>
        <div class="brand-copy">
          <div class="brand-title">AI 5.4 Pro • Soi Cầu SPA Production</div>
          <div class="brand-subtitle" id="contextText">Miền Bắc • Lịch sử • 300 kỳ quay • nhớ số 68</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="topbar-actions">
        <div class="segment" aria-label="Chọn đài">
          <button type="button" class="tab-btn active" data-region="bac">Bắc</button>
          <button type="button" class="tab-btn" data-region="trung">Trung</button>
          <button type="button" class="tab-btn" data-region="nam">Nam</button>
        </div>

        <div class="segment" aria-label="Chọn màn">
          <button type="button" class="tab-btn active" data-section="history">Lịch sử</button>
          <button type="button" class="tab-btn" data-section="stats">Thống kê</button>
          <button type="button" class="tab-btn" data-section="live">Live</button>
        </div>

        <button type="button" class="ghost-btn" id="openAiBtn">AI trợ lý</button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main class="main">
      <section class="screen active" id="historyScreen">
        <div class="controls">
          <div class="field">
            <label class="field-label" for="searchNumber">Số soi</label>
            <input
              id="searchNumber"
              class="smart-input"
              type="text"
              readonly
              inputmode="none"
              autocomplete="off"
              spellcheck="false"
              data-mode="numeric"
              data-label="Số soi"
              data-maxlength="5"
              placeholder="Chạm để nhập số"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <label class="field-label" for="lookbackDays">Số kỳ quét</label>
            <input
              id="lookbackDays"
              class="smart-input"
              type="text"
              readonly
              inputmode="none"
              autocomplete="off"
              spellcheck="false"
              data-mode="numeric"
              data-label="Số kỳ quét"
              data-maxlength="3"
              placeholder="Ví dụ 150"
            />
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <div class="field-label">Hành động nhanh</div>
            <div class="field-actions">
              <button type="button" class="primary-btn" id="analyzeBtn">AI soi cầu</button>
              <button type="button" class="secondary-btn" id="clearBridgeBtn">Xóa cầu</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="field">
            <div class="field-label">Trạng thái hiệu năng</div>
            <div class="status-row">
              <span class="status-pill accent"><span class="status-dot"></span>Virtual Scroll</span>
              <span class="status-pill">300 kỳ / đài</span>
            </div>
            <div class="field-note" style="margin-top:8px">
              Chạm trực tiếp vào ô số để <strong>tự làm cầu</strong>. Chỉ render vùng đang thấy để tránh lag máy.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="selection-bar" id="selectionBar">
          <span class="selection-empty">Tự làm cầu: chạm một ô số → chọn digit → chọn tiếp điểm thứ 2 để tự vẽ tia cầu SVG.</span>
        </div>

        <div class="history-viewport" id="historyViewport">
          <div class="history-canvas" id="historyCanvas">
            <svg id="bridgeSvg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="bridgeGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
                  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#49f3b2"></stop>
                  <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#6de8ff"></stop>
                  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ae8cff"></stop>
                </linearGradient>
                <marker id="bridgeArrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse">
                  <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#6de8ff"></path>
                </marker>
              </defs>
              <g id="bridgeLayer"></g>
            </svg>

            <div class="virtual-layer" id="virtualLayer"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="screen" id="statsScreen">
        <div class="scroll-screen">
          <div class="toolbar-row" id="statsToolbar">
            <div class="chip-row">
              <button type="button" class="chip-btn active" data-stats-chip="ketnoi">Kết nối cầu</button>
              <button type="button" class="chip-btn" data-stats-chip="cham">Phân tích chạm</button>
              <button type="button" class="chip-btn" data-stats-chip="tong">Tổng</button>
              <button type="button" class="chip-btn" data-stats-chip="duoi">Tần suất đuôi</button>
              <button type="button" class="chip-btn" data-stats-chip="xuhuong">Xu hướng</button>
            </div>

            <div class="status-row">
              <span class="status-pill">Đặc biệt Tuần/Năm • Full-width</span>
              <span class="status-pill accent" id="statsRealtimeBadge">Realtime mock: chờ kích hoạt</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="statsContent"></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="screen" id="liveScreen">
        <div class="scroll-screen">
          <div class="toolbar-row" id="liveToolbar">
            <div class="chip-row">
              <button type="button" class="chip-btn active" data-adapter="socket">WebSocket giả lập</button>
              <button type="button" class="chip-btn" data-adapter="polling">API Polling giả lập</button>
            </div>

            <div class="conn-badge disconnected" id="liveStatusBadge">Adapter tạm dừng</div>
          </div>

          <div id="liveContent"></div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  </div>

  <div class="drawer-mask" id="drawerMask"></div>

  <aside class="drawer" id="aiOverlay" aria-label="AI trợ lý">
    <div class="drawer-head">
      <div>
        <div class="drawer-title">AI trợ lý 5.4</div>
        <div class="drawer-subtitle" id="aiContextText">Ngữ cảnh: Miền Bắc • Lịch sử • nhớ số 68 trong 150 kỳ</div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="close-icon" id="closeAiBtn" aria-label="Đóng">×</button>
    </div>

    <div class="drawer-body">
      <div class="ai-quick-wrap">
        <button type="button" class="quick-ai" data-ai-quick="soi cầu 68 150 ngày">Soi cầu 68 / 150 ngày</button>
        <button type="button" class="quick-ai" data-ai-quick="mở live miền bắc">Mở Live miền Bắc</button>
        <button type="button" class="quick-ai" data-ai-quick="phân tích chạm miền nam">Phân tích chạm miền Nam</button>
        <button type="button" class="quick-ai" data-ai-quick="đặc biệt tuần miền trung">Đặc biệt tuần miền Trung</button>
        <button type="button" class="quick-ai" data-ai-quick="ngữ cảnh hiện tại">Ngữ cảnh hiện tại</button>
      </div>

      <div class="chat-list" id="aiMessages"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="drawer-foot">
      <div class="drawer-foot-row">
        <input
          id="aiInput"
          class="smart-input"
          type="text"
          readonly
          inputmode="none"
          autocomplete="off"
          spellcheck="false"
          data-mode="command"
          data-label="Lệnh AI"
          data-maxlength="80"
          placeholder="Chạm để nhập lệnh AI"
        />
        <button type="button" class="secondary-btn" id="openAiKeyboard">Bàn phím</button>
        <button type="button" class="primary-btn" id="sendAiBtn">Gửi</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <div class="modal" id="digitModal" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <div class="modal-head">
        <div>
          <div class="modal-title" id="digitModalTitle">Chọn digit để làm cầu</div>
          <div class="modal-subtitle" id="digitMetaText">Điểm 1 / 2</div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="close-icon" id="closeDigitModal" aria-label="Đóng">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-body">
        <div class="digit-choice-grid" id="digitChoices"></div>
        <div class="modal-note">
          Sau khi chọn đủ 2 điểm, hệ thống sẽ tự động vẽ mũi tên cầu SVG và cuộn mượt tới điểm nối.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="keyboard-sheet" id="keyboardSheet">
    <div class="keyboard-head">
      <div>
        <div class="keyboard-title" id="keyboardTitle">Bàn phím số thông minh</div>
        <div class="keyboard-subtitle" id="keyboardSubtitle">Nhập dữ liệu không làm bật bàn phím mặc định của điện thoại</div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="close-icon" data-key-action="close" aria-label="Đóng">×</button>
    </div>

    <div class="keyboard-preview" id="keyboardPreview">Trống</div>
    <div class="command-chips" id="keyboardCommandChips"></div>
    <div class="keyboard-grid" id="keyboardGrid"></div>

    <div class="keyboard-actions">
      <button type="button" class="secondary-btn" data-key-action="clear">Xóa</button>
      <button type="button" class="secondary-btn" data-key-action="backspace">←</button>
      <button type="button" class="secondary-btn" data-key-action="done">Xong</button>
      <button type="button" class="primary-btn" id="keyboardSendBtn" data-key-action="send">Gửi AI</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <button type="button" class="fab" id="openAiFab" aria-label="Mở AI">AI</button>
  <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      'use strict';

      const PRIZE_LAYOUT = [
        { key: 'special', label: 'ĐB', digits: 5, count: 1 },
        { key: 'g1', label: 'G1', digits: 5, count: 1 },
        { key: 'g2', label: 'G2', digits: 5, count: 2 },
        { key: 'g3', label: 'G3', digits: 5, count: 6 },
        { key: 'g4', label: 'G4', digits: 4, count: 4 },
        { key: 'g5', label: 'G5', digits: 4, count: 6 },
        { key: 'g6', label: 'G6', digits: 3, count: 3 },
        { key: 'g7', label: 'G7', digits: 2, count: 4 }
      ];

      const REGIONS = {
        bac: { key: 'bac', name: 'Miền Bắc', seed: 11111 },
        trung: { key: 'trung', name: 'Miền Trung', seed: 22222 },
        nam: { key: 'nam', name: 'Miền Nam', seed: 33333 }
      };

      const SECTION_LABELS = {
        history: 'Lịch sử',
        stats: 'Thống kê',
        live: 'Sảnh Live'
      };

      const WEEKDAYS = ['Chủ nhật', 'Thứ 2', 'Thứ 3', 'Thứ 4', 'Thứ 5', 'Thứ 6', 'Thứ 7'];

      const ITEM_HEIGHT = 360;
      const BOARD_HEAD_H = 46;
      const ROW_H = 34;
      const LABEL_W = 52;
      const OVERSCAN = 5;

      const state = {
        activeRegion: 'bac',
        activeSection: 'history',
        historyQuery: '68',
        historyLookback: 150,
        bridgeSelections: [],
        currentBridge: null,
        visibleRange: { start: -1, end: -1 },
        data: {},
        statsCache: {},
        pendingCell: null,
        scrollMemory: { bac: 0, trung: 0, nam: 0 },
        keyboard: {
          open: false,
          target: null,
          mode: 'numeric'
        },
        ai: {
          messages: [],
          context: {
            lastQuery: '68',
            lastLookback: 150
          }
        },
        live: {
          adapterType: 'socket',
          adapterLabel: 'WebSocket giả lập',
          connected: false,
          metrics: {
            viewers: 0,
            sales: 0,
            rate: 0,
            hotTail: '--',
            room: '--',
            latency: '--',
            lastAt: '--'
          },
          spark: [],
          stream: [],
          adapters: {}
        },
        statsRealtime: {
          adapterLabel: 'Chưa kích hoạt',
          hotTail: '--',
          lastAt: '--',
          rate: 0
        },
        toastTimer: 0,
        scrollTimerA: 0,
        scrollTimerB: 0
      };

      const dom = {};

      class MockSocketAdapter {
        constructor(handler) {
          this.handler = handler;
          this.timer = 0;
          this.connected = false;
          this.seq = 0;
          this.source = 'socket';
          this.label = 'WebSocket giả lập';
        }

        connect() {
          if (this.connected) return;
          this.connected = true;
          this.handler({ kind: 'status', source: this.source, connected: true, label: this.label });
          this.tick();
          this.timer = window.setInterval(() => this.tick(), 1700);
        }

        disconnect() {
          if (this.timer) {
            clearInterval(this.timer);
            this.timer = 0;
          }
          if (this.connected) {
            this.connected = false;
            this.handler({ kind: 'status', source: this.source, connected: false, label: this.label });
          }
        }

        tick() {
          const regionKey = state.activeRegion;
          const draws = state.data[regionKey];
          if (!draws || !draws.length) return;

          const draw = draws[this.seq % draws.length];
          const hotTail = getSpecialTail(draw);
          const wave = Math.sin(this.seq / 3);
          const viewers = 860 + Math.round((wave + 1) * 94) + (this.seq % 37);
          const sales = 230 + Math.round((Math.cos(this.seq / 4) + 1) * 52) + (this.seq % 19);
          const rate = 12 + Math.round((Math.sin(this.seq / 2) + 1) * 18);
          const payload = {
            region: REGIONS[regionKey].name,
            room: 'Phòng ' + pad((this.seq % 12) + 1, 2),
            viewers,
            sales,
            rate,
            hotTail,
            latency: 35 + (this.seq % 16),
            lastAt: nowTime(),
            title: 'Luồng realtime',
            subtitle: 'Gói dữ liệu WS mock đang đẩy đều',
            drawDate: draw.date,
            special: draw.special
          };

          this.seq += 1;
          this.handler({ kind: 'data', source: this.source, label: this.label, payload });
        }
      }

      class PollingApiAdapter {
        constructor(handler) {
          this.handler = handler;
          this.timer = 0;
          this.connected = false;
          this.seq = 0;
          this.source = 'polling';
          this.label = 'API Polling giả lập';
        }

        connect() {
          if (this.connected) return;
          this.connected = true;
          this.handler({ kind: 'status', source: this.source, connected: true, label: this.label });
          this.tick();
          this.timer = window.setInterval(() => this.tick(), 4200);
        }

        disconnect() {
          if (this.timer) {
            clearInterval(this.timer);
            this.timer = 0;
          }
          if (this.connected) {
            this.connected = false;
            this.handler({ kind: 'status', source: this.source, connected: false, label: this.label });
          }
        }

        tick() {
          const regionKey = state.activeRegion;
          const draws = state.data[regionKey];
          if (!draws || !draws.length) return;

          const draw = draws[(this.seq * 3) % draws.length];
          const hotTail = getSpecialTail(draw);
          const viewers = 740 + ((this.seq * 17) % 180);
          const sales = 180 + ((this.seq * 11) % 90);
          const rate = 8 + ((this.seq * 5) % 22);
          const payload = {
            region: REGIONS[regionKey].name,
            room: 'Snapshot ' + pad((this.seq % 9) + 1, 2),
            viewers,
            sales,
            rate,
            hotTail,
            latency: 92 + (this.seq % 24),
            lastAt: nowTime(),
            title: 'Snapshot định kỳ',
            subtitle: 'API giả lập vừa refresh thống kê',
            drawDate: draw.date,
            special: draw.special
          };

          this.seq += 1;
          this.handler({ kind: 'data', source: this.source, label: this.label, payload });
        }
      }

      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);

      function init() {
        cacheDom();
        seedData();
        bindEvents();
        initSmartInputs();
        syncControlsFromState();
        pushAI('assistant', 'Mình đã sẵn sàng. Ngữ cảnh mặc định: Miền Bắc • Lịch sử. Bạn có thể nhập: "soi cầu 68 150 ngày", "mở live", "phân tích chạm miền nam".');
        renderAll(true);
      }

      function cacheDom() {
        dom.contextText = document.getElementById('contextText');
        dom.historyScreen = document.getElementById('historyScreen');
        dom.statsScreen = document.getElementById('statsScreen');
        dom.liveScreen = document.getElementById('liveScreen');

        dom.searchNumber = document.getElementById('searchNumber');
        dom.lookbackDays = document.getElementById('lookbackDays');
        dom.analyzeBtn = document.getElementById('analyzeBtn');
        dom.clearBridgeBtn = document.getElementById('clearBridgeBtn');
        dom.selectionBar = document.getElementById('selectionBar');
        dom.historyViewport = document.getElementById('historyViewport');
        dom.historyCanvas = document.getElementById('historyCanvas');
        dom.virtualLayer = document.getElementById('virtualLayer');
        dom.bridgeSvg = document.getElementById('bridgeSvg');
        dom.bridgeLayer = document.getElementById('bridgeLayer');

        dom.statsToolbar = document.getElementById('statsToolbar');
        dom.statsContent = document.getElementById('statsContent');
        dom.statsRealtimeBadge = document.getElementById('statsRealtimeBadge');

        dom.liveToolbar = document.getElementById('liveToolbar');
        dom.liveStatusBadge = document.getElementById('liveStatusBadge');
        dom.liveContent = document.getElementById('liveContent');

        dom.openAiBtn = document.getElementById('openAiBtn');
        dom.openAiFab = document.getElementById('openAiFab');
        dom.aiOverlay = document.getElementById('aiOverlay');
        dom.closeAiBtn = document.getElementById('closeAiBtn');
        dom.drawerMask = document.getElementById('drawerMask');
        dom.aiContextText = document.getElementById('aiContextText');
        dom.aiMessages = document.getElementById('aiMessages');
        dom.aiInput = document.getElementById('aiInput');
        dom.sendAiBtn = document.getElementById('sendAiBtn');
        dom.openAiKeyboard = document.getElementById('openAiKeyboard');

        dom.digitModal = document.getElementById('digitModal');
        dom.closeDigitModal = document.getElementById('closeDigitModal');
        dom.digitModalTitle = document.getElementById('digitModalTitle');
        dom.digitMetaText = document.getElementById('digitMetaText');
        dom.digitChoices = document.getElementById('digitChoices');

        dom.keyboardSheet = document.getElementById('keyboardSheet');
        dom.keyboardTitle = document.getElementById('keyboardTitle');
        dom.keyboardSubtitle = document.getElementById('keyboardSubtitle');
        dom.keyboardPreview = document.getElementById('keyboardPreview');
        dom.keyboardCommandChips = document.getElementById('keyboardCommandChips');
        dom.keyboardGrid = document.getElementById('keyboardGrid');
        dom.keyboardSendBtn = document.getElementById('keyboardSendBtn');

        dom.toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      }

      function seedData() {
        Object.keys(REGIONS).forEach((key) => {
          state.data[key] = generateDrawsForRegion(key);
        });

        state.live.adapters.socket = new MockSocketAdapter(handleAdapterEvent);
        state.live.adapters.polling = new PollingApiAdapter(handleAdapterEvent);
      }

      function bindEvents() {
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-region]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchRegion(btn.dataset.region));
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchSection(btn.dataset.section));
        });

        dom.analyzeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const query = dom.searchNumber.value.trim();
          const lookback = dom.lookbackDays.value.trim();
          performBridgeAnalysis(query, lookback, false);
        });

        dom.clearBridgeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          clearBridge(true);
        });

        dom.selectionBar.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const clearBtn = event.target.closest('[data-selection-clear]');
          if (clearBtn) {
            clearBridge(true);
          }
        });

        dom.historyViewport.addEventListener('scroll', throttleRAF(() => {
          renderVirtualHistory(false);
        }), { passive: true });

        dom.virtualLayer.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const cell = event.target.closest('.result-cell');
          if (!cell) return;

          const drawIndex = Number(cell.dataset.drawIndex);
          const prizeKey = cell.dataset.prizeKey;
          const itemIndex = Number(cell.dataset.itemIndex);
          const value = cell.dataset.value;

          openDigitModal({
            region: state.activeRegion,
            drawIndex,
            prizeKey,
            itemIndex,
            value
          });
        });

        dom.openAiBtn.addEventListener('click', openAI);
        dom.openAiFab.addEventListener('click', openAI);
        dom.closeAiBtn.addEventListener('click', closeAI);
        dom.drawerMask.addEventListener('click', () => {
          closeAI();
          closeKeyboard();
        });

        dom.sendAiBtn.addEventListener('click', sendAI);
        dom.openAiKeyboard.addEventListener('click', () => openKeyboardFor(dom.aiInput));

        dom.aiOverlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const quick = event.target.closest('[data-ai-quick]');
          if (!quick) return;
          dom.aiInput.value = quick.dataset.aiQuick;
          sendAI();
        });

        dom.closeDigitModal.addEventListener('click', closeDigitModal);
        dom.digitModal.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          if (event.target === dom.digitModal) closeDigitModal();
        });

        dom.digitChoices.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const pick = event.target.closest('[data-digit-index]');
          if (!pick || !state.pendingCell) return;

          addManualBridgePoint({
            region: state.pendingCell.region,
            drawIndex: state.pendingCell.drawIndex,
            prizeKey: state.pendingCell.prizeKey,
            itemIndex: state.pendingCell.itemIndex,
            value: state.pendingCell.value,
            digit: pick.dataset.digit,
            digitIndex: Number(pick.dataset.digitIndex)
          });

          closeDigitModal();
        });

        dom.keyboardSheet.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const keyButton = event.target.closest('[data-key]');
          if (keyButton) {
            applyKeyboardToken(keyButton.dataset.key, false);
            return;
          }

          const chip = event.target.closest('[data-key-chip]');
          if (chip) {
            applyKeyboardToken(chip.dataset.keyChip, true);
            return;
          }

          const action = event.target.closest('[data-key-action]');
          if (!action) return;

          const type = action.dataset.keyAction;
          if (type === 'clear') {
            setKeyboardTargetValue('');
            return;
          }
          if (type === 'backspace') {
            backspaceKeyboardValue();
            return;
          }
          if (type === 'done' || type === 'close') {
            closeKeyboard();
            return;
          }
          if (type === 'send') {
            if (state.keyboard.target === dom.aiInput) {
              sendAI();
            } else {
              closeKeyboard();
            }
          }
        });

        dom.statsToolbar.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const chip = event.target.closest('[data-stats-chip]');
          if (!chip) return;
          state.statsChip = chip.dataset.statsChip;
          renderStats();
        });

        dom.statsContent.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const tailBtn = event.target.closest('[data-tail]');
          if (!tailBtn) return;
          const tail = tailBtn.dataset.tail;
          state.historyQuery = tail;
          syncControlsFromState();
          performBridgeAnalysis(tail, state.historyLookback, false);
        });

        dom.liveToolbar.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          const btn = event.target.closest('[data-adapter]');
          if (!btn) return;
          selectAdapter(btn.dataset.adapter);
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', debounce(() => {
          renderAll(true);
        }, 120), { passive: true });

        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
        window.addEventListener('pagehide', cleanupApp);
      }

      function initSmartInputs() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.smart-input').forEach((input) => {
          input.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            openKeyboardFor(input);
          });

          input.addEventListener('focus', (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            input.blur();
          });
        });
      }

      function renderAll(force) {
        renderTabs();
        renderSelectionBar();
        renderHistory(force);
        renderStats();
        renderLive();
        renderAI();
        updateHeaderContext();
        manageAdapters();
      }

      function renderTabs() {
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-region]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.region === state.activeRegion);
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.section === state.activeSection);
        });

        dom.historyScreen.classList.toggle('active', state.activeSection === 'history');
        dom.statsScreen.classList.toggle('active', state.activeSection === 'stats');
        dom.liveScreen.classList.toggle('active', state.activeSection === 'live');

        dom.statsToolbar.querySelectorAll('[data-stats-chip]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.statsChip === (state.statsChip || 'ketnoi'));
        });

        dom.liveToolbar.querySelectorAll('[data-adapter]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.adapter === state.live.adapterType);
        });
      }

      function switchRegion(regionKey) {
        if (!REGIONS[regionKey] || regionKey === state.activeRegion) return;

        if (state.activeSection === 'history') {
          state.scrollMemory[state.activeRegion] = dom.historyViewport.scrollTop;
        }

        state.activeRegion = regionKey;
        clearBridge(false);
        state.visibleRange = { start: -1, end: -1 };

        syncControlsFromState();
        renderTabs();
        renderStats();
        renderLive();
        renderAI();
        updateHeaderContext();

        if (state.activeSection === 'history') {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            dom.historyViewport.scrollTop = state.scrollMemory[state.activeRegion] || 0;
            renderHistory(true);
          });
        }

        manageAdapters();
      }

      function switchSection(sectionKey) {
        if (!SECTION_LABELS[sectionKey]) return;
        if (sectionKey === state.activeSection) {
          renderTabs();
          if (sectionKey === 'history') {
            renderHistory(true);
          }
          manageAdapters();
          updateHeaderContext();
          return;
        }

        if (state.activeSection === 'history') {
          state.scrollMemory[state.activeRegion] = dom.historyViewport.scrollTop;
        }

        closeDigitModal();
        state.activeSection = sectionKey;
        renderTabs();
        updateHeaderContext();
        renderAI();

        if (sectionKey === 'history') {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            dom.historyViewport.scrollTop = state.scrollMemory[state.activeRegion] || 0;
            renderHistory(true);
          });
        }

        if (sectionKey === 'stats') {
          renderStats();
        }

        if (sectionKey === 'live') {
          renderLive();
        }

        manageAdapters();
      }

      function renderHistory(force) {
        const draws = state.data[state.activeRegion] || [];
        const totalHeight = draws.length * ITEM_HEIGHT;

        dom.historyCanvas.style.height = totalHeight + 'px';
        dom.bridgeSvg.style.height = totalHeight + 'px';
        dom.bridgeSvg.setAttribute('height', String(totalHeight));

        if (state.activeSection !== 'history' && !force) return;
        renderVirtualHistory(force);
        drawBridge();
      }

      function renderVirtualHistory(force) {
        const draws = state.data[state.activeRegion] || [];
        const viewportHeight = Math.max(dom.historyViewport.clientHeight || 0, 600);
        const scrollTop = dom.historyViewport.scrollTop;
        const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / ITEM_HEIGHT) - OVERSCAN);
        const end = Math.min(draws.length, Math.ceil((scrollTop + viewportHeight) / ITEM_HEIGHT) + OVERSCAN);

        if (!force && start === state.visibleRange.start && end === state.visibleRange.end) {
          return;
        }

        state.visibleRange = { start, end };

        let html = '';
        for (let i = start; i < end; i += 1) {
          html += renderBoardHTML(draws[i], i);
        }

        dom.virtualLayer.innerHTML = html;
        drawBridge();
      }

      function renderBoardHTML(draw, drawIndex) {
        const relative = drawIndex === 0 ? 'Hôm nay' : '-' + drawIndex + ' ngày';
        const specialTail = getSpecialTail(draw);

        return `
          <div class="board-slot" id="board-${state.activeRegion}-${drawIndex}" data-draw-index="${drawIndex}" style="top:${drawIndex * ITEM_HEIGHT}px">
            <article class="board-card">
              <div class="board-head">
                <div>
                  <div class="board-title">${escapeHtml(REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name)}</div>
                  <div class="board-subtitle">Kỳ ${pad(300 - drawIndex, 3)} • ${escapeHtml(draw.date)}</div>
                </div>

                <div class="board-meta">
                  <span class="mini-badge ${drawIndex === 0 ? 'live' : ''}">${escapeHtml(relative)}</span>
                  <span class="mini-badge">ĐB ${escapeHtml(specialTail)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="result-table">
                ${PRIZE_LAYOUT.map((row) => {
                  const values = toArray(draw[row.key]);
                  return `
                    <div class="result-row" style="grid-template-columns: var(--label-w) repeat(${values.length}, minmax(0, 1fr));">
                      <div class="row-label">${escapeHtml(row.label)}</div>
                      ${values.map((value, itemIndex) => renderCellHTML(drawIndex, row.key, itemIndex, value)).join('')}
                    </div>
                  `;
                }).join('')}
              </div>
            </article>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      function renderCellHTML(drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex, value) {
        const queryHit = state.historyQuery && matchesQuery(value, state.historyQuery);
        const pointIndex = getSelectionIndex(drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex);
        const isSelected = pointIndex !== -1;
        const selectedDigitIndex = isSelected ? state.bridgeSelections[pointIndex].digitIndex : -1;
        const isBridgeCell = isBridgeEndpoint(drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex);

        return `
          <button
            type="button"
            class="result-cell ${queryHit ? 'query-hit' : ''} ${isSelected ? 'selected-point' : ''} ${isBridgeCell ? 'ai-match' : ''}"
            data-draw-index="${drawIndex}"
            data-prize-key="${escapeHtml(prizeKey)}"
            data-item-index="${itemIndex}"
            data-value="${escapeHtml(value)}"
            aria-label="Ô số ${escapeHtml(value)}"
          >
            <span class="digits">
              ${renderDigitsHTML(value, selectedDigitIndex)}
            </span>
            ${isSelected ? `<span class="point-badge">P${pointIndex + 1}</span>` : ''}
          </button>
        `;
      }

      function renderDigitsHTML(value, activeDigitIndex) {
        return String(value).split('').map((digit, idx) => {
          return `<span class="digit ${idx === activeDigitIndex ? 'active-digit' : ''}">${escapeHtml(digit)}</span>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      function renderSelectionBar() {
        if (!state.bridgeSelections.length) {
          dom.selectionBar.innerHTML = `
            <span class="selection-empty">Tự làm cầu: chạm một ô số → chọn digit → chọn tiếp điểm thứ 2 để tự vẽ tia cầu SVG.</span>
          `;
          return;
        }

        const pills = state.bridgeSelections.map((selection, idx) => {
          const rowLabel = getRowLabel(selection.prizeKey);
          const dayLabel = selection.drawIndex === 0 ? 'Hôm nay' : '-' + selection.drawIndex + ' ngày';
          return `
            <span class="selection-pill">
              P${idx + 1}: ${escapeHtml(selection.digit)} • ${escapeHtml(rowLabel)} • ${escapeHtml(dayLabel)} • ${escapeHtml(selection.value)}
            </span>
          `;
        }).join('');

        const bridgeInfo = state.currentBridge
          ? `<span class="selection-pill strong">${escapeHtml(state.currentBridge.label)}</span>`
          : '';

        dom.selectionBar.innerHTML = `
          ${pills}
          ${bridgeInfo}
          <button type="button" class="mini-action danger" data-selection-clear>Xóa 2 điểm</button>
        `;
      }

      function drawBridge() {
        const width = Math.max(dom.historyCanvas.clientWidth || 0, 320);
        const totalHeight = (state.data[state.activeRegion] || []).length * ITEM_HEIGHT;

        dom.bridgeSvg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${totalHeight}`);
        dom.bridgeSvg.setAttribute('width', String(width));
        dom.bridgeSvg.setAttribute('height', String(totalHeight));

        if (!state.currentBridge) {
          dom.bridgeLayer.innerHTML = '';
          return;
        }

        const from = computeAnchor(state.currentBridge.from);
        const to = computeAnchor(state.currentBridge.to);

        if (!from || !to) {
          dom.bridgeLayer.innerHTML = '';
          return;
        }

        const path = buildBridgePath(from, to);
        const midX = clamp(((from.x + to.x) / 2) + 22, 110, width - 110);
        const midY = (from.y + to.y) / 2;

        dom.bridgeLayer.innerHTML = `
          <path class="laser-shadow" d="${path}"></path>
          <path class="laser-path" d="${path}" marker-end="url(#bridgeArrow)"></path>
          <circle class="endpoint" cx="${from.x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${from.y.toFixed(1)}" r="6"></circle>
          <circle class="endpoint" cx="${to.x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${to.y.toFixed(1)}" r="6"></circle>
          <g transform="translate(${midX.toFixed(1)} ${midY.toFixed(1)})">
            <rect x="-96" y="-17" width="192" height="30" rx="12" fill="rgba(4, 16, 29, 0.82)" stroke="rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.28)"></rect>
            <text x="0" y="2" text-anchor="middle" class="bridge-text">${escapeHtml(state.currentBridge.label)}</text>
          </g>
        `;
      }

      function computeAnchor(selection) {
        const region = selection.region || state.activeRegion;
        const draw = state.data[region] && state.data[region][selection.drawIndex];
        if (!draw) return null;

        const values = toArray(draw[selection.prizeKey] || []);
        const count = Math.max(values.length, 1);
        const width = Math.max(dom.historyCanvas.clientWidth || dom.historyViewport.clientWidth || 0, 320);
        const cardLeft = 8;
        const cardWidth = width - 16;
        const rowIndex = PRIZE_LAYOUT.findIndex((row) => row.key === selection.prizeKey);
        if (rowIndex < 0) return null;

        const contentWidth = Math.max(cardWidth - 20 - LABEL_W - 8, 140);
        let x = cardLeft + 10 + LABEL_W + 8 + (contentWidth * (selection.itemIndex + 0.5) / count);

        const cellValue = values[selection.itemIndex] || selection.value || '';
        if (Number.isInteger(selection.digitIndex) && String(cellValue).length > 0) {
          const cellWidth = contentWidth / count;
          const relative = ((selection.digitIndex + 0.5) / String(cellValue).length) - 0.5;
          x += relative * Math.min(30, cellWidth * 0.56);
        }

        const y = (selection.drawIndex * ITEM_HEIGHT) + 6 + BOARD_HEAD_H + (rowIndex * ROW_H) + (ROW_H / 2) + 2;
        return { x, y };
      }

      function buildBridgePath(a, b) {
        const direction = Math.abs(b.y - a.y);
        const pull = Math.max(90, direction * 0.22);
        const c1x = a.x + 26;
        const c2x = b.x - 26;
        const c1y = a.y + pull;
        const c2y = b.y - pull;
        return `M ${a.x.toFixed(1)} ${a.y.toFixed(1)} C ${c1x.toFixed(1)} ${c1y.toFixed(1)}, ${c2x.toFixed(1)} ${c2y.toFixed(1)}, ${b.x.toFixed(1)} ${b.y.toFixed(1)}`;
      }

      function openDigitModal(cellData) {
        state.pendingCell = cellData;
        const step = state.bridgeSelections.length === 0 ? 'Điểm 1' : 'Điểm 2';

        dom.digitModalTitle.textContent = `Chọn digit cho ${step}`;
        dom.digitMetaText.textContent = `${REGIONS[cellData.region].name} • ${describeDraw(cellData.drawIndex)} • ${getRowLabel(cellData.prizeKey)} • ô ${cellData.value}`;

        dom.digitChoices.innerHTML = String(cellData.value).split('').map((digit, index) => `
          <button type="button" class="digit-pick" data-digit="${escapeHtml(digit)}" data-digit-index="${index}">
            <strong>${escapeHtml(digit)}</strong>
            <span>Vị trí ${index + 1}</span>
          </button>
        `).join('');

        dom.digitModal.classList.add('active');
        dom.digitModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      }

      function closeDigitModal() {
        state.pendingCell = null;
        dom.digitModal.classList.remove('active');
        dom.digitModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }

      function addManualBridgePoint(selection) {
        const existingIndex = state.bridgeSelections.findIndex((item) =>
          sameCell(item, selection.drawIndex, selection.prizeKey, selection.itemIndex)
        );

        if (existingIndex !== -1) {
          state.bridgeSelections.splice(existingIndex, 1);
        }

        state.bridgeSelections.push(selection);

        if (state.bridgeSelections.length > 2) {
          state.bridgeSelections = state.bridgeSelections.slice(-2);
        }

        if (state.bridgeSelections.length === 2) {
          const ordered = orderSelections(state.bridgeSelections[0], state.bridgeSelections[1]);
          state.bridgeSelections = [ordered.from, ordered.to];
          state.currentBridge = {
            from: ordered.from,
            to: ordered.to,
            label: `Cầu tay ${ordered.from.digit} → ${ordered.to.digit} • ${ordered.to.drawIndex - ordered.from.drawIndex} ngày`,
            mode: 'manual'
          };

          renderSelectionBar();
          renderVirtualHistory(true);
          drawBridge();
          smoothScrollToBoard(state.currentBridge.to.drawIndex);
          toast('Đã vẽ tia cầu thủ công và tự cuộn theo hướng cầu.');
        } else {
          state.currentBridge = null;
          renderSelectionBar();
          renderVirtualHistory(true);
          drawBridge();
          toast('Đã ghi nhận điểm 1. Hãy chọn tiếp điểm thứ 2.');
        }
      }

      function performBridgeAnalysis(queryRaw, lookbackRaw, fromAI) {
        const query = normalizeNumberQuery(queryRaw);
        const lookback = clamp(parseInt(String(lookbackRaw || state.historyLookback), 10) || 150, 7, 300);

        if (!query) {
          toast('Vui lòng nhập số cần soi.');
          return { ok: false, msg: 'Thiếu số cần soi.' };
        }

        state.historyQuery = query;
        state.historyLookback = lookback;
        state.ai.context.lastQuery = query;
        state.ai.context.lastLookback = lookback;

        syncControlsFromState();

        const found = findBridgeCandidates(state.activeRegion, query, lookback);
        if (!found) {
          clearBridge(false);
          renderVirtualHistory(true);
          updateHeaderContext();
          return {
            ok: false,
            msg: `Không tìm thấy cầu phù hợp cho số ${query} trong ${lookback} kỳ gần nhất của ${REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name}.`
          };
        }

        const ordered = orderSelections(
          { ...found.source, region: state.activeRegion },
          { ...found.target, region: state.activeRegion }
        );

        state.bridgeSelections = [ordered.from, ordered.to];
        state.currentBridge = {
          from: ordered.from,
          to: ordered.to,
          label: `Cầu ${query} • ${ordered.to.drawIndex - ordered.from.drawIndex} ngày`,
          mode: fromAI ? 'ai' : 'search'
        };

        switchSection('history');
        renderSelectionBar();
        renderHistory(true);

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          drawBridge();
          smoothScrollToBoard(ordered.to.drawIndex);
        });

        updateHeaderContext();

        return {
          ok: true,
          msg: `Đã nối cầu ${query} từ ${describeDraw(ordered.from.drawIndex)} tới ${describeDraw(ordered.to.drawIndex)} của ${REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name}.`
        };
      }

      function smoothScrollToBoard(drawIndex) {
        clearTimeout(state.scrollTimerA);
        clearTimeout(state.scrollTimerB);

        const roughTop = Math.max(0, (drawIndex * ITEM_HEIGHT) - (dom.historyViewport.clientHeight * 0.45));
        dom.historyViewport.scrollTo({
          top: roughTop,
          behavior: 'smooth'
        });

        state.scrollTimerA = window.setTimeout(() => {
          renderVirtualHistory(true);
          const board = document.getElementById(`board-${state.activeRegion}-${drawIndex}`);
          if (board) {
            board.scrollIntoView({
              behavior: 'smooth',
              block: 'center'
            });
          }
        }, 420);

        state.scrollTimerB = window.setTimeout(() => {
          drawBridge();
        }, 760);
      }

      function clearBridge(showToast) {
        state.bridgeSelections = [];
        state.currentBridge = null;
        renderSelectionBar();
        renderVirtualHistory(true);
        drawBridge();
        if (showToast) {
          toast('Đã xóa tia cầu hiện tại.');
        }
      }

      function renderStats() {
        const stats = getStatsForRegion(state.activeRegion);
        const topTail = topEntries(stats.freqTail, 1)[0] || ['--', 0];
        const topTouch = topEntries(stats.touchMap, 1)[0] || ['--', 0];
        const topTotal = topEntries(stats.totalMap, 1)[0] || ['--', 0];
        const maxTail = Math.max(...Array.from(stats.freqTail.values()), 1);
        const firstConnector = stats.connectRows[0] || { tail: '--', gap: 0 };

        dom.statsRealtimeBadge.textContent = `Realtime mock: ${state.statsRealtime.hotTail} • ${state.statsRealtime.lastAt} • ${state.statsRealtime.adapterLabel}`;
        dom.statsToolbar.querySelectorAll('[data-stats-chip]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.statsChip === (state.statsChip || 'ketnoi'));
        });

        dom.statsContent.innerHTML = `
          <section class="full-width-panel">
            <div class="panel-head">
              <div>
                <div class="panel-title">Tần suất Đặc biệt 300 kỳ • ${escapeHtml(REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name)}</div>
                <div class="panel-subtitle">Không gian thống kê tuần/năm đã mở rộng full-width. Click trực tiếp vào ô tần suất để soi cầu ngay.</div>
              </div>
              <div class="status-row">
                <span class="status-pill">300 kỳ quay</span>
                <span class="status-pill accent">DOM nhẹ • lazy render</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="stats-summary">
              ${summaryCardHTML('ĐB về nhiều nhất', topTail[0], `${topTail[1]} lần trong 300 kỳ`)}
              ${summaryCardHTML('Chạm nóng', topTouch[0], `${topTouch[1]} lần xuất hiện trong ĐB`)}
              ${summaryCardHTML('Tổng nóng', String(topTotal[0]), `${topTotal[1]} lần xuất hiện`)}
              ${summaryCardHTML('Cầu xa nhất', firstConnector.tail, `${firstConnector.gap} ngày cách nhau`)}
              ${summaryCardHTML('Realtime mock', state.statsRealtime.hotTail, `${state.statsRealtime.lastAt} • ${state.statsRealtime.adapterLabel}`)}
            </div>

            <div style="margin-top:12px">
              <div class="panel-subtitle" style="margin-bottom:10px">Heatmap tần suất Đặc biệt 00-99</div>
              <div class="heat-grid">
