                ${Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index) => {
                  const tail = pad(index, 2);
                  const count = stats.freqTail.get(tail) || 0;
                  const ratio = count / maxTail;
                  const alpha = (0.12 + (ratio * 0.88)).toFixed(2);
                  return `
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="heat-cell ${state.historyQuery === tail ? 'active' : ''}"
                      data-tail="${tail}"
                      style="background:
                        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18, 34, 64, 0.96), rgba(9, 20, 38, 0.98)),
                        rgba(9, 20, 38, 0.98);
                        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(109, 232, 255, 0.04), 0 0 0 1px rgba(109,232,255,0.03);
                        border-color: rgba(109, 232, 255, ${Math.min(0.5, alpha)});
                        filter: saturate(${1 + ratio});"
                    >
                      <span>${tail}</span>
                      <small>${count} lần</small>
                    </button>
                  `;
                }).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="full-width-panel">
            <div class="panel-head">
              <div>
                <div class="panel-title">Đặc biệt Tuần</div>
                <div class="panel-subtitle">Tổng hợp theo thứ trong tuần, gắn sẵn hành động soi cầu trực tiếp.</div>
              </div>
              <span class="status-pill">Full-width như bảng Tần suất lô</span>
            </div>

            <div class="wide-table-wrap">
              <table class="wide-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Thứ</th>
                    <th>ĐB về nhiều nhất</th>
                    <th>Chạm nổi bật</th>
                    <th>Tổng nổi bật</th>
                    <th>Số kỳ</th>
                    <th>Hành động</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  ${stats.weeklyRows.map((row) => `
                    <tr>
                      <td>${escapeHtml(row.day)}</td>
                      <td><strong>${escapeHtml(row.topTail.value)}</strong> • ${row.topTail.count} lần</td>
                      <td>Chạm ${escapeHtml(row.touchTop.value)} • ${row.touchTop.count} lần</td>
                      <td>Tổng ${escapeHtml(String(row.totalTop.value))} • ${row.totalTop.count} lần</td>
                      <td>${row.count}</td>
                      <td><button type="button" class="table-action" data-tail="${escapeHtml(row.topTail.value)}">Soi ngay</button></td>
                    </tr>
                  `).join('')}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="full-width-panel">
            <div class="panel-head">
              <div>
                <div class="panel-title">Đặc biệt Năm</div>
                <div class="panel-subtitle">Gom nhóm theo năm, giữ layout rộng rãi để dễ phân tích dài kỳ.</div>
              </div>
              <span class="status-pill">Tự động cập nhật theo adapter mock</span>
            </div>

            <div class="wide-table-wrap">
              <table class="wide-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Năm</th>
                    <th>ĐB hot</th>
                    <th>Chạm hot</th>
                    <th>Tổng hot</th>
                    <th>Độ phủ</th>
                    <th>Số kỳ</th>
                    <th>Hành động</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  ${stats.yearlyRows.map((row) => `
                    <tr>
                      <td>${row.year}</td>
                      <td><strong>${escapeHtml(row.topTail.value)}</strong> • ${row.topTail.count} lần</td>
                      <td>Chạm ${escapeHtml(row.touchTop.value)} • ${row.touchTop.count}</td>
                      <td>Tổng ${escapeHtml(String(row.totalTop.value))} • ${row.totalTop.count}</td>
                      <td>${row.spread} số</td>
                      <td>${row.count}</td>
                      <td><button type="button" class="table-action" data-tail="${escapeHtml(row.topTail.value)}">Soi ngay</button></td>
                    </tr>
                  `).join('')}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="full-width-panel">
            <div class="panel-head">
              <div>
                <div class="panel-title">Phân tích mở rộng • ${statsChipLabel(state.statsChip || 'ketnoi')}</div>
                <div class="panel-subtitle">Các chip lọc thông minh bằng tiếng Việt cho không gian Đặc biệt.</div>
              </div>

              <div class="chip-row">
                <button type="button" class="chip-btn ${(state.statsChip || 'ketnoi') === 'ketnoi' ? 'active' : ''}" data-stats-chip="ketnoi">Kết nối cầu</button>
                <button type="button" class="chip-btn ${state.statsChip === 'cham' ? 'active' : ''}" data-stats-chip="cham">Phân tích chạm</button>
                <button type="button" class="chip-btn ${state.statsChip === 'tong' ? 'active' : ''}" data-stats-chip="tong">Tổng</button>
                <button type="button" class="chip-btn ${state.statsChip === 'duoi' ? 'active' : ''}" data-stats-chip="duoi">Tần suất đuôi</button>
                <button type="button" class="chip-btn ${state.statsChip === 'xuhuong' ? 'active' : ''}" data-stats-chip="xuhuong">Xu hướng</button>
              </div>
            </div>

            ${renderStatsDetail(stats)}
          </section>
        `;
      }

      function renderStatsDetail(stats) {
        const chip = state.statsChip || 'ketnoi';

        if (chip === 'ketnoi') {
          return `
            <div class="wide-table-wrap">
              <table class="wide-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Số ĐB</th>
                    <th>Kỳ mới hơn</th>
                    <th>Kỳ cũ hơn</th>
                    <th>Khoảng cách</th>
                    <th>Gợi ý</th>
                    <th>Hành động</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  ${stats.connectRows.map((row) => `
                    <tr>
                      <td><strong>${escapeHtml(row.tail)}</strong></td>
                      <td>${describeDraw(row.newer)} • ${escapeHtml(stats.draws[row.newer].date)}</td>
                      <td>${describeDraw(row.older)} • ${escapeHtml(stats.draws[row.older].date)}</td>
                      <td>${row.gap} ngày</td>
                      <td>Phù hợp để kéo tia cầu dài</td>
                      <td><button type="button" class="table-action" data-tail="${escapeHtml(row.tail)}">Soi ngay</button></td>
                    </tr>
                  `).join('')}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        if (chip === 'cham') {
          const entries = topEntries(stats.touchMap, 10);
          const max = Math.max(...entries.map((item) => item[1]), 1);
          return `
            <div class="bar-list">
              ${entries.map(([key, value]) => `
                <div class="bar-row">
                  <div class="bar-label">Chạm ${escapeHtml(String(key))}</div>
                  <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${Math.max(8, (value / max) * 100).toFixed(2)}%"></div></div>
                  <div class="bar-value">${value}</div>
                  <span class="status-pill">ĐB tuần/năm</span>
                </div>
              `).join('')}
            </div>
          `;
        }

        if (chip === 'tong') {
          const entries = topEntries(stats.totalMap, 19);
          const max = Math.max(...entries.map((item) => item[1]), 1);
          return `
            <div class="bar-list">
              ${entries.map(([key, value]) => `
                <div class="bar-row">
                  <div class="bar-label">Tổng ${escapeHtml(String(key))}</div>
                  <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${Math.max(8, (value / max) * 100).toFixed(2)}%"></div></div>
                  <div class="bar-value">${value}</div>
                  <span class="status-pill">Nổi bật</span>
                </div>
              `).join('')}
            </div>
          `;
        }

        if (chip === 'duoi') {
          const entries = topEntries(stats.lastDigitMap, 10);
          const max = Math.max(...entries.map((item) => item[1]), 1);
          return `
            <div class="bar-list">
              ${entries.map(([key, value]) => `
                <div class="bar-row">
                  <div class="bar-label">Đuôi ${escapeHtml(String(key))}</div>
                  <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${Math.max(8, (value / max) * 100).toFixed(2)}%"></div></div>
                  <div class="bar-value">${value}</div>
                  <button type="button" class="mini-action" data-tail="${escapeHtml('0' + key).slice(-2)}">Soi</button>
                </div>
              `).join('')}
            </div>
          `;
        }

        const trend = stats.trend;
        const maxTrend = Math.max(...trend, 1);

        return `
          <div class="panel-subtitle" style="margin-bottom: 8px">30 kỳ gần nhất của giải Đặc biệt.</div>
          <div class="trend-grid">
            ${trend.map((value) => `
              <div class="trend-col">
                <div class="trend-bar" style="height:${Math.max(18, (value / maxTrend) * 100).toFixed(2)}%"></div>
                <span>${pad(value, 2)}</span>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        `;
      }

      function renderLive() {
        dom.liveToolbar.querySelectorAll('[data-adapter]').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.adapter === state.live.adapterType);
        });

        dom.liveStatusBadge.className = `conn-badge ${state.live.connected ? 'connected' : 'disconnected'}`;
        dom.liveStatusBadge.textContent = `${state.live.adapterLabel} • ${state.live.connected ? 'Đang kết nối' : 'Tạm dừng'}`;

        const metrics = state.live.metrics;
        const spark = state.live.spark.length ? state.live.spark.slice(-24) : [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
        const maxSpark = Math.max(...spark, 1);

        dom.liveContent.innerHTML = `
          <section class="full-width-panel">
            <div class="panel-head">
              <div>
                <div class="panel-title">Sảnh Live • ${escapeHtml(REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name)}</div>
                <div class="panel-subtitle">Adapter layer đã dựng sẵn để thay bằng API thật / WebSocket thật sau này.</div>
              </div>
              <div class="status-row">
                <span class="status-pill">${escapeHtml(state.live.adapterLabel)}</span>
                <span class="status-pill accent">${metrics.lastAt === '--' ? 'Chưa có gói' : 'Gói mới nhất ' + escapeHtml(metrics.lastAt)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="live-grid">
              ${liveCardHTML('Người xem', String(metrics.viewers || 0), 'Đang theo dõi phòng live')}
              ${liveCardHTML('Doanh số mock', String(metrics.sales || 0), 'Giá trị giả lập mỗi nhịp')}
              ${liveCardHTML('Tốc độ cập nhật', `${metrics.rate || 0}/phút`, 'Realtime mock')}
              ${liveCardHTML('Hot tail', metrics.hotTail || '--', `Phòng ${escapeHtml(metrics.room || '--')}`)}
              ${liveCardHTML('Độ trễ', `${metrics.latency || '--'} ms`, `Cập nhật lúc ${escapeHtml(metrics.lastAt || '--')}`)}
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="full-width-panel">
            <div class="panel-head">
              <div>
                <div class="panel-title">Biểu đồ nhịp cập nhật realtime</div>
                <div class="panel-subtitle">Mini sparkline chạy bằng HTML/CSS, không dùng thư viện ngoài.</div>
              </div>
              <span class="status-pill">24 nhịp gần nhất</span>
            </div>

            <div class="sparkline">
              ${spark.map((value) => `
                <div class="spark-bar" style="height:${Math.max(14, (value / maxSpark) * 100).toFixed(2)}%"></div>
              `).join('')}
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="full-width-panel">
            <div class="panel-head">
              <div>
                <div class="panel-title">Feed cập nhật gần nhất</div>
                <div class="panel-subtitle">Mock stream đổ vào để kiểm thử UI, cleanup interval khi ẩn screen hoặc tab.</div>
              </div>
              <span class="status-pill">${state.live.stream.length} bản tin</span>
            </div>

            <div class="feed-list">
              ${state.live.stream.map((item) => `
                <div class="feed-item">
                  <div class="feed-primary">
                    <div class="feed-title">${escapeHtml(item.title)} • ${escapeHtml(item.region)}</div>
                    <div class="feed-sub">${escapeHtml(item.subtitle)} • ĐB ${escapeHtml(item.special)} • ${escapeHtml(item.drawDate)}</div>
                  </div>

                  <div class="feed-kpi">
                    ${item.viewers}
                    <small>viewers</small>
                  </div>

                  <div class="feed-kpi">
                    ${item.sales}
                    <small>sales</small>
                  </div>

                  <div class="feed-kpi">
                    ${escapeHtml(item.hotTail)}
                    <small>${escapeHtml(item.lastAt)} • ${escapeHtml(item.room)}</small>
                  </div>
                </div>
              `).join('') || `
                <div class="feed-item">
                  <div class="feed-primary">
                    <div class="feed-title">Chưa có dữ liệu live</div>
                    <div class="feed-sub">Chuyển sang tab Live hoặc Thống kê để adapter mock bắt đầu chạy.</div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="feed-kpi">--<small>viewers</small></div>
                  <div class="feed-kpi">--<small>sales</small></div>
                  <div class="feed-kpi">--<small>tail</small></div>
                </div>
              `}
            </div>
          </section>
        `;
      }

      function summaryCardHTML(label, value, foot) {
        return `
          <div class="summary-card">
            <div class="summary-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</div>
            <div class="summary-value">${escapeHtml(String(value))}</div>
            <div class="summary-foot">${escapeHtml(foot)}</div>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      function liveCardHTML(label, value, foot) {
        return `
          <div class="live-card">
            <div class="live-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</div>
            <div class="live-value">${escapeHtml(String(value))}</div>
            <div class="live-foot">${escapeHtml(foot)}</div>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      function renderAI() {
        dom.aiContextText.textContent =
          `Ngữ cảnh: ${REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name} • ${SECTION_LABELS[state.activeSection]} • nhớ số ${state.ai.context.lastQuery || '--'} trong ${state.ai.context.lastLookback || 150} kỳ`;

        dom.aiMessages.innerHTML = state.ai.messages.map((msg) => `
          <div class="chat-msg ${escapeHtml(msg.role)}">
            ${escapeHtml(msg.text)}
            <span class="chat-time">${escapeHtml(msg.time)}</span>
          </div>
        `).join('');

        dom.aiMessages.scrollTop = dom.aiMessages.scrollHeight;
      }

      function openAI() {
        dom.aiOverlay.classList.add('active');
        dom.drawerMask.classList.add('active');
        renderAI();
      }

      function closeAI() {
        dom.aiOverlay.classList.remove('active');
        dom.drawerMask.classList.remove('active');
        if (state.keyboard.target === dom.aiInput) {
          closeKeyboard();
        }
      }

      function sendAI() {
        const raw = (dom.aiInput.value || '').trim();
        if (!raw) {
          toast('Vui lòng nhập lệnh AI.');
          return;
        }

        pushAI('user', raw);
        dom.aiInput.value = '';
        closeKeyboard();
        handleAICommand(raw);
      }

      function handleAICommand(raw) {
        const text = normalizeText(raw);
        const replies = [];
        let didSomething = false;

        if (/\bmien bac\b|\bmb\b|\bbac\b/.test(text)) {
          switchRegion('bac');
          replies.push('Đã chuyển ngữ cảnh sang Miền Bắc.');
          didSomething = true;
        } else if (/\bmien trung\b|\bmt\b|\btrung\b/.test(text)) {
          switchRegion('trung');
          replies.push('Đã chuyển ngữ cảnh sang Miền Trung.');
          didSomething = true;
        } else if (/\bmien nam\b|\bmn\b|\bnam\b/.test(text)) {
          switchRegion('nam');
          replies.push('Đã chuyển ngữ cảnh sang Miền Nam.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\bsanh live\b|\blive\b/.test(text)) {
          switchSection('live');
          replies.push('Đã mở Sảnh Live.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\bthong ke\b|\bdac biet tuan\b|\bdac biet nam\b/.test(text)) {
          switchSection('stats');
          replies.push('Đã mở khu Thống kê full-width.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\blich su\b|\bbang ket qua\b/.test(text)) {
          switchSection('history');
          replies.push('Đã mở màn Lịch sử.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\bket noi cau\b/.test(text)) {
          state.statsChip = 'ketnoi';
          renderStats();
          replies.push('Đã bật bộ lọc Kết nối cầu.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\bphan tich cham\b/.test(text)) {
          state.statsChip = 'cham';
          switchSection('stats');
          renderStats();
          replies.push('Đã bật Phân tích chạm.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\btong\b/.test(text)) {
          state.statsChip = 'tong';
          switchSection('stats');
          renderStats();
          replies.push('Đã bật bộ lọc Tổng.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\btan suat duoi\b|\bduoi\b/.test(text)) {
          state.statsChip = 'duoi';
          switchSection('stats');
          renderStats();
          replies.push('Đã bật bộ lọc Tần suất đuôi.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\bxu huong\b/.test(text)) {
          state.statsChip = 'xuhuong';
          switchSection('stats');
          renderStats();
          replies.push('Đã bật bộ lọc Xu hướng.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\bxoa cau\b|\bdat lai\b/.test(text)) {
          clearBridge(false);
          replies.push('Đã xóa tia cầu hiện tại và reset 2 điểm thủ công.');
          didSomething = true;
        }

        let query = '';
        let days = 0;

        const bridgeMatch = text.match(/(?:soi cau|tim cau|ket noi|noi)\s*(\d{1,5})/);
        if (bridgeMatch) {
          query = bridgeMatch[1];
        }

        const numberTokens = text.match(/\d{1,3}/g) || [];
        if (!query && numberTokens.length && (/soi|cau|tim|ket noi|noi/.test(text) || /^\d{1,3}(?:\s+\d{1,3})?$/.test(text))) {
          query = numberTokens[0];
        }

        const dayMatch = text.match(/(\d{1,3})\s*ngay/);
        if (dayMatch) {
          days = parseInt(dayMatch[1], 10);
        } else if (numberTokens.length > 1) {
          days = parseInt(numberTokens[1], 10);
        }

        if (query) {
          const result = performBridgeAnalysis(query, days || state.ai.context.lastLookback || 150, true);
          replies.push(result.msg);
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (/\bngu canh\b|\bdang o dau\b|\bnho gi\b/.test(text)) {
          replies.push(`Ngữ cảnh hiện tại: ${REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name}, màn ${SECTION_LABELS[state.activeSection]}, nhớ số ${state.ai.context.lastQuery || '--'} trong ${state.ai.context.lastLookback || 150} kỳ.`);
          didSomething = true;
        }

        if (!didSomething) {
          replies.push(`Mình đang nhớ ${REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name} • ${SECTION_LABELS[state.activeSection]}. Bạn có thể nhập: "soi cầu 68 150 ngày", "mở live", "phân tích chạm", "miền trung".`);
        }

        pushAI('assistant', replies.join(' '));
      }

      function pushAI(role, text) {
        state.ai.messages.push({
          role,
          text,
          time: nowTime()
        });

        if (state.ai.messages.length > 48) {
          state.ai.messages = state.ai.messages.slice(-48);
        }

        renderAI();
      }

      function openKeyboardFor(input) {
        if (!input) return;

        state.keyboard.target = input;
        state.keyboard.mode = input.dataset.mode || 'numeric';
        state.keyboard.open = true;

        dom.keyboardTitle.textContent = input.dataset.label || 'Bàn phím thông minh';
        dom.keyboardSubtitle.textContent =
          state.keyboard.mode === 'command'
            ? 'Quick command cho AI + numpad phía dưới'
            : 'Numpad ảo dành cho nhập số, tránh bật bàn phím mặc định của điện thoại';

        renderKeyboard();
        dom.keyboardSheet.classList.add('active');
      }

      function renderKeyboard() {
        const target = state.keyboard.target;
        const mode = state.keyboard.mode;
        const value = target ? target.value : '';

        dom.keyboardPreview.textContent = value || 'Trống';

        const commandChips = mode === 'command'
          ? ['soi cầu', 'miền bắc', 'miền trung', 'miền nam', '30 ngày', '60 ngày', '150 ngày', 'mở live', 'đặc biệt tuần', 'phân tích chạm', 'ngữ cảnh hiện tại']
          : ['00', '01', '68', '79', '30', '60', '90', '150', '300'];

        dom.keyboardCommandChips.innerHTML = commandChips.map((item) => `
          <button type="button" class="command-chip" data-key-chip="${escapeHtml(item)}">${escapeHtml(item)}</button>
        `).join('');

        const keys = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '00', '0', '.'];
        dom.keyboardGrid.innerHTML = keys.map((key) => `
          <button type="button" class="key-btn ${key === '.' ? 'danger' : ''}" data-key="${escapeHtml(key)}">${escapeHtml(key)}</button>
        `).join('');

        dom.keyboardSendBtn.style.display = target === dom.aiInput ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
      }

      function applyKeyboardToken(token, fromChip) {
        const target = state.keyboard.target;
        if (!target) return;

        let current = target.value || '';
        const maxLength = Number(target.dataset.maxlength || (state.keyboard.mode === 'command' ? 80 : 5));

        if (state.keyboard.mode === 'numeric') {
          const numericToken = token.replace(/\D/g, '');
          target.value = (current + numericToken).slice(0, maxLength);
        } else {
          const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(token);
          if (isNumeric && !fromChip) {
            target.value = (current + token).slice(0, maxLength);
          } else {
            const prefix = current && !current.endsWith(' ') ? current + ' ' : current;
            target.value = (prefix + token + ' ').replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').slice(0, maxLength);
          }
        }

        dom.keyboardPreview.textContent = target.value || 'Trống';
        syncStateFromInputs();
      }

      function setKeyboardTargetValue(value) {
        if (!state.keyboard.target) return;
        state.keyboard.target.value = value;
        dom.keyboardPreview.textContent = value || 'Trống';
        syncStateFromInputs();
      }

      function backspaceKeyboardValue() {
        if (!state.keyboard.target) return;
        const current = state.keyboard.target.value || '';
        state.keyboard.target.value = current.slice(0, -1);
        dom.keyboardPreview.textContent = state.keyboard.target.value || 'Trống';
        syncStateFromInputs();
      }

      function closeKeyboard() {
        state.keyboard.open = false;
        state.keyboard.target = null;
        dom.keyboardSheet.classList.remove('active');
        syncStateFromInputs();
      }

      function syncStateFromInputs() {
        const query = (dom.searchNumber.value || '').trim();
        const lookback = parseInt(dom.lookbackDays.value || '', 10);

        if (query) state.historyQuery = query;
        if (!Number.isNaN(lookback)) state.historyLookback = clamp(lookback, 7, 300);

        updateHeaderContext();
      }

      function syncControlsFromState() {
        dom.searchNumber.value = state.historyQuery;
        dom.lookbackDays.value = String(state.historyLookback);
      }

      function getStatsForRegion(regionKey) {
        if (state.statsCache[regionKey]) return state.statsCache[regionKey];

        const draws = state.data[regionKey] || [];
        const tails = draws.map(getSpecialTail);
        const freqTail = buildFreq(tails);
        const touchMap = buildFreq(tails.flatMap((tail) => tail.split('')));
        const totalMap = buildFreq(tails.map((tail) => sumDigits(tail)));
        const lastDigitMap = buildFreq(tails.map((tail) => tail[1]));

        const weeklyRows = buildWeeklyRows(draws);
        const yearlyRows = buildYearlyRows(draws);
        const connectRows = buildConnectorRows(draws);
        const trend = draws.slice(0, 30).map((draw) => Number(getSpecialTail(draw)));

        const stats = {
          draws,
          freqTail,
          touchMap,
          totalMap,
          lastDigitMap,
          weeklyRows,
          yearlyRows,
          connectRows,
          trend
        };

        state.statsCache[regionKey] = stats;
        return stats;
      }

      function buildWeeklyRows(draws) {
        const groups = new Map();
        WEEKDAYS.forEach((day) => groups.set(day, []));

        draws.forEach((draw) => {
          const day = WEEKDAYS[new Date(draw.isoDate).getDay()];
          groups.get(day).push(draw);
        });

        return Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([day, items]) => {
          const tails = items.map(getSpecialTail);
          const touch = tails.flatMap((tail) => tail.split(''));
          const totals = tails.map((tail) => sumDigits(tail));

          return {
            day,
            count: items.length,
            topTail: topEntry(buildFreq(tails)),
            touchTop: topEntry(buildFreq(touch)),
            totalTop: topEntry(buildFreq(totals))
          };
        });
      }

      function buildYearlyRows(draws) {
        const byYear = new Map();

        draws.forEach((draw) => {
          const year = new Date(draw.isoDate).getFullYear();
          if (!byYear.has(year)) byYear.set(year, []);
          byYear.get(year).push(draw);
        });

        return Array.from(byYear.entries())
          .sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0])
          .map(([year, items]) => {
            const tails = items.map(getSpecialTail);
            const touch = tails.flatMap((tail) => tail.split(''));
            const totals = tails.map((tail) => sumDigits(tail));

            return {
              year,
              count: items.length,
              spread: new Set(tails).size,
              topTail: topEntry(buildFreq(tails)),
              touchTop: topEntry(buildFreq(touch)),
              totalTop: topEntry(buildFreq(totals))
            };
          });
      }

      function buildConnectorRows(draws) {
        const occ = new Map();

        draws.forEach((draw, index) => {
          const tail = getSpecialTail(draw);
          if (!occ.has(tail)) occ.set(tail, []);
          occ.get(tail).push(index);
        });

        const rows = [];
        occ.forEach((indexes, tail) => {
          for (let i = 0; i < indexes.length - 1; i += 1) {
            const newer = indexes[i];
            const older = indexes[i + 1];
            rows.push({
              tail,
              newer,
              older,
              gap: older - newer
            });
          }
        });

        return rows
          .sort((a, b) => b.gap - a.gap || a.tail.localeCompare(b.tail))
          .slice(0, 18);
      }

      function findBridgeCandidates(regionKey, query, lookback) {
        const draws = state.data[regionKey] || [];
        const limit = Math.min(draws.length, lookback);
        let source = null;

        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(limit, 20); i += 1) {
          const hits = findCellsByQuery(draws[i], i, query);
          if (hits.length) {
            source = hits[0];
            break;
          }
        }

        if (!source) {
          for (let i = 0; i < limit; i += 1) {
            const hits = findCellsByQuery(draws[i], i, query);
            if (hits.length) {
              source = hits[0];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!source) return null;

        let target = null;
        for (let i = limit - 1; i > source.drawIndex + 1; i -= 1) {
          const hits = findCellsByQuery(draws[i], i, query);
          if (hits.length) {
            target = hits[0];
            break;
          }
        }

        if (!target) return null;
        return { source, target };
      }

      function findCellsByQuery(draw, drawIndex, query) {
        const matches = [];

        PRIZE_LAYOUT.forEach((row) => {
          const values = toArray(draw[row.key]);
          values.forEach((value, itemIndex) => {
            const hitIndex = locateQuery(String(value), query);
            if (hitIndex !== -1) {
              matches.push({
                drawIndex,
                prizeKey: row.key,
                itemIndex,
                value: String(value),
                digitIndex: hitIndex,
                digit: String(value)[hitIndex] || String(value).slice(-1)
              });
            }
          });
        });

        return matches;
      }

      function handleAdapterEvent(event) {
        if (event.kind === 'status') {
          if (event.source === state.live.adapterType) {
            state.live.connected = event.connected;
            state.live.adapterLabel = event.label;
            renderLive();
            renderStats();
          }
          return;
        }

        if (event.kind === 'data') {
          if (event.source !== state.live.adapterType) return;

          state.live.connected = true;
          state.live.adapterLabel = event.label;
          state.live.metrics = {
            viewers: event.payload.viewers,
            sales: event.payload.sales,
            rate: event.payload.rate,
            hotTail: event.payload.hotTail,
            room: event.payload.room,
            latency: event.payload.latency,
            lastAt: event.payload.lastAt
          };

          state.live.spark.push(event.payload.rate);
          if (state.live.spark.length > 24) {
            state.live.spark = state.live.spark.slice(-24);
          }

          state.live.stream.unshift(event.payload);
          if (state.live.stream.length > 24) {
            state.live.stream = state.live.stream.slice(0, 24);
          }

          state.statsRealtime = {
            adapterLabel: event.label,
            hotTail: event.payload.hotTail,
            lastAt: event.payload.lastAt,
            rate: event.payload.rate
          };

          renderLive();
          if (state.activeSection === 'stats') {
            renderStats();
          }
        }
      }

      function selectAdapter(adapterKey) {
        if (!state.live.adapters[adapterKey]) return;
        state.live.adapterType = adapterKey;
        state.live.adapterLabel = adapterKey === 'socket' ? 'WebSocket giả lập' : 'API Polling giả lập';
        state.live.connected = false;
        state.live.stream = [];
        state.live.spark = [];
        renderLive();
        renderStats();
        manageAdapters();
        toast(`Đã chuyển adapter sang ${state.live.adapterLabel}.`);
      }

      function manageAdapters() {
        const shouldRun = !document.hidden && (state.activeSection === 'live' || state.activeSection === 'stats');

        Object.entries(state.live.adapters).forEach(([key, adapter]) => {
          if (!shouldRun) {
            adapter.disconnect();
            return;
          }

          if (key === state.live.adapterType) {
            adapter.connect();
          } else {
            adapter.disconnect();
          }
        });
      }

      function handleVisibilityChange() {
        document.body.classList.toggle('app-paused', document.hidden);
        manageAdapters();
      }

      function cleanupApp() {
        clearTimeout(state.toastTimer);
        clearTimeout(state.scrollTimerA);
        clearTimeout(state.scrollTimerB);
        Object.values(state.live.adapters).forEach((adapter) => adapter.disconnect());
      }

      function updateHeaderContext() {
        dom.contextText.textContent =
          `${REGIONS[state.activeRegion].name} • ${SECTION_LABELS[state.activeSection]} • 300 kỳ quay • nhớ số ${state.ai.context.lastQuery || state.historyQuery || '--'}`;

        renderAI();
      }

      function getSelectionIndex(drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex) {
        return state.bridgeSelections.findIndex((item) =>
          sameCell(item, drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex)
        );
      }

      function isBridgeEndpoint(drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex) {
        if (!state.currentBridge) return false;
        return sameCell(state.currentBridge.from, drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex) ||
          sameCell(state.currentBridge.to, drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex);
      }

      function sameCell(selection, drawIndex, prizeKey, itemIndex) {
        return selection &&
          selection.drawIndex === drawIndex &&
          selection.prizeKey === prizeKey &&
          selection.itemIndex === itemIndex;
      }

      function orderSelections(a, b) {
        return a.drawIndex <= b.drawIndex
          ? { from: a, to: b }
          : { from: b, to: a };
      }

      function getRowLabel(prizeKey) {
        const row = PRIZE_LAYOUT.find((item) => item.key === prizeKey);
        return row ? row.label : prizeKey;
      }

      function generateDrawsForRegion(regionKey) {
        const baseSeed = REGIONS[regionKey].seed;
        const draws = [];
        const today = new Date();

        for (let index = 0; index < 300; index += 1) {
          const rng = mulberry32(baseSeed + (index * 97));
          const date = new Date(today);
          date.setDate(today.getDate() - index);

          const draw = {
            id: `${regionKey}-${index}`,
            date: formatDate(date),
            isoDate: date.toISOString()
          };

          PRIZE_LAYOUT.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
            const values = [];

            for (let item = 0; item < row.count; item += 1) {
              let suffix = (baseSeed + (index * 7) + (rowIndex * 13) + (item * 17)) % 100;

              if (index % 29 === 0 && row.key === 'special') suffix = 68;
              if (index % 41 === 0 && row.key === 'g3' && item === 0) suffix = 79;
              if (index % 53 === 0 && row.key === 'g5' && item === 2) suffix = 23;
              if (index === 0 && regionKey === 'bac' && row.key === 'g3' && item === 0) suffix = 68;
              if (index === 0 && regionKey === 'trung' && row.key === 'g4' && item === 1) suffix = 79;
              if (index === 0 && regionKey === 'nam' && row.key === 'g5' && item === 0) suffix = 23;

              const value = buildNumber(rng, row.digits, suffix);
              values.push(value);
            }

            draw[row.key] = row.count === 1 ? values[0] : values;
          });

          draws.push(draw);
        }

        return draws;
      }

      function buildNumber(rng, digits, suffixNumber) {
        const suffix = pad(suffixNumber % 100, 2);
        if (digits <= 2) return suffix.slice(-digits);

        let prefix = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < digits - 2; i += 1) {
          prefix += Math.floor(rng() * 10);
        }
        return (prefix + suffix).slice(-digits);
      }

      function getSpecialTail(draw) {
        return String(draw.special).slice(-2);
      }

      function buildFreq(items) {
        const map = new Map();
        items.forEach((item) => {
          const key = String(item);
          map.set(key, (map.get(key) || 0) + 1);
        });
        return map;
      }

      function topEntries(map, limit) {
        return Array.from(map.entries())
          .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])))
          .slice(0, limit);
      }

      function topEntry(map) {
        const item = topEntries(map, 1)[0];
        return item ? { value: String(item[0]), count: item[1] } : { value: '--', count: 0 };
      }

      function statsChipLabel(chip) {
        const labels = {
          ketnoi: 'Kết nối cầu',
          cham: 'Phân tích chạm',
          tong: 'Tổng',
          duoi: 'Tần suất đuôi',
          xuhuong: 'Xu hướng'
        };
        return labels[chip] || 'Kết nối cầu';
      }

      function normalizeNumberQuery(text) {
        return String(text || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 5);
      }

      function locateQuery(value, query) {
        const q = normalizeNumberQuery(query);
        if (!q) return -1;
        return String(value).indexOf(q);
      }

      function matchesQuery(value, query) {
        return locateQuery(String(value), query) !== -1;
      }

      function formatDate(date) {
        return `${pad(date.getDate(), 2)}/${pad(date.getMonth() + 1, 2)}/${date.getFullYear()}`;
      }

      function nowTime() {
        return new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', {
          hour12: false,
          hour: '2-digit',
          minute: '2-digit',
          second: '2-digit'
        });
      }

      function describeDraw(drawIndex) {
        const draw = state.data[state.activeRegion][drawIndex];
        if (!draw) return `kỳ -${drawIndex}`;
        return drawIndex === 0 ? `hôm nay (${draw.date})` : `kỳ -${drawIndex} ngày (${draw.date})`;
      }

      function sumDigits(value) {
        return String(value).split('').reduce((sum, digit) => sum + Number(digit), 0);
      }

      function toArray(value) {
        return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
      }

      function pad(value, length = 2) {
        return String(value).padStart(length, '0');
      }

      function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
      }

      function normalizeText(text) {
        return String(text || '')
          .toLowerCase()
          .normalize('NFD')
          .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
          .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
          .trim();
      }

      function toast(message) {
        clearTimeout(state.toastTimer);
        dom.toast.textContent = message;
        dom.toast.classList.add('show');
        state.toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
          dom.toast.classList.remove('show');
        }, 2200);
      }

      function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value)
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
      }

      function throttleRAF(fn) {
        let scheduled = false;
        return (...args) => {
          if (scheduled) return;
          scheduled = true;
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            scheduled = false;
            fn(...args);
          });
        };
      }

      function debounce(fn, delay) {
        let timer = 0;
        return (...args) => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          timer = window.setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay);
        };
      }

      function mulberry32(seed) {
        let t = seed >>> 0;
        return function random() {
          t += 0x6D2B79F5;
          let r = t;
          r = Math.imul(r ^ (r >>> 15), r | 1);
          r ^= r + Math.imul(r ^ (r >>> 7), r | 61);
          return ((r ^ (r >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>HỆ THỐNG QUẢN TRỊ | A1-STEEL-CORE v12.0 | 7 CORE SPACES</title>
    <style>
        :root{
            --bg-main:#0a0a0c;
            --bg-board:#0f172a;
            --bg-soft:rgba(15,23,42,.72);
            --text:#f8fafc;
            --muted:#94a3b8;
            --line:#334155;
            --blue:#0ea5e9;
            --blue2:#38bdf8;
            --red:#ef4444;
            --red2:#d40000;
            --yellow:#facc15;
            --gold:#fbbf24;
            --green:#10b981;
            --purple:#a855f7;
            --cyan:#06b6d4;
            --orange:#f97316;
            --safe-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
            --z-core:10;
            --z-drawer-bot:8000;
            --z-drawer-top:8500;
            --z-nav:9000;
            --z-hud:9999;
            --z-toast:9700;
            --z-confirm:9800;
        }

        *{
            box-sizing:border-box;
            margin:0;
            padding:0;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
            scrollbar-width:none;
            font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
        }
        *::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

        html,body{
            width:100%;
            height:100%;
            overflow:hidden;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(56,189,248,.10), transparent 25%),
                radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(139,92,246,.10), transparent 25%),
                linear-gradient(180deg,#06090f,#0a0d12 45%,#090c11);
            color:var(--text);
        }

        body{
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:stretch;
        }

        .master-app-wrapper{
            max-width:480px;
            width:100%;
            height:100vh;
            position:relative;
            background:#0a0d12;
            overflow:hidden;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
            border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.03);
            border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.03);
        }

        .main-tab-container{
            position:absolute;
            inset:0;
            display:none;
            flex-direction:column;
            min-height:0;
        }
        .main-tab-container.active{
            display:flex;
            animation:fadeInTab .28s ease-out;
        }
        @keyframes fadeInTab{
            from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.985)}
            to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
        }

        .global-ai-fab{
            position:absolute;
            right:15px;
            top:50%;
            transform:translateY(-50%);
            width:46px;
            height:46px;
            border-radius:50%;
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--purple));
            box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(168,85,247,.55), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,.3);
            border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            font-size:22px;
            z-index:var(--z-hud);
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275);
            animation:floatFab 3s ease-in-out infinite;
            user-select:none;
        }
        .global-ai-fab.hidden{
            transform:translateY(-50%) scale(0) translateX(50px);
            opacity:0;
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .global-ai-fab:active{transform:translateY(-50%) scale(.88)}
        @keyframes floatFab{
            0%,100%{transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0)}
            50%{transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(-5px)}
        }

        .glass-back-btn{
            position:absolute;
            top:15px;
            left:15px;
            width:38px;
            height:38px;
            border-radius:12px;
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            backdrop-filter:blur(15px);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
            border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            color:#fff;
            cursor:pointer;
            z-index:var(--z-hud);
            box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
            opacity:0;
            pointer-events:none;
            transform:translateX(-10px);
            transition:all .28s ease;
        }
        .glass-back-btn.show{
            opacity:1;
            pointer-events:auto;
            transform:translateX(0);
        }
        .glass-back-btn:active{
            transform:scale(.86);
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
            box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,.28);
        }

        .drawer-handle{
            position:absolute;
            left:50%;
            transform:translateX(-50%);
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
            font-size:10px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:2px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            cursor:pointer;
            z-index:var(--z-hud);
            transition:.35s ease;
            height:22px;
            user-select:none;
        }
        .drawer-handle:active{transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.95)}
        .top-handle{
            top:0;
            border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;
            border-top:none;
        }
        .bot-handle{
            bottom:65px;
            border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;
            border-bottom:none;
            width:150px;
        }
        .style-loto{
            width:150px;
            background:rgba(14,165,233,.15);
            border:1px solid var(--blue);
            color:#e0f2fe;
            text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--blue);
            box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,.18);
        }
        .style-tuan{
            background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);
            border:1px solid var(--green);
            color:#d1fae5;
            text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--green);
            box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(16,185,129,.18);
        }
        .style-nam{
            width:200px;
            background:rgba(239,68,68,.20);
            border:1px solid var(--red);
            color:#fee2e2;
            text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--red);
            animation:pulseNeonRed 1.5s infinite alternate;
        }
        .style-mt{
            width:160px;
            background:rgba(249,115,22,.15);
            border:1px solid var(--orange);
            color:#ffedd5;
            text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--orange);
            box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(249,115,22,.15);
        }
        @keyframes pulseNeonRed{
            0%{box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(239,68,68,.35)}
            100%{box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(239,68,68,.75)}
        }

        .core-region{
            flex:1;
            position:relative;
            z-index:var(--z-core);
            min-height:0;
            overflow:hidden;
        }

        .space-drawer{
            position:absolute;
            left:0;
            width:100%;
            height:calc(100% - 65px);
            background:var(--bg-main);
            transition:.48s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
            overflow:hidden;
        }
        .drawer-top{
            top:-100%;
            z-index:var(--z-drawer-top);
            border-bottom:2px solid #334155;
        }
        .drawer-top.open{top:0}
        .drawer-bot{
            bottom:-100%;
            z-index:var(--z-drawer-bot);
            border-top:2px solid #334155;
        }
        .drawer-bot.open{bottom:65px}

        .rx-zone{
            width:100%;
            height:100%;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);
            text-align:center;
            padding:20px;
            min-height:0;
        }
        .rx-zone.module-zone{
            padding:0;
            border:none;
            color:inherit;
            justify-content:flex-start;
            align-items:stretch;
            overflow:hidden;
            background:transparent;
        }
        .drawer-zone{background:#0a0d12}
        .mb-core{color:var(--yellow)}
        .mn-core{color:#fff}
        .mt-core{color:var(--orange)}
        .live-core{
            color:var(--red);
            background:rgba(239,68,68,.04);
        }

        .toast-stack{
            position:absolute;
            top:14px;
            left:12px;
            right:12px;
            z-index:var(--z-toast);
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:8px;
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .toast{
            padding:12px 14px;
            border-radius:14px;
            backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
            color:#fff;
            font-size:13px;
            line-height:1.45;
            animation:toastIn .24s ease;
        }
        .toast.info{background:rgba(15,23,42,.92)}
        .toast.success{background:rgba(16,185,129,.16);border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.42)}
        .toast.warn{background:rgba(250,204,21,.14);border-color:rgba(250,204,21,.45)}
        .toast.error{background:rgba(239,68,68,.16);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.45)}
        @keyframes toastIn{
            from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}
            to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
        }

        .confirm-overlay{
            position:absolute;
            inset:0;
            z-index:var(--z-confirm);
            display:none;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);
            backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
            padding:18px;
        }
        .confirm-overlay.show{display:flex}
        .confirm-card{
            width:100%;
            max-width:360px;
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0f172a,#0b1220);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            border-radius:18px;
            box-shadow:0 26px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
            padding:18px;
        }
        .confirm-title{
            font-size:15px;
            font-weight:900;
            margin-bottom:8px;
        }
        .confirm-message{
            color:#dbe6f5;
            font-size:13px;
            line-height:1.6;
            margin-bottom:16px;
            white-space:pre-wrap;
        }
        .confirm-actions{
            display:flex;
            justify-content:flex-end;
            gap:10px;
        }

        .shell-btn{
            border:none;
            border-radius:12px;
            padding:11px 14px;
            cursor:pointer;
            font-size:13px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#fff;
            transition:.22s;
            user-select:none;
        }
        .shell-btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}
        .shell-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#6366f1)}
        .shell-btn.secondary{background:#1f2937;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
        .shell-btn.danger{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#b91c1c)}
        .shell-btn.ghost{
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            color:#e5eef9;
        }

        .ai-brain-space{
            flex:1;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(168,85,247,.12), transparent 28%),
                linear-gradient(180deg,#020617 0%, #0a0a0c 100%);
            padding-bottom:calc(65px + var(--safe-bottom));
            min-height:0;
        }
        .ai-header{
            padding:20px 15px 14px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:6px;
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.25);
            background:rgba(2,6,23,.72);
            backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
        }
        .ai-title-row{
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            gap:10px;
        }
        .pulse-dot{
            width:12px;
            height:12px;
            background:var(--cyan);
            border-radius:50%;
            box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--cyan);
            animation:pulseDot 1.5s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulseDot{
            0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(6,182,212,.7)}
            70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 15px rgba(6,182,212,0)}
            100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(6,182,212,0)}
        }
        .ai-title{
            font-size:16px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#fff;
            text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--purple);
            letter-spacing:2px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
        }
        .ai-meta{
            font-size:11px;
            color:#cbd5e1;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
        }

        .chat-panel-3d{
            flex:1;
            margin:15px;
            margin-top:12px;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.58);
            border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.35);
            border-radius:16px;
            box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.8), inset 0 0 20px rgba(168,85,247,.1);
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            overflow:hidden;
            backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
            min-height:0;
        }
        .chat-messages{
            flex:1;
            padding:20px;
            overflow:auto;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:16px;
            min-height:0;
            scroll-behavior:smooth;
        }
        .msg{
            max-width:86%;
            padding:12px 16px;
            border-radius:16px;
            font-size:13px;
            line-height:1.55;
            white-space:pre-wrap;
            word-break:break-word;
            animation:msgIn .24s ease-out;
        }
        .msg.ai{
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(30,41,59,.92),rgba(15,23,42,.96));
            color:#e2e8f0;
            align-self:flex-start;
            border-bottom-left-radius:4px;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
        }
        .msg.user{
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#7e22ce);
            color:#fff;
            align-self:flex-end;
            border-bottom-right-radius:4px;
            box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(168,85,247,.35);
            border:1px solid #c084fc;
        }
        @keyframes msgIn{
            from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}
            to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
        }

        .chat-input-area{
            background:rgba(2,6,23,.94);
            padding:15px;
            border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            display:flex;
            gap:10px;
            align-items:center;
            position:relative;
            z-index:20;
        }
        .chat-input{
            flex:1;
            background:rgba(30,41,59,.62);
            border:1px solid #475569;
            border-radius:24px;
            padding:12px 16px;
            color:#fff;
            outline:none;
            font-size:13px;
            transition:.25s;
        }
        .chat-input:focus{
            border-color:var(--purple);
            box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(168,85,247,.24);
        }

        .btn-action-chat{
            width:40px;
            height:40px;
            border-radius:50%;
            background:rgba(30,41,59,.82);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            color:#94a3b8;
            font-size:18px;
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.2s;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .btn-action-chat:active{
            transform:scale(.86);
            background:rgba(168,85,247,.35);
            color:#fff;
            border-color:var(--purple);
        }
        .btn-action-chat.recording{
            background:rgba(239,68,68,.18);
            color:#fda4af;
            border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.5);
            animation:pulseMic 1.2s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulseMic{
            0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,.45)}
            70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(239,68,68,0)}
            100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(239,68,68,0)}
        }

        .btn-send{
            width:44px;
            height:44px;
            border-radius:50%;
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--blue));
            border:none;
            color:#fff;
            font-size:16px;
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            cursor:pointer;
            box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(168,85,247,.35);
            transition:.2s;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .btn-send:active{
            transform:scale(.86);
            box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(14,165,233,.9), inset 0 0 8px #fff;
        }

        .chat-plus-menu{
            position:absolute;
            bottom:75px;
            left:15px;
            width:240px;
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(15,23,42,.96),rgba(2,6,23,.98));
            border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.45);
            border-radius:16px;
            padding:10px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:6px;
            box-shadow:0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
            transform:scale(0);
            transform-origin:bottom left;
            transition:all .28s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275);
            z-index:100;
            backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .chat-plus-menu.show{
            transform:scale(1);
            pointer-events:auto;
        }
        .plus-menu-item{
            background:rgba(30,41,59,.35);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            padding:12px;
            color:#e2e8f0;
            font-size:12px;
            font-weight:800;
            border-radius:10px;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.2s;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            gap:10px;
            min-height:42px;
        }
        .plus-menu-item:hover{
            transform:translateX(4px);
            background:rgba(168,85,247,.18);
            border-color:rgba(168,85,247,.38);
        }
        .plus-menu-item:active{transform:scale(.97)}

        .settings-space{
            flex:1;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            padding:30px 20px calc(80px + var(--safe-bottom));
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0f172a 0%, #020617 100%);
            overflow:auto;
        }
        .settings-header{
            font-size:18px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#fff;
            margin-bottom:25px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            letter-spacing:2px;
            border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            padding-bottom:10px;
        }
        .setting-item{
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            border-radius:12px;
            padding:16px 20px;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            gap:15px;
            margin-bottom:12px;
            font-weight:800;
            font-size:13px;
            color:#cbd5e1;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.25s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275);
        }
        .setting-item.youtube{border-left:4px solid var(--red)}
        .setting-item.bug{border-left:4px solid var(--yellow)}
        .setting-item:active{
            transform:scale(.97) translateX(4px);
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            color:#fff;
        }
        .setting-icon{font-size:20px}

        .bottom-nav{
            position:absolute;
            bottom:0;
            left:0;
            width:100%;
            height:65px;
            background:#000;
            border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            display:flex;
            justify-content:space-around;
            align-items:center;
            z-index:var(--z-nav);
            padding-bottom:var(--safe-bottom);
        }
        .nav-item{
            width:20%;
            height:100%;
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            cursor:pointer;
        }
        .nav-item-inner{
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            width:85%;
            height:85%;
            border-radius:8px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            background:#121212;
            transition:.28s;
        }
        .nav-item:active .nav-item-inner{transform:scale(.95)}
        .nav-icon{
            font-size:18px;
            margin-bottom:2px;
            transition:.28s;
        }
        .nav-text{
            font-size:9px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#94a3b8;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            transition:.28s;
        }

        .nav-item.active-mb .nav-item-inner{border-color:var(--yellow)}
        .nav-item.active-mb .nav-icon,.nav-item.active-mb .nav-text{color:var(--yellow)}
        .nav-item.active-mn .nav-item-inner{border-color:#fff}
        .nav-item.active-mn .nav-icon,.nav-item.active-mn .nav-text{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 8px #fff}
        .nav-item.active-live .nav-item-inner{border-color:var(--red)}
        .nav-item.active-live .nav-icon,.nav-item.active-live .nav-text{color:var(--red);text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--red)}
        .nav-item.active-ai .nav-item-inner{
            border-color:var(--purple);
            background:rgba(168,85,247,.1);
            box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(168,85,247,.25);
        }
        .nav-item.active-ai .nav-icon,.nav-item.active-ai .nav-text{color:var(--purple);text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--purple)}
        .nav-item.active-set .nav-item-inner{
            border-color:var(--muted);
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
        }
        .nav-item.active-set .nav-icon,.nav-item.active-set .nav-text{color:#fff}

        .shell-flash{animation:shellFlash .75s ease}
        @keyframes shellFlash{
            0%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0)}
            50%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 999px rgba(56,189,248,.05)}
            100%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0)}
        }

        /* =========================
           SPACE 1 / 5 / 6 : GENERIC BRIDGE REGION
        ========================= */
        .rx-bridge-root{
            height:100%;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            min-height:0;
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b1017,#0a0d12);
            position:relative;
        }
        .drawer-zone .rx-bridge-root{padding-top:54px}

        .rx-bridge-root.theme-mb{--accent:#facc15;--accent2:#38bdf8}
        .rx-bridge-root.theme-mn{--accent:#ffffff;--accent2:#0ea5e9}
        .rx-bridge-root.theme-mt{--accent:#ffedd5;--accent2:#a855f7}

        .rx-bridge-toolbar{
            padding:12px;
            display:flex;
            gap:10px;
            flex-shrink:0;
            background:rgba(8,14,24,.78);
            backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
        }
        .rx-bridge-tool{
            flex:1;
            min-height:54px;
            border-radius:12px;
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b 0%,#020617 100%);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);
            box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.65), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.24s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275);
            padding:8px 6px;
        }
        .rx-bridge-tool:active{transform:scale(.97)}
        .rx-bridge-tool .label{
            font-size:10px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:.6px;
            color:#64748b;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            text-align:center;
            margin-bottom:5px;
        }
        .rx-bridge-tool .light{
            width:35%;
            height:4px;
            border-radius:4px;
            background:#334155;
            transition:.24s;
        }
        .rx-bridge-tool.active{
            background:rgba(16,185,129,.06);
            transform:translateY(-1px);
            border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.32);
        }
        .rx-bridge-tool.active .label{
            color:var(--yellow);
            text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--yellow);
        }
        .rx-bridge-tool.active .light{
            width:75%;
            background:var(--yellow);
            box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow),0 0 24px #fef08a;
        }

        .rx-bridge-smart{
            background:linear-gradient(90deg,#020617,#0f172a,#020617);
            box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(14,165,233,.22);
            border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent2);
            padding:12px 18px;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            gap:14px;
            font-size:12px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:1.4px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .rx-bridge-smart .pulse{
            width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
            background:var(--accent2);
            box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--accent2);
            animation:bridgePulse 1.5s infinite;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        @keyframes bridgePulse{
            0%{transform:scale(.9);opacity:.6}
            50%{transform:scale(1.35);opacity:1}
            100%{transform:scale(.9);opacity:.6}
        }
        .rx-bridge-smart .text{
            text-align:center;
            background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent2) 20%, #fff 50%, var(--accent2) 80%);
            background-size:200% auto;
            -webkit-background-clip:text;
            background-clip:text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
            animation:smartShift 2s linear infinite;
        }
        @keyframes smartShift{to{background-position:200% center}}

        .rx-bridge-station{
            flex-shrink:0;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.82);
            backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            padding:10px 0;
            box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.26);
        }
        .rx-bridge-station-row{
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            gap:15px;
            padding:0 15px;
            width:100%;
        }
        .rx-bridge-station-btn{
            width:44px;
            height:44px;
            border-radius:50%;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            color:var(--blue2);
            font-size:18px;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.22s;
            box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
            user-select:none;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .rx-bridge-station-btn:active{
            transform:scale(.86);
            background:var(--blue);
            color:#fff;
            box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--blue);
        }
        .rx-bridge-station-label{
            flex:1;
            text-align:center;
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(225,29,72,.2),rgba(190,18,60,.38));
            border:1px solid rgba(254,205,211,.35);
            border-radius:12px;
            padding:12px 10px;
            font-size:15px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#fff;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(225,29,72,.2), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            white-space:nowrap;
            overflow:hidden;
            text-overflow:ellipsis;
        }

        .rx-bridge-feed{
            flex:1;
            min-height:0;
            overflow:auto;
            padding:10px 8px 90px;
            position:relative;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
        }
        .rx-bridge-history{position:relative}
        .rx-bridge-svg{
            position:absolute;
            inset:0;
            width:100%;
            height:100%;
            overflow:visible;
            z-index:24;
        }
        .rx-bridge-line{
            stroke:#10b981;
            stroke-width:2.6;
            fill:none;
            filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #10b981);
        }
        .rx-bridge-line-hit{
            stroke:transparent;
            stroke-width:22;
            fill:none;
            cursor:pointer;
            pointer-events:stroke;
        }
        .rx-bridge-line.delete{
            stroke:#ef4444;
            stroke-width:3.5;
            filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #ef4444);
        }
        .rx-bridge-line-ai{
            stroke:#0ea5e9;
            stroke-width:3;
            fill:none;
            stroke-dasharray:8 6;
            animation:laserFlow 1s linear infinite;
            filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #38bdf8);
        }
        @keyframes laserFlow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-14}}

        .rx-bridge-list{
            position:relative;
            z-index:5;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:16px;
        }
        .rx-bridge-board{
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.72);
            backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
            border-radius:16px;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            padding:14px;
            box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
            position:relative;
            overflow:hidden;
            transition:.25s;
        }
        .rx-bridge-board.flash{animation:boardFlash .8s ease}
        @keyframes boardFlash{
            0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0), inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(56,189,248,0)}
            50%{box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(56,189,248,.24), inset 0 0 42px rgba(56,189,248,.07)}
            100%{box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
        }
        .rx-bridge-head{
            display:flex;
            align-items:baseline;
            justify-content:space-between;
            gap:10px;
            margin-bottom:12px;
            padding-bottom:8px;
            border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1);
        }
        .rx-bridge-title{
            font-size:15px;
            font-weight:900;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            color:var(--accent2);
        }
        .rx-bridge-date{
            font-size:11px;
            color:#8fa4be;
            font-style:italic;
            font-weight:700;
            text-transform:capitalize;
            text-align:right;
        }
        .rx-bridge-row{
            display:flex;
            align-items:stretch;
            gap:12px;
            margin-bottom:8px;
        }
        .rx-bridge-row.db .rx-bridge-prize{
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d40000,#990000);
            color:#fff;
            border-color:#ff5252;
            box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(212,0,0,.35);
        }
        .rx-bridge-prize{
            width:42px;
            flex-shrink:0;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            border-radius:10px;
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            color:#94a3b8;
            font-weight:900;
            font-size:14px;
        }
        .rx-bridge-results{
            flex:1;
            display:grid;
            gap:6px;
        }
        .rx-grid-1{grid-template-columns:1fr}
        .rx-grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
        .rx-grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
        .rx-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
        .rx-grid-6{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
        .rx-grid-7{
            display:flex;
            flex-wrap:wrap;
            justify-content:center;
            gap:6px;
        }
        .rx-grid-7 .rx-bridge-box{
            flex:0 0 calc(25% - 4.5px);
            max-width:calc(25% - 4.5px);
        }
        .rx-bridge-box{
            background:rgba(2,6,23,.42);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            border-radius:8px;
            min-height:34px;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            position:relative;
            overflow:hidden;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.2s;
            padding:0 2px;
        }
        .rx-bridge-root.manual-mode .rx-bridge-box:active{
            transform:scale(.96);
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
        }
        .rx-bridge-box.ai-glow{
            box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,.55), inset 0 0 15px rgba(56,189,248,.22);
            border-color:#38bdf8;
            background:rgba(14,165,233,.14);
            z-index:7;
        }
        .rx-bridge-numtxt{
            width:100%;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            color:#fff;
            font-weight:700;
            font-family:"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
        }
        .rx-grid-6 .rx-bridge-numtxt{font-size:11px}
        .rx-grid-4 .rx-bridge-numtxt,
        .rx-grid-7 .rx-bridge-numtxt{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
        .rx-grid-3 .rx-bridge-numtxt{font-size:14px}
        .rx-grid-2 .rx-bridge-numtxt{font-size:16px}
        .rx-grid-1 .rx-bridge-numtxt{font-size:18px}
        .rx-bridge-row.db .rx-bridge-box{min-height:50px}
        .rx-bridge-row.db .rx-bridge-numtxt{font-size:26px;color:#ef4444}
        .rx-bridge-digit{
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            border-radius:3px;
            position:relative;
            z-index:2;
            transition:.25s;
        }
        .rx-bridge-digit.marked{
            color:var(--yellow);
            text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow),0 0 28px #fef08a;
            transform:scale(1.35);
            font-weight:900;
        }
        .rx-bridge-row.db .rx-bridge-digit.marked{transform:scale(1.15)}
        .rx-bridge-digit.ai-marked{
            color:#0ea5e9;
            text-shadow:0 0 15px #0ea5e9,0 0 28px #38bdf8;
            transform:scale(1.35);
            font-weight:900;
        }
        .rx-bridge-row.db .rx-bridge-digit.ai-marked{transform:scale(1.15)}

        .rx-bridge-popup{
            position:absolute;
            inset:0;
            z-index:60;
            display:none;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            background:rgba(0,0,0,.78);
            backdrop-filter:blur(5px);
            padding:18px;
        }
        .rx-bridge-popup.show{display:flex}
        .rx-bridge-popup-box{
            width:100%;
            max-width:340px;
            background:#0f172a;
            border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.42);
            border-radius:16px;
            padding:22px;
            box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(16,185,129,.22);
            transform:translateY(14px) scale(.95);
            transition:.25s;
        }
        .rx-bridge-popup.show .rx-bridge-popup-box{
            transform:translateY(0) scale(1);
        }
        .rx-bridge-popup-title{
            text-align:center;
            font-size:12px;
            color:#94a3b8;
            margin-bottom:16px;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            font-weight:800;
        }
        .rx-bridge-popup-digits{
            display:flex;
            gap:10px;
            flex-wrap:wrap;
            justify-content:center;
        }
        .rx-bridge-popup-digit{
            width:50px;
            height:50px;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            border-radius:12px;
            background:#1e293b;
            border:2px solid #334155;
            color:#fff;
            font-size:24px;
            font-weight:900;
            cursor:pointer;
            box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.42);
            transition:.2s;
        }
        .rx-bridge-popup-digit:active{
            transform:scale(.9);
            background:#0ea5e9;
            border-color:#38bdf8;
        }

        /* =========================
           SPACE 2 : LOTO MATRIX
        ========================= */
        .lotom-root{
            height:100%;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            min-height:0;
            background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20%, #0f172a 0%, #020617 80%);
            overflow:hidden;
        }
        .drawer-zone .lotom-root{padding-top:54px}
        .lotom-scroll{
            flex:1;
            overflow:auto;
            padding:14px 10px 90px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:14px;
            min-height:0;
        }
        .lotom-card{
            position:relative;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.48);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
            border-radius:16px;
            box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
            overflow:hidden;
        }
        .lotom-matrixcard{
            min-height:500px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
        }
        .lotom-hud{
            position:absolute;
            top:0;
            left:0;
            width:100%;
            z-index:50;
            transform:translateY(-100%);
            transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275);
            padding:15px 15px 12px;
            text-align:center;
            color:#fff;
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
            box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
            backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:10px;
            border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;
        }
        .lotom-hud.show{transform:translateY(0)}
        .lotom-hud .eval{
            align-self:center;
            padding:6px 12px;
            border-radius:10px;
            font-size:12px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
        }
        .lotom-hud .hl{font-size:18px;font-weight:900}
        .lotom-hud-btn{
            align-self:center;
            padding:10px 18px;
            border-radius:18px;
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
            background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);
            color:#fff;
