            cursor:pointer;
        }
        .lotom-tier-diamond{
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(14,165,233,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
            border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.46);
            text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(56,189,248,.58);
        }
        .lotom-tier-diamond .eval{border-color:#38bdf8;color:#e0f2fe;background:rgba(56,189,248,.18)}
        .lotom-tier-diamond .hl{color:#7dd3fc}
        .lotom-tier-gold{
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(245,158,11,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
            border-color:rgba(250,204,21,.46);
        }
        .lotom-tier-gold .eval{border-color:#facc15;color:#fef08a;background:rgba(250,204,21,.18)}
        .lotom-tier-gold .hl{color:#fde047}
        .lotom-tier-silver{
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(148,163,184,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
            border-color:rgba(148,163,184,.46);
        }
        .lotom-tier-silver .eval{border-color:#94a3b8;color:#f1f5f9;background:rgba(148,163,184,.18)}
        .lotom-tier-silver .hl{color:#e2e8f0}
        .lotom-tier-bronze{
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(239,68,68,.22),rgba(2,6,23,.95));
            border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.46);
        }
        .lotom-tier-bronze .eval{border-color:#ef4444;color:#fca5a5;background:rgba(239,68,68,.18)}
        .lotom-tier-bronze .hl{color:#fca5a5}

        .lotom-toggle{
            display:flex;
            gap:10px;
            padding:12px;
            background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(153,27,27,.34),rgba(220,38,38,.16),rgba(153,27,27,.34));
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.45);
        }
        .lotom-toggle-btn{
            flex:1;
            padding:14px 8px;
            border-radius:12px;
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(2,6,23,.85),rgba(15,23,42,.85));
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            color:rgba(255,255,255,.52);
            font-weight:900;
            font-size:11px;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.25s;
            box-shadow:4px 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.42), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
        }
        .lotom-toggle-btn.active{
            color:#fff;
            border-color:var(--yellow);
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(250,204,21,.24),rgba(202,138,4,.48));
            box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(250,204,21,.45), inset 0 0 12px rgba(250,204,21,.22);
            text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(250,204,21,.9);
            transform:translateY(-1px);
        }
        .lotom-matrixwrap{
            position:relative;
            flex:1;
            overflow:auto;
            outline:none;
            cursor:grab;
            min-height:420px;
        }
        .lotom-matrixwrap:active{cursor:grabbing}
        .lotom-matrix{
            border-collapse:separate;
            border-spacing:0;
            width:max-content;
            table-layout:fixed;
            transition:.35s;
        }
        .lotom-matrix th,
        .lotom-matrix td{
            width:30px;
            min-width:30px;
            height:30px;
            border-right:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.08);
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.08);
            text-align:center;
            font-size:10.5px;
            font-weight:700;
            color:#94a3b8;
            position:relative;
            transition:.2s;
        }
        .lotom-matrix tr:hover td{background:rgba(14,165,233,.05);color:#fff}
        .lotom-matrix thead th{
            position:sticky;
            top:0;
            z-index:2;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.95);
            color:var(--blue2);
            font-weight:900;
        }
        .lotom-corner{
            position:sticky;
            top:0;
            left:0;
            z-index:20!important;
            background:#000!important;
            color:#fff!important;
        }
        .lotom-rowhead{
            position:sticky;
            left:0;
            z-index:15;
            background:rgba(2,6,23,.95);
            color:#fff;
            cursor:pointer;
            font-size:13px!important;
            font-weight:900!important;
            box-shadow:4px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
            overflow:visible!important;
        }
        .lotom-rowhead:hover{
            color:var(--blue2);
            text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--blue2);
            background:#0f172a;
        }
        .lotom-matrix.double-mode .lotom-rowhead{
            color:var(--yellow);
            text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(250,204,21,.35);
        }
        .lotom-row-badge{
            position:absolute;
            right:-6px;
            top:-6px;
            font-size:7px;
            padding:2px 5px;
            border-radius:8px;
            z-index:25;
            font-weight:900;
            white-space:nowrap;
            box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.8);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
        }
        .lotom-badge-gan{
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#991b1b);
            color:#fff;
            animation:lotopulseGan 1.3s infinite alternate;
        }
        .lotom-badge-hot{
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,#facc15,#b45309);
            color:#000;
        }
        @keyframes lotopulseGan{
            0%{box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(239,68,68,.32);transform:scale(.96)}
            100%{box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.75);transform:scale(1.05)}
        }
        .lotom-laser{
            position:absolute;
            left:0;
            height:2px;
            width:0;
            background:#fff;
            box-shadow:0 0 10px #fff,0 0 20px var(--blue),0 0 38px var(--blue);
            z-index:30;
            opacity:0;
            border-radius:999px;
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .lotom-laser.fire{animation:rowSweep 1.5s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94) forwards}
        @keyframes rowSweep{
            0%{width:0;opacity:1;left:30px}
            50%{width:250px;opacity:1}
            100%{left:100%;width:0;opacity:0}
        }
        .lotom-row-analyzed td{
            border-top:1px solid rgba(14,165,233,.4);
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(14,165,233,.4);
            background-color:rgba(14,165,233,.04);
        }
        .lotom-gap{
            background:rgba(239,68,68,.15)!important;
            color:rgba(239,68,68,.62)!important;
            border-top:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.46)!important;
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.46)!important;
        }
        .lotom-hit{
            background:rgba(16,185,129,.20)!important;
            color:#10b981!important;
            text-shadow:0 0 10px #10b981;
            font-size:16px!important;
            font-weight:900!important;
            border:1px solid var(--green)!important;
            position:relative;
            border-radius:4px;
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(16,185,129,.22);
            z-index:2;
        }
        .lotom-hit::before{
            content:"🎯";
            position:absolute;
            top:-12px;
            right:-10px;
            font-size:16px;
            animation:pinDrop .58s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275) forwards;
        }
        .lotom-hit::after{
            content:"";
            position:absolute;
            top:50%;
            left:50%;
            width:34px;height:34px;
            margin-top:-17px;margin-left:-17px;
            border:2px solid var(--green);
            border-radius:50%;
            animation:hitRipple 1.5s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pinDrop{
            0%{transform:translateY(-25px) scale(2.5) rotate(-20deg);opacity:0}
            100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0);opacity:1}
        }
        @keyframes hitRipple{
            0%{transform:scale(.5);opacity:1}
            100%{transform:scale(2.5);opacity:0;border-width:0}
        }

        .lotom-top{
            padding:16px 14px 18px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:16px;
        }
        .lotom-head{
            display:flex;
            align-items:flex-start;
            justify-content:space-between;
            gap:10px;
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            padding-bottom:12px;
        }
        .lotom-title{
            font-size:14px;
            font-weight:900;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            gap:8px;
            color:#fff;
        }
        .lotom-title span{
            color:var(--yellow);
            text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--yellow);
        }
        .lotom-clock{
            text-align:right;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:3px;
        }
        .lotom-clock .time{
            font-size:16px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:var(--blue2);
            font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
            letter-spacing:2px;
            text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(14,165,233,.65);
        }
        .lotom-clock .date{
            font-size:9px;
            color:var(--muted);
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            font-weight:700;
        }
        .lotom-chart{
            position:relative;
            height:160px;
            display:flex;
            align-items:flex-end;
            justify-content:space-between;
            gap:4px;
            padding-top:28px;
            border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
        }
        .lotom-chart::before,
        .lotom-chart::after{
            content:"";
            position:absolute;
            left:0;
            width:100%;
            height:1px;
            border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1);
        }
        .lotom-chart::before{bottom:30px}
        .lotom-chart::after{bottom:80px}
        .lotom-barwrap{
            flex:1;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:flex-end;
            height:100%;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.25s;
            position:relative;
            z-index:1;
        }
        .lotom-barwrap:hover{transform:translateY(-8px)}
        .lotom-barnum{
            font-size:14px;
            font-weight:900;
            margin-bottom:6px;
            text-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
        }
        .lotom-bar{
            width:100%;
            border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;
            display:flex;
            justify-content:center;
            padding-bottom:8px;
            transform-origin:bottom;
            animation:growUp 1.2s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) forwards;
            transform:scaleY(0);
            position:relative;
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,.14),0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.42);
        }
        .lotom-bar::before{
            content:"";
            position:absolute;
            top:0;left:0;right:0;
            height:6px;
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
            filter:blur(1px);
            border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;
        }
        .lotom-rank{
            writing-mode:vertical-rl;
            transform:rotate(180deg);
            font-size:9px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#fff;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.75);
        }
        @keyframes growUp{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
        .lotom-ai-btn{
            width:100%;
            padding:14px;
            border:none;
            border-radius:12px;
            cursor:pointer;
            color:#fff;
            font-weight:900;
            font-size:13px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            gap:8px;
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(168,85,247,.85),rgba(99,102,241,.85));
            box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(168,85,247,.28);
        }
        .lotom-ai-btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}

        .lotom-freq{
            padding:14px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:14px;
        }
        .lotom-freq-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
        .lotom-freq-filter{
            display:flex;
            gap:10px;
            background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(202,138,4,.20),rgba(250,204,21,.34),rgba(202,138,4,.20));
            padding:12px;
            border-radius:12px;
            border:1px solid rgba(250,204,21,.44);
            box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(250,204,21,.18), inset 0 0 12px rgba(250,204,21,.08);
        }
        .lotom-freq-btn{
            flex:1;
            padding:12px 0;
            border-radius:10px;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,#020617,#0f172a);
            color:#94a3b8;
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            cursor:pointer;
            box-shadow:3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.7), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            transition:.25s;
        }
        .lotom-freq-btn.active{
            color:var(--yellow);
            border-color:var(--yellow);
            box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(250,204,21,.46), inset 0 0 8px rgba(250,204,21,.18);
            text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(250,204,21,.8);
            transform:translateY(-1px);
        }
        .lotom-freq-grid{
            display:grid;
            grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);
            gap:4px;
        }
        .lotom-freq-cell{
            position:relative;
            padding:10px 0;
            text-align:center;
            border-radius:7px;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.42);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            font-size:14px;
            font-weight:900;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.2s;
        }
        .lotom-freq-cell:hover{
            transform:translateY(-2px);
            z-index:2;
            border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);
        }
        .lotom-freq-cell.rhythm{
            background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);
            border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.35);
            color:#67e8f9;
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(16,185,129,.22);
            text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(6,182,212,.4);
        }
        .lotom-freq-cell.gan{
            background:rgba(239,68,68,.14);
            border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.28);
            color:#fca5a5;
            opacity:.75;
        }

        /* =========================
           SPACE 3 & 4 : TERMINAL MATRICES
        ========================= */
        .weekm-root,.yearm-root{
            height:100%;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            min-height:0;
            overflow:auto;
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a0c,#020617);
            padding:12px 10px 90px;
            gap:12px;
        }
        .drawer-zone .weekm-root,
        .drawer-zone .yearm-root{padding-top:54px}
        .termcmd-bar{
            display:flex;
            gap:10px;
        }
        .termcmd-btn{
            flex:1;
            min-height:54px;
            border-radius:12px;
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b 0%,#020617 100%);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
            box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.62), inset 0 -2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            justify-content:center;
            align-items:center;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.24s;
            padding:8px 6px;
        }
        .termcmd-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
        .termcmd-btn .txt{
            font-size:10px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:.5px;
            color:#64748b;
            margin-bottom:4px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            text-align:center;
        }
        .termcmd-btn .core{
            width:35%;
            height:4px;
            border-radius:4px;
            background:#334155;
            transition:.24s;
        }
        .termcmd-btn.active{
            background:rgba(16,185,129,.05);
            transform:translateY(-1px);
            border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.35);
        }
        .termcmd-btn.active .txt{
            color:var(--yellow);
            text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--yellow);
        }
        .termcmd-btn.active .core{
            width:75%;
            background:var(--yellow);
            box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow),0 0 30px #fef08a;
        }

        .matrixterm-card{
            background:rgba(0,0,0,.9);
            border:1px solid var(--green);
            border-radius:12px;
            padding:12px;
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(16,185,129,.08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
            position:relative;
            overflow:hidden;
            min-height:148px;
        }
        .matrixterm-card::before{
            content:"";
            position:absolute;
            inset:0;
            background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(16,185,129,.12) 1px, transparent 0);
            background-size:15px 15px;
            opacity:.28;
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .matrixterm-head{
            position:relative;
            z-index:2;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:space-between;
            gap:8px;
            border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(16,185,129,.28);
            padding-bottom:7px;
            margin-bottom:8px;
        }
        .matrixterm-title{
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            gap:8px;
            color:var(--green);
            font-size:9px;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:2px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
        }
        .matrixterm-tag{
            color:var(--green);
            border:1px solid var(--green);
            border-radius:4px;
            padding:1px 4px;
            font-size:8px;
            animation:pulse 1s infinite;
        }
        .matrixterm-body{
            position:relative;
            z-index:2;
            height:92px;
            overflow:auto;
            color:var(--green);
            font-size:10px;
            line-height:1.5;
            font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
        }
        .matrixterm-log{
            margin-bottom:3px;
            opacity:0;
            transform:translateX(-5px);
            animation:logAppear .28s forwards;
            font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
            white-space:pre-wrap;
        }
        @keyframes logAppear{
            to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
        }

        .weekm-card,.yearm-card{
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
            border-radius:12px;
            overflow:hidden;
        }
        .weekm-card-head,.yearm-card-head{
            padding:10px 12px;
            border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
            display:flex;
            justify-content:space-between;
            align-items:center;
            font-size:11px;
            color:#cbd5e1;
            font-weight:900;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            background:rgba(2,6,23,.55);
        }
        .weekm-gridwrap,.yearm-gridwrap{
            max-height:520px;
            overflow:auto;
            padding:10px;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
        }
        .weekm-grid{
            display:grid;
            grid-template-columns:repeat(7,72px);
            gap:2px;
            width:max-content;
            justify-content:center;
        }
        .yearm-grid{
            display:grid;
            grid-template-columns:50px repeat(12,72px);
            gap:2px;
            width:max-content;
        }
        .matrixcell{
            width:72px;
            height:48px;
            border-radius:4px;
            background:#1e293b;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.03);
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            flex-direction:column;
            transition:.22s;
        }
        .matrixcell:hover{
            background:#0ea5e9;
            box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(14,165,233,.55);
            transform:scale(1.04);
            z-index:2;
        }
        .matrixhead{
            position:sticky;
            top:0;
            z-index:20;
            background:#020617;
            color:var(--blue2);
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:900;
            border-bottom:1px solid #334155;
            box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
            height:35px;
        }
        .matrixrowhead{
            position:sticky;
            left:0;
            z-index:15;
            width:50px;
            background:#020617;
            color:var(--yellow);
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:900;
            border-right:1px solid #334155;
            box-shadow:2px 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
        }
        .matrixcorner{
            position:sticky;
            top:0;
            left:0;
            z-index:30;
            background:#d40000;
            color:#fff;
            font-size:12px;
            font-weight:900;
        }
        .matrixnum{
            font-size:15px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#fff;
            letter-spacing:.5px;
        }
        .matrixnum .tail{
            color:#f87171;
            text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(248,113,113,.5);
        }
        .matrixcell.dim{opacity:.08}
        .matrixcell.valid{cursor:pointer}

        /* =========================
           SPACE 7 : LIVE
        ========================= */
        .livem-root{
            height:100%;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            min-height:0;
            background:#0a0a0c;
        }
        .livem-topbar{
            background:linear-gradient(90deg,#020617,#0f172a,#020617);
            padding:10px 14px;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            gap:12px;
            border-bottom:2px solid var(--blue2);
            box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(14,165,233,.25);
            position:sticky;
            top:0;
            z-index:40;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .livem-clock{
            font-size:14px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:var(--blue2);
            text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(14,165,233,.65);
            letter-spacing:1px;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            text-align:center;
        }
        .livem-pulse{
            width:10px;
            height:10px;
            border-radius:50%;
            background:var(--red);
            box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--red);
            animation:blinkPulse 1s infinite;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }

        .livem-sub{
            display:none;
            flex-direction:column;
            flex:1;
            min-height:0;
            background:#0f172a;
            overflow:auto;
            position:relative;
        }
        .livem-sub.active{display:flex}

        .livem-lobby{
            padding:15px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:18px;
        }
        .livem-card{
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
            border-radius:16px;
            padding:15px;
            border:1px solid #334155;
            position:relative;
            overflow:hidden;
            box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.22s;
        }
        .livem-card:active{transform:scale(.97)}
        .livem-card::before{
            content:"";
            position:absolute;
            left:0;top:0;bottom:0;
            width:6px;
        }
        .livem-card[data-region="vl"]::before{background:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mb"]::before{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--red)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mn"]::before{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--blue)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mt"]::before{background:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--purple)}
        .livem-card-head{
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:space-between;
            gap:10px;
            border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.1);
            padding-bottom:10px;
            margin-bottom:10px;
        }
        .livem-region{
            font-size:18px;
            font-weight:900;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            letter-spacing:1px;
        }
        .livem-card[data-region="vl"] .livem-region{color:var(--yellow);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(250,204,21,.35)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mb"] .livem-region{color:var(--red);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(239,68,68,.35)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mn"] .livem-region{color:var(--blue2);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(14,165,233,.35)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mt"] .livem-region{color:var(--purple);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(139,92,246,.35)}
        .livem-status{
            padding:4px 12px;
            border-radius:20px;
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:900;
            background:#334155;
            color:#cbd5e1;
            transition:.25s;
        }
        .livem-status.live-now{
            background:#ef4444;
            color:#fff;
            box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.7);
            animation:statusBlink .55s infinite alternate;
        }
        @keyframes statusBlink{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:.55}}

        .livem-countdown{
            font-size:31px;
            font-weight:900;
            color:#f8fafc;
            text-align:center;
            margin:10px 0;
            padding:15px;
            background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);
            border-radius:12px;
            border:1px solid #475569;
            letter-spacing:4px;
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,.75);
            transition:.25s;
        }
        .livem-countdown span{
            display:block;
            margin-top:2px;
            font-size:12px;
            color:#94a3b8;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            font-weight:500;
        }
        .livem-countdown.warning{
            color:var(--yellow);
            border-color:var(--yellow);
            text-shadow:0 0 15px var(--yellow);
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(250,204,21,.16);
            animation:pulseWarning 1.5s infinite alternate;
        }
        .livem-countdown.danger{
            color:#ef4444;
            border-color:#ef4444;
            text-shadow:0 0 18px #ef4444;
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(239,68,68,.25);
            animation:pulseDanger .5s infinite alternate;
        }
        .livem-stations{
            font-size:14px;
            color:#cbd5e1;
            font-weight:700;
            text-align:center;
            margin-bottom:15px;
            min-height:20px;
        }
        .livem-enter{
            width:100%;
            padding:14px;
            border-radius:10px;
            font-size:14px;
            font-weight:900;
            text-transform:uppercase;
            letter-spacing:1px;
            border:none;
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .livem-card[data-region="vl"] .livem-enter{background:rgba(250,204,21,.10);border:1px solid var(--yellow);color:var(--yellow)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mb"] .livem-enter{background:rgba(239,68,68,.10);border:1px solid var(--red);color:var(--red)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mn"] .livem-enter{background:rgba(14,165,233,.10);border:1px solid var(--blue);color:var(--blue2)}
        .livem-card[data-region="mt"] .livem-enter{background:rgba(139,92,246,.10);border:1px solid var(--purple);color:#c4b5fd}

        .livem-room-head{
            background:#0a0d12;
            padding:12px 16px;
            border-bottom:1px solid #334155;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            gap:12px;
            position:sticky;
            top:0;
            z-index:20;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .livem-back{
            background:none;
            border:none;
            color:#fff;
            font-size:20px;
            cursor:pointer;
            padding:4px;
        }
        .livem-room-title{
            flex:1;
            white-space:nowrap;
            font-size:16px;
            font-weight:900;
            overflow:hidden;
            text-overflow:ellipsis;
        }
        .livem-shine{
            display:inline-block;
            background:linear-gradient(110deg,currentColor 35%, #ffffff 50%, currentColor 65%);
            background-size:200% auto;
            -webkit-background-clip:text;
            background-clip:text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
            animation:textShineSweep 3s linear infinite;
        }
        @keyframes textShineSweep{
            0%{background-position:-100% center}
            100%{background-position:200% center}
        }
        .livem-draw{
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
            color:#0ea5e9;
            border:1px solid #0284c7;
            padding:8px 14px;
            border-radius:20px;
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:900;
            cursor:pointer;
            transition:.2s;
            box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(14,165,233,.18);
            white-space:nowrap;
        }
        .livem-draw:disabled{
            background:#334155;
            color:#94a3b8;
            border-color:#475569;
            cursor:not-allowed;
            box-shadow:none;
        }

        .livem-assistant{
            position:absolute;
            top:66px;
            right:15px;
            z-index:12;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:row-reverse;
            align-items:flex-start;
            gap:10px;
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .livem-avatar{
            width:45px;
            height:45px;
            border-radius:50%;
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
            border:2px solid #0ea5e9;
            box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(14,165,233,.45);
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            font-size:24px;
            animation:floatMascot 3s infinite ease-in-out;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        @keyframes floatMascot{
            0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}
            50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}
        }
        .livem-bubble{
            max-width:220px;
            margin-top:5px;
            padding:10px 14px;
            border-radius:15px 0 15px 15px;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.95);
            border:1px solid #0ea5e9;
            color:#fff;
            font-size:12px;
            line-height:1.4;
            box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
            opacity:0;
            transform:translateY(5px) scale(.9);
            transform-origin:top right;
            transition:.22s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1);
            pointer-events:auto;
        }
        .livem-bubble.show{
            opacity:1;
            transform:translateY(0) scale(1);
        }
        .livem-highlight{
            color:var(--yellow);
            font-weight:900;
            font-size:16px;
            text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(250,204,21,.45);
        }

        .livem-feed{
            padding:24px 15px 15px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:18px;
            position:relative;
            z-index:5;
        }
        .livem-board{
            background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
            border-radius:12px;
            padding:15px;
            position:relative;
            overflow:hidden;
            transform:scale(1.01);
            box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,.62), inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
            border:2px solid #334155;
        }
        .livem-board::after{
            content:"";
            position:absolute;
            top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:200%;
            background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(14,165,233,.02) 0%, transparent 10%, transparent 90%, rgba(14,165,233,.02) 100%);
            pointer-events:none;
            z-index:1;
            animation:boardScanline 4s linear infinite;
        }
        @keyframes boardScanline{
            from{transform:translateY(-40%)}
            to{transform:translateY(10%)}
        }
        .livem-theme-mb .livem-board{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(239,68,68,.22)}
        .livem-theme-mn .livem-board{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(14,165,233,.22)}
        .livem-theme-mt .livem-board{border-color:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(139,92,246,.22)}
        .livem-theme-vl .livem-board{border-color:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(250,204,21,.22)}

        .livem-board-head{
            text-align:center;
            margin-bottom:15px;
            padding-bottom:10px;
            border-bottom:1px dashed #334155;
            font-size:15px;
            font-weight:900;
            position:relative;
            z-index:2;
        }
        .livem-row{
            display:flex;
            margin-bottom:8px;
            gap:8px;
            align-items:stretch;
            position:relative;
            z-index:2;
        }
        .livem-prize{
            width:45px;
            flex-shrink:0;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            font-size:14px;
            font-weight:900;
            background:#0f172a;
            color:#94a3b8;
            border-radius:8px;
            border:1px solid #334155;
            transition:.2s;
        }
        .livem-prize.db{
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d40000,#990000);
            color:#fff;
            border-color:#ff5252;
        }
        .livem-prize.active-led{
            background:#0ea5e9;
            color:#fff;
            border-color:#38bdf8;
            box-shadow:0 0 15px #0ea5e9;
            transform:scale(1.04);
        }
        .livem-results{
            flex:1;
            display:grid;
            gap:6px;
        }
        .livem-grid-1{grid-template-columns:1fr}
        .livem-grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
        .livem-grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
        .livem-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
        .livem-grid-6{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
        .livem-grid-7{
            display:flex;
            flex-wrap:wrap;
            justify-content:center;
            gap:6px;
        }
        .livem-grid-7 .livem-box{width:calc(25% - 4.5px)}
        .livem-grid-vl{
            display:flex;
            flex-wrap:wrap;
            justify-content:center;
            gap:8px;
        }
        .livem-grid-vl .livem-box{
            width:45px;
            height:45px;
            border-radius:50%;
            border:2px solid var(--yellow);
            background:rgba(250,204,21,.1);
        }
        .livem-box{
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0f172a,#020617);
            border:1px solid #334155;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            border-radius:6px;
            min-height:36px;
            overflow:hidden;
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
            padding:0 2px;
        }
        .livem-row.db .livem-box{
            min-height:50px;
            background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(239,68,68,.1),#0f172a);
            border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.28);
            box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(239,68,68,.18);
        }
        .livem-number{
            width:100%;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            color:#fff;
            font-weight:900;
            transition:.2s;
        }
        .livem-row.db .livem-number{
            font-size:26px;
            color:var(--red);
            letter-spacing:4px;
            text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(239,68,68,.45);
        }
        .livem-grid-vl .livem-number{
            font-size:18px;
            color:var(--yellow);
            letter-spacing:0;
        }
        .livem-grid-1 .livem-number{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:4px}
        .livem-grid-2 .livem-number{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:3px}
        .livem-grid-3 .livem-number{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:1.5px}
        .livem-grid-4 .livem-number{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.5px}
        .livem-grid-6 .livem-number,
        .livem-grid-7 .livem-number{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0}
        .livem-dots{
            display:flex;
            gap:2px;
        }
        .livem-dot{
            width:5px;
            height:5px;
            border-radius:50%;
            background:#475569;
            box-shadow:0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
        }
        .livem-number.spinning{
            color:#0ea5e9;
            filter:blur(.8px) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(14,165,233,.8));
            animation:cyberGlitch .2s linear infinite;
        }
        @keyframes cyberGlitch{
            0%{transform:translate(0) scale(1);opacity:1}
            20%{transform:translate(-1px,1px) scale(1.02);opacity:.8}
            40%{transform:translate(-1px,-1px) scale(.98);opacity:.9}
            60%{transform:translate(1px,1px) scale(1.02);opacity:1}
            80%{transform:translate(1px,-1px) scale(.98);opacity:.8}
            100%{transform:translate(0) scale(1);opacity:1}
        }

        .livem-chatbox{
            margin:10px 15px 15px;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.85);
            backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
            border:1px solid #334155;
            border-radius:12px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            height:176px;
            flex-shrink:0;
            box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
            position:relative;
            overflow:hidden;
            z-index:10;
        }
        .livem-theme-mb .livem-chatbox{border-top:3px solid var(--red)}
        .livem-theme-mn .livem-chatbox{border-top:3px solid var(--blue)}
        .livem-theme-mt .livem-chatbox{border-top:3px solid var(--purple)}
        .livem-theme-vl .livem-chatbox{border-top:3px solid var(--yellow)}
        .livem-chathead{
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:900;
            text-align:center;
            padding:6px;
            color:#94a3b8;
            border-bottom:1px dashed #334155;
            background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
        }
        .livem-chatstream{
            flex:1;
            overflow:auto;
            padding:8px 10px;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            gap:6px;
            scroll-behavior:smooth;
        }
        .livem-chatmsg{
            font-size:12px;
            line-height:1.3;
            display:flex;
            flex-direction:column;
            animation:slideInLeft .3s ease-out;
        }
        .livem-chatmsg .u{
            font-weight:900;
            font-size:10px;
            margin-bottom:2px;
        }
        .livem-theme-mb .livem-chatmsg .u{color:#fca5a5}
        .livem-theme-mn .livem-chatmsg .u{color:#bae6fd}
        .livem-theme-mt .livem-chatmsg .u{color:#ddd6fe}
        .livem-theme-vl .livem-chatmsg .u{color:#fef08a}
        .livem-chatmsg .t{
            display:inline-block;
            width:fit-content;
            color:#f8fafc;
            background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
            padding:6px 10px;
            border-radius:4px 8px 8px 8px;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
        }
        .livem-chatmsg.self{align-items:flex-end}
        .livem-chatmsg.self .u{color:var(--green)}
        .livem-chatmsg.self .t{
            background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);
            border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.3);
            border-radius:8px 4px 8px 8px;
        }
        @keyframes slideInLeft{
            from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-10px)}
            to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}
        }

        .livem-smartui{
            position:absolute;
            bottom:15px;
            right:15px;
            z-index:20;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:flex-end;
        }
        .livem-smartbtn{
            width:45px;
            height:45px;
            border-radius:50%;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.85);
            backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
            border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
            box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            cursor:pointer;
            position:relative;
            z-index:2;
            transition:.22s;
        }
        .livem-smartbtn::after{
            content:"";
            width:20px;
            height:20px;
            border-radius:50%;
            border:2px solid #94a3b8;
            transition:.22s;
        }
        .livem-smartbtn:active{
            transform:scale(.94);
            border-color:#0ea5e9;
        }
        .livem-smartbtn:active::after{
            border-color:#0ea5e9;
            box-shadow:0 0 10px #0ea5e9;
        }

        .livem-voicebar{
            position:absolute;
            right:22px;
            width:0;
            height:45px;
            opacity:0;
            pointer-events:none;
            overflow:hidden;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            background:rgba(15,23,42,.95);
            border-radius:25px;
            border:1px solid transparent;
            transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
            box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,0);
        }
        .livem-voicebar.active{
            width:calc(100vw - 70px);
            max-width:340px;
            opacity:1;
            pointer-events:auto;
            border-color:#0ea5e9;
            box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,.35);
        }
        .livem-voicemic,
        .livem-voicesend{
            width:33px;
            height:33px;
            border-radius:50%;
            border:none;
            display:flex;
            align-items:center;
            justify-content:center;
            color:#fff;
            cursor:pointer;
            flex-shrink:0;
            transition:.2s;
        }
        .livem-voicemic{
            margin-left:6px;
            background:#334155;
            font-size:14px;
        }
        .livem-voicemic.recording{
            background:#ef4444;
            box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.72);
        }
        .livem-voicesend{
            margin-right:6px;
            background:#0ea5e9;
            box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(14,165,233,.25);
            font-size:16px;
            padding-left:2px;
        }
        .livem-voicesend:active{transform:scale(.86)}
        .livem-wave{
            display:none;
            gap:3px;
            align-items:center;
            height:20px;
            margin-left:5px;
            width:25px;
            flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .livem-wave.active{display:flex}
        .livem-wavebar{
            width:3px;
            border-radius:3px;
            background:#ef4444;
            animation:waveBounce .5s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
        }
        .livem-wavebar:nth-child(1){animation-delay:0s}
        .livem-wavebar:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.1s}
        .livem-wavebar:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.2s}
        .livem-wavebar:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.3s}
        @keyframes waveBounce{
            0%{height:4px}
            100%{height:18px;box-shadow:0 0 5px #ef4444}
        }
        .livem-voiceinput{
            flex:1;
            min-width:0;
            background:transparent;
            border:none;
            color:#fff;
            padding:0 10px;
            font-size:13px;
            font-weight:700;
            outline:none;
            width:100%;
            white-space:nowrap;
            overflow-x:auto;
            pointer-events:none;
        }
        .livem-voiceinput::placeholder{
            color:#64748b;
            font-size:11px;
            font-weight:400;
        }
        .livem-heartbtn{
            position:absolute;
            bottom:70px;
            right:15px;
            z-index:20;
            background:none;
            border:none;
            font-size:28px;
            cursor:pointer;
            filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(239,68,68,.5));
            transition:.2s;
        }
        .livem-heartbtn:active{transform:scale(.82)}
        .livem-heartfloat{position:relative;z-index:1}
        .livem-floatingheart{
            position:absolute;
            font-size:20px;
            pointer-events:none;
            z-index:30;
            animation:flyUpHeart 1.5s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) forwards;
            filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px red);
        }
        @keyframes flyUpHeart{
            0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0deg)}
            100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-120px) scale(1.5) rotate(20deg)}
        }

        @media (max-width:400px){
            .livem-countdown{font-size:28px}
            .rx-bridge-station-label{font-size:13px}
            .lotom-freq-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr)}
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="master-app-wrapper">
        <div class="toast-stack" id="toast-stack"></div>

        <div class="confirm-overlay" id="confirm-overlay">
            <div class="confirm-card">
                <div class="confirm-title" id="confirm-title">Xác nhận</div>
                <div class="confirm-message" id="confirm-message">Bạn có chắc không?</div>
                <div class="confirm-actions">
                    <button class="shell-btn secondary" id="confirm-cancel">Hủy</button>
                    <button class="shell-btn danger" id="confirm-ok">Đồng ý</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="wormhole-fab" class="global-ai-fab">⚛️</div>

        <!-- TAB 1: MIỀN BẮC -->
        <div id="TAB_MIEN_BAC" class="main-tab-container active">
            <button id="back-btn-mb" class="glass-back-btn" aria-label="Quay lại">
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"></polyline></svg>
            </button>

            <div id="top-handle-mb" class="drawer-handle top-handle style-loto">▼ LÔ TÔ</div>
            <div id="bot-handle-mb" class="drawer-handle bot-handle style-tuan">▲ ĐẶC BIỆT TUẦN</div>

            <div class="core-region">
                <div id="ZONE_MB_CORE" class="rx-zone module-zone mb-core"></div>
            </div>

            <div id="drawer-loto-mb" class="space-drawer drawer-top">
                <div id="ZONE_LOTO_MB" class="rx-zone module-zone drawer-zone"></div>
            </div>

            <div id="drawer-tuan-mb" class="space-drawer drawer-bot">
                <div id="ZONE_WEEK_MB" class="rx-zone module-zone drawer-zone"></div>
            </div>

            <div id="drawer-nam-mb" class="space-drawer drawer-top" style="z-index:8600;">
                <div id="ZONE_YEAR_MB" class="rx-zone module-zone drawer-zone"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 2: MIỀN NAM -->
        <div id="TAB_MIEN_NAM" class="main-tab-container">
            <button id="back-btn-mn" class="glass-back-btn" aria-label="Quay lại">
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"></polyline></svg>
            </button>

            <div id="top-handle-mn" class="drawer-handle top-handle style-mt">▼ MIỀN TRUNG</div>

            <div class="core-region">
                <div id="ZONE_MN_CORE" class="rx-zone module-zone mn-core"></div>
            </div>

            <div id="drawer-mt-mn" class="space-drawer drawer-top" style="border-bottom-color: var(--orange);">
                <div id="ZONE_MT_CORE" class="rx-zone module-zone drawer-zone mt-core"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 3: LIVE -->
        <div id="TAB_TRUC_TIEP" class="main-tab-container">
            <div class="core-region">
                <div id="ZONE_LIVE_CORE" class="rx-zone module-zone live-core"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 4: AI BRAIN -->
        <div id="TAB_BO_NAO_AI" class="main-tab-container">
            <div class="ai-brain-space">
                <div class="ai-header">
                    <div class="ai-title-row">
                        <div class="pulse-dot"></div>
                        <div class="ai-title">BỘ NÃO AI TRUNG TÂM RX</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="ai-meta" id="ai-meta">GLOBAL COMMAND CENTER • ONLINE</div>
                </div>

                <div class="chat-panel-3d">
                    <div class="chat-messages" id="chat-box"></div>

                    <div class="chat-plus-menu" id="plus-menu"></div>

                    <div class="chat-input-area">
                        <button class="btn-action-chat" id="ai-plus-btn">+</button>
                        <input type="text" class="chat-input" id="chat-input" placeholder="Ra lệnh cho bộ não trung tâm..." autocomplete="off">
                        <button class="btn-action-chat" id="ai-mic-btn">🎤</button>
                        <button class="btn-send" id="ai-send-btn">➤</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 5: SETTINGS -->
        <div id="TAB_CAI_DAT" class="main-tab-container">
            <div class="settings-space">
                <div class="settings-header">⚙️ HỆ THỐNG CÀI ĐẶT</div>

                <div class="setting-item" id="setting-register">
                    <div class="setting-icon">👤</div>
                    <div>Đăng ký tài khoản hệ thống</div>
                </div>

                <div class="setting-item" id="setting-map">
                    <div class="setting-icon">🗺️</div>
                    <div>Chú thích bản đồ Apple</div>
                </div>

                <div class="setting-item youtube" id="setting-youtube">
                    <div class="setting-icon">📺</div>
                    <div>Kênh YouTube của tôi</div>
                </div>

                <div class="setting-item bug" id="setting-bug">
                    <div class="setting-icon">⚠️</div>
                    <div>Báo lỗi Hệ thống</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="bottom-nav">
            <div id="nav-btn-mb" class="nav-item active-mb" data-tab="mb">
                <div class="nav-item-inner"><div class="nav-icon">⭐</div><div class="nav-text">Miền Bắc</div></div>
            </div>
            <div id="nav-btn-mn" class="nav-item" data-tab="mn">
                <div class="nav-item-inner"><div class="nav-icon">🌴</div><div class="nav-text">Miền Nam</div></div>
            </div>
            <div id="nav-btn-live" class="nav-item" data-tab="live">
                <div class="nav-item-inner"><div class="nav-icon">▶️</div><div class="nav-text">Trực Tiếp</div></div>
            </div>
            <div id="nav-btn-ai" class="nav-item" data-tab="ai">
                <div class="nav-item-inner"><div class="nav-icon">🧠</div><div class="nav-text">Bộ Não AI</div></div>
            </div>
            <div id="nav-btn-set" class="nav-item" data-tab="set">
                <div class="nav-item-inner"><div class="nav-icon">⚙️</div><div class="nav-text">Cài Đặt</div></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
    (() => {
        'use strict';

        const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
        const $$ = (sel, root = document) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(sel));

        const MB_SCHEDULE = { 0: "Thái Bình", 1: "Hà Nội", 2: "Quảng Ninh", 3: "Bắc Ninh", 4: "Hà Nội", 5: "Hải Phòng", 6: "Nam Định" };
        const MN_STATIONS = [
            "TP. HCM","Đồng Tháp","Cà Mau","Bến Tre","Vũng Tàu","Bạc Liêu",
            "Đồng Nai","Cần Thơ","Sóc Trăng","Tây Ninh","An Giang","Bình Thuận",
            "Vĩnh Long","Bình Dương","Trà Vinh","Long An","Bình Phước","Hậu Giang",
            "Tiền Giang","Kiên Giang","Đà Lạt"
        ];
        const MT_STATIONS = [
            "Thừa T. Huế","Phú Yên","Đắk Lắk","Quảng Nam","Đà Nẵng","Khánh Hòa",
            "Bình Định","Quảng Trị","Quảng Bình","Gia Lai","Ninh Thuận",
            "Quảng Ngãi","Đắk Nông","Kon Tum"
        ];
        const DAILY_MAP_MN = { 0:"Tiền Giang",1:"TP. HCM",2:"Bến Tre",3:"Đồng Nai",4:"Tây Ninh",5:"Vĩnh Long",6:"TP. HCM" };
        const DAILY_MAP_MT = { 0:"Khánh Hòa",1:"Thừa T. Huế",2:"Đắk Lắk",3:"Đà Nẵng",4:"Bình Định",5:"Gia Lai",6:"Đà Nẵng" };

        const AppModules = {};
        let centralAI = null;
        let currentMainTab = 'mb';
        let lastNonAITab = 'mb';
        let mbState = 'core';
        let mnState = 'core';

        function normalizeText(str) {
            return (str || '')
                .toLowerCase()
                .normalize('NFD')
                .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
                .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                .trim();
        }

        function pad(n, len = 2) {
            return String(n).padStart(len, '0');
        }

        function formatDateVN(date) {
            return date.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', {
                weekday: 'long',
                year: 'numeric',
                month: '2-digit',
                day: '2-digit'
            });
        }

        function nowClockString() {
            return new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour12: false });
        }

        function hashString(str) {
            let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
                h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
                h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
            }
            return h >>> 0;
        }

        function mulberry32(a) {
            return function() {
                let t = a += 0x6D2B79F5;
                t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
                t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
                return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
            };
        }

        function randomDigits(rng, length) {
            let s = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) s += Math.floor(rng() * 10);
            return s;
        }

        function applyTail(num, tail) {
            const n = String(num);
            const t = String(tail);
            if (t.length >= n.length) return t.slice(-n.length);
            return n.slice(0, n.length - t.length) + t;
        }

        function pulseElement(el) {
            if (!el) return;
            el.classList.remove('shell-flash');
            void el.offsetWidth;
            el.classList.add('shell-flash');
            setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('shell-flash'), 760);
        }

        // =========================
        // TOAST + CONFIRM
        // =========================
        let toastTimer = 0;
        function showToast(message, type = 'info', duration = 2400) {
            const stack = $('toast-stack');
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = `toast ${type}`;
            div.textContent = message;
            stack.appendChild(div);
            clearTimeout(toastTimer);
            toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
                div.style.opacity = '0';
                div.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px)';
                setTimeout(() => div.remove(), 220);
            }, duration);
        }

        let confirmCallback = null;
        function showConfirm(message, onYes, title = 'Xác nhận') {
            $('confirm-title').textContent = title;
            $('confirm-message').textContent = message;
            confirmCallback = onYes;
            $('confirm-overlay').classList.add('show');
        }
        function hideConfirm() {
            $('confirm-overlay').classList.remove('show');
            confirmCallback = null;
        }

        $('confirm-cancel').addEventListener('click', hideConfirm);
        $('confirm-ok').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const cb = confirmCallback;
            hideConfirm();
            if (typeof cb === 'function') cb();
        });
        $('confirm-overlay').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === $('confirm-overlay')) hideConfirm();
        });

        // =========================
        // NAV / DRAWER STATE
        // =========================
        function getContextLabelByState(tab = currentMainTab) {
            const effectiveTab = tab === 'ai' ? lastNonAITab : tab;
            if (effectiveTab === 'mb') {
                if (mbState === 'loto') return 'Miền Bắc / Lô Tô';
                if (mbState === 'tuan') return 'Miền Bắc / Đặc Biệt Tuần';
                if (mbState === 'nam') return 'Miền Bắc / Đặc Biệt Năm 2026';
                return 'Miền Bắc / KQXS';
            }
            if (effectiveTab === 'mn') {
                if (mnState === 'mt') return 'Miền Trung / KQXS';
                return 'Miền Nam / KQXS';
            }
            if (effectiveTab === 'live') {
                if (AppModules.live && AppModules.live.getCurrentRegionLabel) return 'Live / ' + AppModules.live.getCurrentRegionLabel();
                return 'Live / Lobby';
            }
            if (effectiveTab === 'set') return 'Cài đặt';
            return 'Bộ Não AI';
        }

        function notifyContextChange() {
            if (currentMainTab !== 'ai') lastNonAITab = currentMainTab;
            if (centralAI) centralAI.updateContext();
        }

        function switchMainTab(targetTab, options = {}) {
            if (targetTab !== 'ai') lastNonAITab = targetTab;

            $$('.main-tab-container').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
            $$('.nav-item').forEach(n => n.classList.remove('active-mb','active-mn','active-live','active-ai','active-set'));

            $('wormhole-fab').classList.toggle('hidden', targetTab === 'ai');

            if (targetTab === 'mb') {
                ensureMBCore();
                $('TAB_MIEN_BAC').classList.add('active');
                $('nav-btn-mb').classList.add('active-mb');
                if (!options.preserve) updateStateMB('core', true);
            } else if (targetTab === 'mn') {
                ensureMNCore();
                $('TAB_MIEN_NAM').classList.add('active');
                $('nav-btn-mn').classList.add('active-mn');
                if (!options.preserve) updateStateMN('core', true);
            } else if (targetTab === 'live') {
                ensureLiveCore();
                $('TAB_TRUC_TIEP').classList.add('active');
                $('nav-btn-live').classList.add('active-live');
            } else if (targetTab === 'ai') {
                $('TAB_BO_NAO_AI').classList.add('active');
                $('nav-btn-ai').classList.add('active-ai');
            } else if (targetTab === 'set') {
                $('TAB_CAI_DAT').classList.add('active');
                $('nav-btn-set').classList.add('active-set');
            }

            currentMainTab = targetTab;
            notifyContextChange();
            if (centralAI) centralAI.hideMenu();
        }

        function updateStateMB(newState, silent = false) {
            mbState = newState;

            const topH = $('top-handle-mb');
            const botH = $('bot-handle-mb');
            const backBtn = $('back-btn-mb');
            const loto = $('drawer-loto-mb');
            const tuan = $('drawer-tuan-mb');
            const nam = $('drawer-nam-mb');

            loto.classList.remove('open');
            tuan.classList.remove('open');
            nam.classList.remove('open');

            if (newState === 'core') {
                ensureMBCore();
                topH.className = 'drawer-handle top-handle style-loto';
                topH.textContent = '▼ LÔ TÔ';
                topH.style.display = 'flex';
                botH.style.display = 'flex';
                backBtn.classList.remove('show');
            } else if (newState === 'loto') {
                ensureLoto();
                loto.classList.add('open');
                topH.style.display = 'none';
                botH.style.display = 'none';
                backBtn.classList.add('show');
            } else if (newState === 'tuan') {
                ensureWeek();
                tuan.classList.add('open');
                topH.className = 'drawer-handle top-handle style-nam';
                topH.textContent = '▼ ĐẶC BIỆT NĂM';
                topH.style.display = 'flex';
                botH.style.display = 'none';
                backBtn.classList.add('show');
            } else if (newState === 'nam') {
                ensureWeek();
                ensureYear();
                tuan.classList.add('open');
                nam.classList.add('open');
                topH.style.display = 'none';
                botH.style.display = 'none';
                backBtn.classList.add('show');
            }

            notifyContextChange();
            if (!silent) {
                if (newState === 'loto') showToast('Đã mở ngăn Lô Tô Miền Bắc.', 'info');
                if (newState === 'tuan') showToast('Đã mở Đặc Biệt Tuần.', 'info');
                if (newState === 'nam') showToast('Đã mở Đặc Biệt Năm 2026.', 'info');
                if (newState === 'core') showToast('Đã quay về lõi KQXS Miền Bắc.', 'info');
            }

            setTimeout(() => {
                if (AppModules.mb && AppModules.mb.refreshLayout) AppModules.mb.refreshLayout();
            }, 360);
        }

        function handleTopClickMB() {
            if (mbState === 'core') updateStateMB('loto');
            else if (mbState === 'tuan') updateStateMB('nam');
        }

        function goBackMB() {
            if (mbState === 'nam') updateStateMB('tuan');
            else updateStateMB('core');
        }

        function updateStateMN(newState, silent = false) {
            mnState = newState;

            const topH = $('top-handle-mn');
            const backBtn = $('back-btn-mn');
            const mtDrawer = $('drawer-mt-mn');

            mtDrawer.classList.remove('open');

            if (newState === 'core') {
                ensureMNCore();
                topH.style.display = 'flex';
                backBtn.classList.remove('show');
            } else if (newState === 'mt') {
                ensureMNCore();
                ensureMTCore();
                mtDrawer.classList.add('open');
                topH.style.display = 'none';
                backBtn.classList.add('show');
            }

            notifyContextChange();
            if (!silent) {
                if (newState === 'mt') showToast('Ngăn kéo Miền Trung đã trượt đè lên Miền Nam.', 'info');
                if (newState === 'core') showToast('Đã quay về lõi Miền Nam.', 'info');
            }

            setTimeout(() => {
                if (AppModules.mt && AppModules.mt.refreshLayout) AppModules.mt.refreshLayout();
                if (AppModules.mn && AppModules.mn.refreshLayout) AppModules.mn.refreshLayout();
            }, 360);
        }

        // =========================
        // CENTRAL AI
        // =========================
        function createCentralAI() {
            const chatBox = $('chat-box');
            const input = $('chat-input');
            const plusMenu = $('plus-menu');
            const meta = $('ai-meta');
            const plusBtn = $('ai-plus-btn');
            const sendBtn = $('ai-send-btn');
            const micBtn = $('ai-mic-btn');

            let recognition = null;
            let isRecording = false;

            function append(role, text) {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = `msg ${role}`;
                div.textContent = text;
                chatBox.appendChild(div);
                while (chatBox.children.length > 80) {
                    chatBox.removeChild(chatBox.firstChild);
                }
                chatBox.scrollTop = chatBox.scrollHeight;
            }

            function bootGreeting() {
                append('ai', 'RX Core online.\n7/7 không gian đã được gắn vào đúng tọa độ.\nTôi là Bộ Não AI trung tâm: nhận lệnh, điều phối cầu, mở drawer, đổi đài, vào live, quay thử.');
            }

            function detectRegion(norm) {
                if (/vietlott|\bvl\b/.test(norm)) return 'vl';
                if (/mien trung|xsmt|\bmt\b/.test(norm)) return 'mt';
                if (/mien nam|xsmn|\bmn\b/.test(norm)) return 'mn';
                if (/mien bac|xsmb|\bmb\b/.test(norm)) return 'mb';
                return null;
            }

            function findStationFromCommand(norm) {
                for (const s of MN_STATIONS) {
                    if (norm.includes(normalizeText(s))) return { region: 'mn', station: s };
                }
                for (const s of MT_STATIONS) {
                    if (norm.includes(normalizeText(s))) return { region: 'mt', station: s };
                }
                return null;
            }

            function getSlots() {
                const contextTab = currentMainTab === 'ai' ? lastNonAITab : currentMainTab;

                if (contextTab === 'mb') {
                    if (mbState === 'core') {
                        return [
                            { icon:'⭐', label:'Soi cầu MB', cmd:'soi cầu 68 miền bắc' },
                            { icon:'📊', label:'Mở Lô Tô', cmd:'mở lô tô' },
                            { icon:'🗓', label:'Đặc Biệt Tuần', cmd:'mở đặc biệt tuần' },
                            { icon:'🎯', label:'Cầu 79 MB', cmd:'soi cầu 79 miền bắc' },
                            { icon:'🔴', label:'Live MB', cmd:'vào live miền bắc' }
                        ];
                    }
                    if (mbState === 'loto') {
                        return [
                            { icon:'🏆', label:'Lô Top VIP', cmd:'lô top vip' },
                            { icon:'📈', label:'Lô Nhịp Đẹp', cmd:'lô nhịp đẹp' },
                            { icon:'🔥', label:'Lô Gan', cmd:'lô gan' },
                            { icon:'🗓', label:'Đặc Biệt Tuần', cmd:'mở đặc biệt tuần' },
                            { icon:'⬅', label:'Về XSMB', cmd:'trở về' }
                        ];
                    }
                    if (mbState === 'tuan') {
                        return [
                            { icon:'🗓', label:'Mở Năm 2026', cmd:'mở đặc biệt năm 2026' },
                            { icon:'⭐', label:'Soi Cầu Tuần', cmd:'soi cầu 68 miền bắc' },
                            { icon:'🧠', label:'Phòng AI', cmd:'phòng ai' },
                            { icon:'📊', label:'Mở Lô Tô', cmd:'mở lô tô' },
                            { icon:'⬅', label:'Về XSMB', cmd:'trở về' }
                        ];
                    }
                    return [
                        { icon:'📅', label:'Soi Cầu Năm', cmd:'soi cầu 86 miền bắc' },
                        { icon:'📊', label:'Thống Kê Năm', cmd:'thống kê năm 2026' },
                        { icon:'🗓', label:'Về Tuần', cmd:'mở đặc biệt tuần' },
                        { icon:'📊', label:'Mở Lô Tô', cmd:'mở lô tô' },
                        { icon:'⬅', label:'Về XSMB', cmd:'trở về' }
                    ];
                }

                if (contextTab === 'mn') {
                    if (mnState === 'mt') {
                        return [
                            { icon:'🏖', label:'Soi Cầu MT', cmd:'soi cầu 79 miền trung' },
                            { icon:'📍', label:'Đổi Đài ĐN', cmd:'đổi đài đà nẵng' },
                            { icon:'📍', label:'Đổi Đài Khánh Hòa', cmd:'đổi đài khánh hòa' },
                            { icon:'🔴', label:'Live MT', cmd:'vào live miền trung' },
                            { icon:'⬅', label:'Về Miền Nam', cmd:'trở về' }
                        ];
                    }
                    return [
                        { icon:'🌴', label:'Soi Cầu MN', cmd:'soi cầu 23 miền nam' },
                        { icon:'📍', label:'Đổi Đài Cần Thơ', cmd:'đổi đài cần thơ' },
                        { icon:'📍', label:'Đổi Đài TP.HCM', cmd:'đổi đài tp hcm' },
                        { icon:'🏖', label:'Mở Miền Trung', cmd:'mở miền trung' },
                        { icon:'🔴', label:'Live MN', cmd:'vào live miền nam' }
                    ];
                }

                if (contextTab === 'live') {
                    return [
                        { icon:'🔴', label:'Live MB', cmd:'vào live miền bắc' },
                        { icon:'🔴', label:'Live MN', cmd:'vào live miền nam' },
                        { icon:'🔴', label:'Live MT', cmd:'vào live miền trung' },
                        { icon:'🎲', label:'Quay Thử MB', cmd:'quay thử miền bắc' },
                        { icon:'🏠', label:'Về Lobby', cmd:'về sảnh live' }
                    ];
                }

                return [
                    { icon:'⭐', label:'Miền Bắc', cmd:'mở miền bắc' },
                    { icon:'🌴', label:'Miền Nam', cmd:'mở miền nam' },
                    { icon:'🏖', label:'Miền Trung', cmd:'mở miền trung' },
                    { icon:'🔴', label:'Sảnh Live', cmd:'mở live miền bắc' },
                    { icon:'📊', label:'Mở Lô Tô', cmd:'mở lô tô' }
                ];
            }

            function renderSlots() {
                const slots = getSlots();
                plusMenu.innerHTML = slots.map(item => `
                    <div class="plus-menu-item" data-cmd="${item.cmd}">
                        <span>${item.icon}</span>
                        <span>${item.label}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }

            function updateContext() {
                meta.textContent = `GLOBAL COMMAND CENTER • ${getContextLabelByState()} • ONLINE`;
                renderSlots();
                input.placeholder = `Ra lệnh • ${getContextLabelByState()}`;
            }

            function hideMenu() {
                plusMenu.classList.remove('show');
            }

            function openWithPreset(text = '') {
                switchMainTab('ai', { preserve: true });
                updateContext();
                input.value = text;
                input.focus();
                hideMenu();
            }

            function telemetry(source, text) {
                append('ai', `【${source}】 ${text}`);
            }

            function reply(text) {
                append('ai', text);
            }

            function execute(raw) {
                const norm = normalizeText(raw);
                const numberMatch = norm.match(/\b\d{2,6}\b/);
                const number = numberMatch ? numberMatch[0] : null;
                const region = detectRegion(norm);
                const stationInfo = findStationFromCommand(norm);
                let handled = false;
                const replies = [];

                if (/ve sanh live|ve lobby|ve sanh/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLiveCore();
                    switchMainTab('live', { preserve: true });
                    AppModules.live.exitRoom();
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã quay về sảnh Live.');
                }

                if (!handled && /mo lo to|lo to/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLoto();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('loto', true);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã mở Không gian Thống kê Lô Tô Miền Bắc.');
                }

                if (!handled && /dac biet tuan|db tuan/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureWeek();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('tuan', true);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã mở Đặc Biệt Tuần.');
                }

                if (!handled && /dac biet nam|db nam|nam 2026|thong ke nam/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureYear();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('nam', true);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã mở Đặc Biệt Năm 2026.');
                }

                if (!handled && /lo top|top vip/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLoto();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('loto', true);
                    setTimeout(() => AppModules.loto.focusTop(), 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã khóa vào bảng Lô Top VIP.');
                }

                if (!handled && /lo nhip dep|nhip dep/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLoto();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('loto', true);
                    setTimeout(() => AppModules.loto.focusFreq('RHYTHM'), 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã lọc Lô Nhịp Đẹp trong ngăn Lô Tô.');
                }

                if (!handled && /lo gan/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLoto();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('loto', true);
                    setTimeout(() => AppModules.loto.focusFreq('GAN'), 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã lọc Lô Gan trong ngăn Lô Tô.');
                }

                if (!handled && /lo don/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLoto();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('loto', true);
                    setTimeout(() => AppModules.loto.setMode('single'), 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã chuyển ma trận sang Lô Đơn.');
                }

                if (!handled && /lo cap/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLoto();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('loto', true);
                    setTimeout(() => AppModules.loto.setMode('pair'), 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã chuyển ma trận sang Lô Cặp.');
                }

                if (!handled && /lo kep/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLoto();
                    switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMB('loto', true);
                    setTimeout(() => AppModules.loto.setMode('double'), 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã chuyển ma trận sang Lô Kép.');
                }

                if (!handled && /quay thu/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLiveCore();
                    const liveRegion = region || 'mb';
                    switchMainTab('live', { preserve: true });
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        AppModules.live.enterRoom(liveRegion);
                        setTimeout(() => AppModules.live.trigger(liveRegion), 280);
                    }, 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push(`Đã kích hoạt quay thử ${liveRegion === 'mb' ? 'Miền Bắc' : liveRegion === 'mn' ? 'Miền Nam' : liveRegion === 'mt' ? 'Miền Trung' : 'Vietlott'}.`);
                }

                if (!handled && /vao live|mo live|truc tiep|sanh live/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureLiveCore();
                    const liveRegion = region || 'mb';
                    switchMainTab('live', { preserve: true });
                    setTimeout(() => AppModules.live.enterRoom(liveRegion), 120);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push(`Đã mở phòng Live ${liveRegion === 'mb' ? 'Miền Bắc' : liveRegion === 'mn' ? 'Miền Nam' : liveRegion === 'mt' ? 'Miền Trung' : 'Vietlott'}.`);
                }

                if (!handled && /soi cau|noi cau|cau td|tu dong/.test(norm)) {
                    const inferredRegion =
                        region ||
                        (currentMainTab === 'mn' && mnState === 'mt' ? 'mt' :
                        currentMainTab === 'mn' ? 'mn' :
                        currentMainTab === 'mb' ? 'mb' : 'mb');

                    if (inferredRegion === 'mb') {
                        ensureMBCore();
                        switchMainTab('mb', { preserve: true });
                        updateStateMB('core', true);
                        setTimeout(() => AppModules.mb.runAIBridge(number, 'ai-brain'), 140);
                        handled = true;
                        replies.push(`Đã phát lệnh soi cầu ${number ? number + ' ' : ''}Miền Bắc.`);
                    } else if (inferredRegion === 'mn') {
                        ensureMNCore();
                        switchMainTab('mn', { preserve: true });
                        updateStateMN('core', true);
                        setTimeout(() => AppModules.mn.runAIBridge(number, 'ai-brain'), 140);
                        handled = true;
                        replies.push(`Đã phát lệnh soi cầu ${number ? number + ' ' : ''}Miền Nam.`);
                    } else if (inferredRegion === 'mt') {
                        ensureMTCore();
                        switchMainTab('mn', { preserve: true });
                        updateStateMN('mt', true);
                        setTimeout(() => AppModules.mt.runAIBridge(number, 'ai-brain'), 220);
                        handled = true;
                        replies.push(`Đã phát lệnh soi cầu ${number ? number + ' ' : ''}Miền Trung.`);
                    }
                }

                if (!handled && /doi dai|chuyen dai/.test(norm)) {
                    if (stationInfo) {
                        if (stationInfo.region === 'mn') {
                            ensureMNCore();
                            switchMainTab('mn', { preserve: true });
                            updateStateMN('core', true);
                            setTimeout(() => AppModules.mn.setStationByName(stationInfo.station), 140);
                            replies.push(`Đã chuyển đài Miền Nam sang ${stationInfo.station}.`);
                        } else {
                            ensureMTCore();
                            switchMainTab('mn', { preserve: true });
                            updateStateMN('mt', true);
                            setTimeout(() => AppModules.mt.setStationByName(stationInfo.station), 220);
                            replies.push(`Đã chuyển đài Miền Trung sang ${stationInfo.station}.`);
                        }
                        handled = true;
                    } else {
                        replies.push('Tôi chưa nhận diện được tên đài. Ví dụ: "đổi đài Cần Thơ" hoặc "đổi đài Đà Nẵng".');
                        handled = true;
                    }
                }
