                if (!handled && /mien trung|xsmt/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureMTCore();
                    switchMainTab('mn', { preserve: true });
                    updateStateMN('mt', true);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã mở không gian Miền Trung đè lên Miền Nam.');
                }

                if (!handled && /mien nam|xsmn/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureMNCore();
                    switchMainTab('mn');
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã mở không gian Miền Nam.');
                }

                if (!handled && /mien bac|xsmb/.test(norm)) {
                    ensureMBCore();
                    switchMainTab('mb');
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã mở không gian Miền Bắc.');
                }

                if (!handled && /trang thai|ngu canh|context/.test(norm)) {
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push(`Ngữ cảnh hiện tại: ${getContextLabelByState()}.`);
                }

                if (!handled && /tro ve|dong ngan keo|ve loi/.test(norm)) {
                    if (currentMainTab === 'mb') updateStateMB('core', true);
                    if (currentMainTab === 'mn') updateStateMN('core', true);
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Đã thu gọn toàn bộ ngăn kéo và quay về lõi.');
                }

                if (!handled && /phong ai|bo nao ai|trung tam ai/.test(norm)) {
                    switchMainTab('ai', { preserve: true });
                    handled = true;
                    replies.push('Bạn đang ở Bộ Não AI trung tâm. Mọi tín hiệu hiện đã được gom về đây.');
                }

                if (!handled) {
                    replies.push('Đã nhận lệnh, nhưng cần rõ hơn.\nGợi ý:\n• mở lô tô\n• soi cầu 68 miền bắc\n• đổi đài cần thơ\n• vào live miền nam\n• mở đặc biệt tuần');
                }

                return replies.join('\n');
            }

            function send(rawText = null) {
                const text = typeof rawText === 'string' ? rawText.trim() : input.value.trim();
                if (!text) return;
                append('user', text);
                input.value = '';
                hideMenu();
                const answer = execute(text);
                setTimeout(() => reply(answer), 240);
            }

            function setupSpeech() {
                const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
                if (!SpeechRecognition) return;

                recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
                recognition.lang = 'vi-VN';
                recognition.interimResults = true;

                recognition.onstart = () => {
                    isRecording = true;
                    micBtn.classList.add('recording');
                    input.placeholder = 'Đang lắng nghe...';
                };

                recognition.onresult = (event) => {
                    let transcript = '';
                    for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
                        transcript += event.results[i][0].transcript;
                    }
                    input.value = transcript;
                };

                recognition.onerror = () => {
                    isRecording = false;
                    micBtn.classList.remove('recording');
                    input.placeholder = `Ra lệnh • ${getContextLabelByState()}`;
                    showToast('Mic AI không khả dụng hoặc đã bị từ chối.', 'warn');
                };

                recognition.onend = () => {
                    isRecording = false;
                    micBtn.classList.remove('recording');
                    input.placeholder = `Ra lệnh • ${getContextLabelByState()}`;
                };
            }

            function toggleMic() {
                if (!recognition) {
                    showToast('Trình duyệt không hỗ trợ nhận diện giọng nói.', 'warn');
                    return;
                }
                if (isRecording) recognition.stop();
                else {
                    input.value = '';
                    try { recognition.start(); } catch (e) {}
                }
            }

            plusBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                plusMenu.classList.toggle('show');
            });
            sendBtn.addEventListener('click', () => send());
            micBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleMic());
            input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') send();
            });
            document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (!plusMenu.contains(e.target) && e.target !== plusBtn) hideMenu();
            });
            plusMenu.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const item = e.target.closest('.plus-menu-item');
                if (!item) return;
                send(item.dataset.cmd || item.textContent.trim());
            });

            setupSpeech();
            bootGreeting();
            updateContext();

            return {
                updateContext,
                telemetry,
                openWithPreset,
                hideMenu,
                append,
                reply
            };
        }

        // =========================
        // GENERIC BRIDGE REGION MODULE
        // =========================
        class BridgeRegionModule {
            constructor(opts) {
                this.opts = opts;
                this.zone = $(opts.zoneId);
                this.state = {
                    manual: false,
                    selectedNodes: [],
                    connections: [],
                    stationIndex: 0
                };
                this.historyData = [];
            }

            init() {
                this.zone.innerHTML = this.buildShell();
                this.root = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-root');
                this.toolbarBtns = {
                    manual: this.zone.querySelector('[data-role="manual"]'),
                    aiRoom: this.zone.querySelector('[data-role="ai-room"]'),
                    aiDirect: this.zone.querySelector('[data-role="ai-direct"]')
                };
                this.smartText = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-smart .text');
                this.stationLabel = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-station-label');
                this.prevBtn = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-station-btn.prev');
                this.nextBtn = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-station-btn.next');
                this.feed = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-feed');
                this.history = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-history');
                this.svg = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-svg');
                this.list = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-list');
                this.popup = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-popup');
                this.popupDigits = this.zone.querySelector('.rx-bridge-popup-digits');
                this.currentPopupBox = null;

                if (this.opts.stations && this.opts.dailyMap) {
                    const today = new Date().getDay();
                    const station = this.opts.dailyMap[today];
                    const idx = this.opts.stations.indexOf(station);
                    this.state.stationIndex = idx >= 0 ? idx : 0;
                }

                this.renderBoards();
                this.bindEvents();
                if (this.smartText) {
                    this.smartText.textContent = this.opts.initialSmartText;
                }
                if (centralAI) centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, `Đã boot không gian ${this.opts.label}.`);
            }

            buildShell() {
                const stationNav = this.opts.stations ? `
                    <div class="rx-bridge-station">
                        <div class="rx-bridge-station-row">
                            <button class="rx-bridge-station-btn prev" type="button">❮</button>
                            <div class="rx-bridge-station-label">ĐANG TẢI...</div>
                            <button class="rx-bridge-station-btn next" type="button">❯</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ` : '';

                const smartBar = this.opts.showSmartBar ? `
                    <div class="rx-bridge-smart">
                        <div class="pulse"></div>
                        <div class="text">AI SMART MODE</div>
                    </div>
                ` : '';

                return `
                    <div class="rx-bridge-root theme-${this.opts.theme}">
                        <div class="rx-bridge-toolbar">
                            <button class="rx-bridge-tool" type="button" data-role="manual">
                                <span class="label">TỰ SOI CẦU</span>
                                <span class="light"></span>
                            </button>
                            <button class="rx-bridge-tool" type="button" data-role="ai-room">
                                <span class="label">PHÒNG AI</span>
                                <span class="light"></span>
                            </button>
                            <button class="rx-bridge-tool" type="button" data-role="ai-direct">
                                <span class="label">SOI CẦU TĐ</span>
                                <span class="light"></span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                        ${smartBar}
                        ${stationNav}
                        <div class="rx-bridge-feed">
                            <div class="rx-bridge-history">
                                <svg class="rx-bridge-svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                    <defs>
                                        <marker id="${this.opts.key}-arrow-green" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                                            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#10b981"></polygon>
                                        </marker>
                                        <marker id="${this.opts.key}-arrow-red" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                                            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#ef4444"></polygon>
                                        </marker>
                                        <marker id="${this.opts.key}-arrow-blue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                                            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#0ea5e9"></polygon>
                                        </marker>
                                    </defs>
                                </svg>
                                <div class="rx-bridge-list"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="rx-bridge-popup">
                            <div class="rx-bridge-popup-box">
                                <div class="rx-bridge-popup-title">CHỌN VỊ TRÍ CẦU (ĐIỂM NỐI)</div>
                                <div class="rx-bridge-popup-digits"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }

            getLayout() {
                if (this.opts.type === 'mb') {
                    return [
                        { key:'DB', label:'ĐB', digits:5, count:1, grid:1, db:true },
                        { key:'G1', label:'G1', digits:5, count:1, grid:1 },
                        { key:'G2', label:'G2', digits:5, count:2, grid:2 },
                        { key:'G3', label:'G3', digits:5, count:6, grid:6 },
                        { key:'G4', label:'G4', digits:4, count:4, grid:4 },
                        { key:'G5', label:'G5', digits:4, count:6, grid:6 },
                        { key:'G6', label:'G6', digits:3, count:3, grid:3 },
                        { key:'G7', label:'G7', digits:2, count:4, grid:4 }
                    ];
                }
                return [
                    { key:'DB', label:'ĐB', digits:6, count:1, grid:1, db:true },
                    { key:'G1', label:'G1', digits:5, count:1, grid:1 },
                    { key:'G2', label:'G2', digits:5, count:1, grid:1 },
                    { key:'G3', label:'G3', digits:5, count:2, grid:2 },
                    { key:'G4', label:'G4', digits:5, count:7, grid:7 },
                    { key:'G5', label:'G5', digits:4, count:1, grid:1 },
                    { key:'G6', label:'G6', digits:4, count:3, grid:3 },
                    { key:'G7', label:'G7', digits:3, count:1, grid:1 },
                    { key:'G8', label:'G8', digits:2, count:1, grid:1 }
                ];
            }

            currentStation() {
                if (!this.opts.stations) return null;
                return this.opts.stations[this.state.stationIndex] || this.opts.stations[0];
            }

            setToolbarActive(role = '') {
                Object.entries(this.toolbarBtns).forEach(([key, btn]) => {
                    btn.classList.toggle('active', key === role);
                });
            }

            generateHistory() {
                const rows = this.getLayout();
                const count = 200;
                const out = [];
                const today = new Date();
                const stationName = this.currentStation();

                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    const d = new Date(today);
                    if (this.opts.type === 'mb') {
                        d.setDate(today.getDate() - i);
                    } else {
                        d.setDate(today.getDate() - (i * 7));
                    }

                    const boardStation = this.opts.type === 'mb'
                        ? MB_SCHEDULE[d.getDay()]
                        : stationName;

                    const board = {
                        region: boardStation,
                        date: formatDateVN(d),
                        rows: []
                    };

                    rows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
                        const values = [];
                        for (let item = 0; item < row.count; item++) {
                            const seedKey = `${this.opts.key}|${boardStation}|${i}|${row.key}|${item}`;
                            const rng = mulberry32(hashString(seedKey));
                            let value = randomDigits(rng, row.digits);

                            if (i % 29 === 0 && row.key === 'DB') value = applyTail(value, '68');
                            if (i % 41 === 0 && row.key === 'G3' && item === 0) value = applyTail(value, '79');
                            if (i % 53 === 0 && row.key === 'G5') value = applyTail(value, '23');
                            if (i === 0 && this.opts.key === 'mb' && row.key === 'DB') value = applyTail(value, '68');
                            if (i === 0 && this.opts.key === 'mn' && row.key === 'DB') value = applyTail(value, '23');
                            if (i === 0 && this.opts.key === 'mt' && row.key === 'DB') value = applyTail(value, '79');

                            values.push(value);
                        }
                        board.rows.push({ ...row, values });
                    });

                    out.push(board);
                }

                return out;
            }

            renderBoards() {
                this.historyData = this.generateHistory();
                if (this.stationLabel && this.currentStation()) {
                    this.stationLabel.textContent = `ĐÀI ${this.currentStation().toUpperCase()}`;
                }

                this.list.innerHTML = this.historyData.map((board, boardIdx) => `
                    <div class="rx-bridge-board" id="${this.opts.key}-board-${boardIdx}">
                        <div class="rx-bridge-head">
                            <div class="rx-bridge-title">${this.opts.titlePrefix} ${board.region.toUpperCase()}</div>
                            <div class="rx-bridge-date">${board.date}</div>
                        </div>

                        ${board.rows.map(row => `
                            <div class="rx-bridge-row ${row.db ? 'db' : ''}">
                                <div class="rx-bridge-prize">${row.label}</div>
                                <div class="rx-bridge-results rx-grid-${row.grid}">
                                    ${row.values.map((num, idx) => `
                                        <div class="rx-bridge-box" data-num="${num}" data-board="${boardIdx}" data-row="${row.key}" data-index="${idx}">
                                            <span class="rx-bridge-numtxt">${num.split('').map(d => `<span class="rx-bridge-digit">${d}</span>`).join('')}</span>
                                        </div>
                                    `).join('')}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `).join('')}
                    </div>
                `).join('');

                this.clearAll(false);
                requestAnimationFrame(() => this.refreshLayout());

                if (this.smartText) {
                    if (this.opts.stations) {
                        this.smartText.textContent = `AI SMART MODE: ${this.opts.label.toUpperCase()} • ${this.currentStation().toUpperCase()} • 200 BẢNG`;
                    } else {
                        this.smartText.textContent = `AI SMART MODE: ${this.opts.label.toUpperCase()} • 200 BẢNG LỊCH SỬ`;
                    }
                }
            }

            bindEvents() {
                this.toolbarBtns.manual.addEventListener('click', () => this.toggleManual());
                this.toolbarBtns.aiRoom.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    this.setToolbarActive('aiRoom');
                    centralAI.openWithPreset(`soi cầu ${this.opts.label.toLowerCase()}`);
                    centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, `Đã chuyển ngữ cảnh về Bộ Não AI từ ${this.opts.label}.`);
                });
                this.toolbarBtns.aiDirect.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    this.setToolbarActive('aiDirect');
                    this.runAIBridge(this.getSuggestedTarget(), 'module-button');
                });

                if (this.prevBtn) {
                    this.prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.changeStation(-1));
                }
                if (this.nextBtn) {
                    this.nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.changeStation(1));
                }

                this.feed.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (!this.state.manual) return;
                    const box = e.target.closest('.rx-bridge-box');
                    if (!box || !this.list.contains(box)) return;
                    this.openPopup(box);
                });

                this.popup.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (e.target === this.popup) this.closePopup();
                });

                window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.refreshLayout());
            }

            getSuggestedTarget() {
                if (this.opts.key === 'mb') return '68';
                if (this.opts.key === 'mn') return '23';
                return '79';
            }

            toggleManual() {
                this.state.manual = !this.state.manual;
                this.root.classList.toggle('manual-mode', this.state.manual);
                if (this.state.manual) {
                    this.clearAll(false);
                    this.setToolbarActive('manual');
                    showToast(`Đã bật Tự Soi Cầu ${this.opts.label}.`, 'success');
                    centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, `Đã bật chế độ Tự Soi Cầu tại ${this.opts.label}.`);
                } else {
                    this.clearAll(false);
                    this.setToolbarActive('');
                    showToast(`Đã tắt và reset cầu thủ công ${this.opts.label}.`, 'info');
                    centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, `Đã reset toàn bộ cầu thủ công tại ${this.opts.label}.`);
                }
            }

            openPopup(box) {
                this.currentPopupBox = box;
                this.popupDigits.innerHTML = '';
                const digits = [...box.querySelectorAll('.rx-bridge-digit')].map(d => d.textContent);
                digits.forEach((digit, idx) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.type = 'button';
                    btn.className = 'rx-bridge-popup-digit';
                    btn.textContent = digit;
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.selectDigit(idx));
                    this.popupDigits.appendChild(btn);
                });
                this.popup.classList.add('show');
            }

            closePopup() {
                this.popup.classList.remove('show');
                this.currentPopupBox = null;
            }

            selectDigit(index) {
                const box = this.currentPopupBox;
                this.closePopup();
                if (!box) return;
                const digit = box.querySelectorAll('.rx-bridge-digit')[index];
                if (!digit) return;

                digit.classList.add('marked');
                this.state.selectedNodes.push(digit);

                if (this.state.selectedNodes.length >= 2) {
                    const nodeA = this.state.selectedNodes[this.state.selectedNodes.length - 2];
                    const nodeB = this.state.selectedNodes[this.state.selectedNodes.length - 1];
                    this.state.connections.push({
                        type: 'manual',
                        nodeA,
                        nodeB,
                        cleanup: () => {
                            nodeA.classList.remove('marked');
                            nodeB.classList.remove('marked');
                        }
                    });
                    this.renderConnections();
                    showToast('Đã nối thêm một đường cầu thủ công.', 'success');
                    centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, 'Đã tạo một đường cầu thủ công mới.');
                } else {
                    showToast('Đã ghi nhận điểm đầu tiên.', 'info');
                }
            }

            matchTarget(value, target) {
                const t = String(target || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
                if (!t) return true;
                return value.endsWith(t) || value.includes(t);
            }

            markAIBox(box, target) {
                box.classList.add('ai-glow');
                const digits = [...box.querySelectorAll('.rx-bridge-digit')];
                const value = box.dataset.num || '';
                let chosen = [];

                if (target && value.includes(target)) {
                    const start = value.lastIndexOf(target);
                    chosen = digits.slice(start, start + target.length);
                } else if (target && digits.length >= Math.min(2, target.length || 1)) {
                    const take = Math.min(Math.max(target.length || 1, 1), digits.length);
                    chosen = digits.slice(-take);
                } else {
                    chosen = [digits[digits.length - 1]];
                }

                chosen.forEach(d => d.classList.add('ai-marked'));
                return chosen[chosen.length - 1];
            }

            runAIBridge(target = null, source = 'local') {
                this.state.manual = false;
                this.root.classList.remove('manual-mode');
                this.clearAll(false);
                this.setToolbarActive('aiDirect');

                const boxes = [...this.list.querySelectorAll('.rx-bridge-box')];
                if (!boxes.length) return;

                let candidates = target ? boxes.filter(b => this.matchTarget(b.dataset.num, target)) : [];
                if (candidates.length < 2) {
                    candidates = boxes.filter((_, idx) => idx % 17 === 0);
                }

                const startBox = candidates[0] || boxes[3];
                const endBox = candidates[candidates.length - 1] || boxes[Math.max(10, boxes.length - 12)];

                const nodeA = this.markAIBox(startBox, target);
                const nodeB = this.markAIBox(endBox, target);

                this.state.connections.push({
                    type: 'ai',
                    nodeA,
                    nodeB
                });
                this.renderConnections();

                const board = endBox.closest('.rx-bridge-board');
                if (board) {
                    board.classList.add('flash');
                    setTimeout(() => board.classList.remove('flash'), 900);
                    setTimeout(() => board.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' }), 280);
                }

                if (this.smartText) {
                    this.smartText.textContent = `AI SMART MODE: KHÓA CẦU ${target || this.getSuggestedTarget()} • SOURCE ${source.toUpperCase()}`;
                }

                showToast(`AI đã khóa cầu ${target ? target + ' ' : ''}${this.opts.label}.`, 'success');
                centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, `AI đã khóa cầu ${target ? target + ' ' : ''}tại ${this.opts.label} bằng nguồn ${source}.`);
            }

            clearAll(showMessage = false) {
                this.state.selectedNodes = [];
                this.state.connections.forEach(conn => {
                    if (conn.cleanup) conn.cleanup();
                });
                this.state.connections = [];
                $$('.marked', this.root).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('marked'));
                $$('.ai-marked', this.root).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('ai-marked'));
                $$('.ai-glow', this.root).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('ai-glow'));
                this.renderConnections();
                if (showMessage) showToast('Đã xóa toàn bộ đường cầu.', 'info');
            }

            changeStation(direction) {
                if (!this.opts.stations) return;
                this.state.stationIndex = (this.state.stationIndex + direction + this.opts.stations.length) % this.opts.stations.length;
                this.renderBoards();
                pulseElement(this.zone);
                showToast(`Đã chuyển sang đài ${this.currentStation()}.`, 'info');
                centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, `Đã đổi đài sang ${this.currentStation()}.`);
            }

            setStationByName(name) {
                if (!this.opts.stations) return false;
                const idx = this.opts.stations.findIndex(s => normalizeText(s) === normalizeText(name));
                if (idx === -1) return false;
                this.state.stationIndex = idx;
                this.renderBoards();
                pulseElement(this.zone);
                showToast(`Đã khóa đúng đài ${this.currentStation()}.`, 'success');
                centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, `Bộ Não AI đã khóa đài ${this.currentStation()}.`);
                return true;
            }

            renderConnections() {
                const defs = `
                    <defs>
                        <marker id="${this.opts.key}-arrow-green" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#10b981"></polygon>
                        </marker>
                        <marker id="${this.opts.key}-arrow-red" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#ef4444"></polygon>
                        </marker>
                        <marker id="${this.opts.key}-arrow-blue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
                            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#0ea5e9"></polygon>
                        </marker>
                    </defs>
                `;
                this.svg.innerHTML = defs;

                const containerRect = this.history.getBoundingClientRect();

                this.state.connections.forEach((conn, index) => {
                    const rectA = conn.nodeA.getBoundingClientRect();
                    const rectB = conn.nodeB.getBoundingClientRect();

                    const x1 = rectA.left - containerRect.left + rectA.width / 2;
                    const y1 = rectA.top - containerRect.top + rectA.height / 2;
                    const x2 = rectB.left - containerRect.left + rectB.width / 2;
                    const y2 = rectB.top - containerRect.top + rectB.height / 2;

                    const d = `M ${x1} ${y1} L ${x2} ${y2}`;
                    const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
                    path.setAttribute('d', d);

                    if (conn.type === 'ai') {
                        path.setAttribute('class', 'rx-bridge-line-ai');
                        path.setAttribute('marker-end', `url(#${this.opts.key}-arrow-blue)`);
                        this.svg.appendChild(path);
                        return;
                    }

                    path.setAttribute('class', 'rx-bridge-line');
                    path.setAttribute('marker-end', `url(#${this.opts.key}-arrow-green)`);

                    const hit = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
                    hit.setAttribute('d', d);
                    hit.setAttribute('class', 'rx-bridge-line-hit');

                    const askDelete = () => {
                        path.classList.add('delete');
                        path.setAttribute('marker-end', `url(#${this.opts.key}-arrow-red)`);
                        showConfirm('Xóa đường cầu này?', () => {
                            if (conn.cleanup) conn.cleanup();
                            this.state.connections.splice(index, 1);
                            this.renderConnections();
                            centralAI.telemetry(this.opts.label, 'Đã xóa một đường cầu thủ công.');
                        }, 'Xóa đường cầu');
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            if (this.state.connections[index] === conn) {
                                path.classList.remove('delete');
                                path.setAttribute('marker-end', `url(#${this.opts.key}-arrow-green)`);
                            }
                        }, 380);
                    };

                    hit.addEventListener('click', askDelete);
                    path.addEventListener('click', askDelete);

                    this.svg.appendChild(path);
                    this.svg.appendChild(hit);
                });
            }

            refreshLayout() {
                this.renderConnections();
            }
        }

        // =========================
        // LOTO MODULE
        // =========================
        function createLotoModule(zoneId) {
            const zone = $(zoneId);
            const state = {
                mode: 'single',
                matrixData: {},
                matrixNumMap: {},
                currentAnalyzedNum: '',
                freqData: [],
                hudTimer: 0
            };

            function getItems(mode) {
                const items = [];
                if (mode === 'single') {
                    for (let i = 0; i <= 99; i++) items.push(pad(i, 2));
                } else if (mode === 'pair') {
                    for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
                        for (let j = i + 1; j <= 9; j++) items.push(`${i}${j}-${j}${i}`);
                    }
                    items.push('00-55','11-66','22-77','33-88','44-99');
                } else {
                    ['00','11','22','33','44','55','66','77','88','99'].forEach(v => items.push(v));
                }
                return items;
            }

            function buildMatrixDaySeed(mode, item) {
                const rng = mulberry32(hashString(`LOTOM-${mode}-${item}`));
                const days = [];
                for (let j = 0; j < 90; j++) {
                    days.push(rng() > 0.85 ? String(Math.floor(rng() * 4) + 1) : '');
                }
                return days;
            }

            function buildFreqData() {
                state.freqData = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                    const number = pad(i, 2);
                    const rng = mulberry32(hashString(`FREQ-${number}`));
                    const daysSinceLast = Math.floor(rng() * 25);
                    const freq30 = Math.floor(rng() * 15);
                    state.freqData.push({
                        number,
                        daysSinceLast,
                        freq30,
                        isGan: daysSinceLast >= 14,
                        isRhythm: freq30 >= 8 && daysSinceLast <= 3
                    });
                }
            }

            function summaryBars() {
                return [
                    {n:'68',r:1,h:100,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#b91c1c,#ef4444)'},
                    {n:'86',r:2,h:85,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#c2410c,#f97316)'},
                    {n:'79',r:3,h:75,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#d97706,#fbbf24)'},
                    {n:'97',r:4,h:65,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#65a30d,#a3e635)'},
                    {n:'12',r:5,h:55,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#0f766e,#14b8a6)'},
                    {n:'21',r:6,h:45,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#0369a1,#0ea5e9)'},
                    {n:'33',r:7,h:35,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#4338ca,#6366f1)'},
                    {n:'55',r:8,h:28,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#7e22ce,#a855f7)'},
                    {n:'99',r:9,h:22,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#be185d,#ec4899)'},
                    {n:'00',r:10,h:15,c:'linear-gradient(to top,#334155,#64748b)'}
                ];
            }

            function renderShell() {
                zone.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="lotom-root">
                        <div class="lotom-scroll">
                            <div class="lotom-card lotom-matrixcard" id="lotom-matrixcard">
                                <div id="lotom-hud" class="lotom-hud">
                                    <div class="eval" id="lotom-eval">XẾP HẠNG</div>
                                    <div id="lotom-hudtext">Phân tích nhịp lô...</div>
                                    <button class="lotom-hud-btn" id="lotom-hudbtn">⚛ XEM CẦU ĐỒNG QUY</button>
                                </div>

                                <div class="lotom-toggle">
                                    <button class="lotom-toggle-btn active" data-mode="single">LÔ ĐƠN</button>
                                    <button class="lotom-toggle-btn" data-mode="pair">LÔ CẶP</button>
                                    <button class="lotom-toggle-btn" data-mode="double">LÔ KÉP</button>
                                </div>

                                <div class="lotom-matrixwrap" id="lotom-matrixwrap" tabindex="0">
                                    <div class="lotom-laser" id="lotom-laser"></div>
                                    <table class="lotom-matrix" id="lotom-matrix">
                                        <thead id="lotom-head"></thead>
                                        <tbody id="lotom-body"></tbody>
                                    </table>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="lotom-card" id="lotom-topcard">
                                <div class="lotom-top">
                                    <div class="lotom-head">
                                        <div class="lotom-title"><span>🏆</span> LÔ TOP VIP</div>
                                        <div class="lotom-clock">
                                            <div class="time" id="lotom-time">00:00:00</div>
                                            <div class="date" id="lotom-date">ĐANG ĐỒNG BỘ...</div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="lotom-chart" id="lotom-chart"></div>
                                    <button class="lotom-ai-btn" id="lotom-ai-btn"><span style="font-size:20px">⚛</span><span>TRUNG TÂM AI - TƯ VẤN SỐ ĐẸP</span></button>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="lotom-card" id="lotom-freqcard">
                                <div class="lotom-freq">
                                    <div class="lotom-freq-head">
                                        <div class="lotom-title"><span>🔎</span> TẦN SUẤT LÔ THÔNG MINH</div>
                                        <div class="lotom-freq-filter">
                                            <button class="lotom-freq-btn active" data-filter="ALL">TOÀN BỘ</button>
                                            <button class="lotom-freq-btn" data-filter="GAN">LÔ GAN</button>
                                            <button class="lotom-freq-btn" data-filter="RHYTHM">NHỊP ĐẸP</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="lotom-freq-grid" id="lotom-freqgrid"></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }

            function initClock() {
                const timeEl = zone.querySelector('#lotom-time');
                const dateEl = zone.querySelector('#lotom-date');
                const tick = () => {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const days = ['Chủ Nhật','Thứ Hai','Thứ Ba','Thứ Tư','Thứ Năm','Thứ Sáu','Thứ Bảy'];
                    timeEl.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour12: false });
                    dateEl.textContent = `${days[now.getDay()]}, ${pad(now.getDate())}/${pad(now.getMonth()+1)}/${now.getFullYear()}`;
                };
                tick();
                setInterval(tick, 1000);
            }

            function renderHead() {
                let html = '<tr><th class="lotom-corner">Lô</th>';
                for (let d = 1; d <= 90; d++) html += `<th>${d}</th>`;
                html += '</tr>';
                zone.querySelector('#lotom-head').innerHTML = html;
            }

            function renderMatrix(mode = state.mode) {
                state.mode = mode;
                state.matrixData = {};
                state.matrixNumMap = {};
                const items = getItems(mode);
                let html = '';

                items.forEach((num, rowIdx) => {
                    const days = buildMatrixDaySeed(mode, num);
                    state.matrixData[rowIdx] = days;
                    state.matrixNumMap[num] = rowIdx;

                    let currentGap = 0;
                    while (currentGap < 90 && days[currentGap] === '') currentGap++;
                    let consecutiveHits = 0;
                    if (currentGap === 0) {
                        while (consecutiveHits < 90 && days[consecutiveHits] !== '') consecutiveHits++;
                    }

                    let badges = '';
                    if (currentGap >= 6) badges = `<span class="lotom-row-badge lotom-badge-gan">Gan ${currentGap}</span>`;
                    else if (consecutiveHits >= 2) badges = `<span class="lotom-row-badge lotom-badge-hot">🔥 ${consecutiveHits} nháy</span>`;

                    html += `<tr id="lotom-row-${rowIdx}">
                        <th class="lotom-rowhead" data-idx="${rowIdx}" data-num="${num}">${num}${badges}</th>
                        ${days.map((v, cIdx) => `<td id="lotom-cell-${rowIdx}-${cIdx}">${v}</td>`).join('')}
                    </tr>`;
                });

                const body = zone.querySelector('#lotom-body');
                const table = zone.querySelector('#lotom-matrix');
                body.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    body.innerHTML = html;
                    table.classList.toggle('double-mode', mode === 'double');
                    body.style.opacity = '1';
                    zone.querySelector('#lotom-matrixwrap').scrollTop = 0;
                    zone.querySelector('#lotom-matrixwrap').scrollLeft = 0;
                }, 140);

                zone.querySelectorAll('.lotom-toggle-btn').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.mode === mode);
                });
            }

            function clearAnalysis() {
                $$('#lotom-body tr', zone).forEach(tr => tr.classList.remove('lotom-row-analyzed'));
                $$('#lotom-body td', zone).forEach(td => td.classList.remove('lotom-gap','lotom-hit'));
                const hud = zone.querySelector('#lotom-hud');
                hud.className = 'lotom-hud';
                zone.querySelector('#lotom-laser').classList.remove('fire');
                clearTimeout(state.hudTimer);
            }

            function analyzeRow(num, rowIdx) {
                const days = state.matrixData[rowIdx];
                if (!days) return;
                state.currentAnalyzedNum = num;
                clearAnalysis();

                const row = zone.querySelector(`#lotom-row-${rowIdx}`);
                const th = row ? row.querySelector('.lotom-rowhead') : null;
                const hud = zone.querySelector('#lotom-hud');
                const laser = zone.querySelector('#lotom-laser');

                let currentGap = 0;
                while (currentGap < 90 && days[currentGap] === '') currentGap++;

                let matchData = [];
                let rhythmCount = 0;

                if (currentGap > 0) {
                    let emptyCount = 0;
                    let temp = [];
                    for (let j = currentGap + 1; j < 90; j++) {
                        if (days[j] === '') {
                            emptyCount++;
                            temp.push(j);
                        } else {
                            if (emptyCount === currentGap) {
                                rhythmCount++;
                                temp.forEach(col => matchData.push({ c: col, t: 'gap' }));
                                matchData.push({ c: j - emptyCount - 1, t: 'hit' });
                            }
                            emptyCount = 0;
                            temp = [];
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (currentGap === 0) rhythmCount = 99;

                if (th) {
                    laser.style.top = (th.offsetTop + 14) + 'px';
                    void laser.offsetWidth;
                    laser.classList.add('fire');
                }
                if (row) row.classList.add('lotom-row-analyzed');

                const tier =
                    rhythmCount >= 4 ? 'lotom-tier-diamond' :
                    rhythmCount === 3 ? 'lotom-tier-gold' :
                    rhythmCount === 2 ? 'lotom-tier-silver' : 'lotom-tier-bronze';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    matchData.forEach(m => {
                        const cell = zone.querySelector(`#lotom-cell-${rowIdx}-${m.c}`);
                        if (cell) cell.classList.add(m.t === 'gap' ? 'lotom-gap' : 'lotom-hit');
                    });

                    const evalText =
                        tier === 'lotom-tier-diamond' ? '💎 KIM CƯƠNG' :
                        tier === 'lotom-tier-gold' ? '🏆 VÀNG' :
                        tier === 'lotom-tier-silver' ? '🥈 BẠC' : '🪨 ĐỒNG';

                    zone.querySelector('#lotom-eval').textContent = evalText;
                    if (currentGap === 0) {
                        zone.querySelector('#lotom-hudtext').innerHTML = `Lô <span class="hl">${num}</span>: ĐANG NỔ RƠI LIÊN TỤC.`;
                    } else {
                        zone.querySelector('#lotom-hudtext').innerHTML = `Lô <span class="hl">${num}</span>: vào form nhịp nghỉ <span class="hl">${currentGap}</span> ngày. AI ghi nhận <span class="hl">${rhythmCount}</span> lần nổ chu kỳ này.`;
                    }
                    hud.className = `lotom-hud ${tier} show`;
                }, 260);

                state.hudTimer = setTimeout(clearAnalysis, 18000);
                centralAI.telemetry('Lô Tô', `Đã phân tích nhịp lô ${num}.`);
            }

            function renderTopChart() {
                zone.querySelector('#lotom-chart').innerHTML = summaryBars().map((item, idx) => `
                    <div class="lotom-barwrap" data-num="${item.n}">
                        <div class="lotom-barnum" style="${item.r === 1 ? 'color:var(--red);text-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,68,68,.8);transform:scale(1.22)' : ''}">${item.n}</div>
                        <div class="lotom-bar" style="height:${item.h}%;background:${item.c};animation-delay:${idx * .08}s">
                            <div class="lotom-rank">TOP ${item.r}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }

            function renderFreq(filter = 'ALL') {
                const grid = zone.querySelector('#lotom-freqgrid');
                grid.innerHTML = state.freqData.map(item => {
                    if (filter === 'GAN' && !item.isGan) return '';
                    if (filter === 'RHYTHM' && !item.isRhythm) return '';
                    let cls = 'lotom-freq-cell';
                    if (item.isRhythm) cls += ' rhythm';
                    else if (item.isGan) cls += ' gan';
                    return `<div class="${cls}" data-num="${item.number}" title="Gan: ${item.daysSinceLast} ngày • Về: ${item.freq30} lần">${item.number}</div>`;
                }).join('');

                zone.querySelectorAll('.lotom-freq-btn').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === filter);
                });
            }

            function focusTop() {
                const card = zone.querySelector('#lotom-topcard');
                card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                pulseElement(card);
            }

            function focusFreq(filter = 'ALL') {
                renderFreq(filter);
                const card = zone.querySelector('#lotom-freqcard');
                card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                pulseElement(card);
            }

            function focusRow(num) {
                setMode('single');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const idx = state.matrixNumMap[num];
                    if (idx === undefined) {
                        showToast(`Không tìm thấy lô ${num}.`, 'warn');
                        return;
                    }
                    zone.querySelector('#lotom-matrixcard').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    setTimeout(() => analyzeRow(num, idx), 200);
                }, 180);
            }

            function setMode(mode) {
                renderMatrix(mode);
                centralAI.telemetry('Lô Tô', `Đã chuyển ma trận sang chế độ ${mode}.`);
            }

            function bind() {
                zone.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    const modeBtn = e.target.closest('.lotom-toggle-btn');
                    if (modeBtn) {
                        setMode(modeBtn.dataset.mode);
                        return;
                    }

                    const rowHead = e.target.closest('.lotom-rowhead');
                    if (rowHead) {
                        analyzeRow(rowHead.dataset.num, Number(rowHead.dataset.idx));
                        return;
                    }

                    const bar = e.target.closest('.lotom-barwrap');
                    if (bar) {
                        focusRow(bar.dataset.num);
                        return;
                    }

                    const freqBtn = e.target.closest('.lotom-freq-btn');
                    if (freqBtn) {
                        renderFreq(freqBtn.dataset.filter);
                        return;
                    }

                    const freqCell = e.target.closest('.lotom-freq-cell');
                    if (freqCell) {
                        focusRow(freqCell.dataset.num);
                        return;
                    }

                    if (e.target.closest('#lotom-ai-btn')) {
                        centralAI.openWithPreset('lô top vip');
                        centralAI.telemetry('Lô Tô', 'Đã chuyển dữ liệu Lô Top về Bộ Não AI.');
                        return;
                    }

                    if (e.target.closest('#lotom-hudbtn')) {
                        centralAI.openWithPreset(`soi cầu ${state.currentAnalyzedNum || '68'} miền bắc`);
                    }
                });

                const wrap = zone.querySelector('#lotom-matrixwrap');
                let isDown = false;
                let startX = 0;
                let scrollLeft = 0;

                wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                    isDown = true;
                    startX = e.pageX - wrap.offsetLeft;
                    scrollLeft = wrap.scrollLeft;
                });
                wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDown = false; });
                wrap.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDown = false; });
                wrap.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                    if (!isDown) return;
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const x = e.pageX - wrap.offsetLeft;
                    const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
                    wrap.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
                });
                wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', clearAnalysis, { passive: true });
            }

            renderShell();
            buildFreqData();
            initClock();
            renderHead();
            renderMatrix('single');
            renderTopChart();
            renderFreq('ALL');
            bind();
            centralAI.telemetry('Lô Tô', 'Đã gắn Ma trận nhịp lô và Lô Top vào drawer-loto-mb.');

            return { focusTop, focusFreq, focusRow, setMode };
        }

        // =========================
        // TERMINAL TYPEWRITER
        // =========================
        function createTypewriterRunner(bodyEl) {
            let runToken = 0;
            async function run(lines) {
                runToken += 1;
                const token = runToken;
                bodyEl.innerHTML = '';
                for (const line of lines) {
                    if (token !== runToken) return;
                    const div = document.createElement('div');
                    div.className = 'matrixterm-log';
                    bodyEl.appendChild(div);
                    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
                        if (token !== runToken) return;
                        div.textContent += line[i];
                        bodyEl.scrollTop = bodyEl.scrollHeight;
                        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 12));
                    }
                    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120));
                }
            }
            return { run };
        }

        // =========================
        function createWeekModule(zoneId) {
            const zone = $(zoneId);

            zone.innerHTML = `
                <div class="weekm-root">

                        <button class="termcmd-btn active" data-mode="SOI_CAU">
                            <span class="txt">SOI CẦU</span><span class="core"></span>
                        </button>
                        <button class="termcmd-btn" data-mode="PHONG_AI">
                            <span class="txt">PHÒNG AI</span><span class="core"></span>
                        </button>
                        <button class="termcmd-btn" data-mode="TRO_VE">
                            <span class="txt">TRỞ VỀ</span><span class="core"></span>
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div class="matrixterm-card">
                        <div class="matrixterm-head">
                            <div class="matrixterm-title"><span class="matrixterm-tag">LIVE</span><span>A1-STEEL CORE SYSTEM</span></div>
                            <div style="font-size:8px;color:rgba(16,185,129,.42);letter-spacing:1px">SECURE_LINK: ONLINE</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="matrixterm-body" id="weekm-terminal"></div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="weekm-card">
                        <div class="weekm-card-head">
                            <span>ĐẶC BIỆT TUẦN • 200 HÀNG</span>
                            <span>WEEKLY_MATRIX_200.SYS</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="weekm-gridwrap">
                            <div class="weekm-grid" id="weekm-grid"></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            const terminalBody = zone.querySelector('#weekm-terminal');
            const typer = createTypewriterRunner(terminalBody);

            const scripts = {
                SOI_CAU: [
                    '> INITIALIZING BRIDGE ENGINE [v5.4]...',
                    '> SCANNING WEEKLY SPECIAL MATRIX...',
                    '> ANALYZING PATTERN: 3-DAY BRIDGE...',
                    '> DETECTING CORRELATION: POS [12] -> POS [45]',
                    '> CALIBRATING SUCCESS PROBABILITY... 89.4%',
                    '> [SUCCESS]: WEEKLY BRIDGE FOUND.',
                    '> SEARCH COMPLETE.'
                ],
                PHONG_AI: [
                    '> ROUTING WEEKLY SIGNALS TO CENTRAL AI...',
                    '> LINKING SPECIAL-WEEK MATRIX...',
                    '> TELEMETRY PIPE ESTABLISHED.',
                    '> CENTRAL BRAIN NOW CONTROLS THIS SPACE.'
                ],
                TRO_VE: [
                    '> INITIATING RETURN PROTOCOL...',
                    '> CLOSING WEEKLY ANALYSIS PIPE...',
                    '> SWITCHING BACK TO MB CORE...',
                    '> SYSTEM STANDBY.'
                ]
            };

            function setActive(mode) {
                zone.querySelectorAll('.termcmd-btn').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.mode === mode);
                });
            }

            function renderGrid() {
                const grid = zone.querySelector('#weekm-grid');
                const days = ['T.2','T.3','T.4','T.5','T.6','T.7','C.N'];
                let html = '';
                days.forEach(d => {
                    html += `<div class="matrixcell matrixhead">${d}</div>`;
                });

                for (let r = 1; r <= 200; r++) {
                    for (let c = 0; c < 7; c++) {
                        const rng = mulberry32(hashString(`WEEKM-${r}-${c}`));
                        const n1 = randomDigits(rng, 3);
                        const n2 = randomDigits(rng, 2);
                        html += `
                            <div class="matrixcell valid" data-week-row="${r}" data-week-col="${c}" data-tail="${n2}">
                                <div class="matrixnum"><span style="opacity:.4;font-size:10px">${n1}</span><span class="tail">${n2}</span></div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    }
                }
                grid.innerHTML = html;
            }

            async function run(mode) {
                setActive(mode);
                await typer.run(scripts[mode] || []);
                if (mode === 'PHONG_AI') {
                    setTimeout(() => centralAI.openWithPreset('đặc biệt tuần miền bắc'), 180);
                }
                if (mode === 'TRO_VE') {
                    setTimeout(() => updateStateMB('core'), 180);

                centralAI.telemetry('ĐB Tuần', `Đã chạy Terminal mode: ${mode}.`);

            zone.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const btn = e.target.closest('.termcmd-btn');

            centralAI.telemetry('ĐB Tuần', 'Đã gắn bảng Đặc Biệt Tuần + Terminal vào drawer-tuan-mb.');
            return { run };
        }

        function createYearModule(zoneId) {

                <div class="yearm-root">

                        <button class="termcmd-btn active" data-mode="SOI_CAU">

                    '> INITIALIZING YEARLY BRIDGE ENGINE...',
                    '> SCANNING 12-MONTH SPECIAL MATRIX...',
                    '> LOCATING RHYTHM RESONANCE...',
                    '> [SUCCESS]: YEARLY PATTERN CLUSTERED.'
                ],

                    '> LOADING 10-YEAR MEMORY INDEX...',
                    '> MATCHING SPECIAL TAIL OCCURRENCES...',
                    '> RESULT: HIGH RECURRENCE CORRIDOR FOUND.'
                ],
                THONG_KE: [
                    '> COMPILING 2026 SPECIAL STATISTICS...',
                    '> COUNTING HOT / COLD WINDOWS...',
                    '> EXPORTING YEARLY GRID METRICS... DONE.'
                ]
            };

            function setActive(mode) {
                zone.querySelectorAll('.termcmd-btn').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.mode === mode);
                });
            }

            function renderGrid() {
                const grid = zone.querySelector('#yearm-grid');
                const year = 2026;
                let html = `<div class="matrixcell matrixcorner">${year}</div>`;
                for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
                    html += `<div class="matrixcell matrixhead">T.${pad(m,2)}</div>`;
                }

                for (let d = 1; d <= 31; d++) {
                    html += `<div class="matrixcell matrixrowhead">N.${pad(d,2)}</div>`;
                    for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
                        const date = new Date(year, m - 1, d);
